aib-c01-d1-001@1.title: Separate the prediction operation from model updates
aib-c01-d1-001@1.prompt: The support department uses a model built from past churn results to calculate the churn probability of new customers each week. The executive in charge believes that every time the probability is calculated, the model learns from recent churn trends. The operations team has not set up automatic updates. How should this be explained to the executives?

A.text: Update the prediction file every week, and use the file update date in the model update record.
A.explanation: Saving the prediction results and updating the version of the model that generated the predictions are separate operations.

B.text: Treat the uncertain predicted value as the new correct answer, and reflect the latest solution in the next update.
B.explanation: It is impossible to confirm from the prediction values whether the subscription was actually canceled; continuing to use it would introduce errors of the existing model into the training.

C.text: The weekly calculation is an inference based on the existing model. The confirmed results are used for evaluation, and the model is updated via another learning and approval process as needed.
C.explanation: Just executing the prediction does not change the learned parameters of the model.

D.text: Since the probability varies per customer, it is assumed that the model was retrained using that customer’s information.
D.explanation: Even for the same model, predictions change depending on the differences in input. Value differences are not evidence of updates.

learning.concept: Inference during operation and model updates using confirmed new data are distinguished from each other.
learning.reason: In inference, a trained model is used to predict new inputs. To update the model based on recent results, the results must be confirmed and another learning/updating procedure including evaluation must be executed.

aib-c01-d1-002@1.title: Evaluate separately the prediction and the text for the responsible person
aib-c01-d1-002@1.prompt: For the retail business, I want to predict the next week’s demand by store, in numbers, and also create a document for the staff to explain the predicted and confirmed inventory data. It is necessary to verify both the accuracy of the predictions and the basis for the document. Which design is appropriate?

A.text: Create a standard text that aggregates past sales, and use the actual performance values as the forecast values for the following week.
A.explanation: Explaining what happened in the past does not verify the accuracy of predicting demand for the following week.

B.text: Use predictive AI to estimate demand, and use generated AI to create explanations based on the results and verified inventory information. Measure the prediction error and the basis of the text separately.
B.explanation: Numbers and text can be created using methods appropriate to the purpose, allowing for the identification of failed steps.

C.text: Have the generative AI generate a summary of numbers and reasons, and if the text is easy to read, it is considered to have accurate demand forecasting.
C.explanation: Readability does not indicate prediction errors or the accuracy of inventory information.

D.text: Only the prediction accuracy of the numbers is measured, and it is not verified whether the text description matches those numbers or inventory information.
D.explanation: Even if the numbers are correct, sometimes unsupported information is added to the description.

learning.concept: Select models based on purpose, and measure the precision of values and the basis for explanations independently.
learning.reason: There are different evaluation targets for numerical predictions and descriptions. Demand is calculated using a prediction model, and text is generated by a generative AI that inputs those predictions and verified evidence.

aib-c01-d1-003@1.title: Creating Learning Data from Attachments Linked to Cases
aib-c01-d1-003@1.prompt: The maintenance department wants to analyze a free-text PDF for the same case using a predefined case table. Since it serves as evidence for accident reports, the extracted content must be able to be compared with the original text later. Multiple cases can occur for the same equipment on the same day. Choose two appropriate actions as the first step to take.

A.text: If the number of cases in the table and the PDF is the same, arrange them by update date and time, then combine those with the same row number.
A.explanation: Arranging by update order does not guarantee correspondence between the documents, and there is a risk of mixing up cases on the same day.

B.text: Treat the free-text PDF as structured data with the same column structure as the case table, and skip verification of extraction.
B.explanation: How the text and tables are arranged in the PDF are independent of the column definitions in the case table.

C.text: Save only the extracted values and remove references to the original text.
C.explanation: It is impossible to identify the original PDF, and content cannot be compared during auditing.

D.text: Check the case ID in the case table and use the ID linked to the attachment to combine them.
D.explanation: Even if the equipment name and date are the same, using the case ID prevents mixing up different cases.

E.text: Treat the PDF as the extraction target for text, retain reference information from the document, and compare the extraction result with the original text.
E.explanation: The extracted content can later be verified to be based on the correct original text of the case.

learning.concept: Ensure the reliability of linking and the traceability of the extraction source when combining data with different structures.
learning.reason: The case table has predefined columns. The free-text data extracts text first, then maintains a stable case ID and reference information from the document, enabling verification and comparison of extracted values.

aib-c01-d1-004@1.title: Do not confuse unrecorded cases with no occurrences
aib-c01-d1-004@1.prompt: A pilot model predicts whether employees will drop out of a training program. Some branches record completion or dropout outcomes late. The data lead proposes labeling blank records as no dropout and using them for training. What should the business owner prioritize?

A.text: Replace all empty cells without leaving any blank, and add rows until the number of items per branch becomes similar.
A.explanation: Even when the quantities are consistent, inaccurate labels remain, leading to incorrect learning of the tendency for slow branches.

B.text: Fill in the blanks using the model's predicted values, and use the same data as the correct answer for prediction accuracy.
B.explanation: It is not verified with a separate correct answer, making it easy to miss errors.

C.text: All branches will uniformly exclude empty fields from learning, and branch-specific registration status will not be compared.
C.explanation: While errors in judging based on the correct answer can be avoided, it is not possible to confirm whether the evaluation is biased only on branches where results are easily registered.

D.text: Make unrecorded items independent, investigate registration delays by branch, and reconfigure learning and validation based on confirmed results.
D.explanation: Don’t confuse the fact that there were no results with not leaving out.

learning.concept: Distinguish between correct answers for yes/no questions and observations pending, and verify the quality of each collection path.
learning.reason: Unobserved results must be distinguished from confirmed negative labels. Even with a large number of inputs, if there are biases in label collection at locations or other places, the interpretation of results may be incorrect.

aib-c01-d1-005@1.title: Check if the history of the old system applies to the new target group
aib-c01-d1-005@1.prompt: At the local government consultation center, we are considering the trial implementation of a model for predicting re-visits to consultations. In past data from the center, only users with reservations were recorded. Starting next month, people without reservations will also be included. Random splitting of the old data resulted in high prediction accuracy. Which action is necessary for making a decision on expansion?

A.text: All new targets will be covered from the beginning, and only the overall average will be reported without distinguishing between booked and unbooked cases.
A.explanation: On average across all groups, failures in the newly targeted segments are less visible.

B.text: Create users without reservations by replicating existing reserved users, and verify accuracy by achieving the same results.
B.explanation: Since the results of the independent new group have not been observed, the actual performance is unknown.

C.text: Re-divide the old data with different random numbers, and apply the best evaluation to all users.
C.explanation: Repeating the segmentation will not increase the number of new groups that are targeted.

D.text: Collect results determined from a small test including the new target layer, verify performance based on whether reservations exist or not, and then decide the deployment scope.
D.explanation: It allows evaluation results to be available even for those not included in the history, so the basis for deployment can be verified.

learning.concept: If the target application changes, do not expand the scope by using only past random splits.
learning.reason: High ratings in past data serve as a basis for the group represented by those data. When a new target group was not included in the past, an evaluation using representative new data is required.

aib-c01-d1-006@1.title: Select a standard to refer to for continuous AI management
aib-c01-d1-006@1.prompt: A company has started using AI across multiple departments. The management team wants to establish a company-wide AI policy, responsible persons, and review procedures, and continue improving the management system even after implementation. Instead of specific model accuracy metrics, they want to refer to the requirements for the organization’s AI management system. Which standard is appropriate?

A.text: Refer to ISO/IEC 42001 to confirm the requirements for the organization’s AI management system.
A.explanation: Targeted at the organizational management system that a company builds and continuously improves.

B.text: Only refer to the concepts and terms of ISO/IEC 22989, without establishing responsible persons or review mechanisms.
B.explanation: The development of common terminology alone is not sufficient to define the system needed for effective management and continuous improvement.

C.text: Refer only to ISO/IEC 23053, treating the framework of machine learning systems as requirements for a company-wide management system.
C.explanation: The explanation of the framework for AI systems using machine learning and the requirements for an organization’s AI management system serve different purposes.

D.text: If internal standards are set for the model accuracy rate, they can be treated as requirements for the company’s AI management system.
D.explanation: Accuracy rate is an individual evaluation metric and cannot replace organizational policies or responsibility allocation.

learning.concept: Determine whether the target to be evaluated is an individual model or an organizational management system before selecting a standard.
learning.reason: ISO/IEC 42001 covers the requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving an organization’s AI management system.

aib-c01-d1-007@1.title: Define the scope of fixed rules and AI responsibilities
aib-c01-d1-007@1.prompt: In the billing department, the payment limit is defined in the contract, and the same limit must be applied to all inputs. However, in free-form emails from customers, the type of inquiry and required information do not follow a consistent format. Where can we prioritize the implementation of AI while maintaining explainable processing?

A.text: Only emails with a specific string in the subject line are targeted, excluding free-form emails for interpretation.
A.explanation: The judgment can be reproduced, but the real challenge remains for handling inputs with inconsistent representations.

B.text: Try using AI for the classification and information extraction of free-form emails, and apply existing fixed rules to the payment limits.
B.explanation: Automate the handling of diverse inputs while keeping the application of contract limits reproducible.

C.text: Both the limit check and email classification are assigned to the same prediction model, and if probabilities are added to the model output, the contract suitability is considered confirmed.
C.explanation: The probability of prediction shall not constitute evidence applied to the stated contract limit.

D.text: Let the payment limit be estimated by AI each time, and follow the most natural response without using contract rules.
D.explanation: Fails to meet the requirements for consistently applying a formalized limit.

learning.concept: Separate deterministic processing that cannot tolerate prediction uncertainty from processing that requires interpretation of diverse inputs.
learning.reason: The fixed upper limit determination can be replicated using known rules. For the classification and extraction of free-form inputs, AI is used, and a design that returns uncertain decisions to humans is appropriate.

aib-c01-d1-008@1.title: Choose an AI that handles verification and operations, and limit its permissions
aib-c01-d1-008@1.prompt: In the repair reception department, the staff reads the desired date and time of the client, checks available slots, and registers the reservation if the conditions are met. I would like to support this process with AI, but reservations that incur additional fees can only be approved by the staff member. Which design meets the requirements?

A.text: Create a notification saying the text generation tool is reserved without obtaining an empty slot, and the responsible person will verify it after sending.
A.explanation: The guidance may not be based on actual booking results, and there is a risk of confirming non-accepted times.

B.text: Predict the desired date and time based solely on past reservation history, and consider the registration valid without checking for available slots.
B.explanation: The prediction model output does not show current available slots or registration results.

C.text: Use an agent that can only perform query of available slots and registration within the conditions, and require approval from a staff member for registrations with additional fees in the business system.
C.explanation: Can act according to plans, and can control operations that must not be executed without approval.

D.text: Give the AI a common account that can be used for any reservation, and control the decision on additional fees solely through instructions.
D.explanation: Even if the instructions are not interpreted as expected, there is no mechanism in the business system to prevent operations.

learning.concept: Distinguish between supporting the creation of articles and supporting actual changes to external systems, and implement access controls for the latter.
learning.reason: The AI agent can obtain current information and perform authorized operations. Operations that require specific approval are controlled by the business system separately from the agent’s responses.

aib-c01-d1-009@1.title: Even while waiting for the results data, degradation was discovered
aib-c01-d1-009@1.prompt: We have deployed a model to predict logistics delay risks. The actual number of delays is determined after delivery completion, but with the increase in new products handled and changes in shipment information entered during prediction, the operation team wants to detect these changes early while avoiding incorrect retraining. Choose two appropriate actions.

A.text: When the input configuration changes, it is confirmed that the model has degraded, and the model is terminated without measurement.
A.explanation: The changes in input are worth investigating, but they do not confirm how much the prediction error has worsened.

B.text: When delivery results are available, link the predictions with actual performance, evaluate the error by category such as products, and determine whether updates are needed.
B.explanation: It can also be confirmed that the impact is concentrated on specific products, allowing for a basis for retraining.

C.text: Continuously monitor operational metrics to enable the start of investigations when input composition and missing values change from the baseline.
C.explanation: Even with uncertain performance records, it is possible to understand the changes in the data that should be investigated.

D.text: Using the latest prediction values as correct answers for automatic retraining, and not using delivery completion records in the evaluation.
D.explanation: The model output is considered to be the actual result, and there is a risk of maintaining existing errors.

E.text: No monitoring of input data until all records are available, and a judgment is made only at the quarter-end.
E.explanation: Problems that can be identified before confirmation are overlooked, delaying operational decisions.

learning.concept: Separate the early-available warning indicators from the business results used for performance validation.
learning.reason: The input distribution and missing data trends can be observed earlier than the final results. After validation, predictions are compared with actual performance to determine whether updates are needed.

aib-c01-d1-010@1.title: Reduce the use of unapproved AI and keep a path for trial
aib-c01-d1-010@1.prompt: Several departments are testing external AI services on their own because the tools look useful for their work. The information management team wants employees to be able to tell which tools are approved for work, which are still being evaluated, and how to submit a request. Some tools must not receive confidential information. Which approach is most appropriate?

A.text: Create a ledger that indicates approved, under evaluation, and unavailable states and allowed data. During evaluation, limit access to specified test environments and data, and specify the requester.
A.explanation: Employees can determine what is currently available, enabling safe trials and formal approvals.

B.text: Manage the approval status only by the Purchasing department, and let employees make individual decisions each time they look for a tool.
B.explanation: Information is fragmented by department, making it easy to make different choices for the same tool.

C.text: Prohibit use during evaluation, and do not provide a way for employees to submit requests for alternative tools.
C.explanation: This stops only trials with clear usage conditions, so the entry point for formal trials required by requirements cannot be created.

D.text: Automatically approve tools with many users, and limit the input of confidential information to be determined after starting use.
D.explanation: Popularity does not indicate data processing or contract conditions are secure.

learning.concept: Make the availability and data conditions of tools visible in a ledger, and provide a formal path for exceptions and evaluations.
learning.reason: Companies should clarify the status of tools, allowed uses, data that can be input, and responsible parties. During evaluation, use only approved trial data. A system where employees can verify and submit requests reduces informal use.

aib-c01-d1-011@1.title: In the summary of the minutes, distinguish between decisions and unresolved items
aib-c01-d1-011@1.prompt: The business representative wants to extract decisions and responsible persons from meeting notes in the same format. For items that were not decided or those without a responsible person, no plausible content should be added. Which is the most appropriate way to improve the request text?

A.text: Use only the information in the notes and define fields for decisions and responsible people. Include an example that labels the responsible person as “Unknown” when the notes do not identify them.
A.explanation: The basis and output format are clear, and an instruction to not fill in uncertain parts by guesswork is conveyed.

B.text: Instruct that all item columns must be filled, and when the responsible person is not specified, let them infer from past performance.
B.explanation: An unspecified person in charge may be presented as a determined individual.

C.text: “Summarize important things clearly” – just write that, and let the AI decide which fields are needed each time.
C.explanation: It may make it easier to read, but the output items and handling for unknown cases are not complete.

D.text: Fix the list of decisions as an exact copy, and ask to return that sentence exactly as it is every time.
D.explanation: The same format can be maintained, but results cannot be extracted from different notes each time.

learning.concept: Specify in the prompt how to handle items without a basis, not just the output structure.
learning.reason: It is expected to convey the desired results by specifying the basis for reference, output format, and handling in case of ambiguity. The expected format can also be illustrated without using real data.

aib-c01-d1-012@1.title: When handling long documents, ensure the required space for the response
aib-c01-d1-012@1.prompt: When using generative AI for document comparisons in a proposal, the request could not be processed only after adding the document. The model shares the same context limit for input and output, and the input alone approaches this limit. Excluding unnecessary appendices during comparison is allowed. Which action is appropriate?

A.text: Send documents of the same length multiple times, and only adopt the response when all are accepted.
A.explanation: The cause of exceeding the limit remains unchanged, and rerunning alone cannot improve the situation.

B.text: Keep all documents in input and only increase the output limit.
B.explanation: There is no room to stay within the shared limit, and not all necessary processing may succeed.

C.text: Prioritize the sections related to the comparison, shorten the input, reserve the space needed for output, and then verify the result.
C.explanation: No space is consumed by unnecessary appendices, allowing both the necessary basis and a sufficient response to be included.

D.text: Manually delete only the last part of the document, without checking whether important comparison criteria are included.
D.explanation: Even if it fits within the limit, omitting necessary bases and conditions may lead to incorrect judgments.

learning.concept: Select highly relevant inputs and leave space for an output that fits within the same limit.
learning.reason: In a configuration where the context limit is shared, both inputs containing bases and outputs for responses need to fit within it. Prioritize related documents and ensure the required space for the desired response.

aib-c01-d1-013@1.title: Separating frequently changing business information from output formats
aib-c01-d1-013@1.prompt: The employee assistant answers questions about internal shipping conditions and exceptions. Business regulations are updated weekly, and it is necessary to verify the relevant regulations as the source of the response. The style of the response is already satisfactory. Which approach is appropriate?

A.text: Choose retrieval-augmented generation, which searches for approved regulations and uses relevant references and sources when providing answers.
A.explanation: The latest basis can be reflected in the search criteria, and the regulations that form the basis of the response can be confirmed.

B.text: Show only answers where the model shows confidence, without presenting the associated regulations as a source.
B.explanation: Confidence does not serve as evidence that the response is based on approved documents.

C.text: Perform one additional training using old regulation examples, and do not reflect subsequent regulation updates in the model.
C.explanation: When asked about updated rules, the model cannot obtain the information it should refer to.

D.text: Perform extensive additional training with past texts to standardize the style, and store the latest regulations separately from training and search data.
D.explanation: Even if the style is consistent, there is no way to use the latest regulations as a basis.

learning.concept: If frequent fact updates and source verification are required, choose a design that searches for approved information during response.
learning.reason: In retrieval-augmented generation, updated approved materials can serve as a basis for responses. Training to change the model’s style cannot automatically ensure the latest information and its source.

aib-c01-d1-014@1.title: Match the meaning of learning labels between the old and new systems
aib-c01-d1-014@1.prompt: The logistics department is considering automated determination for returns from sales stores. Under the old system, “return acceptance” included temporary suspension, while under the new system it refers only to final approval. The column names for past data remain the same, and there are no missing values in all cases. What should be done first to teach the staff what “final approval” means under the new system?

A.text: Write the prediction results of the new model as correct answers for old cases with uncertain judgments, and measure the accuracy for the same cases.
A.explanation: Unable to verify the actual final judgment, the prediction is treated as correct.

B.text: Define the target labels for the new system. Only old cases with final judgment records will be reclassified under the same definition, while those that cannot be judged will be distinguished.
B.explanation: This prevents mixing different business decisions into the same label due to identical column names.

C.text: Maintain the definition of the large number of items under the old system, and the goal of the new system is to make changes after the model is released.
C.explanation: The learning target does not align with current business decisions, and the meaning of the initial evaluation becomes ambiguous.

D.text: Since the column name and value types are the same, all old labels are replaced with the new system’s final approved version.
D.explanation: In type matching, it is not possible to distinguish between temporary suspension and final approval under the old system.

learning.concept: Not only for missing labels, but also to verify whether the recorded judgment has the same meaning across different periods.
learning.reason: Even for labels with the same name, if their business meanings differ, they cannot be directly combined. Define the goals of the new system and align only the well-supported historical records.

aib-c01-d1-015@1.title: A reason that can be predicted even for unprecedented applications
aib-c01-d1-015@1.prompt: A logistics company predicts potential delays in shipments by inputting delivery distance, shipping day, and load factor. In a new delivery route at one branch, this combination of input values has never occurred before. The staff believes the model cannot make a prediction because there are no previous records that match exactly. Which statement most accurately describes how the model works?

A.text: To return a prediction, it is necessary to add rows from the new route with the same input values so they can be referenced in future training.
A.explanation: The performance data for the new route is useful for validation and subsequent training, but it is not a requirement for the existing model to return a prediction.

B.text: As long as each input value falls within its range, the same accuracy as the existing route can be achieved regardless of the combination.
B.explanation: Even if individual values are within their ranges, accuracy may vary depending on the combination and surrounding conditions.

C.text: The relationship between features learned from past data and delays can be applied to new inputs for prediction.
C.explanation: Unlike exact match searches, the learned relationships can be applied to new inputs.

D.text: When no combination has occurred yet, the impact of each input factor is evenly averaged to use as an alternative to the model's prediction.
D.explanation: The strength of the relationships learned may vary by input factor, so there is no basis for replacing the existing model with a simple average.

learning.concept: Inference of a trained model differs from exact match searches as it applies learned relationships to unseen feature combinations
learning.reason: In the learning of prediction methods, the relationship between past features and outcomes is reflected in the model. Even without previous matching records, it can be applied to new inputs. The accuracy under untested conditions can be verified using representative validation data.

aib-c01-d1-016@1.title: Identify trends in inquiries that cannot be captured by existing classification tables
aib-c01-d1-016@1.prompt: The service department of the manufacturing industry received tens of thousands of free-text inquiries regarding new products. They discovered new complaints that cannot be categorized under existing categories, and the staff want to read representative examples to determine the appropriate category names. There are still no data with known category names marked as correct answers. Which is the most appropriate initial analysis?

A.text: Generate responses to each inquiry, and estimate unknown complaints based on the proportion of responses adopted by the responsible person.
A.explanation: Since the adoption rate of the response proposal also reflects factors such as ease of use, it is not possible to organize the actual inquiry topics.

B.text: Predict the total number of inquiries by product over time, and treat the difference between prediction and actuals as a new reason for inquiries.
B.explanation: Just the difference in quantities does not allow for obtaining the inquiry content or new categories.

C.text: Train the classifier using existing categories, and identify the content of new complaints based on the changes in the number of items for each classification category.
C.explanation: The changes in the number of items indicate variations within existing categories, but the content of new complaints cannot be distinguished.

D.text: Unlabeledly group inquiries with similar textual meaning, and experts investigate representative examples in each group to define candidate categories.
D.explanation: Explore undefined categories, and human beings can later assign meaningful labels to them.

learning.concept: In the exploration phase where correct labels cannot be prepared first, unsupervised learning clustering is used, allowing people to interpret the groups
learning.reason: Without a teacher learning clustering does not require known correct categories and creates candidate groups based on text similarities. Through examination of representative examples, it is confirmed whether the categories reflect actual operational differences.

aib-c01-d1-017@1.title: To align the meanings of items with the same name in business events
aib-c01-d1-017@1.prompt: A retail chain integrates inventory events for old and new versions for demand forecasting. Both have quantity fields in JSON, but the old version records transaction quantities including returns, while the new version records changes in quantities available for sale at stores. Records of return categories and sales eligibility remain in the old version. How should we pass the same quantity meaning to the model?

A.text: Assign the average quantity of stores using the new version to stores of the same size in the old version, excluding records of return categories.
A.explanation: Replacing with average store quantities loses actual transaction changes and discards available return information.

B.text: Keep the recorded version of the event, map from return categories and sales eligibility to changes in available quantities, and then integrate both.
B.explanation: The saved items can represent the same business event, and the transformation can be traced back to the recorded version.

C.text: Link both quantities to the same item, and add the version number as an input to let the model determine the difference in meaning.
C.explanation: Even with the version number as an input, different business definitions do not result in the same quantity.

D.text: Standardize the quantities as numeric, add missing values as zero, and then compare existing quantity fields directly.
D.explanation: Even with numeric standardization, the condition for including returns in quantities is not met.

learning.concept: Do not integrate semi-structured events with different meanings per version based solely on the type, but convert them to a common definition and retain the source.
learning.reason: Not all items with the same name in JSON have the same meaning. Verify the differences based on the recorded version and how returns are handled, convert saved items to changes in available quantities, and then use them for prediction.

aib-c01-d1-018@1.title: Investigate why re-delivery records distort the evaluation of predictions
aib-c01-d1-018@1.prompt: The travel agency is evaluating a prediction model for cancellation cancellations. If a confirmation receipt is not returned due to a failure, the same booking event will be resent. Each row has a unique receipt number, but for resends of the same event, the booking event ID is common, while the actual update ID is different. The evaluation based on message units has lower accuracy in real use. What is the first data improvement measure that should be taken?

A.text: Aggregate the resend requests into one event using the original reservation event ID, and recreate the training and evaluation sets so that the same event does not appear in both.
A.explanation: Using independent events as units, eliminating bias in multiple copies and duplication in learning and evaluation.

B.text: For all reservation IDs, only the first event received will be retained, and any actual changes will also be deleted in the same manner.
B.explanation: It is better to use an ID that can identify the original event, as different change events are lost when using the reservation ID.

C.text: For rows with the same reservation event ID but different receipt times, they are retained as additional observations and allocated an extra amount to the evaluation side.
C.explanation: By treating the resend as a separate reservation event, bias in weights and overvaluation remain.

D.text: After confirming that the reception numbers in each row are unique, divide them into training and evaluation sets with equal cancellation ratios.
D.explanation: The uniqueness of the received number does not indicate that the original event is different, and the resend fits into both sets.

learning.concept: Identify retransmissions from the same business event before learning, to prevent double counting and avoid gaps in learning and evaluation
learning.reason: When the re-execution of learned events is also included in the evaluation, performance can be overrated for events that were not observed. Using a reserved event ID to group copies of the same event helps prevent improper weighting.

aib-c01-d1-019@1.title: Observe results even from low-priority projects
aib-c01-d1-019@1.prompt: The equipment maintenance company prioritizes abnormal reports based on the model. Currently, only high-priority reports are verified by experts to record whether actual abnormalities exist or not. After six months, the number of missed cases recorded has decreased, but low-priority reports have been almost completely ignored. What is the best approach for the operation team to measure the tendency of missed reports?

A.text: Reduce the need for expert verification, and monitor only the input values and priority distribution of the population to quantify the missed rate.
A.explanation: Predictions and input distributions may indicate signs of change, but without actual performance data, the false positive rate cannot be measured.

B.text: Sample extraction is performed based on low priority, week or equipment categories, and continuous measurement of missed cases is conducted using abnormal records verified by experts.
B.explanation: To assign results to the group whose model was poorly evaluated, unbiased estimation of omissions becomes possible.

C.text: Treat the classification to low priority as no abnormal results, and verify the accuracy after reclassifying based on that.
C.explanation: If the model output is treated as the correct answer, we cannot measure the phenomena the model missed.

D.text: Divide the number of high-priority items with anomalies by the total number of reports; if the ratio remains stable, it is determined that missed cases are also stable.
D.explanation: No low-priority anomalies that have not been actually confirmed are present in the molecule.

learning.concept: If cases where results are recorded through AI filtering become biased, low-priority items should also be considered for representative verification, and false exclusions should continue to be monitored.
learning.reason: Since the confirmed cases depend on model judgment, only confirmed cases cannot reveal low-priority omissions. Even for low-priority cases, observations that maintain representativeness should continue, and they should be evaluated against the pre-selection population.

aib-c01-d1-020@1.title: Compare prompt revisions in unused cases
aib-c01-d1-020@1.prompt: The welfare and benefits desk revised the prompt for the generative AI that creates responses from internal regulations. The development team repeatedly adjusted the instructions to explain exceptions in the regulations while considering 20 items that can cause confusion. Even those not directly involved want to determine whether the old or new version is better suited for actual inquiries. Which validation method is most appropriate?

A.text: The old case is evaluated as a regular inquiry, while the new case is evaluated as an exception-inclusive inquiry, and the total scores of each review reviewer are compared.
A.explanation: If the difficulty of the evaluation inquiries varies, the difference in results cannot be interpreted as an effect of the revision.

B.text: Replace the AI model and random number settings with those different from during development, then execute the new design, and measure the difference from the scores of the previously reported old design.
B.explanation: Since the model and execution conditions have also changed, it is not possible to identify the differences caused by the prompt revision.

C.text: Apply both proposals to representative query groups that are not used for adjustments, and compare compliance with regulations and justifications using a common criterion.
C.explanation: By comparing under the same unused cases and same criteria, it is easier to determine the improvements expected from operations.

D.text: Compare the success rates of the 20 adjustments used, and report the growth in improved cases as the overall effectiveness of the operation.
D.explanation: Since the instructions match those 20 items, it is not possible to evaluate improvements for unknown inquiries during adoption.

learning.concept: Separate the examples of prompt adjustment from the unknown cases for adoption judgment, and compare the old and new versions using the same evaluation criteria
learning.reason: It is unclear whether improvements made in the revised problems are sufficient to address unaddressed issues. An example isolated from prompt adjustment is where the old version and new version are run under the same conditions and compared using common criteria.

aib-c01-d1-021@1.title: Adapting a consistent editing policy to the model
aib-c01-d1-021@1.prompt: The technical communications team uses a generative AI to create product announcements based on facts provided by the responsible person. While the output can be consistent with the facts, the tone and expression choices defined by the approved editing policy cannot meet the review standards even after adjusting instructions and a few examples. The editing policy is stable, and there are thousands of approved input-output pairs. Which of the following is the most appropriate test?

A.text: Try retrieval-augmented generation by adding the latest product materials to each input, and compare the accuracy rate of product names in the announcements.
A.explanation: The necessary facts are included in the input, and the accuracy rate of product names cannot evaluate the use of the editing policy.

B.text: Learn from all approved cases and determine the publication based on the similarity between the re-generated text and the original announcement for the same case.
B.explanation: By performing learning and evaluation on the same cases, it is impossible to judge the quality and retention of facts for the first announcement.

C.text: Reduce randomness during generation, measure the proportion of similar tones when the same input is used, and use it as an adaptation rate to the editing policy.
C.explanation: Even if the same tone is output, it is not guaranteed that this tone fits the editing policy of each announcement.

D.text: Try supervised fine-tuning on some approved input-output pairs, and compare the adaptation to the editing policy and fidelity to facts in the remaining cases.
D.explanation: Adapt it to cases containing the expected judgment, and simultaneously verify the effectiveness against unknown inputs while maintaining existing capabilities.

learning.concept: If the effect of instructions and examples is limited, train the stable editing judgment using supervised fine-tuning, and check improvements and side effects in unused cases
learning.reason: We want to stabilize the editing judgment when creating announcements from input, rather than updating the provided facts. Adjust the model using approved input-output examples, and compare the adaptation to the editing policy and fidelity to facts in cases not used for learning with the existing method.

aib-c01-d2-001@1.title: Choose a strategy that addresses the bottleneck in return processing
aib-c01-d2-001@1.prompt: The e-commerce company wants to improve the proportion of first-response returns within the next day. Analysis shows that the main cause of delays was the time required for staff to check each product’s approved return policy after obtaining order information. The policies are searchable, and exception handling is still determined by the staff. Which strategy should be tried first?

A.text: Estimate orders that are likely to be returned based on pre-query viewing behavior, with accuracy as the top priority.
A.explanation: Improvement in prediction and improvement in first-response time for returned requests are separate issues.

B.text: Show the location of the policy corresponding to the order and product, then create a response for the staff. Track the response rate and quality within the next day.
B.explanation: Shorten the process that causes delays, and verify whether it aligns with the policy.

C.text: Predict the total number of returns and evaluate strategies based on monthly prediction errors.
C.explanation: It can be used for staffing planning, but it cannot measure improvements in the already identified policy search process.

D.text: Publish a summary of product reviews and determine the effectiveness of return processing based on page viewing time.
D.explanation: It may improve purchasing information, but it is not linked to the staff’s time spent checking policies.

learning.concept: Identify business processes that affect key KPIs and link them to AI capabilities and available data
learning.reason: The delayed process is the verification of policies. Show the relevant section and response to the staff, and measure effectiveness based on processing time including verification and response rate within the next day.

aib-c01-d2-002@1.title: Choose a procurement method that meets the deadline and withdrawal conditions
aib-c01-d2-002@1.prompt: The wholesale company wants to support the confidentiality-bound contract summary within 5 months. There are business specialists in the company, but no personnel responsible for model operations. It is essential that data cannot be exported outside the designated region, and evaluation data and settings can be extracted in a form that allows migration at contract termination. Which of the proposals is the best?

A.text: Sign a contract with partners who can start in 2 months. We will protect the region, but the expenditure conditions will be negotiated just before the contract expires.
A.explanation: The required requirements cannot be secured before the contract is signed due to fulfillment.

B.text: Develop the implementation in-house and manage region and portability. It takes 8 months for necessary recruitment and infrastructure preparation.
B.explanation: The scope of in-house management is an advantage, but it does not match the current capabilities and implementation deadline.

C.text: For suppliers available within 4 months, require regional processing, deletion, and standard-form transfer in the contract, and decide on acceptance or rejection based on trial results.
C.explanation: It can evaluate deadlines, control, and continuity simultaneously.

D.text: Available in 3 months, choose the cheapest subscription. Some data is processed outside the specified region, and settings cannot be exported.
D.explanation: Time and cost are advantageous, but they do not meet two essential conditions.

learning.concept: Make data constraints and transitionability essential conditions, and compare contracts including delivery deadlines, costs, and in-house capabilities
learning.reason: Among the proposals that meet the delivery deadline, select those where the regional, deletion, and migration requirements are specified in the contract, and whose quality can be measured through validation close to real data.

aib-c01-d2-003@1.title: Choose between expanding, suspending, or terminating AI initiatives
aib-c01-d2-003@1.prompt: Non-profit organizations are reviewing three trials. Maintenance plan support aims to reduce the downtime for major failures, and there are operators involved. Payment consultation support is expected to be valuable, but data cannot be used until the required consent is obtained. Public relations image generation has shortened the creation time, but the target project will be discontinued. How should the organization allocate its limited budget?

A.text: Expand the conservation plan, defer payment consultation pending re-evaluation of consent, and complete the trial of the public relations image.
A.explanation: The outcomes, constraints, and strategies are individually reflected in alignment.

B.text: Expand payment discussions, and postpone the maintenance plan. The public relations image will continue to be maintained to recover already spent costs.
B.explanation: Cannot zoom before agreeing, and past expenditures are not a basis for future value.

C.text: Convert the accuracy metrics of the three policies to the same scale, and consolidate the next-period budget into the policy with the highest accuracy.
C.explanation: Accuracy does not reflect business value, data constraints, or the survival of the target business.

D.text: Deploy the public relations image first, and hold back the remaining two measures until the operational load decreases.
D.explanation: Even if it can be deployed quickly, it is difficult to obtain continued value for the discontinued project.

learning.concept: Do not allocate resources based on a single precision or past investment; instead, decide expansion, retention, and termination based on outcomes, constraints, and strategy alignment
learning.reason: Expand policies with practical value and operational feasibility, defer policies with resolvable assumptions after a deadline, and terminate policies that have lost their target projects.

aib-c01-d2-004@1.title: Choose the improvement measures suitable for the source of the failure
aib-c01-d2-004@1.prompt: In the beverage factory, all cases of poor packaging occur repeatedly at specific positions of old-type fixtures. A comparative test using replacement fixtures under the same conditions eliminated the defects. The total replacement cost is half of the implementation cost for image recognition, and the goal is to reduce defect occurrence rather than the number of detections before shipping. Which measure is recommended?

A.text: Replace the fixtures in sequence, and measure the defect rate using the same criteria as before to confirm.
A.explanation: Directly address the causes and verify the effect on target metrics.

B.text: Rewritten visual inspection procedures using generative AI, and manufacturing quality is determined by the implementation rate of inspectors.
B.explanation: The implementation rate of the steps does not eliminate the cause of poor packaging.

C.text: Introduce image classification to determine target achievement based on the detection rate of discarded defective products.
C.explanation: The detection rate does not indicate an improvement in the occurrence rate.

D.text: Predict the downtime period and continue operating with only the old fixtures. On the day the prediction is correct, increase inspections.
D.explanation: The reason is known; continuing to use the old fixtures will cause defects.

learning.concept: If the physical cause at the site has been identified, modify the process itself before using AI to accelerate the discovery.
learning.reason: The cause and exchange effect were confirmed, and the exchange directly acts on the source. Image recognition can be used for detection, but there is no effect in removing the cause under these conditions.

aib-c01-d2-005@1.title: Compare AI infrastructure transitions without halting operations
aib-c01-d2-005@1.prompt: The delivery company moves the receipt reading to another AI infrastructure. During peak periods, operations cannot be stopped, and duplicate receipts cause incorrect payment amounts. We want to switch based on actual business conditions, including misreading and response delays on the new infrastructure. Choose two appropriate preparations.

A.text: If cost reduction is significant, proceed with the transition; collect peak period delay data only after stable operation.
A.explanation: The capabilities required during peak periods cannot be used in the transition decision.

B.text: Process the same receipts on the new infrastructure but do not register them, then compare errors and delays by condition.
B.explanation: Comparisons can be made using actual inputs, preventing duplicate registrations.

C.text: Determine one infrastructure for registration at each stage of the phased transition and practice returning to previous state if quality or delays exceed thresholds.
C.explanation: By assigning responsibility to one entity, the impact on operations can be minimized.

D.text: Write both old and new results into production records, then analyze the difference at month-end to cancel unnecessary registrations.
D.explanation: This does not meet the requirement to prevent double counting in payments.

E.text: Test the new infrastructure only with properly structured receipts, then compare all old infrastructure receipts and overall average.
E.explanation: Due to different input difficulty, it is difficult to distinguish differences between infrastructures.

learning.concept: Maintain a single final process, enable shadow comparison of old and new outputs, and set return conditions
learning.reason: The output of the new infrastructure is not used for final decisions; compare quality and delays using the same approved input. Continue phased transition while keeping one final destination, and define the return threshold and steps.

aib-c01-d2-006@1.title: Measure both the improvement in one-time resolution and the resolution quality simultaneously
aib-c01-d2-006@1.prompt: The public transportation inquiry department wants to use support AI to reduce users who contact multiple times for the same fare inquiry. We want to avoid apparent improvements in metrics by quickly closing chat conversations. What is the combination of core KPIs and prevention-of-degradation metrics?

A.text: Use the share of cases without repeat contact about the same issue within a set period as the main metric. Use the rate of incorrect guidance and satisfaction with the resolution as safeguards.
A.explanation: We can confirm whether the decrease in follow-up contacts is merely an end by using quality metrics.

B.text: CNUC aims to prevent deterioration by maintaining the monthly usage fee due to a decrease in total reception numbers.
B.explanation: It cannot be distinguished between seasonal fluctuations and a decline in access to the reception.

C.text: The duration of the session is used to determine the length of the generated response text for preventing deterioration.
C.explanation: The end time and word count do not measure whether the discussion was properly resolved.

D.text: Use the number of times the support AI is invoked as the primary KPI and the percentage of staff who use it as the safeguard metric.
D.explanation: All are measured in the amount of use and activity, not in consultation resolution or incorrect guidance.

learning.concept: Define business outcomes through actual measurements, and monitor the deterioration of customer experience via corresponding KPIs
learning.reason: Measure the immediate resolution by following up on recontacts for the same item, and identify quality degradation through the audit rate of misdirection and users' resolution experience.

aib-c01-d2-007@1.title: Secure the evaluation criteria values before the busy period changes
aib-c01-d2-007@1.prompt: The travel agency will trial introducing reservation change support in spring. In summer, requests will increase rapidly, and the structure of requests along with partner airlines will also change. The department head wants to explain the improvement in processing time as an effect of AI. What should be done before implementation?

A.text: Compare all sites to the average time of the site where improvements were the greatest after implementation, serving as the reference value.
A.explanation: Post-hoc selection of reference values distorts comparisons and does not reflect the unadopted state.

B.text: Based on the processing time of other departments within the same travel agency, booking changes will be recorded after implementation.
B.explanation: Unable to separate the differences in business processes, no measurements were taken for the target processes before implementation.

C.text: Only use the company average before implementation and the company average the following summer, and consider the one with more cases as a high-precision comparison.
C.explanation: The impact of different seasons and structures of cases remains intact.

D.text: From before implementation, process times are measured by the same standard per project, and during phased implementation, unimplemented groups similar to the target group are tracked over the same period.
D.explanation: When evaluating the difference, factors such as season, task difficulty, and reference values can be considered.

learning.concept: First, fix the possible business units and measurement criteria, then design comparisons that can distinguish between seasonal and difficulty variations
learning.reason: To mitigate the impact of season and project composition, define processing time and targets first, and ensure a comparison group that continues operations under similar conditions.

aib-c01-d2-008@1.title: Converting Sales Growth into Profit to Calculate ROI
aib-c01-d2-008@1.prompt: In the first year of the corporate estimation support AI, external labor reduction achieved a result of 4.2 million yen, additional sales reached 8 million yen, and the marginal profit margin for additional sales was 25%. Only in the first year were implementation and training costs of 1.5 million yen, and operation and quality verification costs of 2.5 million yen incurred. Other expenses were not double-counted. If ROI is defined as (additional benefit - additional cost) ÷ additional cost, what is the value for the first year?

A.text: 205%. Add the full amount of additional sales of 8 million yen and the external labor reduction of 4.2 million yen to the benefit, then subtract the cost of 4 million yen.
A.explanation: It is necessary to use the marginal profit of 2 million yen after deducting additional costs from sales.

B.text: 55%. Convert additional sales into marginal profit, combine it with external labor reduction, then subtract implementation and operation costs and divide by the cost.
B.explanation: All additional benefits and costs are included in the specified ROI formula.

C.text: 148%. Exclude the implementation cost of 1.5 million yen and include only the operation cost of 2.5 million yen as investment costs.
C.explanation: The implementation and training costs in the first year are also additional costs due to the initiative.

D.text: 155%. Divide the benefit of 6.2 million yen by the cost of 4 million yen.
D.explanation: This is a benefit-cost ratio without using net benefit, which is 100 points higher than the given ROI.

learning.concept: Convert additional sales into marginal profit, and calculate ROI using achieved labor reduction and all additional costs.
learning.reason: Incremental benefits: JPY 4,200,000 + (JPY 8,000,000 × 25%) = JPY 6,200,000. Costs: JPY 1,500,000 + JPY 2,500,000 = JPY 4,000,000. Net benefit: JPY 2,200,000. Return on investment: JPY 2,200,000 ÷ JPY 4,000,000 = 55%.

aib-c01-d2-009@1.title: Detect signs of habituation during the initial adoption phase
aib-c01-d2-009@1.prompt: We have started testing an AI to assist in finding damage assessment data. The processing days for the final indicators will not be determined until 6 weeks after the case is closed. The conditions of the target cases can be recorded. In the first 2 weeks, which is the most appropriate as a predictive indicator for future stability?

A.text: Among the target cases, the proportion of staff who used support in actual business operations during the following week after completing their first trial use.
A.explanation: A leading indicator that combines applicable denominators and reusability.

B.text: Percentage of staff who logged in to the device on the first day of training.
B.explanation: We can understand the fact of participation, but we fail to capture the signs used in actual projects afterward.

C.text: Total tokens used by the AI support.
C.explanation: Due to the large use in a few cases, it is difficult to show its establishment at the field level.

D.text: Profit per assessment item for the entire company at the financial reporting date.
D.explanation: As a delay indicator for business results, it is not enough to get a 2-week lead.

learning.concept: Show business establishment earlier than the final result, observe repeated use with the target project as the denominator
learning.reason: Among the business-usable cases, by tracking the proportion of those used voluntarily by the responsible person even after the initial session, it is easier to determine adoption compared to temporary training or login counts.

aib-c01-d2-010@1.title: Maintaining quality while reducing inference costs
aib-c01-d2-010@1.prompt: In the human resources document classification process, 80% of tasks are standard forms, and 20% are complex requests that require free-text input. During testing, the small model meets the quality threshold only for standard forms, while the large model meets it for both. Choose two measures to reduce costs without increasing the number of missed complex requests.

A.text: Switch all tasks to the small model and determine cost savings based solely on token price without monitoring results.
A.explanation: Complex tasks fail to meet the quality threshold.

B.text: Select the model with the lowest monthly cost regardless of processing type, and consider quality deviations when the number of responses decreases.
B.explanation: The number of responses cannot be used to identify missed tasks or classification quality issues.

C.text: Separate standard forms and complex requests based on initial criteria: assign standard tasks to the small model, and complex or unknown-form tasks to the large model.
C.explanation: A low-cost path can be used within the evaluated quality range.

D.text: Shorten the input length of all requests to the same value and measure costs only for the large model.
D.explanation: Important parts of the text may be lost, making it impossible to ensure quality is maintained.

E.text: Compare the acceptance quality per task type with the cost per completed task including re-experiments and manual verification.
E.explanation: It is possible for cost reductions to be offset by additional work.

learning.concept: Select the lowest-cost path that meets requirements for representative tasks, and monitor the cost per task including re-processing and manual work
learning.reason: If tasks can be identified as standard or complex at the start, they are assigned to models that meet quality requirements. The total cost, including re-experiments and manual corrections, is compared based on the accepted output units.

aib-c01-d2-011@1.title: Compare competing AI features as a customer selection criterion
aib-c01-d2-011@1.prompt: In B2B delivery companies, it was mentioned as a reason for delays that it takes several hours to provide individual delay explanations through bidding. Competitors promote generative AI chat, but do not disclose the accuracy of the explanations or the time required for customer verification. Which survey is most helpful for making investment decisions?

A.text: Buy the model with the highest score in general benchmarks, and also consider it superior in bidding explanation quality.
A.explanation: It is uncertain whether the general-purpose performance will give customers a competitive edge in their operations.

B.text: By aggregating the number of AI features listed on competing sites, it is determined that achieving the same number of features can reduce losses.
B.explanation: The number of features does not indicate the speed or accuracy of the explanation.

C.text: Use competing advertising costs as a benchmark for its own AI development expenses, and conduct customer validation after implementation.
C.explanation: It is impossible to estimate the development scale or customer ratings from advertising costs.

D.text: Confirm the selection criteria with lost customers, and compare the time required for accurate explanations to representative inquiries with our own tests and observable competitor performance.
D.explanation: Specific selection reasons can be reflected in the performance metrics.

learning.concept: Evaluate the difference between what customers choose and what your company can offer, not the number of competing product features.
learning.reason: What matters for differentiation is not the names of competitors’ features, but how well a company can improve the results that customers value. Based on contract terms and actual operation, test the quality and speed of explanation.

aib-c01-d2-012@1.title: Test whether we can transition from selling products to a business that sells operational results
aib-c01-d2-012@1.prompt: Machine manufacturers are now able to predict the risk of downtime for installed equipment early on. Customers prioritize operating hours over additional purchases of machines, and manufacturers are exploring new ongoing revenue sources. Which is the most appropriate way to validate the business model?

A.text: Distribute the prediction results to the manufacturing department to see if the assembly time of existing machines can be reduced.
A.explanation: It is about internal efficiency, not the verification of the revenue structure for operational results.

B.text: Add fault data to promotional materials, and measure the number of views on the materials using traditional equipment sales.
B.explanation: An improvement in previous sales, but no verification of the willingness to pay for ongoing income.

C.text: If the prediction accuracy of failure probability is high, a uniform operation guarantee will be applied to all customers without trial contracts.
C.explanation: The repair system, warranty costs, and the price customers pay have not been confirmed.

D.text: Test the maintenance contract including representative customers and operational targets, and measure payment willingness, on-site response costs, coverage scope, and operational performance.
D.explanation: Value offering, pricing, and responsibilities can be verified under actual conditions.

learning.concept: Utilize the operational capabilities created by AI to evaluate changes in value, pricing structure, and delivery responsibilities for customers
learning.reason: By providing a small-scale service that maintains operations using signals, it is possible to assess the willingness to pay for results, service costs, and scope of responsibility, thereby determining the feasibility of a new revenue model.

aib-c01-d2-013@1.title: Even in commercial models, a long-term advantage can be built up.
aib-c01-d2-013@1.prompt: The equipment repair provider uses a versatile model that can be purchased by competitors as well. They have approved records linking the cause of repairs to subsequent recurrence, verification procedures for skilled personnel, and long-term contracts by region. What is the strategy to create a strength that is difficult to replicate, in addition to reducing single-time work hours?

A.text: The number of responses in the first month of implementation will be used as the difference from competitors; subsequent quality records will be discontinued to avoid workload.
A.explanation: The number of responses does not indicate the success in preventing recurrence, and it is also impossible to measure the maintenance of the gap.

B.text: Reflect approved repairs and expert corrections in a re-evaluation, while improving recurrence rates and developing operations and knowledge.
B.explanation: Unique data and operational capabilities lead to continuous improvement.

C.text: Fix the best practices across regions once during implementation, and stop updating them in the future so they don’t need to be changed by region.
C.explanation: Unable to keep up with regional differences and changes in failure patterns.

D.text: By signing a contract for the largest general-purpose model at this point, we expect the performance gap to be fixed before competitors use the same model.
D.explanation: It is possible to procure the same model, without accumulating unique operational advantages.

learning.concept: Leverage continuously updated proprietary business knowledge and approved evaluation feedback
learning.reason: By utilizing tracking results that are only available within the company, we can drive evaluation and operational improvement, and accumulate application conditions for each deployment as knowledge—this could create a sustainable advantage.

aib-c01-d2-014@1.title: Phased investment in markets with low maturity
aib-c01-d2-014@1.prompt: There is growing interest in using AI in local water supply inspection services, but customer payment amounts, compatibility with target equipment, and regional procurement rules are still unclear. Existing service contracts are stable, and results of the pilot program will be available in six months. How should AI investments be structured appropriately?

A.text: Treat the number of competing marketing posts as demand, and transfer the renewal budget for existing contracts to AI without verification.
A.explanation: Public relations figures are not a basis for customers' payment intentions or actual usage.

B.text: Since existing services are profitable, we will not investigate customer requests or trial results until procurement rules are unified across all regions.
B.explanation: Postpone the learning from the market that can be gained with low burden.

C.text: A small paid trial is conducted with a representative customer. The next budget will be reviewed when payment willingness, on-site results, and procurement conditions meet the criteria.
C.explanation: Reduce the three major uncertainties first.

D.text: To secure first-mover benefits, a long-term facility contract is signed for the entire country, and the acceptance rate is measured after the contract is signed.
D.explanation: It incurs irreversible costs due to significant uncertainties regarding the market and systems.

learning.concept: In line with market adoption, price, and regulatory uncertainties, small reversible investments are made with the following conditions
learning.reason: By evaluating demand, feasibility, and regulatory compliance at a defined stage and establishing a time-bound investment criteria, expenses that cannot be reversed can be controlled while learning from the market.

aib-c01-d2-015@1.title: While supplementing specialized talent, retain business assets for the company
aib-c01-d2-015@1.prompt: The logistics software company wants to provide a function that interprets complex delivery commitments for each customer in 4 months. Its own contract rules and evaluation data are a competitive asset, and its operational capabilities are being developed. Generic solutions cannot change contract rules, and full in-house development would exceed the deadline. What is the appropriate approach?

A.text: All will be produced in-house to protect business knowledge, and the plan will be approved assuming the 4 months can be shortened.
A.explanation: It does not match the currently confirmed capabilities and delivery timeline constraints.

B.text: Transfer the rules and evaluation data rights to the partner, and discuss the operation method after the collaboration ends after the initial release.
B.explanation: Almost undermines the control and continuity of differentiated assets.

C.text: Maintain rules and evaluation data internally, and develop features with specialized partners. Acceptance criteria for operational documents and handovers are also included in the contract.
C.explanation: Can fill the talent gap while ensuring the transfer of unique assets and operations.

D.text: Prioritize the initial delivery date, and align the contract with generic products where no custom rules can be changed.
D.explanation: Loss of the core requirements for the function that interprets customer contracts.

learning.concept: Choose a partnership that separates the company’s differentiation assets from volatile factors, with operational handover as a condition
learning.reason: Address the lack of design and implementation through specialized partners, keep unique rules and evaluation assets under company management, and define the conditions for handover during actual operation from the start.

aib-c01-d2-016@1.title: Compare the assumptions common to both individual effects and multiple initiatives
aib-c01-d2-016@1.prompt: Medical device manufacturers are proposing separate AI initiatives to search for product manuals across three departments. There is a mix of old and new versions in each department, making it impossible to distinguish between official and unofficial versions, leading to repeated errors in procedures. The initiatives to standardize the approval and distribution of official versions lack AI features that are directly visible to users. How should the priorities for the first-year budget be determined?

A.text: Focus the budget on the department with the highest expected number of users, and define a common official version once misdirection in that department begins.
A.explanation: Start deployment before meeting the required quality criteria.

B.text: Since simply compiling manuals will not increase the number of AI users for customers, common initiatives will be excluded from the list.
B.explanation: Ignore the assumption that subsequent measures will provide the correct procedures.

C.text: Taking the management of the official version as a common premise first, and incorporating the avoidance costs and achievable benefits when reusing through three measures into the financial evaluation.
C.explanation: The correctness of the steps can be restored, and duplicate investments can also be evaluated.

D.text: All departments will receive the same amount, and each will establish its own separate official version system before sharing it across the entire company.
D.explanation: There are discrepancies and costs remaining due to redundant implementation of the same controls.

learning.concept: Don’t evaluate investment in common assumptions solely based on individual KPIs, but determine the order through incremental effects from dependencies and reuse
learning.reason: Establish a formal version identification that hinders all initiatives, and evaluate it as a condition for the realization of benefits of individual initiatives. The reuse scope and implementation costs will be verified.

aib-c01-d2-017@1.title: Linking predictions to actual routing decisions
aib-c01-d2-017@1.prompt: The local repair shops want to reduce cancellations on the same day due to delayed arrival times. They can act only before the routing is finalized in the morning, and there is one spare vehicle available. There are records of past visit times and customer communications. Which AI strategy to try and its main metric?

A.text: Predict the number of reservations by month on a quarterly basis, using prediction error as the primary metric.
A.explanation: It can be used for hiring and budget planning, but it does not assist in daily priority routing decisions.

B.text: Predict delay risks at the morning stage and propose spare vehicle allocation to the staff. Compare cancellations on the same day with on-time arrivals.
B.explanation: Measure the impact on customer outcomes within a time-bound period and resource constraints.

C.text: Automatically generate delay notifications and measure the opening rate for cases where delays are confirmed.
C.explanation: Notification improvement can be measured, but cancellations prevented by spare vehicles are not accounted for.

D.text: Generate the reason for delays across all visits in the evening and use the review approval rate of the summary as the primary metric.
D.explanation: It helps analyze causes, but cannot improve the routing decision for that day.

learning.concept: Choose the use of predictions based on the decision point, actionable range, and customer outcomes
learning.reason: Predict delays using information available in the morning and apply limited spare resources to routing decisions. Improvements are confirmed by actual cancellations and on-time arrivals.

aib-c01-d2-018@1.title: Check the continuity of data and contracts before replacing the AI foundation
aib-c01-d2-018@1.prompt: Update the AI for document classification in insurance operations. The trial accuracy and processing speed of the new platform exceed those of the current one, but the current contract requires storing processing reasons for 3 years. While past output history and references to reasons can be migrated, the handling of document identifiers differs between the two platforms. What is one of the verifications before deciding whether to update?

A.text: Only the latest results are moved, and old records are regenerated from sample documents when needed.
A.explanation: Does not meet the contract conditions that preserve the output rationale of the time.

B.text: Since the accuracy exceeds expectations, we will terminate the current contract and assume that the records of the old infrastructure can be obtained after cancellation.
B.explanation: It assumes without proof access and evidence restoration after cancellation.

C.text: Match the old document IDs seemingly and migrate them, and if the total number of success records is the same, assume the linking is also correct.
C.explanation: Just matching the quantities is not enough to detect incorrect matching of individual histories and documents.

D.text: Migrate the representative history to reproduce the search and audit of evidence, perform ID conversion matching, and conduct comparisons including transition, storage, and operation costs.
D.explanation: You can verify the contract, the meaning of the data, and the continuity of costs.

learning.concept: In the switching decision, not only the API response is used, but also history interpretation, ongoing auditing, and switching costs are considered
learning.reason: Maintain contractual retention obligations and search/audit capabilities, ensuring that the basis remains intact despite differences in identifiers. Include costs for migration and ongoing operation.

aib-c01-d2-019@1.title: Measure separately the working time and the user's burden
aib-c01-d2-019@1.prompt: The disaster response secretariat is testing an AI to create summaries of on-site reports. The management team wants to reduce the total time spent on support staff. On-site, trust is also important—ensuring no omissions occur during handovers. Choose two KPI combinations that can evaluate both aspects.

A.text: Total time for support staff in similar scale projects, including confirmation and correction of summaries.
A.explanation: The operational human burden can be measured across the entire process.

B.text: After regularly asking the person who received the handover whether they were able to transfer all necessary details without omission, along with their sense of trust and burden.
B.explanation: The experience that is difficult to convert into numbers can be measured by the person actually handling the handover.

C.text: Number of summaries generated during training, and number of prompt updates.
C.explanation: It measures the activity level of policies, not the burden of projects or the outcomes of experiences.

D.text: The amount calculated by multiplying the support staff rate per unit by the inference unit price.
D.explanation: It multiplies different units, and does not represent labor hours or benefits.

E.text: Number of words in the summary and compression ratio relative to the original text.
E.explanation: I can understand the output format, but I don’t know the actual working time and reliability.

learning.concept: Track the benefits directly related to the amount and employee experience using separate metrics to avoid easy double counting
learning.reason: Quantitative metrics related to actual personnel burden, along with the trust and burden on the responsible person regarding handover, are compared under the same conditions to visualize different types of improvements.

aib-c01-d2-020@1.title: Align the reference values for AI-managed processes and peripheral processes
