aib-c01-d2-020@1.prompt: The payment inquiry team wants to speed up task allocation using AI. In terms of design, some requests require manual verification by a different department after allocation. Currently, only the median time from request receipt to completion is recorded. To measure the impact of this implementation, what should be measured now?

A.text: Record the type of projects, allocate them, and measure the time required for transfer, correction, additional verification, and completion from before implementation.
A.explanation: Under the same conditions, both the effectiveness and additional burden can be compared.

B.text: Only the completion time of all current projects will be kept, and in the future, effectiveness will be determined based solely on the working hours of assigned staff.
B.explanation: It’s overlooked when indicators don’t match and additional verification tasks are transferred to other departments.

C.text: Only the cases deemed suitable for AI processing will be recorded after implementation, while other processes are considered unrelated to improvement.
C.explanation: There is no baseline for comparison before implementation, and the impact of changes to the target process on surrounding areas is also unclear.

D.text: Set achievement targets for each allocation officer, and use the gap between targets instead of pre-implementation performance.
D.explanation: The target is not based on actual measured values, and the burden incurred in surrounding processes is also invisible.

learning.concept: Separate the target process and preceding processes, establish pre-implementation standards, and avoid apparent improvements due to effort transfer
learning.reason: In addition to the process from reception to completion, it is necessary to distinguish and track allocation, misdelivery-related rework, and supplementary verification by other departments, and compare different types of projects.

aib-c01-d2-021@1.title: Determine the minimum number of transactions including quality verification fees
aib-c01-d2-021@1.prompt: AI verification of export documents saves JPY 600 in outsourcing costs for every accepted transaction. Usage charges, including failed inference attempts, and exception review together cost an estimated JPY 200 per accepted transaction. Annual fixed costs are JPY 2,400,000, with no other costs or benefits. What is the smallest number of accepted transactions needed for the first-year net benefit to be zero or higher?

A.text: 6,000 transactions. Divide the fixed cost by the amount saved per transaction after subtracting the transaction and exception verification fees.
A.explanation: Both fixed costs and cost based on the number of transactions are evaluated.

B.text: 12,000 transactions. Divide the fixed cost by 200 yen in transaction and exception verification fees.
B.explanation: The denominator is the benefit minus usage costs per transaction. The usage cost alone is insufficient.

C.text: 4,000 transactions. Divide the fixed cost by the amount saved of 600 yen in outsourcing costs.
C.explanation: The transaction and exception verification fees of 200 yen per transaction are reduced.

D.text: 3,000 transactions. Add 200 yen in transaction and exception verification fees to 600 yen in savings, then divide by the fixed cost.
D.explanation: Adding transaction fees to benefits overestimates the net benefit per accepted transaction.

learning.concept: Calculate break-even point by separating fixed costs and net benefit per successful transaction
learning.reason: The net benefit per accepted transaction is JPY 600 − JPY 200 = JPY 400. Dividing the fixed cost of JPY 2,400,000 by JPY 400 gives exactly 6,000 accepted transactions, the break-even volume.

aib-c01-d2-022@1.title: Check if it can be replicated without team support outside the team
aib-c01-d2-022@1.prompt: The search AI for contract managers has achieved time savings in the pilot department. However, the pilot supervisor had to re-set difficult questions on a daily basis on their behalf. The management wants to determine whether results can be achieved in the next department where they cannot increase the same support staff before the quarter. Which metric is most useful?

A.text: Total number of all searches, including the response from the trial responsible person.
A.explanation: Dependence on experts, and inability to distinguish results that meet standards.

B.text: Department-specific realized profits recorded at the end of the quarter after official release.
B.explanation: An indicator that becomes clear after full implementation; it is not available for judgment before implementation.

C.text: The proportion of target projects that meet quality and time standards through standard procedures, by representatives of the next department.
C.explanation: Can quickly confirm the results that can be reproduced during scaling and the dependence on support.

D.text: The upper limit of the search accuracy rate that can be achieved when the responsible person operates with optimal settings.
D.explanation: It is impossible to measure the results under conditions where experts do not provide daily support.

learning.concept: Use the proportion meeting the criteria even without continuous support from the trial responsible person as a leading indicator for preparation
learning.reason: In routine expected operations, the proportion of cases that meet quality and time standards without an agent setting by the trial responsible person early on indicates the operational burden and reproducibility after deployment.

aib-c01-d2-023@1.title: Control the Time Periods When Refining Costs Increase
aib-c01-d2-023@1.prompt: The AI classification cost for reports peaks at the beginning of the month, and even on the same day, the total number of executions can increase several times. According to records, each time the deadline is reached, a new job is added, but many previous processes are completed later. Which is the first measure to reduce costs while maintaining submission deadlines and quality?

A.text: Discard reports with approaching deadlines without hesitation, and match the total number of calls at the beginning of the month to that of the previous year.
A.explanation: Reports that should be processed within the submission deadline are missing.

B.text: Verify progress and completion before reattempting using report processing IDs, set a maximum number of reattempts and exceptions near deadlines, and track costs per completion.
B.explanation: Reduce duplicate processing while still being able to measure both missed tasks and costs.

C.text: Set all timeouts longer, avoid counting processes that are completed late, and compare only monthly payment amounts.
C.explanation: Setting the timeout value alone does not ensure comparison with ongoing work, and the impact on deadlines becomes unclear.

D.text: Increase the daily budget to match the high cost, and consider only new contracts where the amount per instance decreases.
D.explanation: The main reason the same reports are processed unnecessarily remains.

learning.concept: Identify the source of cost overruns and reduce duplicate jobs and reattempts rather than negotiating unit prices
learning.reason: Compare completion status before reattempting, manage the same reports as a single completion using processing IDs. Use a maximum number of reattempts and exceptions near deadlines to limit unlimited costs.

aib-c01-d2-024@1.title: Choose investment targets that show a difference in mature markets
aib-c01-d2-024@1.prompt: In the enterprise meeting-minutes market, transcription accuracy and pricing are converging across vendors. Customers now base renewal decisions on integration with their internal approval processes and compliance with required retention periods. The company’s basic transcription already meets the contract standard. How should it allocate its limited budget for next year?

A.text: Rebuild the general-purpose model from scratch, and select investments based solely on general-purpose accuracy, separate from the reasons for existing customer updates.
A.explanation: There is no basis for how improved precision leads to updates, so the reasons for integration and storage are ignored.

B.text: All additional development has been stopped due to market maturity, and approval coordination will continue to be handled manually by the responsible personnel.
B.explanation: Existing customers lose opportunities to improve on conditions they value.

C.text: First, decide to use the same proportion of sales with competitors for model research, and the collaboration fees will be adjusted according to the remaining amount.
C.explanation: It is more appropriate to judge based on the ratio of competitor expenses, with the condition of supporting the renewal of own customers.

D.text: Maintain accurate translation that meets basic quality standards, verify the integration of approval and storage with customers, and invest based on its impact on update rate.
D.explanation: Separate general functions from customer-specific criteria, allowing resources to be directed toward valuable areas.

learning.concept: In markets where technology has become generic, obtain generic functions at low cost and make additional investments in complementary assets that customers value.
learning.reason: For basic features with minimal differences in the market, ensure they meet and maintain quality standards, and evaluate investments in integration and storage capabilities that affect updates.

aib-c01-d3-001@1.title: Investigating the Difference in Missed Rates Hidden in Average Values
aib-c01-d3-001@1.prompt: Local governments used AI to identify candidates for sending guidance on benefits to households that meet criteria. Although the overall correct rate is high, there are reports that in some areas, many households meet the criteria but are not sent guidance. Data showing independent eligibility assessments can be used for verification. Which metric should be compared first?

A.text: The proportion of households where the presence or absence of guidance was correct across all households, regardless of region.
A.explanation: In the overall summary, some missed cases may be hidden in certain regions.

B.text: Compare the proportion of eligible households that were not guided, by region, among those who were independently verified.
B.explanation: The false negative issue can be measured directly using the denominator of eligible individuals.

C.text: Compare the proportion of households that received guidance and agreed with the content, by region.
C.explanation: Households that were not guided are not included in the denominator.

D.text: The proportion of guidance received among all residents by region.
D.explanation: If the proportion of eligible individuals varies by region, it is impossible to determine the difference in missed guidance.

learning.concept: Evaluate the missed rate by group for eligible individuals, tailored to specific disadvantages faced by the target population, with measurement of fairness.
learning.reason: The issue is missed guidance among eligible individuals. Use independently verified eligible households as the denominator by region and compare the proportions of those who were not guided.

aib-c01-d3-002@1.title: Determining the Conflict Between Promotion Effectiveness and Scope
aib-c01-d3-002@1.prompt: Subscription providers are trying AI-generated promotion text to improve the paid retention rate. Adding a free-text field in the inquiry portal increases response rates, but the usage permission for that record is limited to inquiries only. Users can use it within the contract status and the interest category with promotion usage permission. Which decision is appropriate?

A.text: Re-evaluate only within the approved contract status and interest category, and obtain prior approval if expanding the purpose of free-text usage.
A.explanation: It is possible to verify policies that meet current constraints.

B.text: Only the agent reads the free-text and manually enters it into AI input. The promotion side does not retain the source of usage in the records.
B.explanation: Even with manual intervention, the approved usage purpose remains unchanged.

C.text: Remove only the name from the free-text, and do not record any change in usage purpose; use it in the promotion text.
C.explanation: Removing only the name does not remove personal information recorded in the records or resolve the restrictions on approved purposes.

D.text: Use the original text only for a few customers, and apply for a change in usage purpose after higher response rates.
D.explanation: Even if the scale is small, it is necessary to first maintain the current scope of use.

learning.concept: When improving short-term KPIs conflicts with approved usage purposes, change the purpose within constraints to verify value
learning.reason: Limit input to the current scope of use and re-test whether promotion improvements are feasible. If using for a new purpose, obtain appropriate approval and justification first.

aib-c01-d3-003@1.title: Including objections to decisions in the planning stage
aib-c01-d3-003@1.prompt: A training company is trying to prioritize job applications using AI. If there are not enough seats, applicants who are not selected may request a re-review. The data items and testing scope have not yet been determined. To ensure that explanations and re-reviews can be carried out, when and what should be decided?

A.text: During requirement definition, determine the criteria for decision-making, notifications to individuals, the responsible person and deadline for manual re-review, and verify the procedures during testing.
A.explanation: Evidence, notifications, and re-review can be reflected in the design of functions and operations.

B.text: Publish general AI explanations during official operation, and create re-review procedures for individual decisions after the number of users increases.
B.explanation: General explanations do not provide the basis for individual decisions or specific re-review procedures.

C.text: After confirming a high correct rate during testing, add evidence storage only for the selected cases.
C.explanation: Those who are rejected and request a re-review will not have the necessary evidence left.

D.text: Collect all data first, and determine the required items and storage requirements when complaints are made regarding the results.
D.explanation: This may lead to unnecessary collection, and the items needed for explanations may be missing later.

learning.concept: At the requirements stage, define how decisions affect people, what evidence must be kept, and how appeals will be handled. Waiting until later can leave gaps in the evidence.
learning.reason: At the implementation design stage, include the impact on decisions, criteria to be recorded, notification content, the person responsible for re-review and deadline in the requirements. If appropriate information is not collected, it is impossible to reconstruct the criteria after implementation.

aib-c01-d3-004@1.title: When the basis for the policy conflicts, it is passed on to someone else
aib-c01-d3-004@1.prompt: The insurance benefit guidance AI can include a clause from the regulations as part of its response. If the customer’s plan is unclear, or if multiple regulations with different application dates are searched, there is a risk of misguiding the customer and causing them to lose their application opportunity. Choose two measures that should be taken on-site.

A.text: If the generation model has a high confidence in its self-assessment, it will be sent without checking the application basis.
A.explanation: Self-evaluation alone cannot resolve contradictions in reasoning or missing inputs.

B.text: Send the details to the responsible person’s confirmation queue: referenced regulations and application date, unverified plan information, and response deadline.
B.explanation: People can address the shortage and provide priority handling to avoid losing application opportunities.

C.text: List multiple regulations in the response, and ask the applicant to select which one applies to them.
C.explanation: Leave the decision with significant impact to the applicant in an uncertain state.

D.text: If no applicable conditions can be identified, or if the reasons are conflicting, stop the definitive guidance and respond as a pending confirmation.
D.explanation: Can reduce the leakage of incorrect directions caused by insufficient conditions.

E.text: If the readability of the output meets the criteria, instructions will be sent even if there are conflicting regulations.
E.explanation: Readability does not guarantee the correctness of the conditions.

learning.concept: Reserve the response in case the high-impact output lacks supporting evidence or is incomplete, and send it to the responsible person along with the information needed for decision-making.
learning.reason: Detecting contradictions in evidence or missing application conditions to stop the determination, and transfer the candidate evidence, differences in application dates, and verification items to the responsible person.

aib-c01-d3-005@1.title: Create a system where the committee provides advice and formal approvers make decisions
aib-c01-d3-005@1.prompt: In the retail group’s AI review, representatives from legal, personal information, technology, and operations attend a meeting every week. In one incident, since everyone thought they were advisors, no one made a stop decision or contacted the affected department. What should be the top priority in the next operational change?

A.text: For each service, appoint an accountable owner and give the on-call role authority to stop the service. Document how the committee provides advice and how notifications and remediation are handled.
A.explanation: The responsibilities for judgment and integration are clear, and specialized knowledge can be utilized.

B.text: Increase the number of attendees, and specify that it can stop only when everyone agrees.
B.explanation: Even in situations where immediate judgment is required due to a major incident, the responsible person and the substitute cannot be unique.

C.text: During operation, since the provider makes technical decisions, the company’s right to shut down is left to the contract management team for confirmation.
C.explanation: The technical support for the provider and the responsibility for terminating its use and notifying relevant parties are separate.

D.text: Consider whether the stop can be implemented only during AI Committee meetings; otherwise, each department’s responsible person will make the decision individually.
D.explanation: The permissions and communication channels needed for immediate termination are not defined overall.

learning.concept: Divide advice among multiple departments, with specific approval and correction responsibilities, and clarify the authority to stop major incidents
learning.reason: While maintaining expert review participation, define the business owner for each system, the role to make decisions on operation approval and shutdown, and the deadlines for communication and remediation.

aib-c01-d3-006@1.title: Confirm the management obligations that remain with the company after the commissioning.
aib-c01-d3-006@1.prompt: There is a plan to delegate the payment processing summary to external AI. According to the company policy, there are restrictions on processing regions, deletion within a specified number of days, equivalent management from the delegating party to the re-delegating party, and the submission of evidence during audits is mandatory. What actions does the procurement officer take before obtaining formal approval?

A.text: Receive the comprehensive authentication certificate from the client, and omit the verification of the intended products and sub-clients.
A.explanation: It is unclear whether the subjects of authentication match this processing, or whether individual management requirements are met.

B.text: Divide obligations into contractual clauses and verification items, verify evidence of the target service and subcontractor, and conduct reviews even during changes.
B.explanation: It can be judged by linking contracts, actual conditions, and continuous evidence.

C.text: If communication can be encrypted, the processing region and deletion evidence will be sought only during the audit.
C.explanation: Encryption does not guarantee processing region, retention period, or evidence retrieval.

D.text: The initial assignment will record the self-reporting by the client, but no reconfirmation will be done for contract renewal or change of subcontractor.
D.explanation: I cannot confirm that the management obligations remain intact after the change.

learning.concept: Delegate the assigned management obligations to the contractor’s contracts, technical setup, and evidence collection/review
learning.reason: Verify that all obligations are reflected in the procurement contract and actual configuration and operation, and determine the responsibility for obtaining evidence and the update method, including the subcontractor and re-subcontractor.

aib-c01-d3-007@1.title: Maintain viewing rights through cross-deployment searches
aib-c01-d3-007@1.prompt: Incorporate company-wide policies and documents handled solely by HR staff into the internal document search AI. Sensitive information should not appear as search candidates or answers even when employees without permissions ask questions. Document permissions are changed according to job transfers. What is the appropriate measure?

A.text: After searching all the data, request that the content related to human resources be hidden per the instructions for generative AI.
A.explanation: Unauthorized materials have already been sent for search and generation, relying solely on permission enforcement for instructions.

B.text: Matches the user's authentication information and current data permissions during search, and only provides access to and generates data that is authorized.
B.explanation: Enforces authorization before document acquisition, and can follow changes in permissions.

C.text: Give the search account permission to read every document and merely hide links to document titles in the AI response.
C.explanation: Even if the link is hidden, sensitive information may be conveyed from the content of the response.

D.text: Record the responsible department once during onboarding, and continue using the old department access rights after a transfer.
D.explanation: Does not match the current business permissions.

learning.concept: Limit the search targets based on the currently authorized access of the authenticated user, and enforce this before processing the document text
learning.reason: Apply the latest document permissions for authenticated users on the server side before searching. Restrictions are applied before acquisition to prevent the delivery of unauthorized content to the answer generation side.

aib-c01-d3-008@1.title: Even for the same model, the strength of review varies depending on the use case
aib-c01-d3-008@1.prompt: The transportation company plans to use the same generation model to notify users of draft summaries for internal meetings and alternative operation plans. It is also considering sending these plans without the approval of the responsible person, as incorrect notifications can directly affect passenger movement. Which classification policy is most appropriate?

A.text: Separate the two uses based solely on the highest accuracy at the time of approval; if the accuracy is equal, apply the same review procedures.
A.explanation: Even if the accuracy is equal, the outcomes when errors occur are different.

B.text: Since the model has already been approved for internal documents, external notifications also inherit the same risk category.
B.explanation: For internal approvals, direct impact on passengers and automatic transmission are not evaluated.

C.text: The use case with the highest number of transactions is always considered the highest risk, and the impact of a single error is not assessed.
C.explanation: Only the number of transactions cannot reflect severity or recovery potential.

D.text: Evaluate the impact on users and the presence of approval for each use case, and apply stricter review to external notifications without approval.
D.explanation: Even for the same model, the impact and control measures of errors vary depending on the application.

learning.concept: Do not make uniform judgments based on the model name; determine risk categories based on the impact on the target, reversibility of operations, and level of supervision
learning.reason: Evaluate individually based on business context, impact, supervision, and reversibility of errors, and apply stricter approval and stop conditions for external automated notifications.

aib-c01-d3-009@1.title: Create operations to stop major deviations that occur during operation
aib-c01-d3-009@1.prompt: In the corporate billing guidance AI, errors in responses can spread quickly, causing users to submit requests for incorrect amounts. Quality extraction auditing can be performed hourly, and manual entry channels are also ready. What is the operational measure required for official operation?

A.text: Practice the procedure for setting a threshold and shift to manual desk, and resume operations after verification.
A.explanation: Link observations to the suppression and recovery of impacts on users.

B.text: Notify the supervisor of the significant misdirection, but switching to a manual point of contact will be decided on the spot by finding the responsible person.
B.explanation: No corresponding permissions are set, so the switch is delayed.

C.text: Notifications are sent only when the uptime drops, and no content is reviewed during periods of normal operation.
C.explanation: Even with good uptime, incorrect payment instructions can occur.

D.text: Save the hourly quality records, and determine the shutdown procedure during the end-of-month meeting if there are significant changes.
D.explanation: As we wait until the end of the month, more serious misdirigations occur.

learning.concept: Don’t just use metrics as mere records, but connect them to thresholds, shifts, stops, and restarts
learning.reason: Set a threshold for immediate notification as a key indicator for major errors, and grant the responsible person switching permissions. Practice manual switching and restoration decisions in advance.

aib-c01-d3-010@1.title: Do not only look at downstream models; investigate the source of bias
aib-c01-d3-010@1.prompt: The AI in phone support translates speech to text and then summarizes conversations. Although the summarization model has not been changed since its release, after updates to speech processing, reports continue to appear that users who speak a certain way omit information in their summaries. Which is the most appropriate procedure to investigate the cause and sequence of events using authorized records of responses?

A.text: Exclude the conversations that are already missing due to transcription from the aggregation, and have humans evaluate only the remaining summaries.
A.explanation: The impact of the preprocessing step that is suspected will be removed from the evaluation.

B.text: Confirm that the version of the summarization model and training data have not changed, and if there are no changes, conclude that no impact on bias exists.
B.explanation: If the quality of input changes during the speech processing phase, even with the same summarization model, the results will differ.

C.text: Focus only on overall summary quality and complaint rates; if within acceptable limits, do not investigate speech processing.
C.explanation: The missing data concentrated among a few users is difficult to detect in overall values, and it is unclear where it occurred.

D.text: Compare the verified speech content, transcription, and summary for the same conversation to identify the stage of omission. Continue to monitor the differences between speech patterns and processing versions.
D.explanation: Separate the processes that affect specific users, so any future changes can be used to investigate recurrence.

learning.concept: Even with the same summarization model, bias may occur due to speech preprocessing; therefore, track changes at each input stage and errors by processing phase
learning.reason: For the same conversation, compare the speech, transcription, and summary confirmed by the agent at each stage to determine where omissions occur. Check whether there are no differences based on user speech characteristics and processing versions, and continue verification after updates.

aib-c01-d3-011@1.title: Verify the rights and harmful content of the generated promotional materials
aib-c01-d3-011@1.prompt: The manufacturer creates generated images for exhibitions. Some product photos that can be used as references are only allowed for internal review, and cannot be used as external production materials. There is also a concern that the generated images may contain third-party logos or derogatory expressions. Choose two measures to take before publication.

A.text: Only harmful content is checked; if a third-party logo appears, it is treated as approved at the discretion of the production team.
A.explanation: I have not checked the rights or display conditions of the logo.

B.text: Check public candidates for harmful content, third-party displays, and prominent similarities, and retain疑able ones for further review.
B.explanation: You can identify issues that may occur in the output even when managing inputs.

C.text: The generated result can be used regardless of the contract scope of the input material, as long as the output image differs from the original photo in pixels.
C.explanation: Even without the pixel difference, there are no contractual restrictions on the material elements.

D.text: After publication, count the number of complaints. If there are few complaints, no material review will be conducted.
D.explanation: No way to prevent expressions or rights issues from leaking out before the public release.

E.text: Confirm the rights for use in generation and publication for each reference material, and keep a list of approved materials.
E.explanation: Can clarify the input permissions and usage criteria.

learning.concept: Manage the input authorization scope and output issues separately, and perform similar/harmful content checks before publication
learning.reason: Only materials permitted for external production and generation use are used, and the output is also reviewed for third-party displays and the presence of harmful content.

aib-c01-d3-012@1.title: Determine if the references actually support the claims
aib-c01-d3-012@1.prompt: The AI support system adds a approved procedure link to the response, but there are cases where the linked page describes a different model and does not support the claimed exchange procedures. The link is not broken. What is the most direct solution?

A.text: Shorten the citation title for the template response and prioritize procedures with high view counts.
A.explanation: View counts and title length do not verify the correctness of the claims.

B.text: Monitor the HTTP response from the linked page and treat the response content as confirmed as far as possible.
B.explanation: Even if the link is valid, it does not necessarily indicate the claims are present.

C.text: Verify the model and version against the procedures, and retain responses that cannot provide supporting sections.
C.explanation: It is easy to prevent both incorrect reasons and unsupported assertions.

D.text: Require multiple links per response; publish if the number of links meets the criteria.
D.explanation: The number of references does not guarantee scope or support.

learning.concept: Distinguish between the existence of references and the support of claims; retain responses if none are found
learning.reason: Check whether the model and version apply and whether the references support each claim. Procedures that cannot be supported are not guided and directed to verification.

aib-c01-d3-013@1.title: Make the explanation for judgment available to users in a usable format
aib-c01-d3-013@1.prompt: The discount proposal AI for online learning services asks users for an explanation when it is not applicable. The AI wants to explain the review result, but cannot disclose other users' contract histories used for learning or internal fraud detection details. Which type of information is most appropriate for users?

A.text: Notify the overall accuracy of the business and explain that the same probability applies to individual results.
A.explanation: The overall accuracy does not explain the individual judgment reasons.

B.text: Show inputs and results from other users with similar contracts without anonymizing them to fully explain the information.
B.explanation: Disclose other people's contract information unnecessarily.

C.text: Inform about the main reasons based on personal records, how to verify or correct those records, and the contact point for reconfirmation.
C.explanation: It provides transparency that leads to actual actions and does not include unrelated contract histories.

D.text: Only list the model name and update date; do not disclose how to verify individual records.
D.explanation: It is unclear how to correct specific reasons or errors.

learning.concept: Balancing transparency of public explanations with protection of other data, while showing factors related to the individual and correction paths
learning.reason: Explain the judgment factors related to the user's application, as well as the methods for input correction and inquiries. Do not disclose third-party histories or internal measures unnecessarily.

aib-c01-d3-014@1.title: Even if the target for processing items increases, safety standards will be maintained
aib-c01-d3-014@1.prompt: The facilities management team wants to double the number of inquiries it handles this period. The AI gives adequate directions to facilities, but during field tests it repeatedly gave incorrect information about emergency access restrictions. Staff can distinguish routine and emergency inquiries when they come in. Which policy best balances throughput and safety?

A.text: Automate all inquiries to ensure no speed loss, and staff only check satisfaction after the fact.
A.explanation: Known serious misdirigations will reach users.

B.text: Automate only emergency consultations, and reassign staff familiar with routine guidance to increase the response volume.
B.explanation: Automate focus on areas that do not meet the standards in practice.

C.text: Using AI within the usual verified scope, urgent or unknown types are sent to staff, and serious misdirection criteria are tracked separately.
C.explanation: While utilizing opportunities for efficiency, known high-impact areas can be isolated and monitored.

D.text: The accuracy rate, combining normal and emergency results, is used as the operational criterion; if the overall value exceeds the threshold, the entire range is automated.
D.explanation: The high volume of inquiries can hide incorrect directions in emergencies.

learning.concept: Only expand the low-impact area that has been verified during validation, and leave manual intervention for areas where no serious errors are allowed
learning.reason: The verified normal range will be optimized, and emergency or unknown-type cases will be handled by staff familiar with the procedures. The expansion to the emergency range will be decided after reconfirming safety.

aib-c01-d3-015@1.title: Determining the scope of records sufficient for auditing at the design stage
aib-c01-d3-015@1.prompt: I am designing an internal consultation AI. Consultations may contain sensitive personal information. By policy, it is necessary to verify which model version and approved information were used when issues arise later. There is no basis for long-term storage of the full text of sensitive consultations. What should be decided before receiving trial data?

A.text: Only save the counted number of consultations, and do not retain the model version or reference information separately.
A.explanation: It is impossible to investigate which version was used in the response when a problem occurs.

B.text: Do not save the full text on the generation platform; instead, the responsible person on-site copies it into a personal area for audit requests.
B.explanation: No official record procedures or access control are established, resulting in uncontrolled copies.

C.text: Continue to store all conversations and user identification information for long-term use, so as to handle increased record requirements later.
C.explanation: Includes data without a purpose or storage basis.

D.text: Identify the required responses for model version and material version, record only the necessary portions within the required scope and period, and determine the viewers.
D.explanation: While preserving evidence needed for investigation, the exposure of sensitive information can be limited.

learning.concept: Define the items required for verification and investigation first, avoid uniform storage of sensitive original texts
learning.reason: Design records for auditing, version references, and decisions; identify sensitive information and handle only the necessary parts. Determine access and retention periods based on use cases.

aib-c01-d3-016@1.title: Reduce approvals that merely confirm AI suggestions
aib-c01-d3-016@1.prompt: The AI proposes a payment amount to the person responsible for handling penalty fees in delivery contracts. In practice, humans approve, but during audits, the person often selects the AI’s amount without reviewing the justification. How should this be changed so that humans actually supervise?

A.text: Display the AI’s proposal prominently at the top for all staff members, using the fact of pressing the approval button as evidence of supervision.
A.explanation: If approval remains formal, the impact of the initial numerical value becomes stronger.

B.text: For high-value or unusual cases, first record the staff member’s justified initial judgment, then compare it with the AI’s decision and re-examine any discrepancies.
B.explanation: This can reduce confirmation approvals and make the verification process more substantive.

C.text: Only close the human approval screen when a model from the same provider as the AI matches the result.
C.explanation: Models may make the same errors, eliminating human supervision.

D.text: To maintain processing speed, replace all human verification with random sampling after payment.
D.explanation: Post-approval audits are useful, but they cannot prevent significant unverified payments.

learning.concept: Record human evaluations first for high-impact decisions, and if there is a difference, conduct independent verification to reduce confirmation approvals
learning.reason: For important cases, first record the staff member’s judgment based on contracts and experience, then verify the difference with the AI proposal with justification. Unusual differences are sent for re-examination.

aib-c01-d3-017@1.title: Separating the additional requirements for a new market from existing approvals
aib-c01-d3-017@1.prompt: There is a plan to release the same customer support AI in a different region. The department policy for that region includes additional requirements such as pre-visualization of AI processing, a procedure for users to switch to human assistance, and a record of compliance with the switch request. None of these are present in the current service. What is the decision before release?

A.text: Pre-visualize it for users, and only find the relevant department when a query regarding the switch occurs.
A.explanation: Lack of available switch procedures and compliance records.

B.text: Continue approvals in the existing region, and combine the additional requirements into a next update after official release.
B.explanation: Release the service without meeting the requirements of the new region.

C.text: Store the existing AI processing logs for a long period, and have users prove their desire to switch through email records.
C.explanation: Unable to record that the request has been fulfilled by the company.

D.text: Add regional display, switch procedures, and compliance records, and verify from the user's request to actual human assistance before making it valid.
D.explanation: All additional requirements can be confirmed through the actual service operation.

learning.concept: Compare the requirements of the new region with existing features, fulfill any missing features or operations, and then make it valid regionally
learning.reason: Assign the required requirements for the target region to display, operation, and evidence, and make it valid after testing from request to fulfillment. Do not reuse registrations from existing regions.

aib-c01-d3-018@1.title: Separate permissions for training environment and production processing
aib-c01-d3-018@1.prompt: In the internal AI testing environment, there is a rule that only approved research samples are handled. A proposal was made to use the same execution account used in the production environment, which handles customer inquiries after operation. Since the testing environment cannot access production data, choose two conditions that allow approval of updates to the production environment.

A.text: Automatically copy production data into the testing environment every morning to increase the number of test samples.
A.explanation: Bring customer data other than approved samples into the testing environment.

B.text: In the production environment, only verified artifacts with version and approval records are allowed through the separated permission distribution path.
B.explanation: Maintain separation of operational permissions while enabling approvaled updates to be deployed.

C.text: Assign permissions for both environments to a single execution account, and hide production data from the menu on the testing interface.
C.explanation: By hiding the data, permissions of the processing account cannot be revoked.

D.text: Distribute execution permissions per environment so that credentials on the testing side cannot read or modify production data.
D.explanation: Minimize actual permissions to reduce the risk of errors from testing affecting production.

E.text: Remove writing permissions for production data from the testing side, while allowing all users to read and configure it for quality comparison.
E.explanation: This does not meet the requirement that the testing side cannot read production data.

learning.concept: Divide data and processing permissions for different uses minimally, and share only approved distribution paths
learning.reason: Assign separate permissions to testing and production environments, separate production data and updates. Verify and incorporate approved artifacts through a designated distribution path.

aib-c01-d3-019@1.title: Decide on approval based on the risk reflected by additional measures
aib-c01-d3-019@1.prompt: The credit union uses customer interaction records with the staff-based coaching AI. According to the regulations, the risk before measures for using sensitive records is high, and the retained classification will be re-evaluated only when anonymization and storage restrictions can be confirmed empirically. Additional approval from the responsible person is required for retained risks that are higher than medium. In the trial, anonymization of regular cases was successful, but some cases still allowed individuals to be inferred from descriptions of family members. What is the decision made by the approval authority?

A.text: Record the pre-mitigation classification and the unresolved cases where people remain identifiable. Reassess residual risk and obtain additional approval if it cannot be confirmed as medium or lower.
A.explanation: Evaluate the measures that have been confirmed through verification, and move forward with approval appropriate to the remaining risk level.

B.text: Since there are few examples of failed anonymization, the records are excluded, and only the success rate in typical cases is used as a certification material.
B.explanation: Except for failure cases, the actual remaining disclosure risks cannot be assessed.

C.text: The previous use case for the measure is to treat it as the same category even after the measure is validated, and the evaluation of residual risks is omitted.
C.explanation: The procedures require separately evaluating the risks remaining after implemented verified measures.

D.text: Due to the existence of anonymization settings, the retained category will be reduced to below "medium" regardless of the number of exceptions.
D.explanation: However, the effectiveness cannot be confirmed merely by the implementation of the measures.

learning.concept: Separate the risk without measures from the residual risk after validated measures, and decide on additional approval based on the residual category
learning.reason: Record the pre-measurement category, and evaluate the remaining risk by reflecting the remaining cases identified during verification. Until reduction can be confirmed, the approval procedure for a low-remaining category cannot be applied.

aib-c01-d3-020@1.title: Confirming the handling of harmful expressions in regional terminology
aib-c01-d3-020@1.prompt: The AI for job recruitment guidance is equipped with a mechanism to block derogatory expressions. During multilingual testing, prohibited words in the primary language were blocked, but outputs containing euphemistic expressions in other languages passed through. Which measure reduces harmful outputs without unnecessarily stopping legitimate inquiries?

A.text: When the number of normal examples in minority languages is low, all outputs of the target language are immediately blocked as harmful.
A.explanation: Proper inquiries are also blocked beyond necessary limits.

B.text: Only use the total number of complaints after publication; no verification is performed in languages without user reports.
B.explanation: Cannot pre-understand languages that are difficult to detect harmful behavior in.

C.text: Measure false passes and false blocks using harmful and legitimate examples per language, and adjust control and human verification to handle context.
C.explanation: Can evaluate both security and legitimate use across multiple languages.

D.text: List machine-translated words prohibited in the main language, and judge the quality of all languages through a dictionary matching test only.
D.explanation: The harmfulness, which depends on euphemisms and context, cannot be fully assessed.

learning.concept: Instead of relying on simple keyword matching, test for false positives and false negatives using examples tailored to the user’s language and context
learning.reason: Prepare harmful and valid examples for each language and context, and compare them with expert judgments. Send疑ative outputs for verification, and also measure false disconnections.

aib-c01-d4-001@1.title: Do not determine that preparation is complete merely by having budget approval
aib-c01-d4-001@1.prompt: The newspaper company has secured a trial budget and business sponsors for generative AI. However, the editorial department only reports that article data is available without recording usage permissions. Editors do not know the correction process, and there is no plan for night-time inquiries. Which is the first preparation level assessment to conduct?

A.text: Check only the executive budget approval and the existence of a test account; if sufficient, estimate production-scale usage.
A.explanation: Fails to consider data rights, editing processes, supervision, and preparation levels.

B.text: Report the initial model accuracy as the company’s overall preparation level, ignoring department-specific differences.
B.explanation: Model quality does not reflect organizational or process preparation.

C.text: Evaluate management, data permissions, editorial staff skills, infrastructure, and night-time control separately, and use records and exercises to identify gaps before testing.
C.explanation: Crosses multiple perspectives and uses concrete evidence to support reports.

D.text: Add up internal survey self-assessments; offset low items with high items.
D.explanation: Can hide the absence of essential data permissions and handling procedures.

learning.concept: Crosses management agreement, data, frontline staff, infrastructure, and control; uses actual machine and practical evidence to supplement self-reports
learning.reason: Does not represent preparation levels by partial success; assigns responsible persons for each perspective and supports with records, exercises, and actual usage conditions. Addresses necessary barriers before testing.

aib-c01-d4-002@1.title: Don’t confuse successful individual trials with overall company maturity
aib-c01-d4-002@1.prompt: Two departments at a financial operations company saved time in separate pilots, but each person in charge used a different way of managing the work. There was no common process for approvals, handovers, or quality monitoring, and the pilots stopped when their owners moved to other roles. Which maturity assessment distinguishes a pilot from company-wide rollout?

A.text: Since good results were achieved in the two-phase trial, it will be rolled out company-wide. The differences in procedures will be left to the discretion of each business unit.
A.explanation: There is still no mechanism for reproducibility and operational continuity.

B.text: Since there is no formal AI company policy, each department should include trial results in maturity assessment during the planning phase.
B.explanation: Ignoring the experience of actually using it and measuring results.

C.text: Since the source model is mature for commercial use, the company’s maturity level is also considered at a full-scale deployment stage.
C.explanation: The maturity of a product differs from a company’s operational capabilities.

D.text: Measure the results at the experimental stage and evaluate them; determine whether standard procedures, owners, and common quality monitoring can be actually used as conditions for the next stage.
D.explanation: Distinguish the obtained trial results from the lacking deployment capabilities.

learning.concept: Determine the maturity stage not as the most successful example, but as a standard that can be replicated and continuous responsibility in the field
learning.reason: Even if there are signs of value in individual trials, standardization and continuous operation are lacking. While recognizing the results at the experimental stage, identify the capabilities needed for deployment.

aib-c01-d4-003@1.title: Break down the reasons for error accumulation by type of capability
aib-c01-d4-003@1.prompt: In the Engineering Department, there are responsible persons who can verify model quality, as well as testing equipment for re-testing. Errors during trials are reported in the weekly report, but they never get updated no matter how many times they are reported. In the investigation, it was unclear who accepted the amendments, who requested approval from whom, and when they would be released. Which capability gap should the department address first?

A.text: Provide a basic training on generative AI to the current quality manager again, and continue submitting the same weekly report.
A.explanation: He has sufficient skills; the issue is not a lack of expertise.

B.text: If all identified issues can be recorded based on the coverage rate in the weekly report, it is considered that operational deficiencies have been resolved.
B.explanation: It is not possible to verify whether the recorded issues were actually fixed and released.

C.text: Make change acceptance, priority, responsible person, approval, and distribution into a single operational procedure to execute the workflow from past reports.
C.explanation: Address processes where changes do not progress and fill the void of responsibility.

D.text: Replace with a more high-performance generative model, and investigate the delay in revisions without changing the process from reporting to approval.
D.explanation: Even after changing the model, report acceptance and approval cannot be determined.

learning.concept: When there is sufficient technology and training, identify the missing processes and responsible parties from issue reporting to distribution
learning.reason: What is lacking are the processes for exception handling, responsibility assignment, approval, and distribution. Just having training and facilities is not enough to ensure smooth correction.

aib-c01-d4-004@1.title: Determining the investment order to move from low maturity to strategic goals
aib-c01-d4-004@1.prompt: The strategic goal of the specialized trading company is to accelerate the quotation responses for all branches. Currently, only one branch has completed product naming, and there is no budget to establish a unified platform and talent pool for all stores at once. Which investment in the first year is most aligned with long-term goals?

A.text: This period will include a same comprehensive training for all employees, and the business trials of product data and estimates will be postponed until the next year.
A.explanation: Just training alone cannot ensure the reuse of data and processes needed for strategic goals.

B.text: Prioritize generating general text that is sure to be completed within the budget, without assessing its feasibility for use in estimates.
B.explanation: Has little relevance to the established strategic goals.

C.text: It will be implemented across all branches simultaneously, and any inconsistencies in product names and training for staff will be resolved after deployment.
C.explanation: Taking on issues with immature facilities simultaneously makes accurate estimation difficult.

D.text: Test the estimation process at a prepared site, establish common product definitions and training/measurement procedures, and select the next site based on results.
D.explanation: With a small investment, results can be achieved, and reusable capabilities for full store expansion can also be developed.

learning.concept: In a limited trial that fits the current situation, gradually develop team skills and foundations that can be reused for future goals
learning.reason: At a site where data is available, try improving the estimation process, establish shared product definitions, skills, and evaluation procedures, and move to the next site based on results and readiness.

aib-c01-d4-005@1.title: Distinguish between data volume and the scope of projects that can be used for operations
aib-c01-d4-005@1.prompt: In industrial equipment maintenance support, we use the sales department’s inventory records and repair reports received from contractors. Both departments have large amounts of records, but the completion rate and update timing of equipment IDs vary among contractors. Which evaluation directly determines whether maintenance support can be started across all regions?

A.text: Measure accuracy in the region with the most records, and if the model is consistent, extrapolate the results to the remaining regions.
A.explanation: Ignore the condition that gaps and update periods vary by region.

B.text: Measure the proportion, by region and contractor, of the target equipment whose latest repair information with permission can be correctly matched with the inventory records.
B.explanation: You can see what data is actually needed and where there are shortages.

C.text: Count the records for both departments individually, and if both exceed the count threshold, determine that preparation is complete across all regions.
C.explanation: The number of records does not indicate that the histories of the same device can be correctly matched.

D.text: All history will be gathered in one place, and records that cannot be matched until more data is added will also be included in the total prepared items.
D.explanation: Unifying the storage locations does not solve the issues of matching and permissioning.

learning.concept: Measure the proportion of items that can be matched across departments, delays, and access permissions, and evaluate readiness not only based on quantity
learning.reason: By evaluating matching success, delivery delays, and permission approvals by region and contractor, it is possible to identify areas not addressed, which are not visible in the total number of cases across the entire company.

aib-c01-d4-006@1.title: Determine the meaning and responsibility for changes to shared data
aib-c01-d4-006@1.prompt: The sales, billing, and support departments use the company directory with AI. Each department defines its own "active customers" in separate tables, and after changes in the billing side, the support AI continues to search using the old definition. Which is the most effective method for control during sharing?

A.text: All tables are synchronized to a single memory area, and the official definitions and change notifications are estimated by AI from the latest tables.
A.explanation: Even with a consistent storage location, issues of different definitions and responsibilities remain.

B.text: The departments share the definitions verbally at the end of the month, and the reflection date is determined individually by each user.
B.explanation: Definition tracking, assurance of reflection, responsibilities remain ambiguous.

C.text: Specify the data owner, agree with the using department on definitions and uses, access conditions, quality, change notifications, and transition deadlines for version management.
C.explanation: The provider and user can share the meaning of the changes and the responsibility for implementation.

D.text: To avoid changes, the support side continues to use the obtained list indefinitely without setting a deadline.
D.explanation: Cannot adapt to the latest business definitions or customer conditions.

learning.concept: Define the definition, quality, usage conditions, and notification upon changes for core data, through an agreement between data owners and the usage team
learning.reason: Designate owners to maintain authoritative definitions, and agree with the using departments on definitions, quality, access, update notifications, and reflection deadlines by category.

aib-c01-d4-007@1.title: Confirming the foundation's usability on-site through communication and continuity
aib-c01-d4-007@1.prompt: A logistics company installs an AI system for verifying delivery conditions at the destination for delivery workers. While testing in urban areas is quick, in remote mountainous regions with unstable internet, if the response cannot be displayed within one minute, delivery will be halted. Existing proven procedures for preventing misdelivery can be accessed offline on the device. Which foundation assessment should be performed before full deployment?

A.text: Measure response time and downtime based on the intended device and communication conditions in mountainous areas, then try switching to existing procedures if no response is received within the time limit.
A.explanation: It allows verification of actual constraints and the path to continue delivering goods.

B.text: Have delivery workers wait for the AI even in areas with unstable internet, and plan accordingly by extending all delivery deadlines.
B.explanation: It cannot avoid existing business hours and continuity constraints.

C.text: Measure the median response time using the headquarters' stable network, assuming it can be achieved in less than one minute across all delivery areas.
C.explanation: It does not evaluate unstable on-site communication conditions and downtime rates.

D.text: Determine the required model contract based on predicted monthly usage, and confirm device communication and alternative operations after public release.
D.explanation: It is not possible to verify foundation usability before public release.

learning.concept: Evaluate benchmarks during testing to match on-site network, equipment, latency, and alternative requirements during downtime.
learning.reason: Evaluate responses and timeouts based on the device and typical communication conditions. Also verify alternative procedures for when it cannot be used within time limits, aligning with on-site limitations.

aib-c01-d4-008@1.title: Give time and authority to the lead person at the scene
aib-c01-d4-008@1.prompt: The customer support assistance for the e-commerce company was approved by the department head. The promoters at each site are familiar with the field, but individual performance is determined solely by the number of support cases, and there is no working time available for training or improvement. What kind of action could the sponsor take to advance the implementation in this situation?

A.text: Set a target only for the number of change champions, without checking whether they have time for training and improvement.
A.explanation: The number of appointments does not indicate that the driving role is functioning.

B.text: Adjust the site manager and evaluation criteria, assign working hours and decision-making authority to the promotion officer, and establish a channel to convey issues to management.
B.explanation: Conditions for actual operation, and support for challenges that cannot be solved solely at the field level.

C.text: All promotion roles have been transferred to the central department, and the site operational leader is removed from decision-making on implementation.
C.explanation: Rooted in the site, cross-functional promotion weakens, and responsibilities of various departments become weaker.

D.text: Resend the company-wide email expressing agreement, and continue the training as an off-hours activity for the promotion team.
D.explanation: Evaluation and work hour restrictions remain unresolved.

learning.concept: Sponsors resolve cross-departmental budget and personnel competition, giving role and time to frontline drivers
learning.reason: Adjust the handling of site managers, objectives, and evaluations, and ensure that the facilitator has the time, scope, and reporting channels to focus on training and improvement as its main responsibility.

aib-c01-d4-009@1.title: Clarify responsibility for business outcomes in a team that goes beyond deployment
aib-c01-d4-009@1.prompt: The real estate management company is developing an AI for supporting repair requests across three departments. The model quality is managed by the technology department, the processing time is handled by the operations department, and the contract terms are overseen by legal affairs. In previous tests, no one was responsible for the overall processing results, and issues were left unresolved. Which team composition is the most appropriate?

A.text: Designate the person responsible for receiving results to the operations side, and define the evaluation and handover processes for technology, legal, and on-site teams as a team.
A.explanation: It is possible to combine the role of taking on all results and that of a specialized judge.

B.text: Move the entire process to the technical department, and from the field and legal department, collect only documents at the time of design completion.
B.explanation: Professional constraints were identified late, and the field does not participate in verifying business outcomes.

C.text: After receiving inquiries, a responsible person will be appointed. Participation from legal and operational teams is not required before the initial release.
C.explanation: The conditions required before the public release and on-site responses cannot be aligned.

D.text: The responsibility for the outcomes is evenly distributed among three departments, and unresolved conflicts will be postponed until the next quarter’s committee meeting.
D.explanation: Responsibilities and the intent to move forward remain ambiguous.

learning.concept: Establish a single responsibility for business outcomes and shipping decisions, and separate the outputs and decisions related to technology, legal, and operations.
learning.reason: After defining the individual responsibilities of each specialist in the cross-functional team, assign roles with accountability for business outcomes and public disclosure decisions, and clarify the assessment and resolution of obstacles.

aib-c01-d4-010@1.title: Separate the decisions and pending items and convey them to the site
aib-c01-d4-010@1.prompt: When it was announced that generative AI would be tested for press material creation by the communications department, there were rumors on the ground that “the editorial position will be eliminated next month.” What is certain is a 6-week trial period and that people will continue to provide public approvals, but the final placement after the trial is still undecided. Which explanation by the responsible person is the most appropriate?

A.text: Only the AI benchmark performance is disclosed, and the role and approval process for public release will not be explained until individual questions arise.
A.explanation: No direct response to staff concerns, and no business facts are conveyed.

B.text: Explain the trial period and public approval, indicate the pending deployments with judgment criteria and next sharing schedule, and accept questions and feedback.
B.explanation: Communicate confirmed matters, handle unconfirmed ones transparently, and gather concerns from the field.

C.text: To suppress anxiety, it is asserted that there will be no further role changes, regardless of the results of the trial.
C.explanation: It treats unresolved decisions as commitments that have already been made.

D.text: Since the configuration is not finalized, information dissemination will be stopped, and staff explanations will be provided only after the trial is completed.
D.explanation: Unable to correct rumors during an uncertain period, and cannot incorporate on-site opinions.

learning.concept: With implications for people, it specifies the timing and role, how to determine unresolved issues, and shows a two-way point of contact
learning.reason: Specify the determined scope of testing and roles, indicate that unconfirmed arrangements will be discussed with the evaluation method and consultation opportunities, and then show when to share the conclusions.

aib-c01-d4-011@1.title: Create a safe environment to test safely in a workplace where concerns about failure are strong
aib-c01-d4-011@1.prompt: A purchasing manager at a large trading company believes that reporting errors in generative AI will lower his evaluation, so he avoids participating in testing. He works in a department that has reflected past failures with new tools into personal evaluations. Which is the first intervention that helps overcome cultural barriers?

A.text: Ask the technical department to provide proxy usage, and start interviewing the purchasing manager only after a time reduction is achieved.
A.explanation: Do not address the reasons for anxiety, and reduce opportunities to learn from actual users.

B.text: After training, introduce a usage count ranking into personnel evaluations, and provide individual guidance to employees who do not participate.
B.explanation: Motivation to hide errors and usage results increases.

C.text: Test with pre-publication practice data and limited tasks, and have managers promise not to penalize reporting errors, and review cases together.
C.explanation: Show a working method where risks are minimized, reporting and learning do not cause negative evaluation.

D.text: Only report successful cases, and accept errors only after the adoption rate reaches the target.
D.explanation: Cannot create a situation where failures can be shared safely.

learning.concept: Do not force usage through punishment or rankings, provide reversible targets and responsibility support, and establish exercises where failures can be shared
learning.reason: Place trials within a range that does not affect customers or evaluations, and have managers explicitly state and implement using error reporting for improvement. Review cases together with users.

aib-c01-d4-012@1.title: Design AI education tailored to each department's operations
aib-c01-d4-012@1.prompt: In the manufacturing company, workers verify the generated inspection notes, managers use AI to approve appropriate uses, and data managers ensure proper handling of sensitive information. Everyone watched the same basic video, but mistakes in judgment continued during the trial. Which is the next training measure?

A.text: In a day-long hackathon, the team with the highest number of generated items will be recognized, and that count will serve as evidence of everyone’s judgment ability.
A.explanation: The number of documents and the skills for verification, approval, and information management are separate.

B.text: Unify videos with long viewing times and technical terms; if the completion rate of the videos is 100%, approval for practical use will be granted.
B.explanation: The fact of attending does not indicate the ability to make judgments by role.

C.text: Divided into role-specific exercises, workers conduct error correction, managers perform use reviews, and data managers evaluate information handling in practice.
C.explanation: Depending on the necessary decisions, it is possible to verify whether knowledge is applied in practice.

D.text: At the site, experts will make all decisions on behalf of others, so only legal affairs personnel need to receive training and complete the process.
D.explanation: The skills required of workers and approvers are not developed.

learning.concept: Separate the common aspects of basic knowledge from task-specific decisions, and measure practical skills based on whether someone attended the course or not
learning.reason: In addition to general awareness, each role handles the decisions it actually makes through safe exercises. Using exception handling and completion criteria, it evaluates whether the required skills are demonstrated.

aib-c01-d4-013@1.title: Re分配 work to tasks that AI and humans are skilled at
aib-c01-d4-013@1.prompt: The accommodation booking company can quickly organize potential schedule changes and room availability information using AI. Cancellations due to illness or family matters require consideration in conversation and exception judgment for refund conditions. Which task reassignment reduces the burden of phone interactions without increasing complaints?

A.text: AI is responsible for collecting candidates and organizing verification information, then passes exceptional cases to the handler for interview and refund decision-making.
A.explanation: Reduce the burden of routine tasks and maintain person-to-person interactions and discretion.

B.text: The person in charge first explains the refund rules, and the final decision on exceptional cases is left to AI without human intervention.
B.explanation: Automating processes that require human judgment and dialogue.

C.text: The agent is responsible for everything from understanding the situation to irreversible refusal to refund, while only checking the weekly summaries.
C.explanation: The role of understanding customer circumstances and considering exceptions will be lost.

D.text: All responses are still handled by humans as before, and the AI is only allowed to generate a summary of the conversation after completion.
D.explanation: Summaries are useful, but the automation of usable candidate collection remains unused.

learning.concept: Standardized organization is handled by AI, considerations for emotions and contractual exception judgments are assigned to humans, and the conditions involving human intervention are clarified
learning.reason: Let AI handle information collection and candidate creation, while inquiries and discretionary decisions are carried out by those with authority. Include both confirmed facts and unclear points from the handover.

aib-c01-d4-014@1.title: Proceed to the next stage after determining the success or failure of the experiment
aib-c01-d4-014@1.prompt: The procurement department conducted experiments with AI to extract the key points of the instructions. While time savings for standard projects exceeded the target, extracting exception conditions did not meet the quality threshold set before the start. The department intends to announce at the next trade show that it will release the results the following month. Which is the appropriate decision based on a repetitive process?

A.text: We will treat the exceptional defects seriously and terminate the current trial. The results obtained from regular cases will not be carried over for the evaluation of next round candidates.
A.explanation: There are options to utilize the value gained from regular projects, such as excluding exceptions.

B.text: It will be officially released, and exceptions will be transferred to the person in charge of the next model. The scope for customers will not change until the revision is completed.
B.explanation: Make the areas where necessary quality is not achieved available.

C.text: Since the time limit exceeded the target, the quality threshold will be lowered later, and exceptions will also be officially released within the same range.
C.explanation: Change multiple outcome conditions conveniently as pre-determined.

D.text: Analyze the reasons for failure in exceptions, adjust the design or scope, and re-validate. Publish within the scope that meets the agreed conditions.
D.explanation: Use the experimental results for the next iteration and proceed to the next stage under explicit conditions.

learning.concept: Determine the transition conditions for concept, experiment, and deployment, and revert to a previous version to correct and revalidate any unexpected issues
learning.reason: Prioritize the success criteria for the experiment from the time of publication, identify the causes of failure, reevaluate the design and target, and decide on the next step after revalidation.

aib-c01-d4-015@1.title: Check if the short-term results obtained in a trial can be transferred to other sites
aib-c01-d4-015@1.prompt: The warehousing company improved the on-the-spot processing rate using AI to assist in the submission verification at one facility. Only this facility has standardized formats, while other facilities have different formats and approval procedures. Which is the next step to translate short-term results into a company-wide improvement?

A.text: Unless the first site achieves results, the trial results will not be used until the format for all sites is fully consistent.
A.explanation: The opportunity to design for regional differences is lost as we progress through stages.

B.text: Have each site create a completely different AI, and only share the cases from sites with a large number of users as success stories.
B.explanation: Failed processing cannot be reused, and compatibility with different locations cannot be measured.

C.text: Apply the initial site setup to all sites in one go, and the processing rate on the day will only be compared to the company average.
C.explanation: Due to differences in formatting and approval processes, defects may occur at specific locations, but they can be masked on average.

D.text: Standardize common comparison processes, and separate site-specific formats and approvals through settings. Verify results and quality sequentially at sites with different conditions.
D.explanation: By reusing early methods, constraints and effects during migration can be evaluated.

learning.concept: Extract the core that can be reused from short-term results, and gradually validate it at different locations with similar conditions and different conditions.
learning.reason: Separate the compatible reconciliation process from the formats and approvals that need to be changed per region, and gradually verify effectiveness and suitability at different locations with similar conditions versus those with different conditions.

aib-c01-d4-016@1.title: The specialized organization and on-site team share the responsibility for company-wide deployment.
aib-c01-d4-016@1.prompt: In large wholesale companies, multiple branches create AI review forms and monitoring functions with different contents separately. On the other hand, those who are not inventory staff cannot assess the real impact of incorrect proposals. What is the division of labor when establishing a central AI specialist organization?

A.text: Have each branch build all its own technology and controls. The central AI team collects success stories once a year.
A.explanation: Having each branch build its own controls leaves the duplication in common reviews and monitoring in place.

B.text: The central office provides common review procedures, evaluation components, and infrastructure, while branches have their own definitions of exceptions and business outcomes. Both parties share cases to improve standards.
B.explanation: It can balance reuse and regional operational responsibilities.

C.text: The central organization only specifies the use of a specific model, and does not handle review criteria or the reuse of evaluation components.
C.explanation: Just standardizing models cannot reduce duplication in review and monitoring.

D.text: The central organization takes decisions on inventory not only for the common foundation but also for each branch, and the branch managers report the quantity they followed the instructions on by the end of the month.
D.explanation: Knowledge at the site and responsibility for business outcomes are not reflected in operations.

learning.concept: Center of Excellence manages reusable infrastructure and control, allowing sites to own business quality and outcomes
learning.reason: A specialized organization establishes common review, evaluation methods, and standard components, while knowledgeable on-site teams handle local operations results, exceptions, and operational decisions.

aib-c01-d4-017@1.title: Tracking long-term outcomes including those who have stopped using it
aib-c01-d4-017@1.prompt: After the introduction of estimation support, satisfaction levels are high in optional surveys on the screen. However, in some branches, utilization rates are low, and there is little survey response from people in those branches. Which option is most appropriate as a mechanism to understand long-term value and challenges?

A.text: Exclude branches with low utilization rates from the evaluation target and calculate long-term effects only for branches that continue to use it.
A.explanation: It is impossible to analyze the conditions under which usage does not stabilize.

B.text: Regularly ask reasons from both users who continue to use and those who stop, and review them in conjunction with completion time and quality trends of the usage target.
B.explanation: It allows tracking not only users who answer easily but also business outcomes.

C.text: Fix the satisfaction level at the time of introduction and later only monitor the number of inference executions.
C.explanation: It does not fully measure the reasons for continued use and changes in business outcomes.
