D.text: Increase the number of survey displays on the screen and estimate the value of all branches based solely on overall company-level satisfaction scores.
D.explanation: It fails to reach those who do not use it, and branch-specific challenges are not visible.

learning.concept: Instead of relying solely on voluntary responses from regular users, continuously monitor usage cessation and business outcomes by department
learning.reason: If only examining users, it is impossible to understand reasons for leaving after the introduction. Divide the target by branch and usage status, conduct interviews, and continuously verify along with completion time and quality of work.

aib-c01-d4-018@1.title: Select acceptance criteria to move prototype to production quality
aib-c01-d4-018@1.prompt: The prototype complaint classification AI met quality standards with representative data. The prototype settings are on the developer account, and the revision history and alert recipients are not set up yet. Choose two tasks that the team must complete before incorporating the system into regular operations.

A.text: Establish quality and availability monitoring, response time and shift schedules, and alternative procedures, and practice functionality during outages before going live.
A.explanation: To verify whether the operator can actually monitor and maintain the operation.

B.text: Appoint owners for formal deployment, and move to a distribution/approval process that can replicate the evaluated version and settings.
B.explanation: Can eliminate operation dependent on personal accounts or memories.

C.text: Since the prototype accuracy meets the standards, setup and troubleshooting will continue to be handled solely by the developer’s personal account.
C.explanation: Cannot guarantee the responsibilities and access needed for continuous operation and recovery.

D.text: To accelerate formalization, changes to settings other than core operations should also be made so that anyone can apply them directly in production.
D.explanation: Without approval and tracking, changes cannot maintain quality.

E.text: For the first time in the first month after operation, determine the recipients for quality degradation and failure notifications.
E.explanation: It is necessary to be able to identify and correct issues from the first day.

learning.concept: In addition to the test creation results, acceptance conditions also require the involvement of those responsible for formal deployment, monitoring, failure exercises, and approval of deliverables.
learning.reason: A non-personal, version-managed distribution and approval process, along with monitoring and disaster recovery exercises handled by duty officers, become the basic conditions for transitioning from experimentation to continuous operation.

aib-c01-d4-019@1.title: Investigate the impact of simultaneous use across the entire company on existing operations
aib-c01-d4-019@1.prompt: The three departments of the group company share an AI infrastructure. The individual load of each department meets the response targets, but at the end of the month, the peaks of all three departments coincide. Only the department handling closing processes directly leads to timeouts, while the other two departments have processes that can be postponed. Which tests should be conducted before full company deployment?

A.text: Replicate the expected peak load, ensure the capacity and priority for closing processing, and try department-specific targets that include control of deferred departments.
A.explanation: Find competition through aggregation, and verify operations that require continuity.

B.text: The average processing time per day is fixed at a limit; any processing exceeding this limit will be postponed to the next day, regardless of the importance of the task.
B.explanation: Fails to comply with the termination process that could lead to breach.

C.text: Only if the department handling closing processes is delayed, can we increase the infrastructure starting from the end of the next month.
C.explanation: Has not verified whether the deadline can be met during the first simultaneous peak.

D.text: The average response from individual tests across all departments is averaged, and if within the target, all operations will be processed with the same priority by the end of the month.
D.explanation: Resource competition due to simultaneous use, and no deadlines can be confirmed by department.

learning.concept: Replicates the resource competition at simultaneous peaks that are not visible in individual department tests, and determines the priority capacity for critical operations and conditions for additional expansion
learning.reason: Recreate the peak of each department simultaneously, and measure the deadlines and delays by department. Ensure sufficient capacity for closing processes, and control deferred processes to verify quality.

aib-c01-d4-020@1.title: Linking Idea Collection to Continuous Learning on the Field
aib-c01-d4-020@1.prompt: During AI presentations for branches across the country, many prototypes were created. However, few centers continue to improve after six months, and without experts visiting, the field cannot practice evaluation. Which policy should be prioritized in the next talent development phase?

A.text: Ensure that center instructors can conduct exercises using safe materials, evaluation criteria, and consultation channels, thereby maintaining continuous improvement.
A.explanation: Avoid relying on constant expert visits; retain local capabilities for learning and improvement.

B.text: Stop evaluation exercises until experts visit each center, then start unified company-wide use.
B.explanation: Unable to maintain continuous on-the-fly practice.

C.text: Hold monthly company-wide presentations, with the number of submitted prototypes serving as the sole indicator of success.
C.explanation: Cannot verify whether the ability to continuously evaluate and improve has been developed.

D.text: Distribute the best prototype directly for nationwide use, ignoring branch-specific evaluations and learning.
D.explanation: Just distributing technology does not foster judgment of suitability or improvement capabilities.

learning.concept: Instead of using the number of prototypes as a measure of success, focus on developing the ability for on-site instructors to conduct safe verification and review
learning.reason: Train instructors locally, provide training materials, evaluation criteria, and consultation channels. Measure whether on-site practice and improvement continue independently.

aib-c01-d1-022@1.title: Choose the type of prediction needed for assigning workers
aib-c01-d1-022@1.prompt: The shipping company wants to estimate the required working time for each order and assign staff based on the total daily working hours. The working time ranges from more than 15 minutes to less than 9 hours, and even within the same “long time” category, the required number of staff varies. Historical product features and past working hours are available. Which is the most appropriate purpose for learning?

A.text: Secure orders based on the similarity in product descriptions, and generate representative product names for each group.
A.explanation: Even by creating a group, it is not guaranteed that specific working hours for each member will be obtained.

B.text: In regression using past performance time, the work time per order is estimated as a number, and the total error is compared with the allocation results.
B.explanation: We can provide the required values based on the assignee’s allocation.

C.text: Classify orders as long-term and short-term, and aggregate only the number of long-term orders per day.
C.explanation: Even for long-term projects, the required time varies, and it is difficult to determine the total allocation based solely on the number of items.

D.text: Generate work procedures from order notes, and use the text length as a substitute for work time.
D.explanation: No relationship between article length and actual processing time has been learned, so there is no basis for predicting the necessary values.

learning.concept: Distinguish between threshold excess classification and continuous variable regression, and select the specific predicted values required by the downstream process
learning.reason: Using regression with actual time as the correct value, the numerical predictions for each order can be summed up. In category prediction, differences within the same category cannot be estimated.

aib-c01-d1-023@1.title: Find reports of the same type with different words
aib-c01-d1-023@1.prompt: The support desk of the machine sales company has a field for free-texting symptoms. Even if the descriptions differ (e.g., “easily stops” vs. “doesn’t move”), we want to display similar past reports and relevant departments as candidates. On the ground, actual reports are opened for verification as the basis for these candidates. What is the appropriate approach?

A.text: Convert the report into a meaning vector, search for similar past reports, and display the original report and department.
A.explanation: While handling rephrasings, the results can be verified against the original material.

B.text: Generate a fictional report without referring to past reports, so that the model experiences the same symptoms.
B.explanation: Cannot present a verifiable actual report as a candidate.

C.text: Compress the current report and return a past report that exactly matches the short summary.
C.explanation: Inconsistent reports of the same type cannot be captured in a fully identical manner.

D.text: Search for reports that are only similar in word count and report length, and present them as cases with the same symptoms.
D.explanation: The similarity in text does not match the similarity in symptoms.

learning.concept: The purpose of using embedding is to distinguish search results from generation or strict matching rules used to update correct documents.
learning.reason: Search for similar past reports that express the meaning of the text, and return them along with references to the original text. There is no need to generate new descriptions of the cause of the failure.

aib-c01-d1-024@1.title: Find cases where the import is new but the business data is old
aib-c01-d1-024@1.prompt: The cold storage delivery monitoring AI recommends inspections using the cargo temperature measured within 30 minutes. After a communication outage, old measurement values from the delivery terminal are sent together, and if only the loading time is considered, it appears as new data. The measurement time recorded by the terminal can be used, and any time discrepancies are monitored separately. What is a way to verify the quality of the data used for inspection decisions?

A.text: If the number of records delivered within a certain time period is the same as usual for a week, then all vehicles are considered to meet the freshness criteria.
A.explanation: Old data may arrive all at once, increasing the count, or some vehicles might be old.

B.text: For each vehicle, select the latest value at an appropriate measurement time. If the difference from the judgment time exceeds 30 minutes, switch to on-site verification.
B.explanation: To use the actual observation time and the time for business decisions, data that arrived late is not mistakenly used.

C.text: Subtract the estimated time of communication interruption uniformly from the intake time, and use it instead of the terminal measurement time.
C.explanation: The actual measurement time can be used. If the communication interruption varies by vehicle, the estimated time does not reflect individual freshness.

D.text: Use only records of successful import in the last 30 minutes, and set the latest temperature at the end for each vehicle.
D.explanation: Even immediately after pickup, the measurement might have been done before the communication was interrupted, and the arrival order may not necessarily be the measurement order.

learning.concept: Distinguish the intake time and occurrence time, and verify the freshness that can be used for judgment in order with the event time
learning.reason: Business innovation is determined based on the measurement time. Measurements that arrive late in random order are not treated as new values; vehicles that do not meet the freshness standard are sent for alternative verification.

aib-c01-d1-025@1.title: Ensure processing continues even when multiple AI systems take over
aib-c01-d1-025@1.prompt: In air cargo exception investigations, customs record collection and warehouse inventory checks are performed with separate permissions. Both results are necessary for a decision, and re-processing the same inquiry would cause duplicate notifications to the responsible personnel. Select two appropriate designs for supporting with AI agents.

A.text: Assign permissions to specific responsible persons per investigation, and create a coordinator who only develops solutions when both results are available.
A.explanation: Meets the requirement of separate permissions and merging of results.

B.text: Always start each investigation from the beginning when interrupted, and do not record previous notifications or progress.
B.explanation: Cannot prevent duplicate business communications, and it is impossible to understand the processing status.

C.text: Grant all investigation personnel the authority to change both records, ensuring consistent results regardless of which person handles it.
C.explanation: Breaks the constraints of separate permissions.

D.text: Do not inform the relevant person of progress; consider a case resolved once one result is obtained.
D.explanation: Does not use the other result required for resolution.

E.text: Record completion status and results per case ID; when interrupted, only unfinished tasks are resumed. Transfer overdue cases to the responsible person.
E.explanation: Prevents duplicate notifications and allows distinction between unfinished and transferred states.

learning.concept: Separate specialized tasks and coordination for operations, along with assignment and stop conditions based on shared status
learning.reason: Distribute investigations with different permissions by case, merge progress and results linked to case IDs. Resume only unfinished tasks and define conditions for completion and handover to personnel.

aib-c01-d1-026@1.title: Even if the input distribution is stable, it is determined that the prediction relationship changes.
aib-c01-d1-026@1.prompt: A membership service predicts cancellations from usage frequency and inquiry history. After a new temporary membership pause is introduced, the input distribution remains nearly unchanged from launch. Low-usage members who previously canceled as predicted increasingly use the pause option and retain their memberships. What should the operations team prioritize?

A.text: Collect data to determine continuation and termination under the new system, and compare performance and predictions by usage frequency to judge the need for changes.
A.explanation: The results for the features can be evaluated according to business definitions.

B.text: Only correct the distribution of inputs to the original distribution, and adjust the prediction without using withdrawal records.
B.explanation: What has changed is the way of leaving the service for input.

C.text: Treat a temporary pause and an actual cancellation as the same outcome, without checking whether the business should distinguish them.
C.explanation: When summarizing results that differ from the goal, the performance to be measured changes.

D.text: Since the input distribution is stable, it is determined that there is no change in performance, and the comparison of account termination records is completed.
D.explanation: The expected changes cannot be detected solely by the distribution of inputs.

learning.concept: Instead of proving performance through input distribution stability, it focuses on the changes in the meaning and relationship of results for the same features
learning.reason: Even if the input distribution is the same, the correspondence between features and observed results can vary depending on the system. Evaluate the relationship and accuracy based on the performance of the new system, and revalidate the model or objectives as needed.

aib-c01-d1-027@1.title: Divide the process into steps with ambiguous priorities
aib-c01-d1-027@1.prompt: The city’s public relations team wants to provide concise instructions for residents regarding the usage conditions of public facilities. When given the instruction “concise, but include all necessary details,” sometimes the application deadline is omitted, while other times the word count may be exceeded. The application deadline and target recipients must never be omitted, but only the background explanation can be omitted. What is the most effective way to change the prompt?

A.text: Ask to extract the deadline and target first, use them as required fields, remove content from the background to adjust word count, and finally verify the required fields.
A.explanation: The relative priority of constraints and check procedures are specific.

B.text: Add an example of a detailed background explanation; if it is similar in length to the example guide, it is considered appropriate for the number of characters.
B.explanation: No instructions for prioritizing or checking required items to maintain the specified number of characters.

C.text: Only tighten the character limit, and let the model decide what to remove.
C.explanation: There is no mechanism to avoid losing the most important condition.

D.text: Repeat the same general instructions multiple times to meet both the word count and required information.
D.explanation: It remains unclear what to keep and in what order to adjust.

learning.concept: For generating text that meets multiple operational constraints, clarify activities, priorities, and verification procedures
learning.reason: Specifies the order of extracting necessary items, prioritizing, permitted omissions, and final verification, making it easier to meet both the required items and character count in the input.

aib-c01-d1-028@1.title: Determine the capacity that fits within the context in actual documents
aib-c01-d1-028@1.prompt: The legal team passes one English, one Japanese, and one table-rich version of the same application form to the AI each. They want to limit the document length according to the model’s maximum limit. Currently, they use the same conversion rate for the total character count, but the document format and character types differ. What is a reliable way to determine the limit value?

A.text: Count representative examples of each language and table format using the planned model, and estimate the remaining space including common instructions and output capacity.
A.explanation: It allows you to examine the types of input and the entire context that will be used in production.

B.text: If the file byte count is equal, it is assumed that the token count is also equal, and the same capacity is used for all models.
B.explanation: The handling of character splitting and formats varies between models and content.

C.text: Estimate all languages and tables using the average conversion rate for English documents, and accept the input if the average is below the limit.
C.explanation: Input that deviates from the average value due to other languages or table formats cannot be protected.

D.text: Measure only the character count of the response; if the required response is short, no limit is set for input.
D.explanation: There remains a possibility that the input itself exceeds the model’s limit.

learning.concept: Evaluate the maximum cases based on the token count of the model and the actual input structure, rather than relying on a fixed character count
learning.reason: Even with the same character count, the number of tokens changes depending on language, symbols, and table structure. Count the input combined with documents and instructions using the actual model, and consider the reserved capacity for output.

aib-c01-d1-029@1.title: Separate the prediction probability from the guarantees for individual cases
aib-c01-d1-029@1.prompt: The maintenance department plans inspections based on the failure probability. After adjusting the predictions for the equipment covered by the contract, about 80% of the equipment predicted to fail within the deadline actually failed. When the prediction value for a certain equipment was 80%, which of the following is an appropriate explanation to the responsible person?

A.text: It shows that the accuracy rate of detecting faults across all machines is 80% per device.
A.explanation: The individual prediction probabilities differ in scale from the aggregated classification accuracy.

B.text: Indicates that a failure occurs when 80% of the remaining time until the deadline has passed.
B.explanation: The probability does not represent the expected time of failure.

C.text: It is interpreted that 80% of the equipment is already faulty, and the remaining 20% is outside the prediction scope.
C.explanation: It is not a level of failure, but the possibility that the defined event will occur.

D.text: Similarly, for multiple devices where 80% was predicted, it is interpreted that about 80% will fail. The failure of individual devices cannot be determined yet.
D.explanation: Indicates the meaning of probability correction for the assumed population.

learning.concept: The corrected probability represents the frequency in a population with similar predictions.
learning.reason: The 80% that is properly corrected refers to the proportion occurring in representative groups with the same predicted values. It does not guarantee individual devices, and the priority decision for inspections also takes into account the impact during failures.

aib-c01-d1-030@1.title: Select the input for video analysis where the order of operations is required
aib-c01-d1-030@1.prompt: The manufacturing company wants to detect deviations in assembly procedures. Even if the same three parts and tools are shown, performing two operations in reverse order will result in defects. There are video footage, finished product photos, and daily process summaries on site. Which is the most appropriate trial input?

A.text: Use the finished product photo as the input, and assume the order is correct if all parts are visible.
A.explanation: It is not possible to restore the operation order from the same final state.

B.text: Keep the continuous video of the target task and time order, and evaluate the detection within the intervals confirmed by a person as correct or reverse.
B.explanation: It contains both order identification information and the correct answer.

C.text: Use only daily work counts and number of parts, and determine which task was performed in reverse order based on the daily ratio.
C.explanation: Daily summaries do not retain the time order of individual tasks.

D.text: Keep only clear static images of tools from the video and remove the time to classify whether tools are present or not.
D.explanation: There is video evidence, but the time and continuity are omitted.

learning.concept: When the time order of continuous video is used as a judgment criterion, single frames or summary values are insufficient
learning.reason: In addition to the presence of parts, it is necessary to distinguish between the before and after operations. Evaluate using video segments that preserve the time sequence and records that confirm the order of procedures.

aib-c01-d1-031@1.title: Identifying Items Not Obtained During Prediction
aib-c01-d1-031@1.prompt: A wholesale company wants to predict whether delivery will be delayed the next day at the time of order. Past records include the order time, destination, and refund categories after delivery completion. Including these refund categories significantly improves the accuracy of history verification. Which is the first step in re-evaluating the model?

A.text: Since refund categories are related to delays, we maintain verification accuracy by assuming the shipping staff will temporarily input these values.
A.explanation: The refund categories and temporary inputs are not the same information, so the original accuracy cannot be expected.

B.text: Anonymize the order time and randomly split the history rows, keeping only the refund categories.
B.explanation: Random splitting does not ensure that information unavailable during prediction can be used.

C.text: Convert the refund categories to numerical codes to make them harder to identify, and remove the item names from the description.
C.explanation: Value conversion and presentation methods do not eliminate the use of post-event information.

D.text: Limit to items available at the time of order, and exclude the refund categories determined after delivery from input for verification.
D.explanation: Both operation and history evaluation achieve the same information acquisition conditions.

learning.concept: Values obtained later in history can be excluded from input, even if they are available there
learning.reason: Including items that exist in records but are not obtained during actual prediction makes the accuracy appear higher using post-event information. Verify again using items that can be referenced at the time of order.

aib-c01-d1-032@1.title: Separate the adoption of common vocabulary from verification targets
aib-c01-d1-032@1.prompt: Two AI contractors use the terms 'learning', 'inference', and 'update' in different documents. One proposal adopts a terminology guide derived from ISO, so it states that customer services fall under third-party certification. Choose two actions for the procurement department.

A.text: Since the provider standardizes the terminology, verification documents apply only to sales materials without requiring disclosure.
A.explanation: Sales materials cannot determine whether the target organization, product, and operation are included.

B.text: For services claiming certification, verify the target organization and scope of the certificate, and check if the proposed tasks are included.
B.explanation: The use of standard vocabulary and the subject of certification can be confirmed separately.

C.text: The contract does not list each company’s terminology; if the terms are similar, they are treated as synonyms.
C.explanation: Interpretations may deviate when the contract assumptions or scope of work differ.

D.text: If the same terms are used, it is determined that individual services and contract content also fall under the same certification scope.
D.explanation: The adoption of vocabulary does not prove the scope of review.

E.text: Define the terms used in the contract based on a common terminology guide, and record the differences in meaning between the contractors.
E.explanation: This reduces discrepancies in expectations due to word differences.

learning.concept: Adherence to terminology standards and third-party certification for specific organizations/scope require separate evidence
learning.reason: Use common vocabulary to determine the definitions in both contracts. For cases where certification is claimed separately, verify the organization, service, and scope via certificates.

aib-c01-d1-033@1.title: In operations where correct conditions are explicitly defined, reliance on history is not needed
aib-c01-d1-033@1.prompt: A library wants to allocate lending slots for its mobile library service among branches. Regulations and the agreement establish the per-branch caps, priorities, total cap, and tie-breaking rules. Many historical allocations reflect the previous agreement. Which solution gives every user the same result under the new agreement?

A.text: Clarify the limits, priority, and tie-breaking rules, and allocate using deterministic constrained optimization to check all conditions.
A.explanation: Directly meets the conditions and reproducibility of the new agreement.

B.text: Give the generative AI the original text of the agreement, and adopt the option with tables that is easier to read among multiple answers.
B.explanation: In terms of appearance, it is not possible to verify compliance with constraints or reproducibility under the same conditions.

C.text: Learn from the old allocation as the correct answer, and confirm the achievement of the new agreement based on the match rate with past allocations.
C.explanation: Recreating performance based on old protocols does not indicate compliance with new conditions.

D.text: Instead of using correct conditions, group branches by similarity and automatically assign the same slot to each group.
D.explanation: Similar branches may not necessarily have the same priority or limits under the agreement.

learning.concept: The allocations that can be determined based on known constraints and objectives avoid learning from past decisions and serve as candidates for decisive optimization
learning.reason: Specify the determined constraints and optimization objectives, as well as the handling of coincidences, to determine the allocation. There is no need to learn the old policy.

aib-c01-d1-034@1.title: Assign deadlines and transition conditions to the evaluation tool
aib-c01-d1-034@1.prompt: The Product Department wants to use an external AI image classification tool that is still under evaluation for just 3 weeks. While testing with published samples is allowed, images before productization cannot be used. What appropriate management measures should be taken to ensure no operations remain after the evaluator’s transfer?

A.text: It shall be considered permanent approval at the start of the trial period, and the content can be revoked only if necessary after a review.
A.explanation: Give unapproved ranges to the evaluation tool first.

B.text: Register only the tool name in the company-wide AI list, and make it available to all departments while the evaluation is ongoing.
B.explanation: No restrictions on use, responsible person, data, or deadline.

C.text: Register evaluators and deadlines for handling public samples, stop usage upon the deadline, and decide on formal approval or termination based on the evaluation results.
C.explanation: The scope during evaluation and handling after completion become clear.

D.text: Continue using only the evaluation team’s personal accounts, and after a transfer, gather usage history to obtain formal approval.
D.explanation: The continued use and scope of investment cannot be managed by the organization.

learning.concept: Limit evaluation exceptions by use, data, and deadline, and transition to formalization or termination based on the review results
learning.reason: Register the scope and expiration date of exceptions, owner, and evaluation evidence, and define the conditions for automatic expiration and transition to approved methods.

aib-c01-d1-035@1.title: Separating failures in obtaining and generating evidence
aib-c01-d1-035@1.prompt: The customer-facing AI gave a wrong answer regarding the compatibility of special parts in the approved catalog. In a complaint, it answered correctly when the specific part was directly entered into the input, but in normal search, that part did not appear among the top candidates. What is the most appropriate next verification?

A.text: Remove part numbers from the catalog, so the models can be answered using more general product knowledge.
A.explanation: Loss of information that identifies compatibility, making it difficult to obtain the relevant materials.

B.text: Adjust the model using data that includes only questions answered correctly during validation, and do not check the search results.
B.explanation: The confirmed failure point—the search issue—remains.

C.text: Set it to prolong the model's response time, and if there is a detailed explanation, the compatibility answer is also considered correct.
C.explanation: The stated amount does not prove that the basis was obtained.

D.text: Measure the accuracy of correct sections in the question set, and reflect part numbers and aliases in the search. Re-evaluate the correctness of answers after improvement.
D.explanation: Both search and generation can be verified using separate metrics.

learning.concept: Ensure that answers can be provided when the correct information is given, and improve the lack of knowledge on the knowledge- acquisition side
learning.reason: We can answer when the correct rationale is provided, so first we measure individually whether the rationale can be obtained, and improve search and indexing.

aib-c01-d1-036@1.title: Explain why the same learning method can produce different results
aib-c01-d1-036@1.prompt: The model for estimating device priorities was retrained with half a year of new performance data, using the same learning method. When the same inputs were provided, the new version of the priorities changed. The person in charge believes that since the method was not changed, the results should also be the same. Which is the appropriate explanation?

A.text: The prediction difference for the same input indicates that the device retrained the model during execution.
A.explanation: Even the difference between old and new trained models can change the predictions.

B.text: If the input column names and order are the same, only the learning method determines the post-hoc prediction results.
B.explanation: The results also depend on the learned values.

C.text: Even with the same learning method, the internal state of the model derived from data can change, so even with the same input, there can be differences in predictions.
C.explanation: Properly distinguishes between techniques and learning outcomes.

D.text: When the prediction changes, it is determined that the new model is correct, and past data is not used for validation.
D.explanation: The difference does not prove improvement. A comparison with the target performance is required.

learning.concept: The learning algorithm is the procedure for creating a model, and a model obtained from different data may yield different results.
learning.reason: Even if the learning procedures are the same, changes in learning data can result in different coefficients and conditions. The old and new models are compared as versions, and the business impact of the differences is evaluated.

aib-c01-d1-037@1.title: When supplementing testing with generated examples, measure performance using real data
aib-c01-d1-037@1.prompt: In developing a model for distributing failure reports, there is insufficient training data for rare reports. Business experts possess few real examples, so a generative AI was suggested to create examples with different representations. Which method is the most appropriate for using synthetic examples?

A.text: Treat only synthetic examples as correct examples, and assign examples created from the same generation instructions to training and testing.
A.explanation: It is impossible to measure the discrepancy between actual occurrences, text content, and difficulty levels.

B.text: Experts use synthetic examples that have been verified as valid as a supplement for training and resilience verification, while reserving approved real examples for independent evaluation.
B.explanation: The role of generated data is limited, allowing performance to be measured under conditions close to real environments.

C.text: Synthetic examples are considered equivalent to the number of rare reports, and the warning threshold for predicted values is determined based on the ratio of synthetic examples.
C.explanation: The number of generated cases does not reflect the frequency of occurrences in real environments.

D.text: Since evaluating real examples is difficult, the confidence level provided by the distribution model itself is used as the condition for passing the test.
D.explanation: It is not possible to assess business performance without comparing with correct answers.

learning.concept: Separating the creation of synthetic examples by generative AI from the evaluation of predictive models in real environments
learning.reason: Generative AI can be used to expand representation examples, but the synthesized distributions may not represent actual business operations. Use synthetic examples as a test aid and reserve real examples for independent evaluation to measure accuracy.

aib-c01-d1-038@1.title: Separate the values obtained from text recognition from the table structure
aib-c01-d1-038@1.prompt: I want to extract pairs of items and quantities from a two-column order PDF. Text recognition can read both numbers, but when concatenated in the order of the text, an example appears where the quantity on the right column is linked to the item on the left column. What should I change to keep the corresponding items and quantities?

A.text: Targeting the character recognition rate, order forms where each character is correctly read will be automatically registered as a whole.
A.explanation: Even with a high text recognition rate, errors in combining separate items and quantities still occur.

B.text: Put the numbers in a separate list, sort them in ascending order, and assign them from the top of the item list.
B.explanation: The original relationships are lost due to sorting.

C.text: Extract groups by preserving location, table matrix, and page references, and perform testing to match them with the original counterparts.
C.explanation: The extraction can be verified using information from both text and structure.

D.text: We will only accept orders in which the characters in the signature column can be accurately extracted, and we do not verify the matching of items and quantities.
D.explanation: Cannot verify the correspondence in the table for the quality of the signature column.

learning.concept: In forms where the correspondence between text and matrix is lost without symbols, the position and structure are preserved for verification
learning.reason: Even if the text obtained from the PDF is correct, it does not guarantee a logical correspondence of items. Use the table matrix and positions to link items and quantities in the same row, and verify it against the original text.

aib-c01-d1-039@1.title: Evaluating future predictions based on past training conditions
aib-c01-d1-039@1.prompt: A model was designed to predict monthly demand during the update month. Sales data from the past three years includes seasonal variations and changes in corporate contracts within the year. Based on the accuracy of random splitting including the latest data, a proposal was made to use it starting next month. Which is a validation close to actual operation?

A.text: We will use only the oldest period for validation, and use the model learned from subsequent contract changes to estimate accuracy next month.
A.explanation: It is an evaluation for predicting from the future to the past, and differs from the order of actual operation.

B.text: Learn and validate using the latest confirmed data, and consider as passed if the output for the same project is reproducible.
B.explanation: With the information used for learning, we cannot determine the performance during unknown periods.

C.text: Starting from multiple past cut-off points, it learns only before each point and predicts the subsequent period to compare results.
C.explanation: It can reproduce the conditions of the available information at that point.

D.text: Randomly split across years, and include the history from the following month after the validation row into the learning process to compare average values.
D.explanation: We use future performance data that cannot be used at the prediction time point for learning.

learning.concept: Split the time-series model to exclude future information, and use shifted timestamps to assess future performance
learning.reason: Only the history available at each prediction time point is used for learning, and the subsequent period is used for evaluation. By changing the starting point, we can verify resilience to seasonal or contract changes.

aib-c01-d1-040@1.title: Determine the scope of automation using a few exceptions per example
aib-c01-d1-040@1.prompt: In the purchase process for spare parts, standard applications can be processed using the existing system. Special-purpose applications occur a few times a month, and the criteria for decision-making among staff vary. Only the final result remains in past records. What should be done to establish standards and make exception responses reproducible?

A.text: Leave the exceptional judgment to an experienced person, and simply add the result to the existing records.
A.explanation: Even though the difference on-site has decreased, it cannot be reproduced to be verified by other team members.

B.text: Register exceptions and the reasons, and have the responsible parties confirm their decisions. Consider automating the judgment process once the criteria and evaluation cases are available.
B.explanation: For areas where human judgment is required, it can be improved based on evidence that can be verified later.

C.text: The review criteria of existing standard applications are applied directly to special uses as well.
C.explanation: Without considering specific reasons for special use, even if reproducibility exists, the results may not be valid.

D.text: The remaining approval results are used to train the classifier, maintaining the approval rate per responsible person.
D.explanation: To reproduce the unexplained variability, it is not possible to align the standards among the responsible parties.

learning.concept: When the correct answer and purpose are not determined, do not rush with exception checking—focus instead on refining the recording and review processes.
learning.reason: Define the criteria for using exceptions with the responsible person, and individuals should record the reasons and results for comparison. Acceptance and recording are handled using existing methods, and automation of decision-making can be considered after evaluation based on the same criteria.

aib-c01-d1-041@1.title: Investigate the reasons for the change in the number of alerts step by step
aib-c01-d1-041@1.prompt: The number of AI alerts increased starting from the day when administrators increased the weekly inspection cycles and lowered the threshold value, and the rate of correct predictions per incident decreased. The model version is the same, and post-event failure records can also be obtained. What is a way to determine if the model has degraded?

A.text: The model is re-trained simply because the accuracy rate has decreased, and no other checks are performed except keeping the threshold.
A.explanation: Has not distinguished between the impact of changes on the user side and model degradation.

B.text: Return the threshold to its previous value, and if the number of alerts is the same as before, no performance check will be performed.
B.explanation: Just the same number of items does not ensure that the model is correct in the same proportion.

C.text: Compare predictions for the old and new periods using the same threshold value and ranking metric based on confirmed performance, and separate them by the number of alerts due to frame changes.
C.explanation: The performance changes of the model can be investigated under the same evaluation criteria.

D.text: The increased number of alerts is considered the degradation amount, and new projects selected through the expansion of inspection slots are always excluded from accuracy statistics.
D.explanation: The reason for increasing the alerts, and the performance in new projects, cannot be verified.

learning.concept: Measure the prediction rankings and correction changes separately from the operational threshold changes
learning.reason: When the threshold is lowered, the hit rate of the selection set can change even if the model is the same. Compare predictions using the same threshold or ranking performance, and analyze the effects of operational rules separately.

aib-c01-d1-042@1.title: Linking the reasons required for comparison even when dividing multiple documents
aib-c01-d1-042@1.prompt: The compliance department wants to identify the mandatory procedures and relevant sites that are not consistently followed among 30 sites in a long report. All documents cannot be processed in one input, but each document can be processed independently. The final report requires a regulation number and references to the reasons for each site. Which method is appropriate?

A.text: Estimate non-compliance based on documents from just one site, and use general industry knowledge instead of documents for the remaining sites.
A.explanation: It is impossible to verify all sites, and the sources needed for the report cannot be obtained.

B.text: Link only the beginning of all documents together, and discard the later sections to generate a description of the reasons.
B.explanation: The reasons for the procedures are missed if they are not in the beginning.

C.text: Create a one-sentence summary in free text for each site, reduce the number of words by removing the regulation number and reference to the document.
C.explanation: It is not possible to compare different items or present evidence required in the final report.

D.text: Extract status and original references for each document using a common regulation number, then combine these records to use for cross-site comparison and verification.
D.explanation: The input can be reduced while preserving the comparison criteria and sources of all documents.

learning.concept: When a bulk input is not possible within the context limit, extract required items and references per document and gather them into a short input for comparison.
learning.reason: Extract common mandatory procedure items and reference to reasons for each document, use the gathered short records to compare sites. If a summary is insufficient, add the original text for verification.

aib-c01-d2-025@1.title: Improve the prioritization of experiments in research
aib-c01-d2-025@1.prompt: In the materials development department, only 30 durability tests can be conducted per month from hundreds of candidate formulations. With past formulation conditions and durability test results available, actual durability tests are essential for product adoption. What is the first AI initiative to accelerate market launch?

A.text: Prioritize candidates based on prediction, and compare the time and number of items until finding qualified candidates that have already been tested in the same test slot.
A.explanation: Link AI outputs to business benefits that can be verified through experiments.

B.text: Generate product descriptions to evaluate research speed based on the time the research team spends creating new content.
B.explanation: No improvement is made to the framework of the main constraint, the durability test.

C.text: By excluding the actual test with the highest probability of success, the introduction effect is determined based on a reduction in the number of experiments.
C.explanation: Unable to confirm if the product requirements are met.

D.text: The past tests are summarized by AI, and durability verification is completed when the number of views increases.
D.explanation: The usage of summaries is different from the speed at which qualifying materials are found.

learning.concept: The effectiveness of AI-based candidate selection versus the properties determined through physical experiments
learning.reason: Rank candidates using prediction, and measure whether we can quickly identify candidates who pass within the limited test slots. The actual tests required for hiring will continue.

aib-c01-d2-026@1.title: Compare in-house production and purchases, including fluctuations in general business load.
aib-c01-d2-026@1.prompt: The education company wants to provide text translation for lectures in 4 weeks. The proven commercial service meets quality and contract requirements, allowing selection of volume rates during off-peak periods and reservation slots during peak times. However, in-house implementation requires a continuous operation team, but there is no available slot. Text translation itself does not have unique value. What is the appropriate investment decision?

A.text: If the quality is the same, develop it independently; no immediate operations team will be needed even before adoption is completed.
A.explanation: Unable to meet the constraints of duration and operational maintenance.

B.text: Since it is not a standalone feature, it is released assuming that the free trial quota can be used for all courses.
B.explanation: Unable to confirm the capacity and ongoing conditions for official use.

C.text: Set the maximum quantity during peak season as the minimum purchase quota for the whole year, and determine the lowest cost based solely on the price per reservation quota.
C.explanation: Does not include annual costs including unused slots.

D.text: Reconfirm the quality in a representative lecture, and compare the usage quotas for different ranges to make a purchase.
D.explanation: It aligns with delivery schedules and operational capacity, allowing avoidance of unfavorable contracts due to demand fluctuations.

learning.concept: Compare the fixed costs of standard features not differentiated from those of competitors, and the purchase costs per framework to verify quality and usage continuity conditions
learning.reason: Standard features that meet quality and conditions are based on purchase, and costs including usage range and switching fees are taken into account. Long-term fixed contracts assuming high performance are handled carefully.

aib-c01-d2-027@1.title: Prioritize policies by taking into account the processing capacity of the relevant departments
aib-c01-d2-027@1.prompt: Business sales must choose one of two measures. Proposal generation increases the number of proposals by 3 times, but the existing review capacity is already at its limit, and no additional reviewers can be allocated. The other measure is to clarify the reasons for order losses and increase the proportion of promising proposals within the same review capacity. The business goal is the number of orders received, not the number of proposals. Which is the priority decision?

A.text: Implement copywriting generation across the entire company, and the review department will handle arrangements only after order growth is achieved.
A.explanation: It leaves the capacity of the review required before accepting orders unaddressed.

B.text: Determined solely by the number of users using the service, and the review process and order acceptance are not measured until both measures are completed.
B.explanation: The processes that restrict value and the outcomes of objectives are not included in the evaluation.

C.text: Try to narrow down promising projects within the current review quota, and verify whether orders increase from the same number of reviews.
C.explanation: Reflect capacity constraints in the plan and link them to business objectives.

D.text: Select a measure that triples the number of generated items, and include proposals that are not reviewed in the forecasted orders at the same proportion.
D.explanation: We assume results will be limited by the approval threshold.

learning.concept: Prioritize the increment in effective output that the downstream can process over the upstream generation speed.
learning.reason: If the review is constrained, an increase in output is unlikely to lead to orders. We will test the order effect by comparing small-scale measures to change the structure of proposals that can be processed.

aib-c01-d2-028@1.title: Identify that the source of double input is between systems
aib-c01-d2-028@1.prompt: For customer registration, there is the task of re-entering the normalized company ID already entered in the application system into the accounting system. The values are simply transferred unchanged, and the approval rules remain consistent; there is also an existing integration point between both systems. When an AI proposal was made as a countermeasure against incorrect entries, which is the appropriate suggestion?

A.text: Use AI to predict past errors in transcription tasks, and only verify high-risk staff after re-entry.
A.explanation: Double input remains, and the accuracy of input cannot be directly ensured.

B.text: Have AI estimate the ID from the company name and compare the time taken for estimation and transcription.
B.explanation: Since the correct ID exists, there is no need for estimation, and false estimations can increase.

C.text: Pass the approved ID through the existing integration point, and compare the transfer results with the reprocessing in case of failure.
C.explanation: Eliminate double input, and track connection failures as well.

D.text: The application form is recreated by AI, and the company ID is inserted into the text before being manually extracted by another department.
D.explanation: Complicates the process of moving fixed values further.

learning.concept: No need for value interpretation or estimation; if it's due to notifications or transcription, simple integration eliminates input.
learning.reason: The confirmed company ID is entered once after approval and integration. No errors due to generation or classification can occur, and the cause can be addressed.

aib-c01-d2-029@1.title: Decide on the switch, including temporary transition costs and growth in usage
aib-c01-d2-029@1.prompt: The candidate internal AI platform will reduce the current inference cost by 30%. However, the transition requires a 3-month parallel contract and retraining of the staff. If usage doubles in the next year, the new platform will have a different pricing framework. There is not a significant difference in quality. What is the most useful comparison before making a decision to adopt it?

A.text: Since the migration costs are temporary, do not consider them; calculate the cost of the new infrastructure using only the maximum usage for the next year.
A.explanation: The period and assumptions for comparing costs do not align with the current status.

B.text: Compare the same period for maintenance and transition, including parallel contracts, education, operations, and pricing frameworks, across multiple usage scenarios.
B.explanation: We can determine whether the judgment will reverse based on the growth in usage.

C.text: The annual cost is calculated based solely on the current inference price per unit, and if the price is low, a switch is made.
C.explanation: Missing the temporary costs associated with the migration and future pricing tiers.

D.text: The expected payment amount for the first month of migration is determined by comparing it to the annual average of the old infrastructure.
D.explanation: The evaluation conditions are different between startup and steady-state periods.

learning.concept: Compare transition and parallel operation, price per unit based on usage, and stable operational costs over the same period
learning.reason: Based on the same period and multiple usage volumes, evaluate the total transition costs, savings achieved at the point of realization, including migration, duplication, training, and ongoing operations and usage quotas.

aib-c01-d2-030@1.title: Measure the returns with different burdens even for the same number of items
aib-c01-d2-030@1.prompt: The design office observed that while AI helps with initial drafts, revisions to formality increase, but a full redesign decreases. Both minor revisions and full redesigns are counted as one return request. The goal is to reduce the return burden per delivered item. Which is the appropriate key metric?

A.text: Measure only the time spent on the initial draft, and exclude the time spent on all subsequent revisions.
A.explanation: The burden of return traffic as a target is removed from the measurement scope.

B.text: Only the number of fully redesigned items is counted by period, and differences in the number of delivered items and other corrections are not included in the calculation.
B.explanation: Both the number of deliverables handled and the accumulating correction burden are excluded from the comparison.

C.text: For similar project compositions, the actual revision time is calculated from formatting corrections to redesigns, and compared per delivery item.
C.explanation: Reflects the burden difference of correction types, making comparisons easier even if the number of deliveries changes.

D.text: Treat minor corrections and full redesign as the same item, and compare only the number of corrections per delivery item.
D.explanation: Oversight of the burden difference per correction item.

learning.concept: Instead of simply counting the number of returns, use weights and processing volumes that reflect the actual burden to evaluate improvements
learning.reason: Summarize the real-time return times per case and convert them to per-item values for similar delivery compositions. Changes in format and full redesign can reflect different burdens.

aib-c01-d2-031@1.title: Distinguishing the effects of business improvement implemented simultaneously
aib-c01-d2-031@1.prompt: Next month, the billing team will use a new template for forms and add AI verification to some cases. It is expected that using the new template alone can reduce input errors compared to current forms. Management wants to evaluate the additional benefit of AI. Which design is most appropriate?

A.text: Use the same new template in a similar team that has AI or not, and compare errors using the same period and evaluation criteria.
A.explanation: By keeping the impact of the template consistent across both groups, the effect of AI can be evaluated.

B.text: Target only low-complexity billing cases that have been pre-authorized by AI, and compare them with all billing cases using the old forms.
B.explanation: The complexity of billing cases varies, making it impossible to determine the effect of AI.

C.text: After starting AI usage, use the accurate calculations by staff as the benchmark for overall reporting.
C.explanation: Choosing a comparison target based on post-implementation results distorts the effectiveness.

D.text: Compare next month’s results of AI users with the results of all staff using only old forms this month.
D.explanation: The effects of the template and AI get mixed together.

learning.concept: When everyone changes their business procedures, estimate the effect of AI by comparing AI presence or absence under the same conditions
learning.reason: Maintain the current measurement rules and compare whether AI is added between groups using the same new template. Include complexity factors to distinguish the impact of simultaneous changes.

aib-c01-d2-032@1.title: Avoid double counting of reduced effort and cash expenditures
aib-c01-d2-032@1.prompt: With administrative AI support, 80 hours of work per month are reduced. 30 hours can be used to reduce outsourcing contracts, saving 120,000 yen per month. The remaining 50 hours are redirected by existing employees to other tasks at the same salary; additional profit has not been measured yet. Operational costs are 50,000 yen per month. What is the net cash effect that can be confirmed in the current monthly report?

A.text: −50,000 JPY. Since payroll is unchanged, reducing outsourcing contracts produces no benefit either.
A.explanation: The actual different cost items that can be reduced from outsourcing are excluded.

B.text: 120,000 yen. The amount of outsourcing contract reduction is directly used as the net effect.
B.explanation: The new operational cost of 50,000 yen is not deducted.

C.text: 270,000 yen. Multiply the hourly rate of outsourcing by 80 hours and subtract the operational cost.
C.explanation: Employee time with unchanged salary is also considered as a reduction in cash expenditures.

D.text: 70,000 yen. Subtract the 120,000 yen from outsourcing reduction and the 50,000 yen operational cost, then report the 50 hours of employees separately.
D.explanation: The actual cash expenditures and the resulting operational capacity are distinguished.

learning.concept: Separate the spare time of existing employees from avoided outsourcing costs and prevent overlapping of the same time as costs and benefits
learning.reason: By subtracting 50,000 yen from the actual reduced outsourcing cost of 120,000 yen and 50,000 yen operational cost, the result is 70,000 yen. The spare time of employees is reported as a separate capacity indicator and not counted as cash benefit.

aib-c01-d2-033@1.title: Measuring signs of proficiency between training and practice
aib-c01-d2-033@1.prompt: The insurance administrative department wants to shorten the training period for new employees until they can process applications correctly. The final evaluation is in a few months, but they can score practice tasks of the same difficulty level every week. Which is the most useful early indicator?

A.text: The number of weeks it takes for new employees to be able to complete the correct processing for tasks of the same difficulty multiple times.
A.explanation: It can measure skill consolidation earlier than the final evaluation.

B.text: The total number of questions new employees sent to AI.
B.explanation: It increases when they hesitate repeatedly, so it doesn't necessarily indicate successful learning.

C.text: The percentage of new employees who opened the AI interface on the training start date.
C.explanation: The use on the first day and the acquisition of practical skills are distinct.

D.text: The average salary and retention rate of new employees one year later.
D.explanation: The time to obtain this data is late, and it doesn't directly measure proficiency in processing applications.

learning.concept: Use early KPIs to capture the point when users can repeat correct operations, and consider login count as proficiency without doing so
learning.reason: The time it takes for employees to be able to repeat quality tasks with support is used to capture changes in proficiency before training completion. The difficulty of tasks is aligned before and after practice.

aib-c01-d2-034@1.title: Reuse processing of the same request to reduce costs
aib-c01-d2-034@1.prompt: The AI creates short summaries in the same language for the public brochure across all locations every night. The material is updated several times a month, and whenever there is an update, a new summary is required. Which cost-saving measure maintains quality and update speed?

A.text: Reuse approved results with the same material version, language, and summary conditions; regenerate only if any changes occur.
A.explanation: Limit reuse to the conditions that affect the results.

B.text: Generate only once a month, and display the same summary until the next cycle even if the material is updated.
B.explanation: Violates the requirement to provide new content on the day of update.

C.text: Save the summary only by its name and reuse it for requests in different languages and versions.
C.explanation: Possible to receive summaries with different content or languages.

D.text: Use a cheap model to create summaries for all materials every night; do not verify if the quality is the same as the existing method.
D.explanation: Leaves behind unnecessary regeneration work, and quality cannot be guaranteed.

learning.concept: Reuse only the stable input and approved processing, avoiding mixed results related to new versions or personal information
learning.reason: Reuse approved output when the material version, language, and summary method remain unchanged. Regenerate if any changes occur; measure cost per completion based on version consistency.

aib-c01-d2-035@1.title: Competitors that don’t use AI are also compared using the same criteria
aib-c01-d2-035@1.prompt: In the logistics contract tracking service, customers are shifting from AI-powered competitors to non-AI competitors whose registration is easier. The company also has an AI budget. What is the first analysis that identifies opportunities for competitive improvement?

A.text: Average the number of new customers for companies using AI, and increase the speed of the AI model until it reaches that number.
A.explanation: The relationship between the customer selection reasons and model speed is unverified.

B.text: Compare the effort, accuracy, and costs for customer completion of registration, including competitors without AI, and identify the steps where differences occur.
B.explanation: Customers can understand the difference in competitiveness among the alternative options they actually compare.

C.text: Compare only competitors that have explanations for AI features, and prioritize products with our own AI.
C.explanation: Unable to analyze alternative methods that are actually stealing customers.

D.text: Only conduct a survey on the number of AI features for existing customers, and do not ask about registration experience or comparisons with competitors.
D.explanation: It is not clear why it was chosen or the current operational friction.

learning.concept: Instead of analyzing the competitive environment based on AI, look for alternative methods in terms of quality, effort, and price that customers can compare
learning.reason: Align the alternative services chosen by customers with the same criteria in terms of registration effort, performance results, and price. Differentiate between processes that cause differences and methods for improvement.

aib-c01-d2-036@1.title: Try a new delivery unit with customer segments that have not been profitable so far
aib-c01-d2-036@1.prompt: As a construction estimation support company, fixed costs were incurred for expert document verification, so only annual contracts could be sold. AI can organize documents, reducing the final verification time for people, and providing project-based services tailored to small customers becomes feasible. Which is the appropriate business model for validation?

A.text: Before changing the unit of the contract, remove all customer representatives and minimize costs using AI alone.
A.explanation: Evaluating profitability without the required quality and final verification from people.

B.text: Only the annual contract is maintained, and since internal processing costs have decreased, a new customer base has also been acquired.
B.explanation: Has not tested the delivery unit and payment willingness required by customers.

C.text: Try offering paid services per project to small customers, and measure contract agreements, cost per project, and impact on existing contracts.
C.explanation: We can verify the feasibility of the new sales unit and cost structure.

D.text: It will be provided free of charge per case, and assuming that if the number of uses increases, the same number will be used for a paid service as well.
D.explanation: The demand for free usage does not measure willingness to pay.

learning.concept: When the cost of AI delivery decreases, new contract units can be designed for customers with low usage.
learning.reason: Small-scale verification of the cost per new unit, cost per project, and payment willingness, to determine whether it can be implemented while maintaining existing contracts.

aib-c01-d2-037@1.title: Developing enduring operational advantages even after switching to a new model
aib-c01-d2-037@1.prompt: A corporate procurement support service offers a model that allows competitors to also obtain it, with a summary function. The company wants to easily add connections between customer orders and approvals for each client, but the team prioritizes temporarily reaching the top in the model rankings. What investment ensures continued selection?

A.text: Fix contracts on a long-term basis and prevent customers from changing their usage by making it impossible to record outcomes.
A.explanation: Does not create reasons for selection based on ease of use or practical results.

B.text: Develop the model in a way that allows reuse of approval processes and order infrastructure, maintain model interchangeability, and measure returns and improvement in implementation time.
B.explanation: Enhances practical value that remains even when model performance changes.

C.text: Only engage short-term contracts with the top-ranked model without exclusivity, using that function as the sole competitive advantage.
C.explanation: It is possible to procure the same model, and any change in ranking will not create a difference.

D.text: Force all customers to use the same single interface and eliminate connections to existing order processes.
D.explanation: Reduces existing implementation capabilities and has no link to customer process improvements.

learning.concept: Rather than temporary performance of a generic model, it enhances the value of connections to customer processes, expertise, and operational experience
learning.reason: While maintaining a structure where models can be replaced, integrates with customer approval processes, and demonstrates value through reduced returns and improved implementation costs

aib-c01-d2-038@1.title: Separate the minimum level required for market entry from research investment
aib-c01-d2-038@1.prompt: In public sector document search, competing companies offer nearly the same level of search support, and that level will be a requirement for next bidding. While the company can adapt commercial components in a short time, developing a proprietary model will not allow it to meet the next deadline. What is the optimal level of investment?

A.text: Invest and validate efforts to meet the required standards using existing methods; if a basis for differentiation is established, additional research will be reviewed.
A.explanation: We can separate the necessary defense investments from differentiation options.

B.text: To study the highest performance of standalone models, we will skip the requirements for the next bidding round and make investment decisions based solely on future market share.
B.explanation: Lose short-term market participation conditions, and no basis to gain an advantage in research.

C.text: Pay the full budget as a minimum usage quota for a model with a high reputation for performance.
C.explanation: Bid requirements, actual demand, and additional costs have not been verified.

D.text: The features are equivalent to those of competitors, so no AI investment is made; it is explained that the search support requirements are met during bidding.
D.explanation: Without necessary implementation and verification, requirement compliance cannot be demonstrated.

learning.concept: Maintain AI capabilities that are required for participation in the competitive environment while minimizing additional investments that do not yield a difference
learning.reason: Secure the necessary capabilities and continuous operation in the short term for bidding, and consider additional costs for independent research only when a clear difference in value is identified by the customer.

aib-c01-d2-039@1.title: Verify the developer support effectiveness during the release preparation work
aib-c01-d2-039@1.prompt: In the software department, the renovation of undocumented old features is delayed. AI can generate candidate differences and test proposals, but the goal is not to increase line count, but to deliver reviewed renovations quickly. What is the method for using and evaluating the trials?

A.text: Compare only the review scores of the changes; do not record the additional time spent on corrections or the timing of delivery.
A.explanation: It’s unclear whether the reduced retention is due to just the review ratings.

B.text: Ensure the responsible person can review the candidate differences and test proposals for adoption, and measure the delivery time and issues including review and rework.
B.explanation: It allows for the simultaneous understanding of intended business outcomes and side effects.

C.text: All candidate differences are automatically incorporated, and the number of rows generated is used as the amount of change completed.
C.explanation: No measured time or failures of the approved service have been taken.

D.text: Generate only promotional text for new features, and convert the increase in visitors into efficiency gains from the improvement of old features.
D.explanation: It does not affect processes where renovation delays occur.

learning.concept: Evaluated based on review workload, bugs, and completion of available changes, not code generation volume
learning.reason: People verify and use candidates, and compare the total time from creation to review, rework, and delivery, as well as any issues after publication.

aib-c01-d2-040@1.title: Determine whether to continue the invested trials based on future results
aib-c01-d2-040@1.prompt: The AI guidance for purchases accelerated the proposal display, but significant inventory errors at three branches resulted in additional work costs that exceeded profits. Even after two corrections to the suspected causes, the same result occurred. The department head wants to roll it out to all remaining branches due to a high-cost contract. What is the appropriate decision?

A.text: Although branch reports cannot be compared, the evaluation will be stopped, and decisions will be made based on overall company utilization rates.
A.explanation: It replaces evidence of value and disadvantages with utilization rates.

B.text: Only report the improvement in proposal submission time; corrections for errors are handled by a separate department, so they are excluded from the investment evaluation.
B.explanation: The real-world burden caused by policies is removed from evaluation.

C.text: Since the fees have already been paid, the contract amount will be reduced per item, and it will be rolled out to all remaining branches.
C.explanation: I am making a choice that expects additional losses due to already incurred costs.

D.text: Stop scaling out and evaluate the loss prediction for additional deployment and termination conditions of the contract. Reattempting will be determined only when evidence is provided that the adverse impact has been resolved.
D.explanation: It is a judgment based on future value and losses, as well as costs incurred.

learning.concept: Separate past expenditures from future value, and terminate policies that still cause negative impacts even after realistic improvements
learning.reason: The paid amount does not improve future revenue. Stop operations based on the replicated negative business impact, streamline contracts, and then evaluate alternative measures or restart conditions.

aib-c01-d2-041@1.title: Choose Procurement When It Is Possible to Meet Requirements Inside the Company's Existing Team
aib-c01-d2-041@1.prompt: Companies that sell delivery software need features that allow customers to frequently test their own rules. External products have fixed specifications, and only the rules at the time of contract signing can be set. The company has the necessary development and operation staff, and it is confirmed that implementation can be completed within the deadline. Which of the following is the correct decision?

A.text: Manage core rule management internally, and compare the tested plan with external proposals including costs of maintenance and operation.
A.explanation: Manage features that differentiate the product, and obtain estimates for ongoing operation.

B.text: Move all implementation to external parties and sign a contract that prevents changes inside the company until the other party makes product updates.
B.explanation: Relay the core competitive function to external plans.

C.text: Approve it assuming that no monitoring or support costs occur because development is possible within the company.
C.explanation: It is also necessary to include maintenance and operation costs in the investment decision.

D.text: Since a fixed-specification product can replace it, inform customers that they will not be able to make changes in the future.
D.explanation: Customers lose the continuous changes they need.

learning.concept: When differentiation core features meet both requirements and operational capabilities, compare internal development with the risk of external product changes
learning.reason: Since custom rules affect product value and the deadline and internal capabilities are verified, core development is considered a candidate. Compare procurement plans including operation costs.

aib-c01-d2-042@1.title: Determine whether investment in complex AI meets current achievement standards
aib-c01-d2-042@1.prompt: The company cafeteria predicts the weekly ingredient quantities. With adjustments based on the average of the last 4 weeks and holiday days, both waste and missing items are within the management targets. While a complex prediction model has slightly lower past errors, it cannot be used without additional work by the field staff. What is the best immediate option?

A.text: If past prediction errors are even slightly low, a full transition to a advanced model will be made.
A.explanation: The magnitude of the measured difference and the on-site burden have not been compared.

B.text: Use the current simple method to monitor discards and missing items. If improvements are needed, compare additional costs with business benefits.
B.explanation: Maintain the level and be able to invest according to confirmed needs.

C.text: Create a weekly forecast using the current method and AI predictions, and use that average. The value of additional work is not measured.
C.explanation: The benefits for the workload of the two systems remain unclear.

D.text: Stop creating predicted values, and decide on ingredient orders each week based solely on the experience of different team members.
D.explanation: Losing confirmed valid standards means losing reproducibility.

learning.concept: If a transparent and low-operational-load method meets the business accuracy and explanation requirements, it can be compared against the incremental improvements.
learning.reason: If the existing method meets the established business criteria, we will verify whether a few minor improvements in metrics can justify the additional costs. If not necessary, we will maintain a method that is easy to explain.

aib-c01-d2-043@1.title: Check if the old and new results can be used in the field identically
aib-c01-d2-043@1.prompt: Regional care providers are replacing the system that helps determine visit order. The old “top” option meant “allocate time first,” while the new version indicates “decide the order after sharing with other staff.” The display and integration format on the screen remain the same. What is one measure to avoid mistakes during the transition?

A.text: The new meaning announcement will be made after the switch, and any further confusion on-site will be corrected individually.
A.explanation: Cannot manage the meaning differences that are known at the time of release.

B.text: Since the integration format is the same, it can be switched to the new version without changing the on-site decision process.
B.explanation: Even with the same display, the meaning may differ, and incorrect processing may occur due to the old procedure.

C.text: If the number of high-level cases from both old and new systems match, the transition is considered complete even if individual personnel make different judgments.
