C.explanation: The match of quantities does not indicate the correctness of the operational handling.

D.text: Organize the relationship between meaning and actions per version, update the display and procedures, and test whether the judgment after sharing in representative cases is correct.
D.explanation: Compatibility can be verified up to business outcomes.

learning.concept: In addition to API compatibility, verify the operational meaning of each output and its impact on the decision-making of the responsible personnel
learning.reason: Organize the output labels and the actions taken by the responsible person, and during the parallel period, determine who handles it in what context for a practical test.

aib-c01-d2-044@1.title: Distinguishing between apparent application increases and actual sales
aib-c01-d2-044@1.prompt: After testing an AI for product descriptions, the number of people who started the purchase process increased. However, there are cases where users cancel later due to misunderstandings of the usage conditions. Choose two main financial KPIs and customer-related verification metrics.

A.text: The cancellation rate caused by misunderstandings of product conditions, and complaints related to the explanations provided.
A.explanation: It shows whether customer understanding has worsened despite a high number of applications.

B.text: For the same target audience, the confirmed sales per person, including cancellations, returns, and discounts.
B.explanation: It looks at both the start of the process and the financial results achieved.

C.text: The average number of characters in the explanatory text to ensure consistency.
C.explanation: Length is not a proof that the condition explanation was correctly conveyed.

D.text: The number of seconds from starting the purchase process to reaching the first input field.
D.explanation: It does not capture whether a purchase is finalized or there are misunderstandings in the explanation.

E.text: The number of times candidate explanatory texts were created.
E.explanation: It is an activity measure and does not assess sales or understanding levels.

learning.concept: To measure confirmed results and complaints when cancellations or discounts occur after application
learning.reason: Evaluate not only the number of starts, but also the actual sales achieved by reflecting cancellations and discounts under the same period and comparison conditions. Separate cancellations and complaints caused by explanations.

aib-c01-d2-045@1.title: Including intermediate interruptions in the performance criteria value
aib-c01-d2-045@1.prompt: We are considering an AI to support online financing consultations. Currently, the average processing time for completed consultations is recorded, but consultations where users leave mid-process are not counted. After implementation, we want to evaluate both time reduction and completion of consultations simultaneously. What should be done before implementation?

A.text: Only completed discussions are kept saved, and the reduction in long-term cases is calculated as a reduction achieved by AI.
A.explanation: Just by removing the long abandoned cases from the denominator, the average improves.

B.text: Record the number of times the screen was opened for people who plan to consult with AI, and do not compare with traditional consultations.
B.explanation: The prerequisites and targets for implementation cannot be met.

C.text: Determine the target value for the new benchmark first, and start measuring performance only after implementation.
C.explanation: There is no baseline value before implementation.

D.text: Define the target at the time of reception, track all items including those not completed over a specified period, and align the completion rate and time definitions.
D.explanation: We can compare the impact of time and completion using the same denominator.

learning.concept: When measuring only completed cases, the denominator changes due to implementation, so the targets must be defined at the time of registration and all are tracked accordingly
learning.reason: Define the target under the conditions at the start of the consultation, and record the status of all items, including those not completed, as well as start/end times and observation deadlines. Do not determine apparent improvement based solely on average processing time.

aib-c01-d2-046@1.title: Evaluating Investments by Considering the Period When Benefits Are Recovered
aib-c01-d2-046@1.prompt: The initial expenditure for AI-driven administrative efficiency is 2 million yen. After deducting additional operating costs, the cash benefits at the end of the first year and the end of the second year are 1.21 million yen each. The discount rate is 10% per year, and there are no other cash inflows or outflows. What is the net present value-based benefit?

A.text: 2.1 million yen. Add the discounted benefits for two years.
A.explanation: Since it is a net benefit, the initial expenditure of 2 million yen must be deducted.

B.text: 420,000 yen. Add 1.21 million yen for two years and subtract 2 million yen.
B.explanation: The benefits at different points in time are not discounted.

C.text: 100,000 yen. Discount the benefits at each end date by the number of years and subtract the initial expenditure.
C.explanation: Cash inflows and outflows at different points in time are adjusted to the present value.

D.text: 200,000 yen. Also discount only for one year in the second year, resulting in 1.1 million yen each.
D.explanation: The benefit at the end of the second year is discounted over two years.

learning.concept: Discount benefits at the end date and subtract the initial cost, then adjust for differences in time points
learning.reason: Present value · Year 1: JPY 1,210,000 ÷ 1.1 = JPY 1,100,000. Present value · Year 2: JPY 1,210,000 ÷ 1.1² = JPY 1,000,000. Subtracting the upfront cost of JPY 2,000,000 from the total present value of JPY 2,100,000 gives JPY 100,000.

aib-c01-d2-047@1.title: Understand the range of available projects before the performance metrics are released
aib-c01-d2-047@1.prompt: AI support for inventory management can only be used when the necessary shipping details are provided from the origin. Determining cost reduction will take a quarter, but deciding on expansion to the next location is one month away. In the existing trials, the quality of cases where the feature was applied meets the standards. What is the next priority indicator?

A.text: Count the number of AI screens prepared during the base training.
A.explanation: It does not represent cases that meet the inventory conditions and are ready for use in practice.

B.text: The proportion of all received cases where the required shipping information meets the requirements is measured by base location.
B.explanation: We can first identify the scope of projects that can leverage the quality we have already verified.

C.text: Only measure the cost reduction amount per site determined at the end of the quarter.
C.explanation: It’s a significant achievement, but it’s too late for decision-making on deployment.

D.text: Compare the total number of cases processed by AI, without considering the total number of items in stock or support conditions.
D.explanation: Unable to distinguish between the difference in handling capacity and the difference in available range.

learning.concept: Using the applicable case rate as a leading indicator, we confirm that the vast number of excluded cases restricts long-term effects
learning.reason: Measure the proportion of targets that become supported items when all required items are available by the deadline per base. Can quickly understand how many opportunities to achieve results there are.

aib-c01-d2-048@1.title: Identifying Cost Increases on the Shared Infrastructure
aib-c01-d2-048@1.prompt: The expenditure on a common text analysis AI is increasing monthly. Calls by department can be identified, but cost aggregation does not separate departments. High-value review tasks and tests that are rarely used are on the same infrastructure. Choose two measures to reduce budget while maintaining quality.

A.text: Reduce the number of unused tests without lowering the quality assessment for high-value uses.
A.explanation: Shift disadvantages to high-value uses.

B.text: Cut the budget for all uses equally, without investigating usage amounts or impacts by department.
B.explanation: Important reviews are affected, while causes of low-value usage remain.

C.text: Assign each call to a department and purpose. Show the department the cost per outcome and how far it is from the monthly target.
C.explanation: It is possible to determine who uses for what purpose and where costs increase.

D.text: Set a deadline and usage quota for ineffective tests, and only allow the responsible department to approve continuation if value is confirmed.
D.explanation: Adjustments can be made from low-value consumption, and the impact on important uses can be minimized.

E.text: Calculate the budget limit using a single payment for common services, and remove performance data by use type.
E.explanation: Costs cannot be linked to usage purposes.

learning.concept: Link department usage and costs, correct issues from low-value paths, and avoid uniform reduction
learning.reason: Link usage purposes and departments to costs to understand fluctuations, examine cost per outcome, and impose restrictions and responsibilities on low-value tests

aib-c01-d3-021@1.title: Same service is provided for those who cannot use audio paths
aib-c01-d3-021@1.prompt: The city-operated counter will start accepting reservations via voice AI. The completion rate for voice users is good, but the text-based route for users who have difficulty speaking lacks a confirmation function for reservations, requiring waiting for a call the next day. What is the top priority?

A.text: Improve the recognition accuracy of voice AI, and keep the text route as it was for future phone reservations.
A.explanation: The users who need things other than audio still suffer disadvantages.

B.text: Make sure the same reservation slot can be confirmed via text route as well, and check the completion rate and wait time per route.
B.explanation: Can evaluate both the ability to use the service and the results obtained.

C.text: Summarize the completion rate across all users; if high, do not evaluate the text booking feature.
C.explanation: The difficulty in using it through a few routes is buried by the average.

D.text: Only make the text route instructions easy to read, and do not record results until the reservation is confirmed.
D.explanation: Only improving the guidance does not account for booking availability and wait times.

learning.concept: Fairness is measured not only by average performance, but also by access to routes and final results
learning.reason: Ensure equivalent booking results can be achieved through mutually usable routes, and verify the completion rate and wait time for each route.

aib-c01-d3-022@1.title: Compare the slight performance difference with the certainty of the reasoning
aib-c01-d3-022@1.prompt: There are two methods for reviewing candidates for fee reductions or exemptions for facility usage. Method A has a detection rate of 93% for eligible individuals, but technical verification frequently revealed cases where individual judgment reasons did not align with actual decisions. Method B has a rate of 91%, allowing records of the regulations used in the judgment. The minimum detection rate is 90%, and recording reasons is also required. Which policy is appropriate?

A.text: By adopting A, the reason it cannot be recorded is that the responsible person later selects and adds the relevant provisions from the regulations.
A.explanation: It cannot resolve issues where the explanation does not correspond to the actual decision process.

B.text: Operate with B to verify eligibility and the reasoning, while A is re-evaluated only after the reasoning can be verified.
B.explanation: It can be started in a way that meets both mandatory requirements.

C.text: Average the scores of A and B, and use B's record directly as the final reason.
C.explanation: A average judgment cannot necessarily be explained by the reason of just B.

D.text: Prioritizing the detection rate, we will relax the requirements, and only provide individual responses for post-event objections.
D.explanation: Does not meet the required condition of recording reasons.

learning.concept: When explanation is essential for business purposes, select a method that meets both the requirements and minimum performance standards.
learning.reason: Adopt a method that meets the minimum quality and description requirements in advance, and compare higher performance only when the validity of the description can be confirmed.

aib-c01-d3-023@1.title: Design the end-time data and customer handling before the experiment.
aib-c01-d3-023@1.prompt: Customer support AI may be terminated after the experiment. Even after the trial, unresolved user issues must continue to be processed, and experimental personal data must be disposed of according to contract terms. When and what policies should be established?

A.text: When stopping, customers can understand the situation by closing the related screen, so individual notifications and transfers are not required.
A.explanation: Response to unresolved issues is interrupted.

B.text: Before the trial starts, define how to transfer open cases and notify users when the trial ends. Also define how to verify that personal data has been returned or deleted. Reflect these procedures in the vendor terms and the case intake process.
B.explanation: It allows continued project handling and data management even after completion.

C.text: The data handling by the contractor is first confirmed after the termination decision is made.
C.explanation: We cannot guarantee that retrieval or deletion can be done within the deadline.

D.text: The experimental data is stored without a deadline so it can be resumed in an emergency.
D.explanation: Unable to carry out the disposal in accordance with the contract.

learning.concept: Before starting, include requirements for stopping, alternative processing, and history handling, and reflect them in the vendor contract and operations
learning.reason: Before the experiment, define the shutdown conditions, customer notifications, transfer of unresolved cases, storage/deletion, and confirmation traces.

aib-c01-d3-024@1.title: In major operations, separate the AI proposal and approval permissions
aib-c01-d3-024@1.prompt: AI creates a draft notification of contract termination for external clients. It’s a difficult-to-rectify measure, and the policy requires a different approver than the on-site responsible person to confirm the contract and facts. Choose two appropriate controls.

A.text: If the internal confidence level of AI is high, another approver confirmation will be conducted on the day after transmission.
A.explanation: Does not meet the necessary independent verification required before sending.

B.text: Independent approvers compare the contract with the latest facts and send only cases where approval justification is retained.
B.explanation: The validity of the conditions and the responsibility of the responsible person can be confirmed.

C.text: The on-site responsible person’s ID is used, and the AI and independent approver verify using the same credentials.
C.explanation: It’s impossible to assign responsibilities to approvers.

D.text: Do not grant external transmission rights to the proposed AI; only approved alternative processes should be able to send notifications.
D.explanation: Unapproved proposals should not be used as external measures.

E.text: All notifications will be audited at the end of the month, and the assigned individual approvals will be unnecessary.
E.explanation: Post-publication audits cannot prevent irreversible actions.

learning.concept: Irreversible external operations should be executed after verification independent of proposal generation and approval by authorized personnel.
learning.reason: Let AI handle notification adjustment and draft creation, but do not grant sending permissions. Another approver will verify the target and conditions, and record who approved it when and why.

aib-c01-d3-025@1.title: Separate the departments seeking exceptions from those deciding approvals
aib-c01-d3-025@1.prompt: The sales director is responsible for AI implementation performance, and even during periods where standards are not met, some customers still want services provided. A proposal was made for each department head to approve the exceptions for their own initiatives. Which of the following is appropriate as a responsibility design for control?

A.text: Departments submit reasons and alternatives, an independent review officer determines impact and deadline, and a re-evaluation is assigned within the deadline.
A.explanation: The business objectives and the validity of exceptions can be evaluated separately.

B.text: Move both application and approval to the provider, with the company's responsibility limited to the model contract.
B.explanation: It is not possible to manage exceptions for the company's own services.

C.text: First submit exceptions without a deadline, and only review them when the review committee raises objections.
C.explanation: Lack of records for deadline, re-evaluation, and reasons.

D.text: The department head approves if it is important for achieving their own goals, and the reasons are recorded after being made public.
D.explanation: No separation of conflicts of interest, and no records are kept before public release.

learning.concept: In cases of exceptions with conflicts of interest, establish separate review, deadline, re-evaluation, and objection handling processes
learning.reason: The business side submits the exception, another approver reviews the reasons, impact, deadline, and alternatives. The responsibilities for approval and re-evaluation are clarified and recorded.

aib-c01-d3-026@1.title: Enabling audit of past decisions even after model update
aib-c01-d3-026@1.prompt: In an AI that supports item approval, it is necessary to have records that can reproduce the model version and approval documents used later. The provider regularly updates the model within the same API name. Which of the following should be confirmed through procedures and contracts?

A.text: If the output has been saved by the user, the old model version and approval documents are not saved.
A.explanation: Only the result cannot confirm the version used for the decision at that time and the basis.

B.text: Record only the inquiry date, and estimate the model version on the provider’s public page after audit.
B.explanation: It is impossible to determine the version that was actually responded to at that point.

C.text: Record the API name each time, and if the name is the same, assume the responses before and after update are the same version.
C.explanation: It is not possible to identify the version that actually operated from the name.

D.text: Confirm that the version corresponding to the response can be obtained and recorded, link it to the version of settings and documents, and also verify the conditions for update notifications.
D.explanation: The evidence needed for audit can be tracked even if the version changes.

learning.concept: When the recording obligation is based on versions, require a contract and setting that allow obtaining and saving the version that was actually responded to
learning.reason: Obtain and record the version used in each response, link it to the version of settings and approval documents. Verify whether an unnotified update meets the requirements.

aib-c01-d3-027@1.title: Organize access to the generated materials after the transfer
aib-c01-d3-027@1.prompt: The internal AI summarizes restricted HR materials and creates sharing links within the team. It has been found that even when an employee loses their access, they can still view the summaries from previous links. What is the priority fix?

A.text: The generated result also inherits the restrictions from the original data, checks the current permissions during acquisition, and revokes existing sharing permissions due to role changes.
A.explanation: Access to information derived from the original data can also be adapted to the current role.

B.text: Extend shared links to make speculation more difficult, and allow those who already have links to continue obtaining them.
B.explanation: Links owned by users who have lost their permissions will not become invalid.

C.text: Only the original data will be preserved, and the summary is a general shared document created by the model.
C.explanation: The summary also contains content subject to restrictions.

D.text: The sharing link is removed from the generated response screen, but no verification is performed when accessing the URL directly.
D.explanation: Users who keep the old link will continue to have access.

learning.concept: Even if the original data is protected, the same permission changes must be applied to generated shared resources and cache.
learning.reason: Apply the classification from the original data to the generated result as well, and verify the current access during retrieval. Incorporate the deactivation of old links and cache into the migration procedure.

aib-c01-d3-028@1.title: Do not exclude low-frequency critical risks from the review process
aib-c01-d3-028@1.prompt: In the company's classification table, additional reviews are conducted regardless of the probability of occurrence for risks that have a significant impact on individuals. A frequently causes the display format to break, but the content remains intact. B occasionally misrepresents the specific reasons for account suspension that are sent to the individual. Which is the appropriate priority for early response?

A.text: Since notification to users is required for handling B, it will be treated as a communications issue and excluded from risk registration.
A.explanation: Even with a notice, the impact of an incorrect termination reason remains.

B.text: A occurs frequently, so it is reviewed first, while B is only recorded until the number of occurrences becomes the same.
B.explanation: Violates the rules for serious incidents that are reviewed regardless of probability.

C.text: B conducts additional reviews and verification of measures, while A improves frequency and impact through standard quality management.
C.explanation: Applies the severity criteria specified by the organization and can manage both.

D.text: We will not assess the operational impact until one complaint per week arises in both incidents.
D.explanation: It replaces the review with the number of complaints.

learning.concept: Distinguish between likelihood and impact in the evaluation table, and apply mandatory severity assessment criteria
learning.reason: Instead of just comparing frequencies, B will be subjected to additional review based on severity rules. The impact of A on ease of use will be managed separately.

aib-c01-d3-029@1.title: When the verification process for people starts to get stuck, address it
aib-c01-d3-029@1.prompt: Cases where AI suspended the decision will be checked by the business representative within the same day. During peak periods, the AI’s operational rate is high, but handovers are postponed to the next day, causing users to exceed the deadline. Which measure should be added to monitoring?

A.text: Record the AI's operating hours in detail, and assume the transition is successful if it continues.
A.explanation: The process bottlenecks at the responsible party have not been measured.

B.text: The total number of handovers will be calculated at the end of the month, and processing on the same day shall be at the individual's discretion.
B.explanation: Cannot address it before the deadline.

C.text: Set alerts for remaining time and unprocessed cases, and prepare priority processing and support procedures for cases with approaching deadlines.
C.explanation: It allows monitoring whether people’s measures work within the deadline.

D.text: All reservations are removed to reduce the number of handovers, and the resulting false positives are not verified.
D.explanation: The problem prevented by verification of people is now affecting users again.

learning.concept: In addition to monitoring model quality, it also tracks whether the handover to personnel is completed on time.
learning.reason: Monitor waiting times for transition tasks, the number of tasks approaching deadlines, and processing capacity, and quickly allocate and support tasks before the deadline.

aib-c01-d3-030@1.title: Investigate the biases that aren’t visible in each attribute individually
aib-c01-d3-030@1.prompt: The employment support AI guide achieved sufficient completion rates whether by language or device type. Once operations began, it was reported that guidance might be interrupted only on minority languages and older devices. Which is the appropriate investigation?

A.text: Disclose the identification information of a few relevant users so all employees can review each case.
A.explanation: More exposure of non-research browsing and identification information.

B.text: Make sure the language is not displayed, and isolate only the terminal to see if complaints decrease.
B.explanation: Unable to verify the suspected combination.

C.text: Aggregate the business results combining language and devices within the allowed range, and conduct additional verification for categories with high uncertainty.
C.explanation: Identify the conditions affected and avoid conclusions based on a small amount of data.

D.text: If there are no differences when comparing the properties individually, continue operations without investigating combination issues.
D.explanation: Separate aggregations can hide specific combination issues.

learning.concept: Evaluate reasonable group combinations in advance, and handle the uncertainty and privacy of small datasets
learning.reason: Within the permitted aggregation scope, verify the combination of two attributes, and evaluate them along with additional examples without treating minor estimates as definite.

aib-c01-d3-031@1.title: Even for approved materials, compliance with display conditions is required
aib-c01-d3-031@1.prompt: The publisher uses generative AI to create introduction texts for exhibitions. Some reference materials can be reused externally, but when cited, the original author and modified sections must be indicated per the contract. Which processing step is performed before publishing from the AI output?

A.text: Calculate the share of reproduced material across the whole output. If it is small, skip the attribution requirements for individual items.
A.explanation: The conditions required by the original contract cannot be met using only the reproduction volume.

B.text: Since it can be reused for external public use, the information about the original author is removed.
B.explanation: Even if it can be made public, the contractual display conditions remain.

C.text: The company name of the AI source is used for consistency, and the correspondence with original materials is not preserved.
C.explanation: It is impossible to track the original authors and modifications.

D.text: Record the data and contract terms, verify the areas that were actually quoted or modified, and add necessary displays.
D.explanation: Retain the correct source and modification information in the publication.

learning.concept: In addition to the input permissions, the credits and modification conditions required at publication are inherited by the output.
learning.reason: Match the data used with the display conditions in the contract, and verify the citation and modification of the output. Items for which the display basis cannot be confirmed will be removed from public release.

aib-c01-d3-032@1.title: To verify whether numerical values are valid even with a structured format
aib-c01-d3-032@1.prompt: The purchasing AI structures the unit price and quantity from the order document. Although all required items are present, there are cases where the unit price per item differs significantly from the total per box. What is the most direct solution before automated registration?

A.text: Recalculate using approved conversion rules including units, and route cases where the allowable tolerance is exceeded for human review.
A.explanation: It can detect numerical inconsistencies that cannot be identified solely by the schema.

B.text: Check if all item names are present; if they match, do not evaluate units or values.
B.explanation: Errors in units and discrepancies in amounts cannot be detected.

C.text: Adjust only the final quantity to ensure the total matches, without retaining the original unit.
C.explanation: Changing the quantity or justification results in losing the essential facts.

D.text: If the two totals generated by the model match, do not compare them to the original total.
D.explanation: It may lead to repeated incorrect conversions.

learning.concept: Verify external validation of units, digits, and arithmetic invariants for results that appear correct
learning.reason: Confirm the relationship between units and quantities, perform approved conversion and total comparison. Isolate order documents with unclear or inconsistent details.

aib-c01-d3-033@1.title: Preserve individual records while maintaining the value of analysis
aib-c01-d3-033@1.prompt: The employee consultation service uses AI to generate monthly summaries that allow managers to understand the trends in consultations. The original text includes symptoms and family information, enabling personal identification even from small department-level summaries. What managers need are just the trends by company and major category. What is the appropriate disclosure policy?

A.text: Aggregate by necessary major categories, and integrate small group categories. Examples are not taken from the original text that links to individuals.
A.explanation: It is possible to limit personal speculation while sharing a tendency to meet objectives.

B.text: Open all original text to administrators, and let each person manage personal information based on their own judgment.
B.explanation: Share unnecessary business sensitive information widely.

C.text: Categorized and shared in detail by department and age group, regardless of the granularity required by the responsible person.
C.explanation: There is a risk of being reidentified from details beyond the purpose.

D.text: All consultations will be summarized in chronological order, with only the names removed and distributed by department.
D.explanation: The date, time, content, and combination of small units allow individuals to make inferences.

learning.concept: Separate information for department improvement from content that can identify individuals, and share it at the required granularity
learning.reason: Limit to the required aggregation granularity and integrate small group categories to prevent speculation. Original text and identifiable excerpts should be excluded from sharing.

aib-c01-d3-034@1.title: Do not force uncertain judgments based on target processing rates
aib-c01-d3-034@1.prompt: There are AI systems that seriously and normally distinguish between complaints from legal entities. Examples where evaluations across departments are consistent allow for stable judgment, but in borderline cases, decisions become inconsistent. If overlooked, external responses will be delayed; if all are treated as serious, the responsible person cannot handle them all. Which operation is appropriate?

A.text: Use the threshold with the highest processing rate, and exclude classification errors from the evaluation scope.
A.explanation: Unable to assess significant business disadvantages.

B.text: To eliminate unverified cases, boundary examples are always treated as normal, and the number of complaints is tracked later.
B.explanation: Confirmation for important boundary projects may be delayed.

C.text: Not only the boundary cases, but all cases are treated seriously, and those that cannot be processed are postponed to the next period.
C.explanation: It exceeds the capacity of the responsible person, and the actual required response may be delayed.

D.text: Automatically segment a reliable range, and send boundary examples to a time-limited confirmation queue. Measure both missed items and review volume.
D.explanation: It can handle automation, the capacity of the personnel, and safety conditions simultaneously.

learning.concept: Unable to process cases with uncertain confidence due to a tough choice, thus deciding on a reserved range and a safe approach
learning.reason: Only the stable range from the preliminary evaluation is automatically processed, while boundary cases are sent for priority review. The boundaries are adjusted based on missed cases, excessive alerts, and the amount of review.

aib-c01-d3-035@1.title: Make it clear to users what AI usage they are choosing before they make a selection
aib-c01-d3-035@1.prompt: A recruitment service is considering using AI to summarize interview notes, with staff checking the summaries. Before any recording starts, users must be told what the recording is for and be able to choose an interview without recording. The interface and instructions have yet to be specified. What should the team do first?

A.text: Only include a description of AI usage in the email after recording, and confirm consent via read-through rate.
A.explanation: Users cannot select it before recording.

B.text: Users who wish to refuse recording can cancel it via a complaint channel after publication, so no prior selection is provided.
B.explanation: In post-event procedures, the decisions made before the recording cannot be replaced.

C.text: Briefly present the purpose and the options before recording. In a pilot, check whether users understand them and can actually complete an interview without recording.
C.explanation: Information provision and actual selection can be verified during the specification phase.

D.text: Add explanations of technical terms at the end of the terms of use, and omit instructions regarding the start of recording during the interview.
D.explanation: It has not been verified that the purpose and alternative methods are clear at the time of use.

learning.concept: Make transparency not just a later statement, but use the notification time and understanding level as trial conditions
learning.reason: Make advance notice and the option of an interview without recording part of the requirements. In design testing, check whether users understand the purpose and their options.

aib-c01-d3-036@1.title: Also include verification of human removal in the automated processing scope
aib-c01-d3-036@1.prompt: The AI automatically responds to inquiries about minor, pre-approved delivery conditions when its confidence meets a threshold. Staff currently review only cases put on hold. The team wants to catch a gradual rise in errors in automated responses. What form of human oversight is appropriate?

A.text: The automated response is re-verified solely based on the model's self-evaluation, while human evaluation is sought after a failure occurs.
A.explanation: It is possible to miss errors of the same pattern, and early supervision cannot be achieved.

B.text: If the number of automated responses is the same every day, it can be assumed that quality remains the same even without collecting audit results.
B.explanation: The stability of the count does not mean the stability of accuracy.

C.text: Review the retained cases in detail, and since the automated response has high confidence, exclude it from the investigation.
C.explanation: I can’t see the accuracy of the automated processing I most want to know about.

D.text: Sample automated responses across different case types and time periods. Have a staff member check the basis and outcome of each sampled response.
D.explanation: It can detect errors in the automated processing part that cannot be understood from retained cases.

learning.concept: When only retained cases are viewed by humans, errors in automated processing cannot be seen, so processed results need to be independently verified
learning.reason: Even from highly confident automated responses, the timing and type of project are considered, and the person in charge verifies accuracy based on independent evidence.

aib-c01-d3-037@1.title: Ensure restoration is possible while protecting backups
aib-c01-d3-037@1.prompt: The approved customer documents used by internal AI are encrypted. In operation, backups are stored monthly, and staff not responsible for them are not allowed to read the restored documents. Even after the encryption key is updated, the documents must be recoverable during the specified retention period. Select two appropriate designs.

A.text: While updating the keys, all past encryption will be made unusable, and restoring old backups should only be attempted during a failure.
A.explanation: Even if an old backup is needed during the retention period, it may become unreadable.

B.text: Since backups do not access primary data, encryption is removed, and access is only verified in case operations are halted.
B.explanation: The copy contains the same customer information, and protection is needed even outside of restoration.

C.text: Maintain the decryption method required until the retention period, and try to restore past data in an environment with restricted permissions after key update.
C.explanation: It can be confirmed that both protection and recovery function properly after the key is updated.

D.text: Backups are also encrypted, and permissions for the approved restoration officer and the person responsible for reading the restored documents are each restricted.
D.explanation: Do not grant restoration operation permissions as unconditional access rights to the document.

E.text: To speed up recovery, all writers will also be given permission to view documents and manage keys.
E.explanation: It expands sensitive permissions beyond what is needed for normal operations.

learning.concept: The encrypted management targets include backups and older versions, ensuring both confidentiality and decryption rights during restoration.
learning.reason: Copy should also be encrypted, and separate permissions required for restoration and content viewing. The keys capable of decrypting the necessary data should be stored for the same duration, and attempts at restoration should be made after updates.

aib-c01-d3-038@1.title: Evaluating operational risks after component assembly
aib-c01-d3-038@1.prompt: An AI that summarizes internal shipping notes and an AI that generates delivery instructions based on approved conditions were both rated as low risk for individual uses. In the new proposal, the first summary is automatically sent to the second AI, which then provides guidance to users. How should approvals for different components be handled?

A.text: Verify through post-assembly notifications and assess how missing information spreads and its external impact to rechoose controls.
A.explanation: Consider both the characteristics of components and how they are actually used in operations.

B.text: Since the risk of individual components is low, the same conclusion applies to the assembled process.
B.explanation: Conditions where errors propagate between components are not subject to individual review.

C.text: Use the average of the two evaluation scores for risk classification, and do not include points in external notifications.
C.explanation: The evaluated subject does not affect the overall operation.

D.text: Since it is difficult to distinguish which component caused the error, return to the pre-assembly evaluation and investigate only after operation.
D.explanation: It is not possible to verify issues that occur during integration before notifying customers.

learning.concept: Do not estimate risks of the assembly process without considering individual low-risk approvals; instead, review the possibility of error amplification through the output chain
learning.reason: Separate the uses for which each component is approved from customer-facing uses where errors cascade after assembly. Reassess including the impact of information gaps and inconsistencies on notifications.

aib-c01-d3-039@1.title: Check whether the protection features and the agent's response work properly
aib-c01-d3-039@1.prompt: The AI responsible for publishing the data has a setting that delays publication and notifies the person in charge when an unapproved version is found. During auditing, it was determined that although the notification destination has been removed, the settings screen is still functional. What is the appropriate permanent fix?

A.text: Record the time when the settings are enabled; do not perform periodic checks as long as the configuration file exists.
A.explanation: I don’t know if the notification will reach the recipient.

B.text: A delay as intended for test data occurs, and we will check whether the notification reaches the responsible person and is processed or if it is a regular test.
B.explanation: Can verify that management and communication work effectively.

C.text: Monitor only the complaints after publication, and replace notifications to the responsible person with the number of emails.
C.explanation: Unable to verify the series of functions for retention, notification, and receipt.

D.text: Remove the retention settings and send all materials to the regular list of responsible persons. Let the viewers decide whether it is the approved version.
D.explanation: Cannot prevent the release of an unverified version.

learning.concept: Not only for setting protection features, but also to regularly verify isolation, notifications, and delivery to the responsible party through authorized tests
learning.reason: It will be retained as a dedicated verification document, and the delivery of notifications and receipt by the responsible person will be regularly tested. Not only the presence or absence of settings, but also verification results will be recorded.

aib-c01-d3-040@1.title: Minimize the areas with reduced reliability changes
aib-c01-d3-040@1.prompt: The response quality of the corporate support AI suddenly declined. Both the document indexing and model version were updated on the same day, and it is unclear which caused the issue. The old evaluation data configuration and the old version of the documents are still retained. What is the method for investigating to pinpoint and restore the affected part?

A.text: Only the model is restored to the old version by inference, and the evaluation ends if the phenomenon is not consistent.
A.explanation: The impact of the two updates has not been evaluated individually.

B.text: For the same representative question, switch between configurations one by one, and compare the basis for obtaining the results with the correctness of the answers. Identify the modified changes that caused degradation.
B.explanation: By conducting a comparative analysis with matching input conditions, the cause can be identified.

C.text: The old configuration will be removed, and the quality will be judged based on whether the overall response time of the new configuration is the same as before.
C.explanation: Unable to determine the correctness and cause of the answer.

D.text: Both are simultaneously updated to a different version; when the issue is resolved, we determine which one was the cause.
D.explanation: To increase changes, the impacts cannot be separated.

learning.concept: Compare multiple configurations with known inputs to isolate the impact of upstream data updates and model changes
learning.reason: For the same representative question, switch between old/new models and data index configurations, compare the source data acquisition and response quality. If an impact can be identified, revert the corresponding changes.

aib-c01-d4-021@1.title: Determine the readiness for each target deployment scope
aib-c01-d4-021@1.prompt: The university document creation AI includes usage procedures and support channels in the internal drafts reviewed by staff. There is no overnight human replacement for student automated responses, and no method has been established to identify urgent inquiries. At the meeting, a single preparedness assessment was required across all schools. Which is the appropriate assessment?

A.text: Due to insufficient preparation for students, internal drafts that meet the criteria are also excluded from evaluation under the same premise.
A.explanation: Cannot utilize the evidence of preparations obtained by purpose.

B.text: Make both uses at the same level of preparation, and offset non-compliant items by simply averaging the technical and operational aspects.
B.explanation: The lack of required conditions before public release is hidden.

C.text: Evaluate internal drafts and student automated responses separately; the latter will be made public only after emergency consultation identification and alternative responses are confirmed.
C.explanation: Can handle the preparation conditions that vary in actual usage scenarios.

D.text: Since there is a support desk for internal use, overnight services for students are also prepared and will be released on the same day.
D.explanation: The internal operational capabilities cannot prove night-time student support.

learning.concept: Even with the same technology, the requirements for the internal drafts and external operations differ in terms of the required level of quality.
learning.reason: Define the necessary conditions for each target and impact. Differentiate between usage within the satisfied conditions and conditions that need to be tailored for external use.

aib-c01-d4-022@1.title: Evaluate cases where the progression of maturity within an organization differs
aib-c01-d4-022@1.prompt: In financial-related service companies, the environment for new teams can be prepared immediately using a common platform. However, confirming the usage policies and assigning actual personnel for live operations is being tried for the first time by each team, and most projects lack a public responsible person. Which is the most appropriate approach for reporting on mature models?

A.text: Since we are checking the regulations for each team, even with a common platform, the technology maturity is still considered at an early stage.
A.explanation: It does not reflect the actual capabilities in each perspective.

B.text: Average all perspectives and recognize the company's status only by the team that reached the top.
B.explanation: Cover up the inconsistencies within the organization and the lack of required capabilities.

C.text: Since the days for infrastructure preparation are short, it is recorded that other aspects have also reached the stage of company-wide expansion.
C.explanation: The speed of environment preparation does not reflect real-world judgment and responsibility allocation.

D.text: The infrastructure is assessed as reusable, and operations & control are recorded as in a trial phase. Public accountability and consistent auditing will be conditions for expansion.
D.explanation: The difference in maturity and the required conditions next are clear.

learning.concept: Do not extrapolate the maturity of technical infrastructure to operations or governance, but evaluate each capability required at each stage
learning.reason: Separate the reproducibility and operational/control capabilities of the infrastructure, and establish the minimum requirements needed before scaling across the entire company.

aib-c01-d4-023@1.title: Identifying the reasons why user registration does not progress across environments
aib-c01-d4-023@1.prompt: The training AI is available for the responsible person, but access rights required for practical trials must be manually registered twice in two systems each time. Both the business and security personnel understand the procedure, and approval is completed on the same day. When extending this to 10 departments, which capability should be prioritized to avoid waiting for approved users?

A.text: Establish a coordinated system to set and revoke permissions in the two environments based on approval results, and measure the time required for these changes to take effect.
A.explanation: Improve the actual delays while maintaining necessary approvals.

B.text: Distribute common permissions for both environments to all employees before approval to speed up registration.
B.explanation: Result in losing valid approval processes and expanding access scope.

C.text: Have users take a refresher training on the basics, while continuing manual access setup as before.
C.explanation: Training experienced personnel does not resolve the wait time issue.

D.text: Limit the number of approval requests to reduce waiting time, and continue separate registration in the two environments as before.
D.explanation: Does not meet the purpose of expansion, and the system remains unchanged.

learning.concept: Distinguish between skill deficiency and basic coordination deficiency, and address the capabilities that actually hinder processing
learning.reason: The bottleneck is the handoff to provisioning, rather than approval decisions or training. Set up the creation and revocation of identities and permissions so that both follow the approval process.

aib-c01-d4-024@1.title: Develop a plan to gradually reduce reliance on external support
aib-c01-d4-024@1.prompt: While external experts are needed for the first implementation of internal AI, the company plans to conduct quality assessment and troubleshooting internally starting next year. Currently, internal technicians can only perform basic operations. What is an investment plan that doesn’t just end as a handover document?

A.text: The first time, it is completed only externally. Upon contract termination, once the document is received, it will be switched to internal operation.
A.explanation: I haven’t checked if we can do the necessary work in-house.

B.text: Rejecting external collaboration, operating in production from the start while learning the necessary tasks only during failures.
B.explanation: It does not take into account the current lack of capabilities.

C.text: After everyone completes the introductory course, a handover will be conducted, and the evaluation and recovery exercises will be moved to the next year.
C.explanation: No verification of the target practical skills exists.

D.text: Proceed in the order of joint implementation, internal-led operation, independent evaluation and restoration, then move on to the next stage upon passing the exercises at each phase.
D.explanation: Can reduce dependencies while confirming learning outcomes.

learning.concept: Prioritize collaborative work, supported operations, and independent validation based on performance metrics toward the target capabilities
learning.reason: From initial collaborative work, it moves to a stage where internal staff take the lead with external support, and they accomplish evaluation and restoration independently before completing the handover.

aib-c01-d4-025@1.title: Visualize where no evaluation data exists for the target business activities
aib-c01-d4-025@1.prompt: The AI that classifies reasons for wholesale returns has detailed classification records in direct warehouses. The contractors have a similar number of return records, but most classifications fall under “other,” and damage and quantity discrepancies cannot be distinguished. Which judgment can be used to determine whether all company data can be used for learning and evaluation?

A.text: Since the number of cases per warehouse is similar, it is determined that the differences in reasons are offset across the entire company average.
A.explanation: In “Others,” the required types cannot be matched.

B.text: Remove detailed classifications for direct operations to ensure the "other" ratio matches that of the client.
B.explanation: Lose the overall classification information needed for the target.

C.text: Check the detail of labels and the number of verifiable items, depending on the warehouse operation mode and return reasons, and evaluate after improving cases of failed contractors.
C.explanation: Can confirm whether the reasons required for actual deployment can be evaluated.

D.text: Many copies of the client records are replicated through learning, and the lack of labels is compensated by the number of cases.
D.explanation: The missing classification information in the copy of the record does not increase.

learning.concept: Match the entire candidates and labeled ranges, and detect the omission of specific important case types
learning.reason: Instead of the total count, we look at the range of valid reasons for returns that can be labeled. Add cases where the contractor can confirm the required reasons.

aib-c01-d4-026@1.title: Define the responsibility for reporting corrections to existing data and suspension of usage
aib-c01-d4-026@1.prompt: Obtain public information from multiple facilities from external partners and use it with the search AI. The partners cannot confirm whether the withdrawn documents have been removed by the users, and corrections to the information only reach some departments. What is the priority item to include in the joint operation agreement?

A.text: The corrections will be left to the individual email of the responsible person; if the person changes, records should be made from the beginning.
A.explanation: Unable to verify organizational tracking and feedback.

B.text: Determine the owners and responsible parties on both the owner and user sides, and agree on the version of the materials, notification for corrections or withdrawals, response deadline, and confirmation of the response results.
B.explanation: Continue sharing information while being able to track the responsibility and results of corrections.

C.text: All data will be copied once a month, and the withdrawn materials will continue to be stored at the discretion of the user side.
C.explanation: The explicitly stated withdrawals cannot be reflected in all users.

D.text: The provider provides the information only once initially, and subsequent relevance is left to the search AI’s self-evaluation.
D.explanation: The facts of the model's withdrawal and the deadline for response are not conveyed.

learning.concept: Link the correction of the provider metadata and changes to usage rights to the determined communication and downstream confirmation verification
learning.reason: Determine the responsibilities of the data owner and the user side, and share details on versions, corrections/revisions notices, response deadlines, and confirmation of whether it has been removed from searches.

aib-c01-d4-027@1.title: Evaluate the setup of the site where there are data that cannot be sent
aib-c01-d4-027@1.prompt: In a service company, customer identification information cannot be sent outside the management domain. I want to use external AI to only classify the topics of inquiries. Within the management domain, identification information can be deleted, but it is not confirmed whether all necessary information for classification will also be lost. What should be done before selecting the infrastructure?

A.text: Delete all articles, send only the inquiry time to external parties, and approve without verifying the actual classification quality.
A.explanation: Has not verified the establishment of classification operations if necessary information is removed.

B.text: Create the allowed inputs in the management domain, verify the removal success and classification quality in representative cases, and compare candidates based on required processing time.
B.explanation: It allows for an early evaluation of data constraints and the establishment of performance and operations.

C.text: Pass the original text to external AI, and if the identification information is removed after classification, it will be deemed sufficient to meet the constraints during transmission.
C.explanation: Does not meet the conditions at the time of sending to external parties.

D.text: Measure accuracy only with a short example without sensitive information, and try preprocessing and connection from the management domain after publication.
D.explanation: It is unclear the quality and processing capability for inputs that reflect production constraints.

learning.concept: Only the items that can be sent to external processing are created in the front end, and the results along with necessary evaluations are verified under real data conditions
learning.reason: Test whether the input excluding identification information can be created within the management domain, correctly removed, and sufficient information remains for classification. If the conditions are not met, compare with another processing location.

aib-c01-d4-028@1.title: Continue promoting cross-site initiatives even after organizational changes
aib-c01-d4-028@1.prompt: Due to organizational restructuring, the management sponsor of the marketing support AI has changed. Although there is a promotion team on the ground, a position is vacant for coordinating across departments and approving next-year budgets. Which action ensures continuous implementation?

A.text: Request a decision without appointing the previous sponsor, without changing internal authority.
A.explanation: Formal authority and responsibility are not transferred to the next structure.

B.text: Disband the on-site promotion team temporarily and hold the company-wide expansion plan on hold until the next year.
B.explanation: Unnecessary on-site activities and decision-making are lost.

C.text: Appoint a new sponsor officially, and inherit budget, decision-making, priority items, and reporting channels for the promotion team.
C.explanation: Continued decision-making on cross-site issues and funding can be maintained.

D.text: All sites continue implementation based on their own decisions, with the next-year budget responsibility determined after expansion.
D.explanation: Cross-site decisions and funding are interrupted.

learning.concept: When the sponsor changes, formally inherit decision-making authority, budget, and unresolved issues
learning.reason: Officially appoint a new business leader, transferring success conditions, budget, cross-cutting issues, and decision deadlines. Maintain a reporting channel for the promotion team.

aib-c01-d4-029@1.title: In addition to users, include those affected in the field for verification
aib-c01-d4-029@1.prompt: The education company plans to allocate learning consultations using AI. Development and planning are progressing, but the consultants are responsible for handling exceptions, and learners were unsure what to do next with the current prototype. What is the next team design?

A.text: Include counselors and learner representatives in validation. Counselors own the exception procedures, the planning team owns the user completion criteria, and the technical team owns fixes and retesting.
A.explanation: Supports the knowledge gaps in design, and clarifies who will verify the results.

B.text: The completion will be based solely on technical department operation verification, and explanations for consultants and learners will be provided just before the public release.
B.explanation: Exceptional on-site operations and the results obtained cannot be incorporated into the design.

C.text: The Planning Department will decide on exceptions instead of the consultant, and the final completion of the learner’s program will be guaranteed by the provider.
C.explanation: The responsible person who knows the practical operations and user conditions is not included in the verification.

D.text: Everyone participates in the final exam without assigning roles, and individual approval and re-checking after corrections are left to each person.
D.explanation: No allocation for reconfirming responsibilities and corrections.

learning.concept: Add representatives from operations and users to the core development team, and clarify responsibilities for each deliverable
learning.reason: Invite development, consultation staff, and user representatives to participate in validation, and the responsible department will have outputs related to exceptions and user outcomes.

aib-c01-d4-030@1.title: When conveying effects to the entire organization, also indicate the conditions of the implementation
aib-c01-d4-030@1.prompt: After testing document AI in three locations, standard documents could be processed quickly, but in locations with many exceptions, the verification time for staff increased. Management wants to notify everyone of the implementation timeline and expected effects. Which way of communicating maintains trust?

A.text: Notify only those locations where time increased; do not disclose the start date and support information for other locations.
A.explanation: Preparation and comparison conditions per location are not shared.

B.text: Do not provide observation results to avoid variability in effects, and promise overall productivity improvement to all staff.
B.explanation: Guarantees uncertain results and overstates expectations.

C.text: Publish only the improvement rate of the location where performance improved the fastest as the goal for everyone, without mentioning the burden of exceptions.
C.explanation: Overgeneralizes favorable results and cannot explain them to those who need support.

D.text: Explain the stage start date, contact for issues, and next review time based on results in standard and exceptional cases.
D.explanation: Success stories and notes can be shared as useful information for the field.

learning.concept: Show both the measured range and uncertain effects, along with contact information for on-site issues
learning.reason: Indicate observation results and support procedures per location, and do not promise the same effects to all departments. Also provide next measurement and inquiry contact.

aib-c01-d4-031@1.title: The Reason Why the Field Cannot Trust the System
aib-c01-d4-031@1.prompt: The experienced inspection officer feels that past automation ignored their experience. The new AI also provides few reasons, and they believe using it removes their decision-making authority. What should the first action be taken by the implementation owner?

A.text: The administrator compares the number of times it was not used each week and mandates use without asking for reasons.
A.explanation: Only requiring use without addressing the reasons for distrust.

B.text: Remove examples of errors from the implementation materials and only show representative cases that were correct in tests.
B.explanation: Eliminating opportunities to confirm limits, thereby damaging trust in practice.

C.text: Involve those who have gained the field's trust, compare the basis and failure modes of recommendations with real cases, and jointly decide on the final judgment and correction steps.
C.explanation: Preserve the value of experience and enable verification of AI.

D.text: The central officer only provides function descriptions, and the field uses the complaint channel after release.
D.explanation: Unable to reflect causes of distrust into design before release.

learning.concept: Listen to actual concerns rather than mandating use, verify the basis through understandable evaluation and field participation
learning.reason: Involve officers in evaluation and design, test how recommendations fail and how decisions are handled with real examples, and link approval or rejection to opinions and results

aib-c01-d4-032@1.title: Practice scenarios where you might get stuck in real work during training
aib-c01-d4-032@1.prompt: The contract officer passed the test on basic AI terminology. However, during practical testing, when incorrect contract clauses were included in the output, they couldn’t decide where to stop using it and who to report it to. Which training is next?

A.text: If no one uses it, errors will decrease, so only the responsible person takes the test and skips on-site training.
A.explanation: The judgment skills needed by on-site users are not developed.

B.text: In exercises including errors in items and lack of support, procedures such as verification, suspension, communication, and documentation must be carried out.
B.explanation: The necessary decisions for the responsible person can be evaluated across a series of scenarios.

C.text: Increase the passing marks for basic terminology tests, and keep accident response only to the existing explanation at onboarding.
C.explanation: Term knowledge and the ability to stop or communicate are different things.

D.text: Use only exercises for generating text without errors; the number of items created during practice will be used as the passing standard.
D.explanation: Unable to practice detecting and resolving issues.

learning.concept: Not only for comprehension tests, but also as practice in identifying and reporting dangerous examples to ensure responsible use
learning.reason: In authorized training exceptions, practice actions such as verification of grounds, suspension of use, handover, and documentation, and evaluate judgments.

aib-c01-d4-033@1.title: Redirect the time saved from work efficiency toward quality improvement
aib-c01-d4-033@1.prompt: The maintenance team has used AI to streamline the entry of reports into designated fields. The quality of the response depends on whether it can identify causes from rare anomalies and revise procedures. Which is the appropriate structure for the next task to be implemented?

A.text: Return routine tasks to humans, and let AI determine the cause of exceptions independently.
A.explanation: Lose the efficiency already achieved, leaving difficult decisions unverified.

B.text: Measure only the time saved, and reduce the verification of causes for abnormal cases compared to before.
B.explanation: The ability to conduct surveys that determine the quality of work will decline.

C.text: The new scheduling method proposed by AI is applied to all sites without confirmation, and the person in charge continues to only input the number of cases.
C.explanation: No role is assigned to determine reasons and impacts.

D.text: AI helps with routine recording, the person in charge investigates abnormal cases to confirm the reasons, and reviews process changes.
D.explanation: Leverage expert judgment of people to continuously improve the quality of work.

learning.concept: All the time spent on formatting and aggregation that can be automated by AI is allocated to exception detection by staff and improving judgment criteria
learning.reason: Support regular organization, and assign personnel to analyze abnormal cases, explain root causes, and improve validated procedures.

aib-c01-d4-034@1.title: Create a hypothesis that can be verified before deciding on a company-wide release
aib-c01-d4-034@1.prompt: The procurement officer believes that AI will make request estimates faster. The candidates involve data search and automated writing; the main cause of delays is unknown. What is the most appropriate way to proceed with the experiment while maintaining the traditional procedures?

A.text: Measure the slow processes to form hypotheses, determine the target and period, and test various measures. Judge the next stage based on time, quality, and rework.
A.explanation: It allows for comparison of causes and effects, and trial failures can be utilized in the next attempt.

B.text: Just repeat and demonstrate the model; the target for actual measurement will be determined after there are no more user requests.
B.explanation: Cannot decide to move to the next stage without verifying improvements in practice.

C.text: First, confirm the production-ready contract, and use the price as a basis for the decision-making.
C.explanation: We will commit to deployment before verifying the hypothesis and business impact.

D.text: Deploy both simultaneously across the entire company, and aggregate the effects during estimation.
D.explanation: It’s difficult to determine which use case yielded results, and the impact of the trials is broad.

learning.concept: Turn the concept into an experiment with specific targets, metrics, and completion criteria, and decide first what to learn.
learning.reason: Formulate hypotheses to reduce the time for each task, test them separately with small targets, compare quality and rework, and narrow down the applicable use cases.

aib-c01-d4-035@1.title: Determine the expanded budget step by step based on short-term results
aib-c01-d4-035@1.prompt: The pilot implementation of one site for contract review support has yielded results. In the first instance, experts provided free assistance, but other sites require regular training and quality assurance costs. What is a way to expand using this small success?

A.text: Approve a production contract only for the site where the pilot succeeded, without investigating whether support could be shared with other sites.
A.explanation: I don’t know the capabilities and costs that can be reused during scaling.

B.text: Measure the results including support costs in the next small cluster of sites, and expand each time they meet the benefits and continuous operation criteria.
B.explanation: While leveraging early results, we can confirm the cost changes in scale.

C.text: Before scaling up, purchase all the actual usage quota, and confirm the operating conditions that can produce the same results as the initial result later.
C.explanation: Fix the cost before verifying profitability and execution capability.

D.text: Use the rate for free pilot support as the ongoing unit rate and approve a rollout to all sites at once by multiplying the pilot's time savings by the number of sites.
D.explanation: Reducing costs due to trial and expansion.

learning.concept: Re-estimate the exception support and fixed costs used in early success at future scale, and link the profitability conditions to the next investment
learning.reason: Separate the trial results from support costs, and measure the benefits and paid support expenses that can be replicated by the next limited site group. Expand the budget within the range that meets the criteria.

aib-c01-d4-036@1.title: Create information sharing to prevent redevelopment of the same mechanism
aib-c01-d4-036@1.prompt: Each company in the group has developed its own AI evaluation and generation mechanisms, and some have achieved similar functionality. There are specialized teams, but each company does not know what evaluation methods and components are already available. Which of the following is the next step?

A.text: To avoid duplication, all AI implementations are moved to a dedicated team, and business evaluation and exception handling are also conducted solely at the central level.
A.explanation: Remove the person responsible for understanding on-site decisions and exceptions.

B.text: Record the responsible person, target, evaluation materials, and reusable features in a common project list, and discuss both standardization and customization at the beginning of new proposals.
B.explanation: Reuse verification and implementation across organizations with the right roles.

C.text: Only standardize by contracting with the same AI provider, and do not share components or evaluation results.
C.explanation: Consistency in the source does not eliminate duplication in implementation and verification.

D.text: After all are completed by each company, the number of items is aggregated, and if there are different owners for the same function, it is not reusable.
D.explanation: Cannot prevent the first duplication, and fails to leverage other companies' achievements.

learning.concept: Specialized organizations visualize assets and responsible parties, and determine reusability through new proposals
learning.reason: The specialized organization gathers information on projects, responsible persons, outcomes, evaluations, and reusable components, and conducts discussions and reuse assessments during the initial stage of design.

aib-c01-d4-037@1.title: To track whether the on-site improvement requests actually led to results
aib-c01-d4-037@1.prompt: I collect weekly requests for improvements regarding AI. The operations team updates the system based on these requests, but they don’t measure which complaints have been resolved or reoccurred. What is a way to improve the long-term value verification?

A.text: Link each request to the scenario, improvement metrics, responsible person, and version to be addressed, re-measure the same metrics, and deliver results to the field.
A.explanation: Continuous changes can be verified through actual business results.

B.text: Only the completion date of the implementation is recorded, and stakeholders estimate the past situation when the next request arises.
B.explanation: There is no standard to verify the effectiveness of the measures later on.

C.text: To avoid dissatisfaction due to changes, the measurement items are changed monthly after implementation, and no comparison is made with the initial data.
C.explanation: Unable to distinguish between sustained progress and deterioration.

D.text: Increase the channels for accepting requests, and use the increased number of collected items as an opportunity for quality improvement.
D.explanation: Even as the number increases, I don’t know how to solve problems or prevent recurrence.

learning.concept: Link the acceptance of requests to the version and results of the measures, and measure the sustainability of improvement using the same KPIs
learning.reason: Link the requests to conditions and metrics, record the corresponding version, re-measurement date, and responsible person. Confirm with the site that reported the results.

aib-c01-d4-038@1.title: To determine if the conditions of a trial contract can ensure production operation
aib-c01-d4-038@1.prompt: AI-assisted document processing passed a pilot during weekday business hours. Production processing also runs on weekends, and if it fails, the provider it depends on must be able to investigate within 2 hours. The trial contract guarantees neither weekend support nor ongoing capacity. What should be done before launch?

A.text: Assume that if the provider is the same, the operating conditions for trial and commercial use are also the same, and no additional verification is performed.
A.explanation: Ignore the possibility that the subject and conditions of the contract are different.

B.text: Increase the number of output examples, and if it is assumed that there will be no failures on weekends, skip the contract verification.
B.explanation: Quality examples cannot confirm the response time and capacity guarantee for failures.

C.text: Verify the weekend support and capacity conditions, specify the necessary contracts or alternatives, and test whether they can be actually integrated before releasing.
C.explanation: The business hours and dependency relationships during failures can be confirmed before production.

D.text: Maintain the contract because the trial quality is good, and negotiate the necessary responses after the first failure occurs on weekends.
D.explanation: The necessary support and continuous conditions are not determined at the time of release.

learning.concept: Verify the usage conditions, maintenance responses, and capacity changes of the production-dependent party according to actual business hours
learning.reason: In addition to the accuracy during trial, confirm the scope of response between production-dependent services and contracts. Ensure contracts or alternative paths that meet the required response time and capacity, and test them.

aib-c01-d4-039@1.title: Continuing the transition based on the department's busy schedule plan
aib-c01-d4-039@1.prompt: The company-wide document AI has completed its testing. This month, accounting will enter the quarterly financial reporting period, but the procurement department is operating normally. The deployment support team can establish some departments fully, and each department can choose the old procedures. Which deployment maintains continuity?

A.text: All employees must adopt the new method on the same day, and inquiries will be received only through the company’s common queue.
A.explanation: During the financial reporting, changes and insufficient support overlap.

B.text: Since a spillover effect can be expected in the most busy department, all areas must be covered from the first day, including accounting.
B.explanation: Focus the impact on a period when it is difficult to accept changes.

C.text: Split support and provide it simultaneously to both departments; only the closing time of the financial report is excluded from the operational evaluation.
C.explanation: Exceeding the support capacity, unable to detect delays in critical operations.

D.text: Support procurement first for the transition, and ensure accounting can return to the old procedures after the financial year ends, along with the necessary support resources for the switch.
D.explanation: It can continue considering the constraints on departmental workload and support.

learning.concept: Confirm the additional capacity and changeable period from multiple departments, and enable features step by step
learning.reason: Support is provided from departments that are normally prepared, and carried out during the period when busy departments are freed up. Each department should confirm preparations, old procedures in emergencies, and metrics.

aib-c01-d4-040@1.title: Extend the team's skills to tasks that only a few experts can handle
aib-c01-d4-040@1.prompt: Document analysis AI is used in each department, but only one person across the entire company can implement the evaluation process. If that person is absent, the revision stops. Which development plan ensures quality and continues deployment?

A.text: Standardize the evaluation process, allowing representatives from multiple departments to independently assess representative cases and compare them with expert opinions.
A.explanation: You can verify the ability to maintain quality.

B.text: Reduce experts' holidays, and the evaluation method remains the same—only the individual holds it.
B.explanation: The structure that stops due to one person's absence remains the same.

C.text: All evaluation for revision during deployment is omitted; only user reports will be used for later verification.
C.explanation: If the talent shortage is not addressed, it will compromise the actual quality.

D.text: Publish the recording of the evaluation procedure, but do not verify whether other personnel can carry it out; consider it completed.
D.explanation: What can be viewed does not indicate independent reproducibility.

learning.concept: To prepare for any shifts in the understaffed roles, confirm that colleagues can cover duties through training and practical work
learning.reason: Create a procedure that can reproduce the most important evaluations, and systematically select agents from multiple departments. Confirm that the representative can execute them independently.

aib-c01-d1-043@1.title: Do not use the numbered categories as quantities
