aib-c01-d1-043@1.prompt: In delivery delay prediction, delivery regions are stored using numbers such as 17, 18, and 90. The regional numbers are assigned in order of establishment, and are not related to distance or road conditions. Workers proposed treating regions with similar numbers as having similar conditions. Which of the following is the appropriate approach?

A.text: Assume that higher regional numbers indicate greater demand and use them as rankings to be given by the responsible person.
A.explanation: The numbers assigned in order of establishment do not indicate the ranking of demand.

B.text: Treat the regional numbers as categories, and represent distance and transportation conditions as separate items based on actual measurements or predefined values.
B.explanation: Separate the identifier from the quantity, allowing use of characteristics that match each meaning.

C.text: Replace the difference in numbers with distance and correct it using address information after prediction.
C.explanation: The order of numbers does not represent distance, and is not an appropriate measurement.

D.text: Normalize the numbers to a range of minimum and maximum values, and assume that numbers with smaller differences are geographically closer.
D.explanation: Misunderstandings in numerical ranges cannot be corrected through transformation.

learning.concept: Even if stored as numbers, do not treat the identifiers as continuous quantities; design input by verifying the meaning
learning.reason: Regional numbers are identifiers for classification, and the difference in values does not represent geographical or delivery differences. Treat regions as categories, and obtain actual distance separately if necessary.

aib-c01-d1-044@1.title: Do not evaluate rare events solely based on the overall correct rate
aib-c01-d1-044@1.prompt: Of the 100 applications, 1 is urgent. The accuracy rate of the model treated as normal is 99%, but urgent processing did not improve. There is also a limit to the additional verifications that the responsible person can handle. What is one way to evaluate the next trained model?

A.text: Only count the total number of errors based on the records used in learning, and if it is low, the verification amount will be sufficient even after operation.
A.explanation: Do not evaluate the performance or details of emergency assessments in unknown cases.

B.text: Only routine cases are retained for evaluation, while emergency omissions are estimated based on claims after publication.
B.explanation: Before hiring, it is not possible to evaluate the small class that the policy emphasizes.

C.text: Use representative data to measure the emergency reproduction rate and fit rate, and select a threshold value that meets the required number of detection and confirmation items.
C.explanation: Can identify both missed minor issues and unnecessary verifications.

D.text: If the overall accuracy rate exceeds 99%, the candidate will be hired without checking the details of actual emergency projects.
D.explanation: The correct answers to most typical projects obscure the failures of a few projects.

learning.concept: When high precision is observed in most classes, verify the performance for the desired few classes.
learning.reason: Compare the proportion of urgent cases that can be handled, and the actual proportion of cases classified as urgent. Choose a threshold that matches the practical workload and the risk of being overlooked.

aib-c01-d1-045@1.title: Explain Machine Learning Systems Using the Same Framework
aib-c01-d1-045@1.prompt: Multiple companies collaborate to develop a machine learning system. Each development team has different ways of describing models, training pipelines, and inference diagrams, making it difficult to assign responsibilities during technical handover. What is needed is a framework that explains the structure of the AI system uniformly, rather than organizational management and authentication. Which option is the most appropriate reference?

A.text: Use security audit results instead of diagrams to define the scope of inference and training without specifying responsibilities.
A.explanation: Audit results alone cannot describe the technical structure or responsibility assignments of the system.

B.text: Place the vendors’ product manuals side by side as they are. Do not create a mapping table even where their terms for models and training differ.
B.explanation: No common explanation is obtained needed for collaborative work.

C.text: Arrange the functions of each company according to the ISO/IEC 23053 framework for machine learning systems and show the terminology and input/output mappings.
C.explanation: This aligns with the goal of explaining different implementations using common concepts.

D.text: If ISO/IEC 42001 certification is obtained, the diagrams of each company will use the same terminology; therefore, no technical description of the project is required.
D.explanation: Organizational management systems and individual system structure explanations are necessary separately.

learning.concept: Use the ISO/IEC 23053 framework to map ML terminology and components across different teams
learning.reason: ISO/IEC 23053 deals with a common framework for AI systems that use machine learning. The purpose of structure explanation is to distinguish it from organizational management system requirements.

aib-c01-d1-046@1.title: Do not treat new features of approved tools the same way
aib-c01-d1-046@1.prompt: The AI tool used for summarizing published documents is approved within the company. The provider has added new collaboration features. These features allow integration of internal shared documents and save search indexes for the provider. The person in charge wants to keep it valid with existing approvals. Which is appropriate as ethics and data management practices?

A.text: Since it is an approved provider, the index storage by the provider will also be classified the same way as the summary of public documents.
A.explanation: The new ingestion scope and storage handling have not been evaluated.

B.text: Maintain existing allowed uses, and for new features, evaluate data scope, index removal, and access before making classification decisions.
B.explanation: The approval scope can be aligned with the added data processing.

C.text: Not only those who use the new features, but also existing approved uses will be permanently prohibited, and no investigation will be conducted on the changes.
C.explanation: Identify no specific range of potential issues and remove all evaluated uses.

D.text: If the number of internal documents is limited, functional reviews are not required, and users can start using them at their own discretion.
D.explanation: Even a small number of unverified documents or those with applicable storage conditions will be affected.

learning.concept: Do not unconditionally expand approval of tool units to data processing for new features
learning.reason: The new features differ from the processing evaluated through existing approvals. While existing uses are maintained, only the new processing is subject to review, and use is restricted until approval.

aib-c01-d1-047@1.title: Indicating the classification criteria for similar requests in a prompt
aib-c01-d1-047@1.prompt: A generative AI that helps categorize facility management notes often confuses 'change of revisit reservation' with 'new inquiry about visit date'. There are examples where the length is similar to both cases, along with reasons for the correct classification. Which prompt improvement is the first step?

A.text: Increase the number of correct examples for one category only, while leaving the definition of the other category unchanged.
A.explanation: It is impossible to define boundaries in both directions, which may lead to biased classifications.

B.text: Just increase the repetition of label names and shorten the explanation of the classification reason.
B.explanation: It cannot address the missing judgment criteria that cause the confusion.

C.text: Show a definition that classifies based on whether there is a reservation, along with examples that are very similar but have different correct answers. Clearly state that if no judgment criteria are available, it is left unresolved.
C.explanation: It specifies the desired difference and reduces arbitrary classifications.

D.text: Since both are inquiries about reservations, if the wording is polite, classify them as new inquiries.
D.explanation: The wording does not serve as a basis for determining whether they are reserved.

learning.concept: It is better to clarify the differences in boundary examples and the features needed for judgment rather than simply listing label names
learning.reason: It defines the binary classification, provides a basis to distinguish between reserved and not reserved, and shows contrasting boundary examples. It specifies the condition for leaving it unresolved if no judgment criteria are present.

aib-c01-d1-048@1.title: Even if the conversation gets long, we ensure the agreed-upon points are correctly transferred
aib-c01-d1-048@1.prompt: In the booking support AI, the number of accompanying guests and meal preferences initially confirmed by the user are used at the end of a long conversation. To address the upper limit issue, old conversations were filtered out, and the AI made assumptions to change the confirmed conditions. Which is the most appropriate method for maintaining these conditions?

A.text: Always keep all conversations connected, and if the model exceeds its limit, prioritize sending the confirmation of the reservation.
A.explanation: Due to limits, we cannot guarantee providing final information.

B.text: Only send the latest few messages; if there is no information, fill in with similar user conditions.
B.explanation: The confirmed details of users mix with assumptions.

C.text: As old records are removed, summarize in free text, and do not distinguish between fixed values and values under consideration.
C.explanation: Temporary information mixed into the summary can overwrite the definite value.

D.text: Record the confirmed conditions separately, and reflect only the results updated by the individual. Provide those records at the time required for the response.
D.explanation: It can maintain confirmed information even in short contexts.

learning.concept: When unable to provide the full history of a long conversation, explicitly save the confirmed state and include it in input when needed
learning.reason: Save the verified conditions in a structured record, requiring personal verification for updates. If needed, add this record to the prompt, ensuring it does not depend on the entire old conversation.

aib-c01-d1-049@1.title: Assign the model only to uses that have been improved through adaptation
aib-c01-d1-049@1.prompt: The machine manufacturer adjusted the generative AI to match product code extraction requirements for maintenance requests. Extraction performed successfully, but multilingual error descriptions used by the same company became worse with the adjusted version, while the original version meets quality standards. The two are on separate screens, and it is known before sending whether to process one or the other. Which deployment policy is correct?

A.text: Assign the adjusted version for extraction and the original version for multilingual descriptions, and monitor quality by use type.
A.explanation: Since uses can be distinguished in advance, known improvements can be used while preventing deterioration in other uses.

B.text: Only when the adjusted version cannot respond in multiple languages, switch to the original version based on the user’s country instead of the screen.
B.explanation: It may not be possible to correctly determine the use and desired language from the country, leading to responses that do not meet standards being generated first.

C.text: Except for the option of separating uses, even if quality improves through extraction, completely abandon the adjusted version.
C.explanation: Since they can be used on separate screens, improvements limited to extraction can also be utilized.

D.text: Average the results of extraction and multilingual responses, and if the overall score of the adjusted version is high, replace both screens.
D.explanation: Using an average score, multilingual descriptions that do not meet individual quality requirements are hidden.

learning.concept: If another capability falls below the standard due to specialization, if uses can be identified, assign models differently
learning.reason: Adjustments do not guarantee improvement in other capabilities. Since uses can be identified, assign the adjusted version to product code extraction, while maintaining the quality of the existing version for multilingual descriptions.

aib-c01-d1-050@1.title: Using the probability of occurrence and its impact on operations together
aib-c01-d1-050@1.prompt: The maintenance team can inspect only one device today. A has a 60% failure probability with a loss of 100,000 yen when it fails, and B has a 20% probability with a loss of 800,000 yen. The inspection cost is the same, and it is assumed that both can prevent the respective failure through inspection. Which choice minimizes the expected loss?

A.text: Inspect B. Compare the product of the probability of occurrence and loss for each device.
A.explanation: Comparing frequency and impact with the same amount of money.

B.text: Inspect A. If the probability of occurrence is high, the expected loss is also large.
B.explanation: It does not reflect the difference in loss amounts.

C.text: Select each device with equal probability. Since probabilities do not represent determined losses, a comparison is not possible.
C.explanation: Even for uncertain events, priority can be assigned based on expected loss under the same conditions.

D.text: Inspect A. If B's failure probability is less than 50%, the loss is considered zero.
D.explanation: Even if the probability is low, if the loss is large, it cannot be ignored.

learning.concept: Multiply the predicted probability by the impact magnitude, and handle cases with higher expected loss at the same intervention cost
learning.reason: A's expected loss is 60,000 yen, and B's is 160,000 yen. If both can be prevented with the same cost, B should be prioritized.

aib-c01-d1-051@1.title: When it is impossible to list the types of failures in advance, choose an AI
aib-c01-d1-051@1.prompt: In the production line, there is sufficient sensor data during stable operation, but there is little accurate data for each type of failure. The goal is to capture the behaviors that the personnel should investigate, including unknown anomalies. Which is the first approach?

A.text: Detects deviations from normal operation patterns and presents them for verification.
A.explanation: Matches conditions where the types of failures cannot be covered in advance.

B.text: Determine no anomaly if the annual average value of all devices remains unchanged.
B.explanation: Short-term anomalies and device-specific behaviors are buried by the average.

C.text: A supervised model for classifying fault names is trained without any fault name records.
C.explanation: No required training labels.

D.text: Have the generative AI generate a description of expected failures, and determine sensor behavior anomalies based solely on the text.
D.explanation: There is no comparison with actual measurements.

learning.concept: In addition to classification for identifying types of anomalies, it detects deviations from normal operating conditions
learning.reason: It learns within normal ranges and identifies deviant behavior as candidates. These candidates are not definitive diagnoses of failure; instead, people compare them with actual machines.

aib-c01-d1-052@1.title: Also for the same item name, check the measurement unit and aggregation interval
aib-c01-d1-052@1.prompt: Factory A records pressure in kilopascals per second, while Factory B stores the average per minute in megapascals. The goal is to predict a pressure increase over a few seconds. Choose two things that should be done before integrating the data.

A.text: A also reduces to the average per minute, and short-term increases can be observed in minutes.
A.explanation: The few seconds of change needed for judgment are lost.

B.text: Copy the average of B 60 times and treat it as data per second.
B.explanation: Copying does not allow reconstructing the peak from the average.

C.text: Differentiate measurement intervals and add measurements that can verify changes of just a few seconds even in B.
C.explanation: It can confirm short-term changes that cannot be observed with already averaged data.

D.text: If the units are consistent, the measurement intervals are also considered the same, and the values from both factories are linked to the same learning items.
D.explanation: The difference in time resolution remains.

E.text: Record the original unit and verify the conversion rules for the same unit.
E.explanation: It allows for accurate comparison of pressure levels across factories.

learning.concept: Check unit conversion and aggregation intervals to avoid creating time information that cannot be restored from history.
learning.reason: Even if units are standardized, the average peak of the disappearing seconds cannot be restored. Distinguish the data used for short-term events and measure B at the necessary detail level.

aib-c01-d1-053@1.title: Before increasing the teacher data, align the evaluation criteria
aib-c01-d1-053@1.prompt: Create a query classification AI. There are sufficient records for each employee, but some employees label the same text as "refund" while others label it as "contract change". The issue was that the classification guide was ambiguous. Which preparation is prioritized?

A.text: Add duplicate cases directly to increase the number of items, and use only the current record labels for evaluation.
A.explanation: Does not resolve the root cause of the inconsistency.

B.text: Increase the model size and let the differences in judgment criteria between employees be learned directly.
B.explanation: Model size does not determine which judgment should count as correct.

C.text: Treat all classifications made by the employee with the most inputs as correct, without comparing with other employees.
C.explanation: The number of inputs does not indicate the validity of the judgment.

D.text: Classify the same examples independently to identify the reasons for differences, revise the definitions, and develop agreed-upon teacher labels.
D.explanation: Ensures consistency between learning objectives and correct judgments.

learning.concept: When different teacher labels are assigned to the same case, measure consistency and standardize the handling of criteria and exceptions
learning.reason: Multiple employees independently evaluate the same case, creating a guide to resolve discrepancies. Learn and evaluate using cases with aligned criteria.

aib-c01-d1-054@1.title: Before operating, decide which sources to trust.
aib-c01-d1-054@1.prompt: The reservation agent refers to two documents. The internal list shows availability, but the official reservation ledger confirms that the same slot is already reserved. The agent can register available slots, and double registration should be avoided. Which control is the most appropriate?

A.text: Determine the empty state by majority vote; if equal, use the internal list obtained first.
A.explanation: Ignores the authority of the source and differences in updates.

B.text: Only when a vacancy in the official ledger is confirmed, a slot will be reserved; if there is a discrepancy and cannot be resolved, it will be handed over to someone else.
B.explanation: Operations follow the authoritative status and verification results.

C.text: First, register the slot, and then check if a duplicate registration notification comes from the official ledger.
C.explanation: I have performed the operations that should be avoided first.

D.text: Responds with an available slot for the user, but does not record the agent registration results.
D.explanation: The booking status cannot be aligned with the promises made to users.

learning.concept: The operation agent detects inconsistencies in the reference results and waits for an authoritative decision or human resolution before making a determination.
learning.reason: Use the official ledger for the availability determination, and verify the latest status even before registration. If inconsistencies between documents prevent a decision, it is confirmed as pending.

aib-c01-d1-055@1.title: Correct the probability deviation when the rank is maintained
aib-c01-d1-055@1.prompt: In the model that calculates the delay probability of requests, when arranged in descending order as before, the top detection rate was maintained. However, recently, the actual delay rate for cases reported as 40% turned out to be about 25%, resulting in an excessive verification range set based on probability. What is the appropriate action?

A.text: Re-evaluate the probability calibration using recent confirmed data, and verify the probability and ranking performance with another validation dataset.
A.explanation: It can be improved for properties that have actually degraded.

B.text: As long as the ranking is preserved, do not treat the drift in predicted probabilities as an operational problem.
B.explanation: The meaning of the probability for determining the confirmation slot has changed.

C.text: Completely reverse the ranking and swap the targets in accordance with the reduced latency rate.
C.explanation: Losing the maintained rank performance, and the probability cannot be corrected either.

D.text: Exclude past transactions that did not experience delays, and align the displayed probability with the delay rate.
D.explanation: Distorts the actual distribution of the target.

learning.concept: Separate the ranking and probability calibration in evaluation; if only the probability is off, try recalibration first
learning.reason: The discrepancy between ranking performance and predictive probability is different. Verify the recalibration of probabilities using recent deterministic data, and also check the ranking performance.

aib-c01-d1-056@1.title: Do not execute the text of the data as a command for the system
aib-c01-d1-056@1.prompt: The accounting department uses AI to read free-text messages received from business partners and extract the site name and preferred date. Some senders phrase requests to staff as commands in the message body. Which improvement keeps the AI from treating commands in the document as additional instructions or guessing missing fields?

A.text: If there is even one command, the entire document can be deleted, and two fields can be filled with values from another document.
A.explanation: Unable to handle correct documents, incorrect registrations based on other materials also occur.

B.text: Connect the customer documents directly at the end of the instructions, giving priority to the command written last.
B.explanation: Commands in the data may override the intended extraction instructions.

C.text: Separate the items to be extracted, and explicitly state that the instructions within them will not be executed. Only return the business location and desired date; if not specified, it is considered unknown.
C.explanation: It can distinguish between business instructions and input data.

D.text: To respect the intent of the request, we first execute the actions described in the document before extracting the items.
D.explanation: There is no authority to command actions on the document sender.

learning.concept: Explicitly specify the documents to be extracted as the target, and limit responses to only the items where the source of the instruction is identified
learning.reason: Explicitly separate instructions from the extraction targets, and treat requests within the targets only as documentation. Specify the allowed output items and values when not specified, and verify the results.

aib-c01-d1-057@1.title: Select the execution conditions for inference based on the time of use
aib-c01-d1-057@1.prompt: Each branch office receives a forecast of visit counts for one day before business hours begin. The input is the data recorded at the end of each night, and does not change during business hours the next day. To avoid waiting time when viewing, all staff in branches open at the same time in the morning. Which usage method is appropriate?

A.text: Fix the forecast using values before the input is finalized, and do not reflect the final value until the next month.
A.explanation: The finalized data usable in the day's forecast cannot be used.

B.text: Perform inference with the same input each time the screen is opened, and collect the delay during peak hours after display.
B.explanation: Repeating inference with the same input may increase morning waiting time.

C.text: Make a consolidated forecast for all branches after closing, record the target date and version used, and display the saved results in the morning.
C.explanation: It can balance update requirements with response time during viewing.

D.text: Retrain the model each time a staff member opens it, and make predictions on the spot.
D.explanation: With conditions finalized by the previous day, retraining is not required during viewing.

learning.concept: Select a consolidated inference based on the latest point and response time without changing the model
learning.reason: Make a consolidated forecast for all branches after the input is finalized, save the target date and version used, and can return the pre-calculated result in the morning.

aib-c01-d1-058@1.title: Distinguish the AI that classifies the entire image and finds the location of the target.
aib-c01-d1-058@1.prompt: During the material verification, multiple identical cases appear in one photo. The person in charge wants to check the positions on the photo in order and know if the required number is met. Just having “cases present” is not enough. Which way of using AI is appropriate?

A.text: Classify whether the case exists across the entire image, and treat the value indicating its presence as the number of images taken.
A.explanation: Labels do not indicate quantity or position.

B.text: Predict the number of items based on the shooting times of each photo, but do not handle where they are on the image.
B.explanation: Fails to meet the business requirements for location verification.

C.text: Generate a brief description for the photos, and count the number of times the term "case" appears in the text.
C.explanation: The number of terms in the description does not refer to the count in the image.

D.text: The positions for each case are shown on the image in object detection; detection results are evaluated even in overlapping photos.
D.explanation: Can handle both the number of targets and their positions.

learning.concept: A task that requires the number and location of multiple objects, and a method to detect each object individually rather than using image labels.
learning.reason: Detect locations for each item and count the number of items, so the responsible person can verify the results even in cases of density or overlap.

aib-c01-d1-059@1.title: Do not remove extreme values uniformly
aib-c01-d1-059@1.prompt: There are orders 20 times higher than usual in the order prediction history. Upon checking, some are indeed from actual large-scale promotions, while others seem to be due to an error in the input numbers. I also want to handle future promotions. What is the appropriate data preparation?

A.text: Treat all extreme records as correct and learn an extra amount to increase high orders.
A.explanation: Recording errors affect the model.

B.text: Use the original invoices and promotional records to distinguish between genuine large orders and incorrect entries, and verify the performance of the confirmed promotional conditions.
B.explanation: Maintain important business changes and correct obvious errors.

C.text: All rows where the difference from the average exceeds the threshold value are removed, and even in a month including promotional activities, the results are considered representative.
C.explanation: Lose the actual promotions that should be predicted.

D.text: Just decide to release it because all extreme values have been replaced with the median, making predictions easier.
D.explanation: Cannot handle the increase in existing short-term demand.

learning.concept: Identify the causes of outliers using original data and related metrics, and distinguish between correct exceptions and recording errors
learning.reason: Compare with representative cases in the source materials to distinguish confirmed achievements from recording errors. If promotional factors are evident during operation, they are treated as items for evaluation in large-scale cases.

aib-c01-d1-060@1.title: Determine where to collect additional training data
aib-c01-d1-060@1.prompt: In independent evaluation for review assistance, while standard applications are good, applications involving multiple parties including agents often contain many errors. The format of the data is known, and the cause of errors is the lack of correct examples in this category. Which budget usage applies to the additional label?

A.text: Use the predictions of the current model as correct answers for all cases, and train the same output for the incorrect categories as well.
A.explanation: Copy the identified errors into the training data.

B.text: Exclude data involving agents from training, reduce the total number of measurements, and speed up evaluation.
B.explanation: Remove the categories that need improvement from the target.

C.text: Randomly add cases in the same proportion as the current configuration, and judge based solely on improvements in standard applications.
C.explanation: Information about categories where errors are concentrated remains insufficient.

D.text: Prioritize cases involving agents for independent verification of correct answers, separate them into training and evaluation sets, and re-evaluate standard applications.
D.explanation: Add cases targeted at missing information, allowing for the verification of side effects.

learning.concept: Do not collect new data uniformly from the entire set, but instead collect according to identified high-impact failure categories.
learning.reason: Collect correct examples from categories that are affected. Use some of them for evaluation purposes and confirm whether the performance of standard applications can be maintained.

aib-c01-d1-061@1.title: Distributing inquiries with many different manifestations
aib-c01-d1-061@1.prompt: There are three correct departments responsible for inquiries related to home appliance services. There are many labeled records confirmed by the staff, but there are multiple variations for similar requests, and many cases cannot be classified using fixed word rules. Which of the following is appropriate as a decision-making criterion when using AI?

A.text: Determine the next allocation based on past processing rates per deployment, and do not use the inquiry text.
A.explanation: Cannot consider the actual requirements.

B.text: Since the deployment is already confirmed, a new department name will be generated for each inquiry and adopted.
B.explanation: It won’t be a allocation aligned with existing responsibilities.

C.text: To eliminate keyword leaks, all words seen for the first time are assigned to the most busy department.
C.explanation: Increase unnecessary transfers without evaluating components.

D.text: Try text classification using confirmed examples, send cases with uncertain classifications to the responsible person, and compare misrouted messages by department.
D.explanation: While accommodating diversity of expression, exceptions can be handled by humans.

learning.concept: When there are confirmed labels but the text matching cannot be listed using handwritten rules, try classification assistance
learning.reason: Classify from free entry into known departments, and if it's difficult to judge, send it to the existing responsible person. If there are clear assignment criteria already in place, use the existing rules.

aib-c01-d1-062@1.title: When you can’t provide all the images, choose the range to read
aib-c01-d1-062@1.prompt: A maintenance team uses AI to identify equipment model numbers from many high-resolution photos. Providing all photos at once exceeds the input limit. Downscaling entire images makes the small lettering on the equipment nameplates unreadable. How should the team process the images while retaining evidence of the model numbers?

A.text: Extract the area of the plaque while maintaining readable text quality and references to photos, and process only the necessary portion.
A.explanation: Can preserve evidence while minimizing input capacity.

B.text: All images are reduced to the same minimum resolution, and any model numbers that become unreadable are left to AI to guess.
B.explanation: Loses the desired text information.

C.text: Send all images, trim off the excess beyond the limit, and do not record which original sources were referenced.
C.explanation: Missed items and inability to track the evidence will occur.

D.text: The model number is determined based on the average number of times it appears in photos, and the plaque image can only be viewed after inquiry.
D.explanation: I cannot verify the model number that was actually photographed.

learning.concept: Consider both the details of the image and the constraints on context volume, and select the area needed for the task while maintaining quality.
learning.reason: Extract the text area from the plaque to maintain readable quality. Add a label to the image and process only the necessary images; if they cannot be read, it is sent for verification.

aib-c01-d1-063@1.title: Use knowledge in a form that can be excluded individually later
aib-c01-d1-063@1.prompt: The organization may use its training partners’ materials to answer questions only while consent is valid. If one company withdraws consent, the organization must be able to remove only that company’s material from the sources used to answer questions on the same day. The materials contain proprietary information that the original model was not trained on. Which way of adding the information is appropriate?

A.text: Mix materials from all contract partners for fine-tuning, and only delete the original learning file when consent is revoked.
A.explanation: Even if the source of learning is deleted, it cannot be said that the influence of specific materials has been removed from the already updated model.

B.text: Manage reference materials per contract partner and verify them during permission searches; when consent is revoked, remove them from the results that are used and reused.
B.explanation: You can apply individual material usage restrictions without rewriting the learned weights.

C.text: Even when consent is revoked, obtain old materials for a certain period and indicate 'revoked' at the end of the generation.
C.explanation: It is not possible to meet the requirement of not using requirements that are requested to be stopped.

D.text: Summarize materials from each company into a single learning dataset, and set the configuration so that only the name of the revoked company is not displayed.
D.explanation: Even if the name is hidden, it is not possible to confirm whether the use of content derived from the relevant material has been stopped.

learning.concept: Do not reflect documents requesting suspension of use in model weights; enforce usage permission during searches to confirm reflection
learning.reason: Do not train materials into model weights; treat them as reference data with clear contract partners and permissions. When consent is revoked, stop obtaining them and remove them from cache as well, to test whether they remain in the answer path.

aib-c01-d2-049@1.title: Distinguish those who are likely to purchase and those whose purchases increase due to targeted measures.
aib-c01-d2-049@1.prompt: The retail company wants to increase net profit with a limited number of discount coupons. If distributed to regular customers, only the cost of the discounts will increase. Within approved limits, a pilot program where some coupons are not sent out can also be implemented. Which AI strategy is suitable for the goal?

A.text: Estimate purchases that increase due to distribution from a comparison of with and without coupons, and test distribution targets based on the additional profit after discounts.
A.explanation: The effectiveness and cost of policies can be evaluated by separating them from the customer’s purchase probability.

B.text: Rank the distribution targets based on the number of coupons used, and do not verify purchases before or after distribution.
B.explanation: Even if the used coupon was used, it’s unclear whether it changed the purchase.

C.text: Change the promotional text, and use the high-opening-rate copy for all customers.
C.explanation: In conversion rates, we cannot measure the profit generated by limited coupons.

D.text: Distributed to customers with high purchase probabilities in order, and it is estimated that the maximum number of uses will result in the maximum net profit.
D.explanation: Even without coupons, the sales of those who purchased it are treated as a increase in revenue, and discounts remain.

learning.concept: According to the purpose of marketing initiatives, separate the predicted purchase probability from the increment caused by the initiatives.
learning.reason: Compare the increased purchasing and discount costs due to the delivery, and verify the distribution to the segments whose behavior changed after receiving the coupon.

aib-c01-d2-050@1.title: Combine purchase and in-house production by function unit
aib-c01-d2-050@1.prompt: The railway company’s AI guide requires general Japanese processing capabilities, as well as support for determining transfer shipments specific to the company. Commercial language processing components meet the requirements, and transfer rules are updated daily by the company’s staff. Building everything in would exceed the deadline, but only the processing of transfer rules can be developed in-house. What is the appropriate approach?

A.text: Move the decision-making of transfers to external generic functions, and develop language processing from scratch solely for differentiation.
A.explanation: The functions that require in-house implementation are the opposite of those that can be replaced.

B.text: Leave the transfer rules to the commercial answer service, and wait for the provider’s annual update when changes occur.
B.explanation: Unable to handle unique operations that require daily updates.

C.text: Buy language processing components, and handle transfer decisions, approved documents, and evaluations in-house. Try to connect the two.
C.explanation: Can obtain basic features within the deadline while maintaining its own responsibilities.

D.text: All functions will be developed in-house, and new staff are not needed even though the deadline has passed.
D.explanation: Does not meet the conditions for available time and capabilities.

learning.concept: Buy basic capabilities that can be standardized, and manage the differentiated and responsible parts internally
learning.reason: General language processing involves purchasing proven components, and the changing unique rules and their validation are managed by the company itself. Clear boundaries and versions are defined.

aib-c01-d2-051@1.title: Avoid double counting of measures that expect the same effect
aib-c01-d2-051@1.prompt: In the claims department, AI document checking and the update of business input forms are both expected to reduce the same type of verification errors. Individual trials have shown certain improvements. How should we decide whether to allocate funds for both?

A.text: Evaluate the improvement range of each unit together under the same criteria, and make an investment decision based on the second additional component and additional costs.
A.explanation: By not adding the individual results of both measures directly, overlapping improvements can be avoided.

B.text: Increase points only for initiatives that use AI, but exclude from comparison even if the improvement in form refresh is confirmed.
B.explanation: It is given priority as a measure of policy, and no net benefits are compared.

C.text: Since it is difficult to determine duplicates, both budgets are set at the same amount, and no differences between standalone or combined use are recorded after implementation.
C.explanation: The basis for budget allocation and additional outcomes remain unclear.

D.text: Simply add the reduced number of errors from individual tests, and include the full effect in both budgets.
D.explanation: Two results of reducing the same error are included.

learning.concept: The individual effects per policy and the additional effects when used in combination, to avoid duplicate expectation of the same business outcome
learning.reason: Since the targets for improvement overlap, a comparison is made between using only one approach and combining them, to evaluate whether additional benefits are obtained for the additional costs.

aib-c01-d2-052@1.title: Do not leave judgment to AI while business rules remain contradictory
aib-c01-d2-052@1.prompt: There are official documents stating that sales and accounting handle refunds differently, so it is not yet decided which one should be prioritized. The main cause of current errors is not the difficulty of input, but this contradiction. In response to a proposal that asking the new AI to read both documents could solve the issue, what should be prioritized?

A.text: Provide both documents to the model and use the explanation with the highest generation probability as the future official policy.
A.explanation: There is no authority to unify the policy based on the model’s output.

B.text: Change only half of the erroneous processes according to AI judgment, and verify compatibility with the old policy later.
B.explanation: Change business decisions without resolving the contradiction.

C.text: Automatically prioritize documents from departments with a high number of processes, skipping approval by business owners.
C.explanation: The priority of policies is not determined by the number of processes.

D.text: Gather policy owners to decide on applications and exceptions, then organize the old version. After that, re-evaluate the processes that can be supported.
D.explanation: Resolve the root cause and create reliable business requirements.

learning.concept: When the correct answer for judgment is not determined by organizational policy, first organize authority and application of rules
learning.reason: The owner determines the policies and exceptions applied, as well as revisions and announcements. Ambiguous organizational policy is not replaced by AI output.

aib-c01-d2-053@1.title: Determine the person in charge and record for cases across transitions
aib-c01-d2-053@1.prompt: Change contract acceptance from manual work to AI support. On the transition date, there are many unfinished cases, and some have already been answered by humans with customer deadlines. The new system will automatically recognize only new submissions. Choose two preparations for the actual transition.

A.text: Treat all existing cases as new, and discard previous responsibilities and deadlines information.
A.explanation: Lead to returns, deadline violations, and duplicate commitments.

B.text: Stop old processes after stopping new submissions. Do not check which cases remain in the stopped list.
B.explanation: The ongoing state required for the transition is not carried over.

C.text: Test only the performance of new submissions, and handle unfinished cases when users contact again.
C.explanation: Cannot meet the promised deadline before the transition.

D.text: Use existing case IDs to distinguish new submissions, and check for unprocessed or double registrations during transition exercises.
D.explanation: Can verify whether the transfer proceeds as planned through actual paths.

E.text: Compare the person in charge and deadlines of unfinished cases, and decide which parts to complete using the old process and which to transfer.
E.explanation: Can maintain promised answers and responsibilities even during transitions.

learning.concept: During transition, compare the state of unfinished cases and inherit the person in charge and deadlines for each case
learning.reason: Inventory retained cases, inherit responsibilities, progress, and answer deadlines. Identify new and ongoing processing to prevent leftovers and duplicates

aib-c01-d2-054@1.title: Measuring deadlines violations that are not visible in average time
aib-c01-d2-054@1.prompt: With AI support, the average processing time for applications has reduced from 60 minutes to 30 minutes. However, there are reports indicating that long manual verification cases remain, and the operational goal of processing all applications within 2 hours is not being met. What should be added as the next key metric?

A.text: Average of the 10 items that completed the processing fastest.
A.explanation: Exclude long-term projects from observation.

B.text: Average number of seconds until text input begins.
B.explanation: It does not measure whether the entire application process is completed on time.

C.text: Count the proportion of projects exceeding 2 hours by category, including exception cases.
C.explanation: Directly measure which types of delays remain to achieve the usage goals.

D.text: The value divided by the number of text drafts created by AI in the application.
D.explanation: Even when indicating the amount of processing, it does not indicate whether there is a deadline violation or not.

learning.concept: Evaluate the expiration of the deadline that needs to be protected in business operations separately from the average processing time
learning.reason: On average, long-term projects are hidden. The proportion of projects exceeding 2 hours and the excess per category are measured under the same criteria.

aib-c01-d2-055@1.title: Compare processing levels across all sites by setting different baseline standards
aib-c01-d2-055@1.prompt: Site A, where AI is implemented, has many experienced staff; site B, where AI is not, has half of its cases handled by novices. Some propose comparing only the average values after implementation. What should be prepared before implementing AI?

A.text: Use the time of the most skilled staff in A as the company standard, and do not measure pre-implementation performance in B.
A.explanation: There is a bias in the target group, and comparable conditions are not available.

B.text: If a case is low difficulty, do not record it; later, change the target case without reason after implementation.
B.explanation: It is impossible to evaluate changes within the same population.

C.text: Compare only the time after A implementation and the time after B implementation, and attribute all differences to AI effects.
C.explanation: Include the difference in staff and case composition into AI effects.

D.text: Measure time and quality before implementation in both sites using the same method, and compare pre- and post-changes among teams with similar staff experience and case types.
D.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between existing differences and post-implementation changes.

learning.concept: Measure which site was faster originally before implementation, and evaluate changes relative to the baseline
learning.reason: Collect pre-implementation data for both sites using the same definition, differentiate between skill level and case difficulty. Evaluate changes in comparable conditions.

aib-c01-d2-056@1.title: According to average estimates, the hiding loss is reflected in the funding plan
aib-c01-d2-056@1.prompt: The net benefits for the first year of AI support were estimated at 1.5 million yen under normal assumptions, and -2 million yen if usage is low. Management will only accept losses of up to 1 million yen in the first year. The provider can choose fixed contracts for the first year, as well as contracts with low base fees and higher unit prices when usage increases. What is the evaluation to be conducted before approval?

A.text: Compare usage and net benefits across multiple cases per contract to determine the maximum loss at low usage and the benefits under normal conditions.
A.explanation: The average value and allowable dips in terms of funds can be evaluated per contract condition.

B.text: It is determined that a contract with low base fees will definitely allow maintaining the maximum loss in the first year, so there is no need to check usage fees and contract duration.
B.explanation: In addition to the low base fee, costs based on usage and a revenue and expense assessment are required.

C.text: Simply average the low utilization and normal expected net benefits, and decide to sign a contract based solely on the positive value.
C.explanation: Even if the average is profitable, the maximum loss for individual scenarios cannot be determined.

D.text: Since the expected result is a profit, a fixed contract is chosen without considering funding constraints during low usage.
D.explanation: The expected profit does not serve as a basis to meet the maximum loss limit during low utilization.

learning.concept: Don’t just decide based on positive benchmark ROI; also verify a conservative scenario under the loss limit condition
learning.reason: The fixed contract exceeds the allowable loss in low-usage scenarios. Compare other contracts from low to high usage, and verify whether the loss limit is met and the impact on expected benefits.

aib-c01-d2-057@1.title: Measuring Actions Before a Long-Term Contract Renewal
aib-c01-d2-057@1.prompt: The contract renewal for enterprise services is finalized in six months. AI organizes the contract details to help the representative easily reach an agreement with the customer. Which early indicator is used for next month's operational decision?

A.text: The total number of emails between the representative and the customer.
A.explanation: Even if interactions increase, it doesn't guarantee agreement or contract continuation.

B.text: Only the total renewal sales across the company obtained after six months.
B.explanation: It's a crucial final indicator, but it's not available in time for next month's decision.

C.text: The proportion of target customers who have agreed on the renewal date, time, and considerations.
C.explanation: It shows whether discussions about renewal have progressed before the final renewal date.

D.text: The number of characters in the contract summary generated by AI.
D.explanation: It's a processing format and does not indicate that renewal is nearing.

learning.concept: Tracking the proportion of customers who have moved from initial confirmation to actual decision-making regarding outcomes that are finalized later
learning.reason: It focuses on the proportion of customers who have taken next actions such as inquiries or agreements, rather than just the number of views or creations. This proportion is later compared with the actual renewal.

aib-c01-d2-058@1.title: Separate storage purposes to manage operational costs
aib-c01-d2-058@1.prompt: The cost of AI to support proposals has increased. Analysis shows that the reason is that instead of long-term storage of approval reasons, temporary draft files are stored indefinitely. Proper storage for official reasons is mandatory. What is the appropriate cost mitigation measure?

A.text: Change the draft generation model; do not compare the amount of already accumulated temporary files.
A.explanation: The source of the increased costs identified has not been addressed.

B.text: Maintain the retention of official records, set a deadline on the intermediate file that can be recreated, and ensure the retention of costs and required data.
B.explanation: Only the causes of cost can be reduced, and obligations can be fulfilled.

C.text: Delete those with large capacity without considering their use, and set the approval criteria for the request to the same deadline.
C.explanation: It undermines the necessary long-term storage obligation.

D.text: Move all data to a cheaper storage location, without considering recovery conditions or the growing volume.
D.explanation: Unable to manage unlimited accumulation of temporary data.

learning.concept: Maintain audit records while setting a deadline for the temporary output that can be rerun to reduce pure additional costs
learning.reason: Classify formal evidence and temporary files, and set a deadline appropriate for their use in the intermediate files. Verify the dependency on auditing before deletion.

aib-c01-d2-059@1.title: Find out the usage conditions that are not met by the competitor
aib-c01-d2-059@1.prompt: In conference support for municipalities, the major competitors generally have high transcription accuracy. On the other hand, several small municipalities focus on being able to create records and send them later without an internal office network. What is the first survey to identify business gaps?

A.text: Compare the operation in a non-connectable state with the requirements of the target customer and the actual operations of competitors, and determine the value of addressing those deficiencies.
A.explanation: Identify the conditions available to customers beyond overall accuracy.

B.text: Ranks are determined based solely on the general recognition accuracy of all customers, and usage outside the network is not evaluated.
B.explanation: The decision criteria that determine the difference between candidates are excluded.

C.text: Without investigating how the terms are used, a lower price than competitors is offered to all municipalities.
C.explanation: It does not verify whether customers can perform the required tasks.

D.text: Since the competitor's market share is high, the constraints on intra-agency communication are not meaningful from a competitive perspective.
D.explanation: The individual conditions of the target layer are inferred from the market average.

learning.concept: Don’t end competitive evaluation with average functions, but compare the minimum requirements by customer segment with the shortcomings of existing services
learning.reason: Understand the key requirements of target customers, and determine whether the candidate service meets them and their willingness to pay if it does not.

aib-c01-d2-060@1.title: Utilize existing data to validate new products
aib-c01-d2-060@1.prompt: The distribution operator maintains records of the forecasts used for its own demand predictions. Under the contract, it can provide external data only for aggregated results that are not identifiable as individual transactions. Suppliers are interested in regional demand trends. Which is the most appropriate for testing a new revenue model?

A.text: Only improve the ordering accuracy within the company; do not verify the actual value that suppliers will purchase.
A.explanation: Internal improvements and the willingness to pay for new services are separate.

B.text: A service will be built for the whole country based solely on interest in the needs, and the subscription fee will be determined by the number of inquiries after launch.
B.explanation: I haven’t confirmed the price or usage intention before making a prepaid investment.

C.text: Since providing the history itself allows for free analysis, all items are provided for a fee without the aggregation conditions.
C.explanation: Exceeds the scope of external provision permitted by the contract.

D.text: A paid trial is conducted using the aggregation in the agreement to return regional trends, and it measures the update frequency, payment willingness, and maintenance costs.
D.explanation: You can verify the revenue and costs of new offerings.

learning.concept: Go beyond the efficiency of existing operations, and test analytical products based on the scope of authorization and the willingness to pay of new customers
learning.reason: Try small paid services from the aggregated offerings within the contract. Determine the frequency of use, price, and sales and maintenance costs for customers.

aib-c01-d2-061@1.title: Creating a system that increases partners capable of enhancing AI value
aib-c01-d2-061@1.prompt: A company providing AI for inspection services saw increased orders when customers could use it without changing their existing specialists. Specialists do not have time to establish individual connections. Which investment creates long-term benefits?

A.text: Require unique connections from all specialists and maintain high connection duration as a barrier to entry.
A.explanation: Bespoke integrations do not increase the number of available partners, limiting customers’ choices.

B.text: Provide common connection rules and vetted information exchange, and assess the areas of expertise that can be connected and the customer’s sustained benefits.
B.explanation: Participation allows customers to continuously increase the value they can use.

C.text: Improve only the performance of the latest model, while maintaining business connections with specialists as individual requests.
C.explanation: No changes are made to proven factors that drive orders.

D.text: Replace all specialists’ outputs with internal AI, eliminating the designation of approved specialists for customers.
D.explanation: Customers who want to retain existing providers lose their value.

learning.concept: Designing compatibility and connection costs to increase value from participants rather than a single model
learning.reason: Establish standard connection methods and contract requirements to make it easier for specialists to participate, and evaluate the breadth of available expertise areas and customer continuity.

aib-c01-d2-062@1.title: Don’t apply the same investment ratio to markets with different levels of maturity
aib-c01-d2-062@1.prompt: In Market A, the AI maintenance support has established partners and operational models, and competitors are also strengthening local support. In Market B, the types of device data permitted and the demand from enterprises are still unclear, and it is uncertain whether existing AI can be provided as is. Which is the most appropriate investment allocation for next period?

A.text: Stop investing in customer support for Market A until the investigation of Market B is completed, and handle all responses to competitors together.
A.explanation: It is delayed until it can confirm the demand in Market A and respond to competition.

B.text: A will strengthen local operations based on the obtained value and competition, while B will limit investments to conditionality and verification of paid demand.
B.explanation: In confirmed and unconfirmed markets, the required funds and judgment criteria can be handled separately.

C.text: Because competitors have little track record in market B, roll out across that entire market ahead of market A, before establishing the data-use terms.
C.explanation: Long-term costs are incurred based on uncertain demand and implementation conditions.

D.text: Since the models are the same, budgets are allocated equally to both markets using only the existing sales scale.
D.explanation: No differences in competition and adoption conditions across regions are addressed.

learning.concept: Even if the product technologies are the same, reflect the competition speed and adoption conditions into additional investments by region
learning.reason: In A, proven customer value is compared with competitive conditions to invest in operations. In B, rather than large deployments, the usage conditions and payment willingness are evaluated to determine the next investment.

aib-c01-d2-063@1.title: Deliver the experience lost due to role change to the right people
aib-c01-d2-063@1.prompt: In night maintenance of equipment, restoration is delayed as the night staff has to re-examine symptoms observed during the day and uncompleted checks. The work details are listed in the approved handover records. Which measures and evaluations are appropriate?

A.text: Let AI generate night plans, and use the number of schedule tables created as business performance.
A.explanation: It does not check if the diagnostic information needed for restoration will be received.

B.text: Predict future equipment upgrade costs and measure whether the gap with quarterly budgets decreases.
B.explanation: Doesn’t handle the problem of searching for information during overnight handovers.

C.text: Present symptoms, confirmed and unimplemented actions, and reference to original records for handover, along with investigation time and identifying omissions.
C.explanation: Can directly improve the handover that causes delays.

D.text: Rank the number of items restored before the handover, and do not measure post-assignment changes.
D.explanation: Unable to evaluate the value in cases requiring succession.

learning.concept: Linking the diagnostic information required for department transfer to the performance metrics that make it effective
learning.reason: Extract the necessary grounds and ongoing matters, and assess any gaps in confirmation during handover and the time required for re-examination.

aib-c01-d2-064@1.title: Distinguish benefits that require a change to an external process
aib-c01-d2-064@1.prompt: The AI in the logistics department can significantly shorten delivery times if external vendors temporarily increase two pickups per day. On the other hand, measures to detect incorrect shipping labels in advance are less effective, but can be implemented solely by the company. Negotiations with external parties will not yield results until half a year later. What is the next plan?

A.text: Try to improve the misdelivered notices, and the collection improvement will be planned and estimated separately under external agreement.
A.explanation: It can distinguish uncertain benefits while achieving the effects obtained by the company itself.

B.text: Since there is no agreement with external parties, both effects are set to zero, and improvements that can be tested solely by the company are not evaluated.
B.explanation: Remove measures that can be implemented independently.

C.text: The maximum benefits of both measures will be fully recorded for this fiscal year, allowing budget execution even if external contracts are not finalized.
C.explanation: Uncertain dependencies have been treated as implemented.

D.text: It is assumed that by only improving the AI performance without changing the number of delivery contracts, the same delivery timeline effect can be achieved for all items.
D.explanation: The constraints on physical pickup capacity remain the same.

learning.concept: Separate benefits that depend on others' uncertain actions, and prioritize those within the scope where operators can improve
learning.reason: First, verify the conditions under which benefits can be achieved, and start with improvements that can be measured by the company itself. The effects of external dependence should be conditional until an agreement is reached.

aib-c01-d2-065@1.title: Evaluate the license as a condition of adoption separate from the purchase price
aib-c01-d2-065@1.prompt: The marketing company uses generative AI to create regional guides for customers. The cheapest provider reuses manuscripts into shared data, and cannot offer the usage rights required for commercial products. Another provider agrees to both conditions in writing and within budget. The functionality was equivalent during testing. Which provider selection policy should the agency adopt?

A.text: It is claimed that by limiting input to a small amount, operations can be carried out without verifying the terms of rights.
A.explanation: The usage conditions that apply even in small amounts remain the same.

B.text: Evaluate providers whose usage rights and input handling can be confirmed in a contract, and compare contracts with actual practices.
B.explanation: Can handle the rights and operating conditions that must be met before price comparison.

C.text: If the trial results are equivalent, the cheapest option will be chosen; whether data is reused or not will be confirmed during contract renewal.
C.explanation: Does not meet the customer requirements needed before public release.

D.text: Once the output is edited within the company, it is treated as having contractual usage rights.
D.explanation: According to the edited facts, contractual rights cannot be confirmed.

learning.concept: After confirming the rights to the service and reliance on the provider, compare the required features and costs
learning.reason: First require providers to prohibit data reuse and grant commercial usage rights. Compare cost, quality, and operational responsibilities among the proposals that meet both requirements.

aib-c01-d2-066@1.title: Determine whether we can choose a reliable actual measurement that is cheaper than estimated.
aib-c01-d2-066@1.prompt: There is a proposal to estimate the storage capacity of warehouses accurately using AI from daily photos. Goods hidden behind obstacles cannot be seen in photos. By adding a simple counting device to existing loading equipment, the number of target goods can be measured directly with the required accuracy and cost. Which option should be chosen?

A.text: Skip accuracy verification and evaluate improvement in counts based on the number of departments using AI.
A.explanation: The values required by the warehouse have not been measured.

B.text: Both complex AI and counting machines will be implemented, and how to handle different values will be determined by each responsible person after operation.
B.explanation: More than necessary mechanisms remain, along with inconsistencies in judgment.

C.text: The total is estimated based only on the visible parts of the photos, and the number of hidden cargo items is not evaluated.
C.explanation: Errors remain in the parts that cannot be observed.

D.text: Verify the counting machine’s operation through typical input and output processes, and select the direct counting method if it meets the required accuracy and operational costs.
D.explanation: Data close to the cause can be obtained within the necessary conditions.

learning.concept: Compare AI based on the required accuracy and operational burden when on-site measurement can be performed at a low cost
learning.reason: If the determined cost allows direct measurement of the required value, try counting instead of estimating invisible goods, and verify the operation procedure and accuracy.

aib-c01-d2-067@1.title: Find existing confirmations that are lost due to AIization
aib-c01-d2-067@1.prompt: The approvers marked the lines where the price exceeded the standard with a hand mark on the paper application form. After transitioning to AI support, the price list becomes a short list, so it can be read without marking. The verification of high-value items remains essential. What should be done before accepting the transition?

A.text: Display an image of a paper mark on the screen, and do not record who checked the relevant row.
A.explanation: It’s not clear that the necessary matching was performed only through visual representation.

B.text: Identify price overruns and request verification, trying to confirm the approvaler’s match result and the target later.
B.explanation: Existing business controls can be replicated in the actual new process.

C.text: Prioritize the ability to display concisely, and consider the presence of previous marks as a requirement solely on paper.
C.explanation: The verification obligations tailored to India will not be replaced.

D.text: Accept it just by reducing the creation time, and address any missed high-value items when audit comments come in.
D.explanation: Postpone the controls that can be verified before operation.

learning.concept: Inventory the operational controls included in the old system, and ensure the same purpose is maintained in the new configuration after the transition
learning.reason: Continuing the traditional purpose of stamps, identifying overages, and confirming the conditions and evidence for cases requiring human judgment.

aib-c01-d2-068@1.title: Are the internal time savings not becoming a burden on users?
aib-c01-d2-068@1.prompt: With AI support, the internal verification time has been reduced. Instead, customers manually fill in the additional formats required by AI. The goal is not only to reduce internal time but also to minimize the customer’s burden until the request is completed. What is the most appropriate KPI?

A.text: Track the customer input and correction time, number of re-submissions, and final completion rate under the same criteria.
A.explanation: The additional burden and final result can be measured together.

B.text: Only for applications with short completion times, the generation time of the text submitted by AI is measured.
B.explanation: Except for difficult applications, it does not account for the actual customer burden.

C.text: Count the number of formats provided to customers; the higher the count, the more convenient it is.
C.explanation: The number of options cannot evaluate the burden of inputting and retrying.

D.text: Convert the shortened amount to the amount based on the verification time of the person in charge.
D.explanation: Does not measure the impact on the customer side.

learning.concept: Measuring the total burden, including the processing time of the responsible department and the customer-side input and rework
learning.reason: Measure customer work, additional requests, errors-related corrections, and completion results, and confirm whether the burden has been shifted to another location.

aib-c01-d2-069@1.title: Exclude changes in review criteria from the measured effect of AI
aib-c01-d2-069@1.prompt: Before AI implementation, internal summaries were judged verbally as good or bad. After implementation, another person will score them using a 5-point scale. What should be done first to make changes in quality comparable?

A.text: Start only with the evaluation after implementation, and consider the average score on the start date as the previous state.
A.explanation: There is no baseline for comparison before implementation.

B.text: Create a common scoring table to gather scorers, and compare representative past results with post-implementation summaries under the same conditions.
B.explanation: The change in evaluation method can be distinguished from changes in quality.

C.text: Before implementation, the length of the text is used; after implementation, accuracy scores are used to compare changes on an equal scale.
C.explanation: The properties being measured are different.

D.text: Before implementation, the good/bad ratings are mechanically converted to 5 points/1 point, assuming they meet the new criteria.
D.explanation: It cannot be proven that the actual quality and grading criteria are the same.

learning.concept: Using the same quality standards and calibration methods for reviews since before implementation, to avoid differences in standards
learning.reason: Define common grading criteria, and evaluate the representative outputs before and after implementation using the same method. Align the judges' judgments with examples.

aib-c01-d2-070@1.title: Calculate the funding recovery period in case improvement is delayed
aib-c01-d2-070@1.prompt: The implementation cost of the AI support service is 900,000 yen. After deducting operating costs, the net benefit is 0 yen in the first and second months, and 150,000 yen per month starting from the third month. The benefit is recorded at the end of each month, with no other revenues or expenses. When is the first time the initial cost is recovered?

A.text: At the end of month 9. Wait until the month after benefits match the upfront cost.
A.explanation: The upfront cost is first recovered at the end of month 8, when cumulative benefits equal the cost.

B.text: At the end of month 6. Use only the upfront cost and the regular monthly benefit.
B.explanation: It does not include the period when there is no benefit in the first two months.

C.text: At the end of month 8. The 6 positive monthly benefits from month 3 through month 8 add up to JPY 900,000.
C.explanation: It reflects the actual start point of benefits and the cumulative amount.

D.text: At the end of month 7. Assume benefits start in month 2.
D.explanation: The benefit in month 2 is JPY 0.

learning.concept: Use the period before the net benefit stabilizes as well, and find the month when the cumulative benefit reaches the initial cost
learning.reason: It takes JPY 900,000 ÷ JPY 150,000 = 6 months of positive benefits. The first 2 months yield no benefit, so the upfront cost is recovered at the end of month 8.

aib-c01-d2-071@1.title: Use the implementation rate of proposals in practice as a leading indicator
aib-c01-d2-071@1.prompt: Even if the conservative AI inspection system identifies potential issues, actual inspections cannot be carried out without the necessary parts. It will be several months before we can determine a reduction in failures. What is the leading indicator to use for operational improvement next month?

A.text: Just the rating for the readability of the proposal text.
A.explanation: Unable to measure the physical conditions that hinder the implementation of inspections.

B.text: Disposal costs for all equipment in the next year.
B.explanation: It won’t be ready by the month when the decision on improvement implementation is made.

C.text: The proportion of proposals deemed appropriate that were implemented within the specified time frame, and the reasons for non-implementation.
C.explanation: Can observe the necessary actions at the recommended end.

D.text: Total number of proposal displays per day.
D.explanation: Does not measure the execution status.

learning.concept: Early detection of reasons for execution and non-implementation that are not apparent during the proposal review
learning.reason: Identify the number of approved proposals that could be implemented within the allowed period, and the reasons why they cannot be implemented due to components or other factors.

aib-c01-d2-072@1.title: Reduce the cost of waiting processes that no longer contribute to results
aib-c01-d2-072@1.prompt: The sales script generation process is processed sequentially after receiving an order. During the waiting period, the sales representative may cancel the order, but the current system continues to generate all orders. In verification, canceled processes accounted for 20% of the usage costs. What is the appropriate measure?

A.text: Move all orders to a larger model to increase the accuracy rate of scripts, without changing the cancellation process.
A.explanation: It is impossible to reduce usage costs that do not lead to results.

B.text: Remove the cancel button from the screen, and continue counting the number of orders generated per month as before.
B.explanation: There is no way to stop the obsolete processes.

C.text: To reduce the monthly budget by the same percentage, process half of all orders and ignore the rest.
C.explanation: Necessary tasks are also lost, and it is unclear which costs have been reduced.

D.text: Before processing, check for cancellations and expired dates to exclude them, and monitor the delivery time and cost per completed order for valid orders.
D.explanation: Reduce unnecessary generation and track the quality of ongoing tasks.

learning.concept: Recheck the order status before processing to prevent canceled or expired work
learning.reason: Verify the case status at the start of processing and exclude cancellations or expired orders. Measure delays and costs for orders that remain.

aib-c01-d3-041@1.title: Limit how the information needed for fairness verification can be used
aib-c01-d3-041@1.prompt: For guiding users to AI consultation contacts, there is no need to use age groups. However, in auditing, it is necessary to check whether misguidance occurs unevenly by age group. Only for audit purposes can collection be approved, and access to personal information can also be restricted. Which is the appropriate design?

A.text: Keep the data separate from inference. Let a limited audit team use it for evaluation within the approved scope, then aggregate and report the results.
A.explanation: It allows for checking errors by group while limiting the use of unnecessary information.

B.text: If used for fairness checks, the age range should be sent with each inference as well, allowing the provider to reuse it freely.
B.explanation: Approval for auditing is not a permission for inference or secondary use.

C.text: Remove the age group from all operations, and assume there is no difference in misdirection between groups.
C.explanation: Remove any means to directly verify fairness.

D.text: Keep only the age group of correct users, and exclude misdirection records from auditing.
D.explanation: The failure cases needed for bias detection are removed.

learning.concept: Separate the attributes of the protected object from the inference inputs and handle them exclusively for approved fairness auditing.
learning.reason: Without adding unnecessary attributes to the normal inference, it is linked to auditing with approved deadlines and permissions, and reports are aggregated.

aib-c01-d3-042@1.title: Examine whether cost reduction measures are not a unfair decision
aib-c01-d3-042@1.prompt: The internal AI system calculated the response times for each employee. To streamline evaluations, management proposed automatically targeting those who respond slowly as training subjects. In reality, the more experienced employees handle more complex tasks, and there has been no verification of the relationship between time and ability. Which is a valid judgment?

A.text: The proposal to automatically identify individuals based on response time will be put on hold, and a decision will be made on what is feasible and subject to human review by comparing difficulty, quality, and evaluation objectives.
A.explanation: Both the benefits of efficiency and the validity of decisions that cause personal harm can be confirmed.

B.text: The subject's name is hidden during the initial review, and the target audience is automatically determined based on the response time.
B.explanation: Anonymization does not improve the validity of the metrics.

C.text: It is fair to evaluate all personnel using the same time standard, and the complexity of the tasks is excluded.
C.explanation: Even with seemingly the same criteria, differences in task allocation affect the results.

D.text: Since achieving the usage goals is prioritized, the validity is determined based on the number of objections after the evaluation starts.
D.explanation: Incorrect personal evaluations were made first, and those metrics were not verified.

learning.concept: Before applying business metrics to individual capabilities, verify the differences in working conditions and the validity of judgments
