learning.reason: The response time can serve as a reference for business improvement, but its validity as a basis for personal evaluation has not been confirmed. A re-evaluation should be conducted by aligning the criteria, including project complexity and quality, with human review.

aib-c01-d3-043@1.title: Identify those affected before finalizing requirements
aib-c01-d3-043@1.prompt: There is a plan to transfer phone guidance after a branch closes. The draft order is created solely by management and development, and responsibilities for handling cases involving non-native speakers, family members acting on behalf, and human agents remain unconfirmed. What should be done before design review?

A.text: During testing, only users who find automated responses easiest to use are checked; other users will be reviewed after official release.
A.explanation: It is not possible to verify conditions that could cause disadvantage based on specifications.

B.text: Treat the target number set by management as the requirement for all relevant parties, excluding the convenience of the responsible person during testing.
B.explanation: It is not possible to understand the conditions of those directly affected and those responsible for alternative responses.

C.text: Identify representatives of relevant parties and the impact in case of failure, then incorporate alternative paths and acceptance criteria into specifications and testing.
C.explanation: Difficulties can be reflected in the design before deciding on models or delivery methods.

D.text: Recruit participants after development is completed, and consider the path for cases where it cannot be used through maintenance.
D.explanation: Impact and necessary conditions are not reflected in the initial design.

learning.concept: At the beginning of design, separate the impact on direct users, decision-makers, and operators, and use these as criteria for failure
learning.reason: Investigate the conditions of those affected and operators, and include unusable conditions and safe alternatives in requirements and acceptance criteria.

aib-c01-d3-044@1.title: Check if the approval officer has the skills needed for the decision
aib-c01-d3-044@1.prompt: Generate loan terms instructions in multiple languages. In the current approval screen, the system allows submission even if the staff cannot understand the original text. During testing, there were mistranslations in terms of repayment conditions in other languages, which general staff did not notice. Choose two measures to effectively enforce human supervision.

A.text: To save time in finding a language-ready person, formal submissions are made based only on formal conditions such as numbers and terms.
A.explanation: Even the same numbers may be misinterpreted.

B.text: If the person responsible for pressing the approval button on the screen is present, whether they understand the language is not recorded.
B.explanation: Even counting the approval operations, it is not guaranteed that the content can be verified.

C.text: Send it to the responsible person who can confirm the output language and repayment terms, and entrust the judgment and approval of any mistranslation.
C.explanation: You can acquire the language skills and business knowledge needed to evaluate the meaning of results.

D.text: If the required-skilled person is not available, hold back the unverified translation and transfer it to a verified manned guide or similar.
D.explanation: Even during low-person-time periods, support can be provided without delivering unclear information to customers.

E.text: Translate it again using the same AI that created the translation, and treat the same text as if it had been approved by a human.
E.explanation: The same model may repeat incorrect translations, and it cannot replace expert judgment.

learning.concept: Even for settings verified by people, if the language or expertise doesn’t match, it cannot become a supervisor, so it must be sent to the appropriate person.
learning.reason: Assign the project to a responsible person who can verify both language and business knowledge. If the required person cannot be secured, postpone the submission and transfer it to an approved channel.

aib-c01-d3-045@1.title: Clarify the standards set by the central authority and the operational responsibilities at the field level
aib-c01-d3-045@1.prompt: The AI committee of the group establishes common prohibitions. Each company has the best understanding of users and operations. There is a plan for each company to use the same AI for different tasks, and each company believes that 'if a model is approved centrally, the business decision-making falls under central responsibility.' How should this be organized?

A.text: Do not determine operational responsibilities within the organization; when issues arise, gather those responsible for the implementation costs.
A.explanation: Judgment and correction of accidents are delayed.

B.text: Prioritize each company's discretion, and do not apply common prohibitions or exceptions reporting.
B.explanation: The minimum standards of the group are not established.

C.text: Establish central minimum standards and review criteria, and business owners for each use case shall assume operational tolerances, supervision, and correction.
C.explanation: It is possible to balance common control with operational responsibility.

D.text: Models approved by the central authority are approved by all companies regardless of use, and operational issues shall be borne by the provider.
D.explanation: Judgment related to use cases and field responsibilities are omitted.

learning.concept: Do not confuse central review with final business decision; separate common standards from specific business risk responsibilities
learning.reason: The central authority handles minimum standards and high-impact case reviews, while business owners of each company are responsible for supervision of their own use cases and residual risks. Boundaries and reporting conditions are clarified.

aib-c01-d3-046@1.title: When obligations change, they must be reflected in products and operations
aib-c01-d3-046@1.prompt: A new requirement was added to the company’s advertising operation policy: when using AI-generated images, records of display and approval must be kept. The existing generation function can be made public without checking these conditions. What is needed to implement this change?

A.text: Organize the relevant items, make display and approval mandatory before publication, and assign a responsible person to verify and record this compliance.
A.explanation: Link the policy to actual operations and evidence.

B.text: Distribute only a link to the new policy; leave the processing and evidence during publication to individual team members.
B.explanation: It is not possible to confirm that the obligation is consistently fulfilled.

C.text: Only change the agreement for the generation model; keep existing public features as exceptions to formal procedures.
C.explanation: New conditions are not applied to the relevant public channels.

D.text: Regularly measure the accuracy of image generation, and only check display and approval records if accuracy declines.
D.explanation: The policy conditions and image quality are separate.

learning.concept: Not only maintain static documents during approval, but also expand new requirements to responsible persons, inspections, and evidence of fulfillment.
learning.reason: Identify relevant tasks and exceptions, assign display and approval responsibilities to specific individuals. Confirm that verification and record-keeping are in place before making it effective.

aib-c01-d3-047@1.title: Even for the same AI, operation permissions can be changed based on the user's scope of work
aib-c01-d3-047@1.prompt: The internal equipment AI can query past repair records, and only administrators can determine the repair date. Requests are made from the same screen, but if a regular employee writes 'I am an administrator' in the text, the update cannot be performed. Choose two solutions.

A.text: Give all users the same update rights and hide only the administrator icon on the screen.
A.explanation: It is not possible to restrict backend operation permissions through screen display.

B.text: Separate the query and update operations, and limit the qualifications and target equipment for updates to the minimum required by role.
B.explanation: The effects of reading and state changes can be managed separately.

C.text: If a regular employee claims to be an administrator, allow the update and verify it in the next day's summary.
C.explanation: Permission cannot be determined through self-reporting.

D.text: In the update process, compare the current role of the authenticated user with the permissions granted to the target before confirming.
D.explanation: The input text of the model and the approval of operations can be separated.

E.text: In instructions to the model, write 'only administrators are allowed', and the actual operation side does not check the approval.
E.explanation: The decision on permissions depends on text generation.

learning.concept: Separate only information viewing from record modification, and have the server enforce it based on the role of the authenticated user
learning.reason: Handle query and update with different permissions, and verify the authenticated role and target for update requests. Do not determine roles based on input text.

aib-c01-d3-048@1.title: Even with the same mechanism, reassess the risk based on scale of delivery and dependencies
aib-c01-d3-048@1.prompt: Summary: AI was considered low-risk as only a few interested individuals could use it voluntarily. In the future, it will be required for all employees' task handover, and there is a plan to eliminate alternative procedures. The generation function remains unchanged. Which aspect should be evaluated through reclassification?

A.text: Risk is determined solely based on the ratio to the traditional trial size, and no dependence on critical operations is investigated.
A.explanation: Just the number of people is not enough to grasp the severity of the business disruption.

B.text: Re-evaluate the target number of users, alternative routes, dependence on critical handovers, and recovery conditions, and increase necessary management.
B.explanation: The impact that changes during deployment can be reflected in risk assessment.

C.text: It is assumed that as the number of users increases, the model's output accuracy also improves, so the low tier is maintained.
C.explanation: Usage and accuracy improvement are not the same, and the impact of shutdown is not addressed either.

D.text: If the functions are the same, the dependence on the number of users and operations does not affect the risk.
D.explanation: The damage at shutdown and the user choices change.

learning.concept: Do not extrapolate the low impact during testing to the entire company; re-evaluate the risks of stopping and restoring when dependence becomes deep
learning.reason: With the expansion of usage and the loss of alternative methods, the impact of errors and downtime spreads. Re-examine classification and management, including the number of processes that depend on it and recovery capabilities.

aib-c01-d3-049@1.title: To notify when monitoring data itself stops
aib-c01-d3-049@1.prompt: The critical incorrect guidance from AI is counted every hour. One day, the quality value showed zero issues, but in reality, no records reached the monitoring statistics. Which item should be monitored similarly to critical incorrect guidance?

A.text: Replace it with the rate of excluding periods with no records, and do not include missing periods in the report.
A.explanation: The time when risks cannot be identified disappears.

B.text: Do not add additional monitoring, and report that if there are no incorrect guidance incidents, it has been processed correctly.
B.explanation: Confuses what was not observed with the actual zero value.

C.text: Rely solely on periodic checks to see if the monitoring screen responds.
C.explanation: Even if the screen is open, it is not guaranteed that measurement data has arrived.

D.text: Compare the processing results with the number of arrivals and freshness on the monitoring side, and notify about omissions and delays separately from quality zero.
D.explanation: It is possible to discover the stop of monitoring and confirm the actual situation.

learning.concept: Distinguish between zero events and unobservable situations, and independently verify the arrival of monitoring inputs and freshness
learning.reason: Monitor the difference between the processing count on the business side and the number of records received by monitoring, the final arrival time, and the omission rate independently, and notify about unobserved cases.

aib-c01-d3-050@1.title: Check if attributes that are not used directly are not shown in other items
aib-c01-d3-050@1.prompt: In the priority model of job guidance, applicant background information is not entered. However, it has been noted that after training, even people with the same qualifications and experience may have different rankings depending on the postal code used. What is a way to verify the cause of bias during operation?

A.text: Since no origin information has been entered, it is determined that the proxy item may not have an impact.
A.explanation: Another feature may be correlated with group differences.

B.text: Using comparison and verification examples with defined business conditions to investigate the impact of postal codes, and if there is unnecessary dependency, review input and track it.
B.explanation: Can evaluate the features that act as proxies and their correction effects.

C.text: All applicants with different postal codes are ranked equally, and valid differences in qualifications are not evaluated.
C.explanation: No cause is identified, and necessary selection information is lost.

D.text: The relationship between postal codes and results is compared based solely on the number of users, without considering qualifications or performance.
D.explanation: It is difficult to distinguish the effects of different business conditions and characteristics.

learning.concept: Regarding characteristics that may represent attributes unrelated to judgment, differences are measured under the same conditions in business operations
learning.reason: Using records or test examples with business conditions such as qualifications and experience, it evaluates whether rankings rely too heavily on postal code changes.

aib-c01-d3-051@1.title: Separating the verification of harmful original text from re-distribution
aib-c01-d3-051@1.prompt: The moderator handles organizing the key points of reported conversations by AI. The investigation team needs the original text, but for company-wide reports, only the context and classification are sufficient. The AI should not inadvertently copy offensive language into the report. What is the best change?

A.text: Show the source text only to authorized investigators. Limit the company-wide version to categories and necessary details, and review the output.
A.explanation: This prevents unnecessary re-exposure of evidence while preserving it.

B.text: Add only a warning note to the text for all employees, keeping the content and audience scope unchanged.
B.explanation: A warning note alone cannot prevent unnecessary re-distribution.

C.text: Completely remove words identified as harmful from the original record and ensure no one else, including auditors, can verify this.
C.explanation: This results in loss of necessary evidence, making it impossible to verify the correct determination.

D.text: Keep all reported cases in their original form in company-wide reports, removing only the individual names.
D.explanation: Even after removing individual names, harmful expressions may still be re-distributed.

learning.concept: Maintain restricted access for necessary investigations and limit the re-exposure of harmful content in outputs
learning.reason: Limit access and purpose for the investigation team to preserve evidence, and use classification and necessary key points in reports. Verify that no harmful original text is re-output before public release.

aib-c01-d3-052@1.title: Prevent Invalid Inputs from Being Mistaken for Operational Errors
aib-c01-d3-052@1.prompt: The expense breakdown AI is accurate for predefined formats, but it cannot distinguish between taxes and discounts in new overseas subsidiaries' formats. Both can be entered as valid numbers on the screen. Choose two measures to prevent real-world incorrect registrations.

A.text: To reduce incorrect registrations, set all taxes and discounts to zero for unknown formats.
A.explanation: Even correct documents may show incorrect amounts.

B.text: Exclude all overseas locations permanently and do not add new formats or re-evaluate quality.
B.explanation: There is no way to review problematic areas through verification.

C.text: Collect manual verification results and format occurrences, then add them to the target only after independent testing for overseas use.
C.explanation: Changes to the application scope can be based on real-world evidence.

D.text: If the output is a numeric type, register it regardless of format.
D.explanation: Misinterpretation of meaning cannot be determined solely by structure.

E.text: Identify recognized formats at the entry point, and delay automatic registration for new or uncertain formats.
E.explanation: Do not mix unevaluated inputs into operations.

learning.concept: Explicitly identify conditions outside the operational scope and confirm processing feasibility before sending to the appropriate path
learning.reason: Identify evaluated input conditions at the entry point, send non-targets to manual or verified alternative paths. Measure the emergence and correction of new formats, and expand after independent evaluation.

aib-c01-d3-053@1.title: Enable users to identify limitations in areas where AI decisions are used
aib-c01-d3-053@1.prompt: The AI that supports temperature changes in facilities has been tested with standard equipment. Although it has not been evaluated for special equipment, different conditions are only described in a long design document on another page. Which change improves transparency?

A.text: Show only the probability of generation, without indicating the conditions of available equipment.
A.explanation: A numerical value alone cannot determine the evaluation range.

B.text: Show the applicable conditions near the proposal, indicate that they need verification for special equipment, and provide an alternative procedure.
B.explanation: Users can verify the restrictions required for decision-making on the spot.

C.text: Since the information is already available, remove guidance from the design document to the usage interface.
C.explanation: It is difficult to understand the limitations at the time of decision-making.

D.text: Include examples of use with special equipment as well as explanations of standard operations, without distinguishing between evaluated and unevaluated options.
D.explanation: Users may misinterpret the evaluated range.

learning.concept: Avoid being confined to technical documents; convey the purpose of use, avoidable usage methods, and verification procedures through the actual decision interface
learning.reason: When using the proposal, briefly present the applicable conditions and non-applicable examples, along with the steps users should follow. Verify in actual operations whether users can understand the meaning and make decisions.

aib-c01-d3-054@1.title: Usually reconcile deletion with individual record retention
aib-c01-d3-054@1.prompt: Records of AI consultations are typically deleted after 90 days. The audit officer has formally instructed that certain cases be retained until the investigation is completed. Other records maintain their usual deletion criteria. How should they be managed?

A.text: All will be deleted as planned, and the content of those records will be regenerated by AI for audit purposes.
A.explanation: No actual records from that time can be preserved.

B.text: Copy the backup records into the meeting materials, and no procedures for viewing or deleting these copies are specified.
B.explanation: Unable to manage access and post-preservation processing.

C.text: Since the audit is scheduled, all records of all users will be permanently saved, with exceptions.
C.explanation: Exceeds individual scope limits and violates normal retention conditions.

D.text: Only the relevant records should be preserved, along with permissions, reasons, and termination decisions. Other records should be managed according to standard expiration rules.
D.explanation: It can balance the necessary evidence with the usual management of other data.

learning.concept: If any retention exceptions occur, limit the scope and record the normal deadlines and evidence preservation decisions.
learning.reason: Specify the subject, deadline, and responsible person to preserve this record, and continue to delete regular records. Keep the termination and processing details as evidence.

aib-c01-d3-055@1.title: As a condition of joining, no unnecessary personal information is requested
aib-c01-d3-055@1.prompt: In the member-specific application guide, only the application eligibility and region can provide the correct basic guidance. The staff want to make detailed information about family and health mandatory to increase click rates. As a rule, the basic guide is also provided to those who choose not to opt for any customization. What is the appropriate policy?

A.text: If the click rate increases, request detailed information from everyone and skip guiding those who don’t respond.
A.explanation: Does not meet the conditions and necessity for providing basic guidance.

B.text: It is considered that anonymous detailed items can be required for everyone, and the basic guidelines and choices should not be separated.
B.explanation: Not confirmed regarding the necessity of information and user selection.

C.text: Basic guidance is provided with the minimum items, and personalized options based on additional information are optional choices with a clear purpose.
C.explanation: Can maintain user selection while also testing the personalization effect.

D.text: Initially, gather all details from everyone, and only review unnecessary items if the user requests deletion later.
D.explanation: Perform unnecessary collection first, which can hinder the selection during the application.

learning.concept: Separate the accuracy of business proposals from the necessity of data, and maintain basic services even if any customization is rejected
learning.reason: Basic instructions are provided with a few necessary details. If additional information is used, clarify the purpose and flexibility, and ensure that the basic route is available.

aib-c01-d3-056@1.title: To enable the person in charge to stop incorrect assignments
aib-c01-d3-056@1.prompt: The internal AI automatically updates the maintenance schedule. The responsible person can verify the plan, but even if work is assigned to already installed equipment, changes cannot be made until the next day. Which feature is missing due to lack of human supervision?

A.text: Display the reason for the assignment for a longer time, and let the schedule automatically be determined even if it violates constraints.
A.explanation: The display of reasons and the authority to make changes are different.

B.text: Allow the authorized person in charge to immediately pause and modify the assignment, return to a manual plan, and keep the reason.
B.explanation: Enables intervention and explanation before the schedule is executed.

C.text: Share the number of incorrect assignments in weekly reports, and the person in charge only inputs an evaluation for the AI.
C.explanation: The person cannot actually stop or modify the plan.

D.text: Display the schedule earlier, but changes to incorrect assignments must wait until the next batch processing.
D.explanation: Even if it can be verified, necessary corrections cannot be made on the same day.

learning.concept: Instead of just observing human supervision, when there is an incorrect judgment, the authorized person in charge can stop the process and switch to alternative methods
learning.reason: It is necessary for the responsible person to immediately pause incorrect assignments and switch back to the human plan. Record the operation and reason so that the original judgment can also be verified.

aib-c01-d3-057@1.title: Do not mix derived information between companies on a shared AI platform
aib-c01-d3-057@1.prompt: Multiple customer companies use the same AI platform. While data is separated per customer, the storage key for common areas where past responses are reused is only the question text. Choose two measures to prevent data from one customer from being returned to another.

A.text: Separate the reuse results by customer company and scope, and do not search for results of other customers.
A.explanation: Do not mistakenly use results from other companies in the same question text.

B.text: When retrieving responses or outputs, check the current permissions, and handle invalidation in case the original information's permissions have expired.
B.explanation: The same control can be maintained even if the conditions change after saving.

C.text: If the same question comes from two companies, distribute the previously created answer regardless of the company.
C.explanation: Company-specific documents and permissions are not maintained.

D.text: Since companies were separated during data ingestion, saved responses can be returned without identifying the company.
D.explanation: Reuse and output can bypass the separation of the original data.

E.text: Reuse of questions is common across all companies; only the company names that appear in the answers are hidden.
E.explanation: Information from other companies may remain in the main text.

learning.concept: In addition to the metadata, separate the storage location of the generated results and each company’s access permissions.
learning.reason: Separate the reused results by customer and permissions. Compare current permissions with saved results or written outputs, and stop the corresponding reuse if the original material becomes unusable.

aib-c01-d3-058@1.title: Ensure another person can verify the self-evaluation of AI application.
aib-c01-d3-058@1.prompt: The departments responsible for operating AI report each period that their own management functions are working properly. The management meeting requests a system where another person verifies whether the reported procedures have been implemented on-site. Which is the appropriate responsibility design?

A.text: The operations manager approves his verification results and uses a verbal report to his supervisor instead of evidence.
A.explanation: There is no independent verification or traceable evidence.

B.text: The independent responsible person changes the model each month, and the person who made the change reviews that process again.
B.explanation: The verification side makes direct changes, and self-evaluation is inevitable.

C.text: Only when control fails to function will reports be received from the business owner.
C.explanation: We cannot verify the claim that it works separately.

D.text: The implementation is left to the business department, with a separate responsible person obtaining evidence through restricted access and reporting to management along with the corrective deadline.
D.explanation: Separation of roles and verification of actual operations can be achieved simultaneously.

learning.concept: Separate the operation by the construction side from the role of independently reviewing and reporting evidence.
learning.reason: Leave the responsibility for operations with the relevant department, and give the independent assurance officer the authority to verify necessary evidence and report results to management.

aib-c01-d3-059@1.title: Even with permission to reference, excessive reproduction is not allowed
aib-c01-d3-059@1.prompt: The training support AI can search for materials via contracts and guide users to relevant chapters. Reprinting the main text to users is prohibited, and during testing, long continuous texts were returned in response to questions. Choose two measures to prevent recurrence.

A.text: Since search permission is granted, the citation restrictions in the answer are removed.
A.explanation: The permission to search and the permission to redistribute the main content are different.

B.text: If the generated result is saved to a separate file within the company first and then returned to the user, it will not be redistributed.
B.explanation: Even if the save location is changed, distribution to users still occurs.

C.text: It is assumed that it can be reproduced unlimitedly if the author's name is included, and no length or usage conditions are checked.
C.explanation: The condition for prohibited re-distribution due to source indication will not be lifted.

D.text: During pre-publication testing and operation, a long alignment was detected; suspicious results are retained to confirm the scope of the contract.
D.explanation: It allows verifying whether a non-visual design actually works.

E.text: In the output, the reference locations for relevant sections are provided, and the requirement to continuously return the main text is limited within the permitted scope.
E.explanation: Can provide the necessary guidance within the contract.

learning.concept: If the permissions for reference and redistribution are different, prepare the citation range in the output and a review of suspicious examples.
learning.reason: Define the output range that guides the reference source, and detect long continuous extracts to reject or review them. The provision of the original text is left to the existing regular path.

aib-c01-d3-060@1.title: Investigating the reliability issue where rephrasing alone can change the conclusion
aib-c01-d3-060@1.prompt: The member-specific guideline AI may return contradictory conclusions when asking whether the same application eligibility is "available?" or "excluded?". The version of the supporting document was the same. Which approach is appropriate?

A.text: If the response speed is the same for all questions, the conclusions of the regulations are also consistent.
A.explanation: Speed and the consistency of conclusions are separate.

B.text: It is determined that if the number of characters in the response remains constant, the conclusion will also be the same.
B.explanation: Even when the lengths are consistent, consistency in content is not guaranteed.

C.text: Create alternative phrasing for the same business conditions, evaluate the consistency of the rationale and conclusion, and verify the hold in case of inconsistency.
C.explanation: It can measure problems where different judgments are made based solely on input representations.

D.text: Only the first question expression is verified as a standard example, and errors in other expressions are excluded from the aggregation.
D.explanation: The reported issues are excluded from the testing scope.

learning.concept: When using the same rationale with the same input, evaluate contradictions due to different phrasing
learning.reason: Compare using various synonyms under the same conditions, aiming for a common format for the conclusion. If there is no consistency with the evidence, refer to verification and retest.

aib-c01-d4-041@1.title: Verify the preparations needed for operation under actual working conditions
aib-c01-d4-041@1.prompt: The accuracy and budget for delivery AI are sufficient, but there will be staff rotations at two locations during the launch date. There are also few vacancies in the department that supports authority setting for the team members. Management wants to determine which site can operate. Which is the most appropriate method for assessing readiness?

A.text: Set the completion condition as not requiring support, and investigate troubled departments sequentially after service begins.
A.explanation: Unable to address the preparatory shortcomings known before the release.

B.text: By location, actually compare duties and shifts, skills, permissions, and support department hours to determine operational locations.
B.explanation: Evaluate based on the success of the trial and the conditions under which operations can be maintained.

C.text: Determine by combining the average accuracy and overall company budget, and skip the verification of required personnel at individual locations.
C.explanation: Unable to confirm the conditions required for operation per deployment.

D.text: It is assumed that all locations can start operations based on the number of users who have already opened the AI interface.
D.explanation: I haven’t measured the daily assigned roles or access preparations.

learning.concept: Work time, responsibilities, technical dependencies, and management decisions are compared with actual plans
learning.reason: In the actual work plan, verify responsibilities, shifts, skills, permissions, and communication per site, and address any essential gaps first.

aib-c01-d4-042@1.title: The large number of users and the maturity of live operations
aib-c01-d4-042@1.prompt: 500 people participate in Company A's free trial, but there are no defined operational standards or official responsible persons. Company B targets 40 people, but establishes a responsible person and monitoring as part of the operation to handle issues. Which is the appropriate explanation for comparing maturity levels?

A.text: Since both companies can utilize AI, regardless of their responsibility for formal deployment, they are at the same stage.
A.explanation: It does not reflect the difference in ability to maintain actual operations.

B.text: Since issue resolution was required in B, A, which does not involve production deployment, is considered more mature all the time.
B.explanation: Confusing the existence of response capabilities with low maturity.

C.text: A is a large experiment, B is treated as a limited production start-up, and whether B can be rolled out across the entire company will be confirmed separately through common operations evidence.
C.explanation: The scale of the experiment, formal deployment, and expansion to the whole can be distinguished.

D.text: A involves company-wide deployment based on the number of users, while B is a small scale experiment.
D.explanation: The operational capacity is evaluated based on the number of people.

learning.concept: Even if the experiment is large-scale, it cannot move to operation stage without daily responsibility and control.
learning.reason: Instead of determining stages based on number of users, use the existence of stable service provision, responsibility, and monitoring as evidence for the actual launch.

aib-c01-d4-043@1.title: Identify the shortage of people capable of evaluating specialized assessments
aib-c01-d4-043@1.prompt: The AI classifies reports of equipment accidents. Technicians can calculate values and have established operating procedures and infrastructure, but there is no safety officer who can evaluate the basis for determining if an accident is serious. Which capability should be filled first?

A.text: Remove the assessment of severity because accident frequency is low, and determine approval or rejection based solely on screen responses.
A.explanation: Does not inspect important business objectives.

B.text: Increase the processing capacity of the infrastructure, and leave the validity of labels to existing evaluation values.
B.explanation: Cannot verify the validity of business decisions based on calculation speed.

C.text: Provide technicians with only training to increase the number of classifications, and have experts join after formal provision.
C.explanation: Cannot confirm the necessary correctness before release.

D.text: Assign a responsible person who can determine severity, and have experts and technicians establish standards and evaluation examples.
D.explanation: Can fill the shortage of business verification capabilities.

learning.concept: Even with model functions and monitoring, separate skills necessary to verify the correctness of business decisions are required
learning.reason: Just improving numerical values does not ensure valid judgments. Include experts in the evaluation, and create reproducible judgment criteria and evaluation examples.

aib-c01-d4-044@1.title: Prioritize developing the capabilities required for the deployment purpose
aib-c01-d4-044@1.prompt: A tourism industry consultation AI has been put into production for domestic use. The next business goal is to support two foreign languages. There is a shortage of staff capable of evaluating accuracy in both languages using approved translation materials, but the inference foundation has sufficient capacity. Which is a valid priority for investment?

A.text: Double the infrastructure by prioritizing technology improvement, and verify the accuracy of materials through translation logs after public release.
A.explanation: Does not directly address the current shortage.

B.text: Enable all languages simultaneously, and let customers report errors until the staff are hired.
B.explanation: No responsibility or evaluation before external release.

C.text: First establish official materials and evaluation capabilities for the priority language, then verify quality and operation within a limited scope before moving to the next language.
C.explanation: Budget can be allocated for actual dependencies.

D.text: Plan language expansion after domestic operations stop, and do not continue existing quality standards.
D.explanation: Lose existing strengths and fail to prepare for unmet languages.

learning.concept: Identify dependency conditions that hinder future expansion, make phased investments while maintaining existing usable capabilities
learning.reason: Develop materials and evaluation for the language in use, verify operational capability in the priority language before moving on. Do not invest additional funds in a capable foundation until there is confirmed demand.

aib-c01-d4-045@1.title: Check if there is data that allows verification of the correct answer even with input
aib-c01-d4-045@1.prompt: There is a plan to predict the continuation of the maintenance contract. The contract terms and inquiry history are available, but the confirmation record of contract continuation is under the management of the sales agent, and it has not been agreed upon whether it can be used for learning or evaluation. What is the appropriate method to determine the readiness of trial data?

A.text: Confirm the scope and linkage of the agency and performance records, and determine whether learning and evaluation are possible using approved examples.
A.explanation: Distinguish between the existence of input and the conditions under which results can be matched.

B.text: Since the number of inquiry records is sufficient, it can be assumed that the correct data for continuing customers has also been collected.
B.explanation: The number of inputs does not confirm the continuation result of the contract.

C.text: Run the model without learning, and request usage permission after the contract ends.
C.explanation: There is no basis to evaluate performance before deployment.

D.text: Assume those who had long inquiries stopped their contracts, and no confirmation records for continuations are needed.
D.explanation: It may not necessarily match the actual results.

learning.concept: Determine separately whether legal and contractual access to the performance records for obtaining and evaluating features is allowed.
learning.reason: Separate the input and correct conditions, and determine which can be used for which purpose. Determine the scope of results that can be verified with confirmed outcomes.

aib-c01-d4-046@1.title: Agree on the retention period for shared data with the provider
aib-c01-d4-046@1.prompt: Data for next-day predictions from multiple warehouses is received. Previously, there was no agreement on the closing time, and some warehouses sent items only after the next-day prediction was available. Which item should be added to the data-sharing agreement instead of blaming the responsible party?

A.text: Establish agreements with each warehouse regarding data closing time, delivery deadline, responsible person, and communication and actions in case of delays or omissions.
A.explanation: The freshness of the data can be shared for procedures that require it.

B.text: Replace the arrival time with the delivery record time, without managing the original time of the provider.
B.explanation: Distorts the record time, making it impossible to trace the cause.

C.text: The person responsible for the prediction estimates the delay in shared data and does not determine the delivery time with the provider.
C.explanation: Unable to operate in a way that ensures delivery at the required time.

D.text: Standardize only the name saved by all warehouses, without resolving differences in closing times.
D.explanation: Even if the names are the same, they may not meet the time required for the next-day prediction.

learning.concept: Share responsibility for quality not only with the user side, but also agree on delivery frequency, arrival time, and communication in case of omissions
learning.reason: Clarify the target point, delivery deadline, handling of delays or omissions, and permissions and responsibilities between the provider and user sides.

aib-c01-d4-047@1.title: Assessing the foundation that allows multiple teams to conduct experiments safely
aib-c01-d4-047@1.prompt: 20 internal teams are trying AI simultaneously. There are available samples for testing, but they must not access production customer settings and data. The inference framework is shared, and in the past, one department’s use of it has prevented other departments from using it. Choose two acceptance criteria for the foundation.

A.text: Define separate usage quotas per team and verify that concurrent use with other teams does not cause issues in production.
A.explanation: It allows for the verification of resource control and actual testing capabilities together.

B.text: Give all teams unlimited quotas and management rights for production preparation, with only the order of use specified in a document.
B.explanation: Separation and resource control are not effective.

C.text: Measure only the processing speed of the first team; if no problem, assume the same for all 20 teams.
C.explanation: It is impossible to measure competition in shared quotas during concurrent use.

D.text: Share the production environment to simplify preparation for testing, and leave the distinction between samples and customer data to each responsible person’s memory.
D.explanation: There is a risk of accidentally manipulating the production environment.

E.text: Create a testing area and separate permissions for approved samples from operations on production settings and data.
E.explanation: The impact of experiments can be isolated from the production environment.

learning.concept: Isolation of testing resources, maximum load, and verification of access to approved data
learning.reason: Separate permissions and data between production and testing, set team-specific quotas and impact ranges. Verify whether the required scale and isolation work during concurrent use.

aib-c01-d4-048@1.title: Linking Unacceptable Implementation Conditions Across Departments to Executive Decisions
aib-c01-d4-048@1.prompt: An AI that assists in confirming tasks: sales require quick acceptance, while review requires additional verification of all items. The field promotion officer has no authority to change the evaluation criteria, and the trial was suspended for 3 weeks. What should the sponsor do?

A.text: Remove either sales or review from the trial and consider the result as a general outcome.
A.explanation: It does not meet the intended operational conditions for collaboration between the two departments.

B.text: Remeasure the model quality score; if high, provide it without setting departmental standards.
B.explanation: It does not resolve conflicts between operational goals and acceptable limits.

C.text: The promotion officer increases meetings and waits until one department voluntarily accepts its own goals.
C.explanation: It does not address the lack of authority to resolve conflicts.

D.text: The sponsor adjusts the conditions of both departments, approves the trial criteria, and conveys responsibilities and exception decisions to the field.
D.explanation: It enables cross-department decision-making and clarifies the role of implementation.

learning.concept: Conflicts that cannot be resolved by the field promotion officer are judged by a sponsor with common goals and authority
learning.reason: Organize interests and necessary conditions, establish quality and time balance criteria, departmental responsibilities, and exception decisions aligned with business goals. The promotion officer tests them on the field.

aib-c01-d4-049@1.title: The external operations process is also included in the responsibility of the cross-functional team.
aib-c01-d4-049@1.prompt: During the trial of the accident notification AI, notifications from the scene are sent to a non-company call center. Since the operations team wasn’t involved in discussing this, it was unclear which company is responsible for any missed notifications. Which option is appropriate as a change to the cross-team structure?

A.text: The client is not involved in the design, and only the name of the responsible person should be written in the report after it is generated.
A.explanation: The conditions for transition and the responsibility for handling exceptions cannot be defined in advance.

B.text: The participants include the representatives of both companies, contract and technical officers for the notification and acceptance process, as well as the decision-makers and deadlines in case of non-acceptance.
B.explanation: It is possible to design a system that does not stop handling at the department and company boundary.

C.text: Remove contract management, and the content and deadline of notifications are determined by each company’s operations team on that day.
C.explanation: Unable to maintain standardized responsibility allocation and deadlines.

D.text: Internal technicians will only verify the distribution of the notification, and it will not be subject to testing after receipt.
D.explanation: Processes that affect business outcomes are not verified.

learning.concept: Don’t decide solely based on departmental design, but consider the coordination of contracted operation, contracts, and quality assessment as roles.
learning.reason: Involve internal projects, contract management, technology, and entrusted operations, conduct handovers, make judgments when targets are not met, and define responsibilities for each company to practice.

aib-c01-d4-050@1.title: To inform the workflow procedure and re-evaluation period when an experiment is interrupted
aib-c01-d4-050@1.prompt: An unexpected error occurred during AI input support, resulting in a one-week interruption for some projects. The responsible person must meet the deadline using an alternative method, and the restart date has not yet been determined. What is an appropriate way to communicate this?

A.text: Identify the affected projects, old procedures, and contact persons, and inform the restart conditions and the next information sharing date.
A.explanation: Do not provide a guarantee of restart; allow the field team to handle it immediately.

B.text: Do not explain the reason for interruption, but promise to restart after one week.
B.explanation: Telling a pending restart as a confirmed decision.

C.text: Do not notify the user until they open the screen, and explain individually to those who need help.
C.explanation: The field team cannot prepare an alternative method in advance.

D.text: Do not inform until the technical investigation results are available, and leave handling unavailable projects to individuals.
D.explanation: There is no information indicating continuation of a time-bound task.

learning.concept: Include reasons, impact scope, alternatives, feedback reception, and next evaluation date in notifications to the field team
learning.reason: Indicate the target and time of interruption, provide alternative procedures, contact points, restart conditions, and the next update date. Also gather issues from the field team.

aib-c01-d4-051@1.title: Investigate why the field team returns to informal procedures
aib-c01-d4-051@1.prompt: The use of approved AI in branches has not increased. It seems that the forms required at the start of work cannot be printed by AI, so experienced staff returned to informal spreadsheets. What is the first step to increase usage?

A.text: Exclude staff familiar with spreadsheets from the target group and report only the usage rate of remaining staff.
A.explanation: Remove employees with problematic usage conditions from the statistics without improving them.

B.text: Confirm the work at the field and during printing, try to improve the approved process to achieve the same results, and measure the burden and usage.
B.explanation: Address the specific reasons for returning to informal methods.

C.text: Warn everyone who uses informal procedures, and do not investigate issues with the approved method.
C.explanation: Do not establish alternative conditions for continued use of the procedure.

D.text: Make logging into AI mandatory at work start, and do not add printing functionality until usage increases.
D.explanation: The problem of being unable to create the forms required by the field remains.

learning.concept: Understand specific work constraints that lead to resistance, and improve processes and procedures at the field level
learning.reason: Do not judge resistance based solely on usage rates; verify the actual conditions handled by spreadsheets. Test the printing procedures with responsible personnel and validate the burden and safety.

aib-c01-d4-052@1.title: Maintain the skills needed when it stops after automation
aib-c01-d4-052@1.prompt: As AI assists with reception processing, new employees have little opportunity to verify things manually correctly. According to business procedures, it must be able to continue manually within 2 hours even when unusable. What is the training plan?

A.text: Only training is provided for button operations using AI, and manual tasks are learned among team members after any issues occur.
A.explanation: It cannot be guaranteed that processing will be done correctly within the deadline.

B.text: Just place the manual materials in a shared location, without conducting any reference or processing exercises.
B.explanation: Having steps is different from being able to execute them within the deadline.

C.text: Conduct exercises to regularly switch to alternative procedures, and evaluate the accuracy of the checks, the time taken, and the skills of the replacement personnel.
C.explanation: Can maintain the actual required skills and continuous conditions.

D.text: Due to the high performance of AI, manual tasks are excluded from the review scope.
D.explanation: In terms of uptime, the continuous requirements during downtime cannot be met.

learning.concept: Processes that require continuation in exceptional cases should maintain their training and certification even if not used in normal operations.
learning.reason: Regularly conduct training on alternative procedures similar to real examples, and ensure that new employees can handle them independently and within the required time.

aib-c01-d4-053@1.title: Design the maintenance of procedures and daily searches as separate capabilities
aib-c01-d4-053@1.prompt: In the contract department, much of the staff’s time is spent searching for approved documents. When contradictions are found between regulations, legal and sales departments must discuss and resolve them together. How should the role be designed after the introduction of AI?

A.text: People search for all the data as usual, and AI only changes the wording of the regulations without referring to the negotiation results.
A.explanation: There is still a burden to explore, and the agreed-upon content cannot be incorporated.

B.text: Let AI search for data, and let it also handle the resolution of contradictions and the revision of formal regulations.
B.explanation: Proceed with organizational decisions and policy changes without confirmation.

C.text: Automatically prioritize rules with many correct answers to AI, eliminating legal and sales discussions.
C.explanation: The priority of the rule cannot be determined based on the number of uses or accuracy rate.

D.text: Daily data research is supported by AI, and contradictions are adjusted among departments by humans for approval and revision.
D.explanation: Time can be devoted to policy decisions that should be made by people.

learning.concept: AI is used to assist in searching for confirmed data, while adjusting and formally updating conflicting policies is handled by humans
learning.reason: AI is used for searching permission documents and presenting justifications, while humans assess the impact of contradictions and formally update agreed-upon policies.

aib-c01-d4-054@1.title: When an unexpected effect occurs in a trial, formulate the next hypothesis
aib-c01-d4-054@1.prompt: In the AI procurement trial, errors increased when it was fully automated. On the other hand, when only candidates were shown, the accuracy rate of the staff members was maintained, and decision time also decreased. The initial concept assumed full automation. Which is the appropriate next step?

A.text: Due to the failure of full automation, all judgment support results have also been discarded, and the causes will not be recorded.
A.explanation: The success range obtained from the trial cannot be used for learning.

B.text: To adhere to the original plan, it will be announced as having achieved the standards through full automation.
B.explanation: Ignore the serious deterioration found in the experiment.

C.text: Both methods will be released simultaneously based solely on time reduction, and the difference in errors will be excluded from the validation scope.
C.explanation: Unable to assess quality using two different methods with different premises.

D.text: Re-evaluate the use case for judgment support, set usage conditions and success criteria, and conduct experiments to expand the target.
D.explanation: We can test another hypothesis derived from actual measurements.

learning.concept: Revise the initial hypothesis through measurements and design the next experiment focusing on the confirmed effect
learning.reason: Record the failure of the automation hypothesis and revalidate the support method’s effectiveness in core operations. Proceed with publication within the range where evidence and conditions are available.

aib-c01-d4-055@1.title: Choose something that can be transferred to another department based on short-term results
aib-c01-d4-055@1.prompt: The Finance Department achieved initial results using an AI document description tool. Human Resources also wishes for similar support, but the use, access, and impact of errors in HR documents differ from those in Finance. Which expansion method can leverage short-term results?

A.text: Use the evaluation and operation methods that worked in Finance, and test them on a small scale using HR approval documents, permissions, and operational requirements.
A.explanation: By leveraging reusable capabilities, you can verify the impact of new operations.

B.text: Create everything independently in Human Resources, and do not share Finance’s evaluation materials or intermediate failures.
B.explanation: You lose the reusable knowledge obtained from early results.

C.text: If the number of uses in Finance is similar in Human Resources, skip the validation trial and expand.
C.explanation: Based on usage, it is not possible to prove the quality and control required by Human Resources.

D.text: Copy the documents and access settings used in Finance to Human Resources and publish them with the same quality as expected.
D.explanation: Without addressing the differences in purpose and permissions, you cannot transfer the success conditions.

learning.concept: Reuse the evaluation procedures and operations used in early success, and verify the validity of business data and judgments in the new department
learning.reason: Transfer the procedures for evaluation, distribution, and training from Finance, and confirm the purpose, data, and standards for Human Resources. Validate on a small scale.

aib-c01-d4-056@1.title: Transform Sharing Failure Cases Across Departments into an Evaluation System
aib-c01-d4-056@1.prompt: Each business unit's AI operation team fixes errors individually. Similar failures occur in other departments, but sensitive original records cannot be shared. What action should the central specialized organization take?

A.text: Distribute the original records to all employees, and have each responsible unit investigate the requested content.
A.explanation: Disclosing information that cannot be shared, and the evaluation process is not established.

B.text: Use approved representative cases for cross-departmental review, and share common causes, reproduction conditions, and tests so they can be used by other departments.
B.explanation: Do not spread sensitive records, and the identified issues can be prevented by other departments as well.

C.text: Let each department complete the fixes independently, and the central organization only manages the total number of reports.
C.explanation: Other departments cannot learn from the same failure.

D.text: Assume using the same provider in each department will resolve errors, and no case investigation or testing is performed.
D.explanation: Uniforming providers does not necessarily prevent similar operational errors.

learning.concept: The specialized organization generalizes cases across departments and establishes tests and judgment criteria that can be used by other departments
learning.reason: Use anonymized approved cases and synthesized representative examples from each department to define common failures and verification methods. Distribute them in a format that can be reused by target departments.

aib-c01-d4-057@1.title: To check if the growth continues after implementation
aib-c01-d4-057@1.prompt: In the first month of using an AI writing assistant, the rollout team provided daily support and work got faster. Support will be reduced in month 3. The owner wants to know whether the gains will last under normal working conditions. What should they check?

A.text: Just verify how many inquiries the support team received, and measure quality and working hours by the first month.
A.explanation: Unable to evaluate business results after the reduction in support.

B.text: Fix the initial monthly cost, and subsequent expenses and outcomes will be recorded in the budget at the same ratio.
B.explanation: Confusing the effectiveness of short-term support with sustained results.

C.text: Even after moving to the standard system, the same quality and work time are measured, and usage patterns, support volume, and utilization challenges are tracked together.
C.explanation: It can determine whether the effect depends on the initial support amount.

D.text: In the third month, satisfaction levels are asked only from new users; first-month users are excluded from analysis.
D.explanation: It is not possible to compare whether improvements continued using the same target.

learning.concept: Even after transitioning from the startup phase with extensive support to regular operation, the results and constraints remain unchanged
learning.reason: At multiple points after launch, track the support volume, operational results, quality, and user challenges under the same criteria to assess effectiveness in normal operation.

aib-c01-d4-058@1.title: To enable safe updates to the prototype during production
aib-c01-d4-058@1.prompt: There is a prototype where inference and search settings can be changed in the same interface. The prototype’s quality was acceptable, but the settings were not saved, and there is no plan on how to revert to the previous state if issues occur. Choose two conditions necessary for transitioning to official operation.

A.text: If no rollback is needed during issues, do not save the latest settings if the average response on the day is good.
A.explanation: Unable to handle performance degradation or inconsistencies.

B.text: Post-operational changes are made directly by the responsible person, and only when discrepancies occur are the changes restored from memory.
B.explanation: Cannot track changes during official operation and the previous state.

C.text: Practice rollback when standards are exceeded, and confirm that the restored version can handle existing business records.
C.explanation: Not only can the configuration be restored, but business continuity can also be proven.

D.text: Document the procedures, but whether the old configuration can be executed is determined after a failure occurs.
D.explanation: The capabilities required for recovery are not verified before starting.

E.text: Save the evaluated version of the model, index, prompt, and settings as a consistent copy, so that the same configuration can be reproduced.
E.explanation: Confirm which configurations have been approved and distribute them.

learning.concept: Accept the condition that the same version can be reproduced and the business can continue after changes are restored
learning.reason: Keep the evaluated model, materials, and settings as a version, reproduce approved configurations. Also test in advance whether the restored configuration can handle business operations.

aib-c01-d4-059@1.title: Check if an alternative path stops simultaneously with the main path
aib-c01-d4-059@1.prompt: The business offices in three regions are scheduled to rely on AI search. A prototype interface has been prepared, but search and identity verification will use the same dependency source as the main interface. We want to continue critical operations even in case of issues on the provider side. What are the checks before deployment?

A.text: Simulate a primary-path outage in which the shared dependencies are unavailable to the backup too. Verify that an independent fallback can keep operations running.
A.explanation: An independent fallback covers failures that switching to a different interface alone cannot avoid.

B.text: In normal mode, only response time is measured on the preview screen, and no fault condition tests are conducted.
B.explanation: I don’t understand the continuity under conditions where backup is required.

C.text: Since it can be accessed via a different URL than the main screen, no reliance on search or identity verification is needed—it is recognized as preliminary.
C.explanation: The processing cannot be done if the common features in another screen are stopped.

D.text: AI only confirms that the metadata generates a failure notification, and does not create a path for users to continue processing.
D.explanation: Notifications are not a substitute for continuing business operations.

learning.concept: Before deploying to multiple instances, verify the primary path, common dependencies and alternatives, and their effectiveness.
learning.reason: Identify common dependencies and test whether alternative procedures can function independently of those failures. If necessary, prepare manual paths or other dependencies.

aib-c01-d4-060@1.title: To verify whether the rationale for processed items can be traced before implementation
aib-c01-d4-060@1.prompt: There is a proposal to use a job classification table created by a department independently for the salary inquiry AI. There are no gaps, but no rules corresponding to the original personnel data are recorded in documents, and the creation methods vary between departments. Which is the evaluation for preparation readiness?

A.text: Ask the AI to read the job title and infer the creation procedure, with no one verifying whether the inference is correct.
A.explanation: The generated explanation does not prove the origin of the actual data.

B.text: Track the original documents and conversion rules, and compare the classifications with samples. Fill in the areas without rationale from approved data.
B.explanation: It becomes possible to check whether there are errors or actual definitions.

C.text: Since there are no gaps, consider it as completed preparation, and copy the same item name to all tables.
C.explanation: It is impossible to determine whether the intended meaning is complete.

D.text: Make the method for departments with many rows a formal one, and confirm the differences from other departments after publication.
D.explanation: The validity of the business definition is not determined by the number of created items.

learning.concept: Even if the values are filled in, verification of where and how they were created is necessary to verify changes or errors in the definition
learning.reason: Trace the source and conversion, and confirm the meaning and scope of application. Those that cannot be compared with original documents or creators are reconstructed from approved data.

aib-c01-d1-064@1.title: Do not directly compare probabilities with different periods
aib-c01-d1-064@1.prompt: It was predicted that device A would have a 40% failure probability within 30 days, and device B would have a 25% failure probability within 7 days. The same maintenance person wants to choose the inspection order to prevent failures this week. How should this be interpreted?

A.text: Since 40% is greater than 25%, it is determined that A is more prone to failure this week.
A.explanation: The probability subjects differ on the 30th and 7th.

B.text: Assuming 40% of A is divided into 4 equal parts, the probability for this week can be determined without any other information.
B.explanation: The failures do not occur evenly each week.

C.text: Confirm the same 7-day failure probability for both, and make a judgment considering the impact that can be avoided through inspection.
C.explanation: It can be compared as a prediction with the same occurrence period.

D.text: Only the values for Model A are considered as daily results, and the 7 days worth are multiplied for comparison.
D.explanation: The probability within 30 days is interpreted as per day.

learning.concept: Define the events and time period to compare probabilities
learning.reason: Predictions with different timelines cannot be compared as the magnitude of risk for the same period. Both will be compared according to this week’s definition.

aib-c01-d1-065@1.title: Distinguish between items found from the data and AI predictions
aib-c01-d1-065@1.prompt: The General Affairs Department wants to record the device number and expiration date in the ledger from the contract text. Blank spaces must not be filled with estimates, as they will be verified by another person. Before registration, the position of the selected values must be clearly visible in the original text. Which is the appropriate function?

A.text: Extract the specified items from the original text while keeping their positions, and send any missing fields for human verification.
A.explanation: The required values can be verified along with their justifications.

B.text: Summarize the contract by item, and add a link to the entire document in the output. The values found are not saved.
B.explanation: There are no references to the areas needed to directly verify the values later.

C.text: Learn past contract periods to estimate the end date, and treat the estimated value as it is in the original text.
C.explanation: Estimates and extracted facts are not distinguished.

D.text: Documents are classified by equipment or contract periods, and the responsible person searches for values from the ledger of similar categories.
D.explanation: There is no value specified in the contract itself, nor a way to verify its location.

learning.concept: Use extraction for matching identifiers in existing documents, and do not generate information that does not exist.
learning.reason: Extract the specified items from the original text and return them along with the relevant sections. Columns with no values or uncertain values should be sent for verification.

aib-c01-d1-066@1.title: Also check the combination of each individual appropriate value
aib-c01-d1-066@1.prompt: In the records used for predicting cancellation cancellations, the application date, confirmed cancellation date, and start date of use were all valid as date types. However, some confirmed cancellation dates are earlier than the application date, which is impossible in business practice. Which correction should be made first?

A.text: Add temporal relationships to quality rules, and compare any violations with the original records for correction or exclusion.
A.explanation: Can handle combinations of contradictions that are invisible in type checks.

B.text: Convert all values to the same date format; if the formats are the same, the order is not checked.
B.explanation: Due to formatting consistency, the date before and after may not be correct.

C.text: Rearrange the dates used in the input without distinction between before and after, and save the earlier one as the application date.
C.explanation: Without checking which record is incorrect, the meaning is rewritten.

D.text: Add the contradictory lines as correct training examples, and only measure whether the running model can handle abnormal sequences.
D.explanation: The quality of the business facts used for learning cannot be ensured.

learning.concept: In addition to the type of each item individually, verify the possible relationships in practice to identify contradictions
learning.reason: In addition to the accuracy of individual dates, ensure compliance with the workflow sequence. Compare violations with original records, and manage those that cannot be corrected properly separately.

aib-c01-d1-067@1.title: Don’t use existing customer history to benefit new customer predictions
aib-c01-d1-067@1.prompt: Predicting inquiries shortly after a new contract. In the history, there are similar initial records every time a company adds a branch. If rows are randomly divided, the same company remains in both the learning and evaluation groups. The decision-making criterion is when no such company has been seen at all. What is the appropriate evaluation?

A.text: Divide companies into learning and evaluation categories, and measure only the information available at the start of unlearned companies.
A.explanation: Matches the conditions for generalization for new enterprises.

B.text: It is acceptable if the company name is removed, and the branch data of the same company exists on both sides.
B.explanation: Even excluding the name, they can share the same corporate-specific trends.

C.text: Only verify with companies included in the learning set; if they are in the same industry, the same accuracy can be achieved with unlearned companies as well.
C.explanation: Unable to verify the validity for a company I'm handling for the first time.

D.text: Break down the branches into even smaller rows and verify by including the same company equally in both.
D.explanation: Does not replicate the criteria for evaluating unknown companies.

learning.concept: When confirming the generalization to new customers, do not apply the same customer’s related history to learning and evaluation
learning.reason: Using the company as a unit for division, it is reproduced using only the establishment records of companies not involved in learning. In the row division by branch, the influence of memorizing company-specific patterns remains.

aib-c01-d1-068@1.title: To determine whether an anomaly in monitoring occurs in the execution path rather than the model
aib-c01-d1-068@1.prompt: In an AI scheduling service, the number of failures per completed task has increased. For cases where responses were received, there is no change in accuracy rate; however, the wait time for dependent lookup functions is rising. What is the priority action?

A.text: Replace all responses with a new model, without comparing wait times for previous and subsequent lookups.
A.explanation: Due to remaining problematic dependencies, it is not possible to verify the effectiveness of the change.

B.text: Separate cases with no response from incorrect answers, and investigate the delay and dependent entities of the lookup. After restoration, check the completion rate and accuracy rate.
B.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between execution issues and prediction issues.

C.text: Since only the accuracy rate remains stable, no records are sent to other departments regarding changes in the completion rate; the process is concluded.
C.explanation: Allowing the increase in operational failures to continue.

D.text: Treat the failure rate as a lack of training data, skip investigating the lookup process, and retrain the model.
D.explanation: The cause of no response cannot be resolved.

learning.concept: Distinguish between timeouts and the quality of correctly returned predictions, and select an update that addresses the root cause
learning.reason: Separate changes in quality from service unavailability. Investigate the causes of lookup wait times and timeouts, and measure both after restoration.

aib-c01-d1-069@1.title: Indicating How Words Should Be Used According to the Reader
aib-c01-d1-069@1.prompt: Create a short guide for residents who are using this for the first time regarding remote inspection of buildings. Keep the official name of the equipment used exactly as it is, but explain technical terms in a simple way. If you simply ask to make it "easy to understand," the official name will also be rephrased. Which improvement is correct?

A.text: Keep all expressions as they are and only instruct to reduce the number of characters.
A.explanation: It is not possible to add explanations needed for residents who are encountering this for the first time.

B.text: Rephrase all difficult words at a similar level, without changing the official name.
B.explanation: It will replace terms that need to be preserved.

C.text: Specify for residents who read this for the first time, include short examples for words that require preservation and explanation of the official name.
C.explanation: It is possible to distinguish where to rephrase and which names must not be changed.

D.text: Specify that the explanation should be in Japanese only, leaving how readers and technical terms are handled to the model.
D.explanation: Even in the same language, the difficulty of vocabulary and the names that should be preserved are not conveyed.

learning.concept: In addition to general instructions, specify the reader, words that need definition, and official terms that must not be changed
learning.reason: Inform the reader and purpose, keep the official name fixed, and briefly explain other technical terms. Add conditions for checking good output examples and terminology.

aib-c01-d1-070@1.title: The latest figures are based on confirmed information, and only explanations are generated.
aib-c01-d1-070@1.prompt: The employee-friendly AI answers questions regarding the current inventory count of equipment and the considerations when selecting equivalent items. The inventory count frequently changes in the approved ledger, and a precise value must be displayed separately from the description. Which is the appropriate method for adapting the model?

A.text: Only the number of digits and format of the generated values are checked, and they are not compared with the ledger values.
A.explanation: Even if the format is correct, we don’t know the accuracy of the inventory count.

B.text: The person in charge estimates the inventory count based on past descriptions, reducing access to the ledger.
B.explanation: Not referring to the constantly changing accurate values.

C.text: In the approval ledger, retrieve and display the values for each product ID, and generate explanations for notes in the approved information.
C.explanation: It can maintain quality by separating the acquisition of definite values from text generation.

D.text: Adjust the model based on last month's inventory, and output the learned values as current inventory.
D.explanation: The updated values cannot be tracked solely by past learning results.

learning.concept: Use fetch for the constantly changing accurate values, and do not estimate values using a generation model
learning.reason: Extract the confirmed value from the inventory ledger using the correct product ID, and present that value in a separate column. The language model assists with explaining to users and does not help in guessing numbers.

aib-c01-d1-071@1.title: Evaluate cases where business losses vary in the direction where the forecast value deviates
aib-c01-d1-071@1.prompt: The theater assigns entry staff for the day based on a prediction of the number of attendees. If the prediction is too low, entry will be delayed and refunds will be issued; if it’s too high, a single person can handle both tasks. The absolute error of the average of the two predictions is the same. How should we choose the one that is suitable for operation?

A.text: Separate too small and too large errors, and compare them with the actual refund and configuration adjustment costs.
A.explanation: Can reflect the difference in costs that occurs even with the same error.

B.text: Since the average absolute error is the same, we assume the operational costs are also equal.
B.explanation: The average error does not include the difference between the error direction and the cost.

C.text: All over-estimates are correct, all under-estimates are incorrect, and the cost of the over-estimate is not aggregated.
C.explanation: There is also a burden in adjusting personnel and deployment.

D.text: Only compare the performances with the highest number of attendees; the costs of other performances are not included.
D.explanation: Unable to determine the representative business conditions, including regular performances.

learning.concept: Compare two same average absolute errors predictions by their under- and over-estimation costs.
learning.reason: Even if the magnitude of the error is the same, the burden differs by direction. Convert under- or over-performance in representative performances into costs, and compare with operational losses including refunds and staff adjustments.

aib-c01-d1-072@1.title: To determine if general performance is applicable even in company-specific terminology
aib-c01-d1-072@1.prompt: I am considering an AI that explains specialized maintenance materials. The candidate foundation model scores highly in general text evaluation, but there is no test using internal shorthand codes. Which evaluation is used for the adoption decision?
