A.text: Compare only the number of words each model references; if the vocabulary is the largest, it is deemed suitable for the specialty field.
A.explanation: The size of the vocabulary does not prove that internal shorthand codes can be used correctly.

B.text: Collect unused examples including actual shorthand codes and maintenance scenarios, and have business personnel compare the accuracy of the explanation and justification.
B.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between the general score and suitability for actual use cases.

C.text: Automatically convert internal shorthand codes into common words and pass them to the model; do not verify whether the conversion results are correct or the original codes are accurate.
C.explanation: Misuse of shorthand codes could lead to different explanations.

D.text: Choose the model with the highest score in general text; even if shorthand codes appear, maintain a similar level of accuracy.
D.explanation: With scores for general tasks, it is uncertain whether the meaning of specific shorthand codes can be understood.

learning.concept: Separate the learning range of general foundation models from the quality of specific applications, and determine usability under business conditions
learning.reason: Refer to general benchmarks while experts evaluate representative examples including internal shorthand codes and context in work. Also confirm the information needed for an accurate explanation.

aib-c01-d1-073@1.title: Select signals that text translation cannot preserve as input
aib-c01-d1-073@1.prompt: During equipment inspection, we want to detect bearing abnormalities based on changes in sound frequency. There is recording, but only the speaker's conversation remains after transcription. Which is the appropriate input and evaluation?

A.text: Detailed translation of the text is summarized, and all segments without the term "abnormal" in the conversation are treated as normal.
A.explanation: Not all sound changes are mentioned in conversation.

B.text: Determine the failure category based only on the recording length and file name, without evaluating the frequency.
B.explanation: The target features do not appear in the input.

C.text: Not only for conversations, but also use the audio characteristics of recordings to evaluate records that can match the abnormal time in inspection results.
C.explanation: The signals needed for judgment can be linked to the performance that constitutes the correct answer.

D.text: Replace the frequency changes per recording with the number of conversations with the responsible person.
D.explanation: With the speaker's information, the audio signals of the equipment cannot be represented.

learning.concept: In texturing of speech content, audio-related information that disappears is handled at the time of recording and verification.
learning.reason: What is needed are the characteristics of sound waves. This is evaluated using the acoustic information from recording, with examples of identifying abnormal conditions and normal operation.

aib-c01-d1-074@1.title: Do not use the value rounded to the upper limit of measurement directly
aib-c01-d1-074@1.prompt: The device’s AI predicts the maximum vibration value during operation. When some sensors exceed the limit, they actually record the upper limit even for stronger vibrations. Since this value is within the valid range, it passes through the current type inspection. What is a way to improve the training data?

A.text: Add a fixed amount to all upper limits, and consider the corrected value as the true maximum.
A.explanation: It is impossible to determine how much it has exceeded the limit from the records.

B.text: All data from sensors that record the limit is deleted, and evaluations under strong vibration are omitted.
B.explanation: Cannot measure performance under extreme conditions that are important in deployment.

C.text: If the measurement value is within the valid range, the value at the upper limit will also be treated as the maximum actual measurement.
C.explanation: No true vibration exceeding the limit has been recorded.

D.text: Distinguish examples where the machine's upper limit and operation records cap it, and add extreme value assessments using a device capable of measuring the necessary range.
D.explanation: Understand information gaps due to device limitations and evaluate predictions of maximum values.

learning.concept: If the values visible within the range also reach the upper limit of the measuring device, they cannot be distinguished from the true maximum value.
learning.reason: Distinguish the recorded values rounded to the limit from the exact maximum value. Identify corresponding examples based on device settings and conditions, and verify through measurement up to the required strength.

aib-c01-d1-075@1.title: Investigate Why Increasing the Same Type of History Does Not Improve
aib-c01-d1-075@1.prompt: An event venue’s demand model still has similarly high errors on both its training and evaluation sets after the team quadruples the historical training data. The investigation finds that event size and type, which affect demand, are missing from the inputs. Both are known when predictions are made. What should the team try next?

A.text: Duplicate the current history with the same content further and assume that a higher number of cases reduces the error.
A.explanation: Duplication does not increase the missing information, and only the number of cases cannot indicate improvement.

B.text: Add the scale and type of events known at prediction time to the input, and compare the error with the conventional model under the same representative conditions.
B.explanation: The missing information can be addressed, allowing verification of the effect of additional items.

C.text: Include the confirmed number of attendees on the day after the event to improve accuracy, and report that it can be used before the event.
C.explanation: Information that cannot be used at prediction time is utilized.

D.text: Exclude only events with a large scale from evaluation, and if the remaining conditions meet the criteria, expand to all venues.
D.explanation: Performance under business conditions that cause errors cannot be confirmed.

learning.concept: Investigate the necessary inputs and model conditions when increasing learning examples does not reduce error and sufficient explanatory information is missing
learning.reason: Simply increasing the number does not allow knowledge of information not present in the input. Link the scale and type of events usable at prediction time to history, and compare improvements under the same evaluation conditions.

aib-c01-d1-076@1.title: Just using the tool doesn’t allow selecting an agent
aib-c01-d1-076@1.prompt: The purchase process simply records only the approved rows in a fixed order into three ledgers. In case of errors, it is also determined to stop and send a standard notification. No external search or decision to change the order is required. Which configuration is the most appropriate?

A.text: The agent checks the status of each ledger and changes the recording order each time, recording the result only when processing is complete.
A.explanation: Cannot maintain the prescribed order, and no intermediate decisions remain.

B.text: Leave the procedures per ledger solely to document generation, and do not verify whether people execute the content.
B.explanation: Actual transcription and standard error handling cannot be automated.

C.text: Verify approvals through a fixed workflow, record them in the determined order, and notify of stop if there are errors.
C.explanation: It makes it easier to track operations with fully defined steps.

D.text: Three agents are prepared to start transcription simultaneously, and the errors will be corrected by the responsible person later.
D.explanation: Does not meet the requirements for order and stop specifications.

learning.concept: In processes with fixed calling order and conditions, choose a predefined process that can be tracked rather than a free plan.
learning.reason: Fix the known processing order and stop conditions into a fixed workflow. The existence of tool calls alone does not require an agent that can plan freely.

aib-c01-d1-077@1.title: Distinguish between annual changes and unexpected degradation
aib-c01-d1-077@1.prompt: In the travel inquiry classification AI, input for family trips increases in summer. In June this year, the distribution of input sources changed significantly compared to May, but it is similar to the same period last year. The normal summer scenario has been learned, and the performance of representative examples has not yet deteriorated. What is the appropriate response?

A.text: Since the distribution changed from the previous month, retraining will be performed immediately, excluding records from summer.
A.explanation: Without distinguishing between annual changes and performance degradation, the scope is narrowed.

B.text: Track distribution and confirmed performance under the same seasonal criteria and operational conditions, and determine the cause and update if any degradation deviates from the standard.
B.explanation: It can distinguish between planned changes and changes that require action.

C.text: Exclude family trips from evaluation to bring the distribution closer to May, while maintaining overall accuracy.
C.explanation: Remove important conditions that have increased in practice from evaluation.

D.text: Since it changes every year, no comparison is made, and summer performance is excluded from quality reporting.
D.explanation: Not able to notice deterioration beyond the seasonal range or new inputs.

learning.concept: Evaluate the seasonal changes in input using the standards and confirmed performance of the same season to avoid unnecessary updates
learning.reason: Establish a standard for each planned season, and compare it with the quality of the same period in the previous year or the latest standards. Do not decide on updates based solely on the extent of changes.

aib-c01-d1-078@1.title: Integrate AI-specific issues into existing risk management
aib-c01-d1-078@1.prompt: The development company already has existing overall company risk management procedures. Instead of replacing these procedures, we want to incorporate guidelines for identifying, assessing, and addressing the risks associated with AI system development and use. Third-party certification of the organization and the standardization of technical architectures are not part of this goal. What is the most direct reference?

A.text: Refer to ISO/IEC 23053 and standardize the description format for the technical architecture of machine learning systems.
A.explanation: It is a standard that deals with common configuration descriptions, and the risk management guidelines sought here have different purposes.

B.text: First, decide to obtain ISO/IEC 42001 certification, and organize the risk procedures after the investigation is completed.
B.explanation: The objectives of implementation differ in the requirements for the organization’s management system and the guidelines for individual approaches.

C.text: Use ISO/IEC 22989 to standardize the definitions of AI terms and concepts across the entire organization.
C.explanation: Common vocabulary is useful, but the goal is a guideline for handling AI-specific risks.

D.text: Refer to ISO/IEC 23894, and integrate methods for identifying, evaluating, and addressing AI risks in existing activities.
D.explanation: Directly aligns with the goal of incorporating AI risk management into existing procedures.

learning.concept: Selecting AI risk management guidelines and requirements of the organization’s management system for the purpose
learning.reason: ISO/IEC 23894 provides guidelines for managing AI-specific risks throughout the lifecycle and integrating risk management into existing activities.

aib-c01-d1-079@1.title: Adjust the workflow based on unexpected observation results
aib-c01-d1-079@1.prompt: Internal investigation AI examines the causes of the differences reported by users. If the reference ledger stops working, it is necessary to select alternative documents or scopes. The operation is only a lookup; there is a limit on the number of processing cycles. You can choose 2 functions required by the agent.

A.text: Record any remaining questions and investigated materials up to the limit, and hand them over to the responsible person.
A.explanation: Keep people in a state where they can continue while meeting the termination conditions.

B.text: We will create content that may serve as a basis even in the case of insufficient information, and report it as investigated.
B.explanation: Fill in the points requiring confirmation with fake results.

C.text: Rewrite the failed inquiry documents to achieve the investigation objective.
C.explanation: Exceeds the permitted reading range.

D.text: Without changing the plan, simply repeat only the first failed query without any restrictions.
D.explanation: No progress, and it also violates the processing limit conditions.

E.text: Based on the obtained information and gaps, select approved alternative documents and change the investigation order.
E.explanation: Can adapt to different procedures depending on the situation.

learning.concept: Reorganize information acquisition within fixed operational rights and budget, and stop and transfer out of scope areas
learning.reason: The observed results allow for re-planning of the next queries. It is stopped when the allowed range or number of processing steps is reached, and the investigated results are retained.

aib-c01-d1-080@1.title: Notify users of the approval scope before the contract expires
aib-c01-d1-080@1.prompt: The sales team’s AI tool was approved under the existing contract on the condition that the provider does not retain submitted documents. The renewal would allow the provider to retain them, and the new terms are still under review. How should the team manage which uses are allowed while keeping users’ work moving?

A.text: Update the register with the switchover date and the approval status of the new terms. Pause processing that is still under review and point users to an approved alternative.
A.explanation: Transparently communicate restrictions and continuation methods.

B.text: Individual responsible persons read the storage conditions, and they decide on the product usage category themselves.
B.explanation: The cross-departmental criteria and authorization scope do not match.

C.text: Since it remains the same product name, the list is not updated, and the selected users will be informed of the storage conditions later.
C.explanation: We start using it already under the review conditions.

D.text: All approved alternative tools that can be used for the same task must be disabled until the save settings are finalized.
D.explanation: Even the approved safe alternative is lost.

learning.concept: Even for tools with the same name, attach a deadline to the approved conditions, and update availability and alternative routes
learning.reason: When the existing contract expires, mark processing under the new terms as pending approval. Tell users which uses are blocked, when the restriction starts, and which approved alternative they can use.

aib-c01-d1-081@1.title: Improve the variability of output and the accuracy of facts separately
aib-c01-d1-081@1.prompt: Every time a standard guide is created from the same approval documents, the wording changes significantly. Headings and items must remain fixed, and the dates must be presented as in the documents. Choose two things that should be done during setup and verification.

A.text: Increase diversity to create multiple suggestions, and register the most frequent date as the correct answer.
A.explanation: Only the frequency cannot be confirmed as the same date as the document.

B.text: Assume that reducing the temperature will definitely make the date correct, and complete the evaluation.
B.explanation: The reduction in performance fluctuation and the accuracy of facts are different.

C.text: Specify the format, test low temperatures, and compare the variability of the output with the same input.
C.explanation: Can evaluate the impact on the desired reproducibility.

D.text: Match the output items and dates individually with the fixed item list and approval documents.
D.explanation: It can detect errors that may remain in stable output.

E.text: Remove permission data from the input and keep only the properly formatted result as the official answer.
E.explanation: Loses the evidence needed for fact verification.

learning.concept: Adjust variations in representation through sampling, and match the correct values individually with rationale.
learning.reason: Controlling variability is attempted through sampling settings and format instructions. Since settings do not guarantee the accuracy of the facts, dates and items are compared with the document.

aib-c01-d1-082@1.title: Does not consider the well-formatted intermediate output as processed
aib-c01-d1-082@1.prompt: Generate descriptions for each product in a consistent format. When combining 100 items, only 50 with correct formatting are returned, and it is recorded that the output has reached the limit. What is a way to verify all 100 descriptions?

A.text: Send the same 100 items each time, and determine whether they were added by the number of characters in the output.
A.explanation: Cannot identify input limits, duplicates, or IDs that have not been output.

B.text: Break the processing into smaller parts, check the completion reasons and product IDs for each part, and compare them with the overall list.
B.explanation: Can continuously detect missing or duplicate outputs.

C.text: If the first 50 items' format is correct, the rest will be registered as generated.
C.explanation: Correct formatting does not prove that the required number of items has been included.

D.text: Remove the product ID for creating explanations and shorten the output; missing items will be filled in sequentially.
D.explanation: Cannot ensure a match between targets and descriptions.

learning.concept: Confirm the end points and required count due to output limits, and maintain completeness through task splitting and matching.
learning.reason: Match the input list and output by ID, and divide into processing steps shorter than the limit. Check the completion reasons and counts for each part to detect any omissions.

aib-c01-d1-083@1.title: When the language of questions and reasons differs, improve based on the quality of retrieval
aib-c01-d1-083@1.prompt: The internal AI refers to current device documentation. Although the documents are in English, questions in Portuguese only produce incorrect types of documents. With equivalent English questions, appropriate reasons can be obtained, and the scope of approval remains the same. Which improvement should be addressed first?

A.text: Adjust the model to answer all exception questions using general knowledge and avoid accessing current documents.
A.explanation: Does not meet the condition of answering according to approved documents.

B.text: Change the answer model's text to English only, without checking which document was used.
B.explanation: The problem of misinterpreting reasons based on the input language remains.

C.text: Since it can be searched correctly in English, only change the style of the answer for Portuguese.
C.explanation: Changing the style does not make incorrect documents correct reasons.

D.text: Try multilingual search and conversion of inquiries with retained reasons to see if the correct section can be obtained in both languages.
D.explanation: The evaluation can target the differences in retrieval between confirmed languages.

learning.concept: Evaluate whether language can be crossed to reach the relevant original text, and distinguish it from adjustments on the generation side
learning.reason: Compare query conversion methods that maintain intent across languages and multilingual search approaches. Verify the acquisition rate of correct sections and the reasons for answers in both languages.

aib-c01-d1-084@1.title: Compare the achievements obtained late with the corresponding predictions
aib-c01-d1-084@1.prompt: Delivery delay AI makes predictions during shipping. Results for short-distance flights are confirmed on the same day, while those for long-distance flights are confirmed a few days later. The performance is calculated by summing the prediction on the same day and the actual performance of another flight that arrived on the same day. Which improvement is made?

A.text: Calculate performance only for flights with early results, and assume the same for unconfirmed long-distance flights.
A.explanation: It is not possible to verify the performance of different required flights.

B.text: Compare the aggregation of another flight based only on days of the week, and exclude days with large variability.
B.explanation: Even after aligning days of the week, the same subjects are not compared.

C.text: Record all unarrived flights as delayed and compare them with the prediction on the same day.
C.explanation: Flights that ultimately arrive as scheduled are also treated as delayed.

D.text: Link predictions and actual results by flight ID, measure performance for confirmed subjects, and separate the number of unconfirmed cases.
D.explanation: Predicted targets and results can be evaluated using the same flight identifier and period.

learning.concept: Do not compare aggregations over different periods; instead, link predicted targets/points and confirmed results
learning.reason: Link predictions and actual results using the same flight identifier and compare them by confirmed targets. The number of still unconfirmed cases is displayed separately.

aib-c01-d2-073@1.title: Not only reduce inquiries, but also enable users to complete their procedures.
aib-c01-d2-073@1.prompt: The power company is unable to find the identity verification documents required for address change, so they are contacting the counter. The conditions have been approved, and the user’s verification and registration will be carried out through existing procedures. Which of the following is appropriate as a way to reduce the burden on the counter?

A.text: AI estimates the address and registers it before existing identity verification, evaluating only the number of lines on the screen.
A.explanation: It skips required verification and does not measure registration errors.

B.text: Summarize the previous trends in all inquiries, and use the report views to measure the trial results.
B.explanation: It does not measure whether the user has completed the necessary procedures.

C.text: Remove the contact information of the window from the AI screen; if the number of contacts decreases, the completion rate increases.
C.explanation: Even just making inquiries difficult reduces the number of cases.

D.text: Show approved procedures tailored to the user's situation, measure the completion of address change and follow-up inquiries after guidance.
D.explanation: Address the reasons for contacting the support desk, and be able to observe the actual service outcomes.

learning.concept: Link the use case that reduces the effort of the portal to tasks that users can complete
learning.reason: Provide guidance at required locations in accordance with approved conditions, and confirm that the user’s procedures are completed and re-verified.

aib-c01-d2-074@1.title: Separate the planned features of the provider from the currently available features
aib-c01-d2-074@1.prompt: The delivery company uses AI for sorting from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. every morning. The low-cost option is currently in planning for support during the required hours, but the date is not yet determined. The partnership option involves setting up night shifts at the start and transferring operations to the company side, which is within budget. What should the company consider when choosing between the options?

A.text: Prioritize the price difference and buy without checking the official release date of the feature.
A.explanation: The overnight support required at the start is not guaranteed.

B.text: Since the schedule is posted, both proposals are considered to provide the same overnight service from the first day.
B.explanation: Future plans and available contracts are treated as the same.

C.text: No verification of the delivery method is done; if changed to in-house production, night shifts can always be arranged.
C.explanation: No evidence of recruitment or operational capability.

D.text: Verify support at start, alternatives when not met, and handover via shift schedule or contract, and compare costs and risks.
D.explanation: The required operating conditions and costs can be compared based on feasibility.

learning.concept: Reflect delays in future features without formal contracts or proof in the procurement method and continuity measures
learning.reason: Staff available during critical hours, with restoration treated separately from pricing. Planned features are not confirmed capabilities; only dates and alternatives are verified.

aib-c01-d2-075@1.title: Allocate specialized resources that cannot be procured even with a budget
aib-c01-d2-075@1.prompt: There is funding for two AI trials, but the technical experts responsible for approval have only 20 hours per month. While A is valuable, using all 20 hours each month would prevent the review of existing safety inspections. B can continue with inspections while using the remaining time. How should this be decided?

A.text: If the setup cost for B is the same as that for A, it will be fair even if we ignore the difference in value.
A.explanation: The effects achieved and the time spent by the professionals used are not included in the evaluation.

B.text: Ensure a slot for mandatory inspections, and use the remaining time to verify B. A will be re-evaluated under the condition of securing review responsibilities and a dedicated team.
B.explanation: Based on non-budget constraints, you can choose the range in which benefits are actually realized.

C.text: Due to the budget, A will be expanded, and necessary inspections will be carried out after the results compiled by AI are available.
C.explanation: Affects established necessary operations.

D.text: Split the review time equally between the two pilots, drop the safety checks, and run pilot A even if its approval review is incomplete.
D.explanation: Allocating review time alone does not satisfy the mandatory safety and approval requirements.

learning.concept: When the verification time for experts is limited, it is chosen based on the value realized per hour and the impact on essential tasks
learning.reason: First, secure the necessary space for mandatory inspections, and evaluate the benefits that can be achieved with surplus capacity. If A can change the review burden, it will be re-reviewed.

aib-c01-d2-076@1.title: If we can eliminate ambiguity in input, we won’t increase the estimation process
aib-c01-d2-076@1.prompt: There are three purchase categories for equipment requests. Users know which category is needed, but the current screen only allows free-text input, and accounting staff must estimate the category later, leading to errors. We can add a short selection field to the existing system. Which is the first improvement?

A.text: Allow users to select a category during input and provide a verification path for unknown cases to confirm errors and time spent.
A.explanation: Obtain information at the point where decision-making is clear, reducing subsequent estimation.

B.text: Make the instructions given to the AI by staff longer for everyone, without improving input procedures.
B.explanation: Do not record the category that can be clearly understood by the input side.

C.text: Even for uncertain categories, automatically confirm them to a category similar to the input string.
C.explanation: The problem remains that estimation is done without verifying the user’s judgment.

D.text: Keep free-text input and copy large amounts of past estimates for learning purposes.
D.explanation: Leave unnecessary estimations, and past errors could also serve as training data.

learning.concept: When the correct item is obtained at the source of input, compare it with the cost of later AI correction
learning.reason: If users select the category they know, there is less need to estimate the content later. Test the usability of selection and exceptions.

aib-c01-d2-077@1.title: Even if the new system is operational, it is not guaranteed that the old costs will disappear
aib-c01-d2-077@1.prompt: Moving to a new AI platform can reduce inference costs. Financially, the reduction amount was calculated assuming the old contract would be terminated in the following month. Investigations show that monthly operations in other departments rely on a function of the old platform, and there is also a notification deadline for contract termination. Which plan should be reviewed?

A.text: Immediate cessation of usage by other departments to reduce costs, with verification of compatibility with monthly operations later.
A.explanation: The old operations required before the transition will stop.

B.text: Cancel the costs of the old contract once the quality of the new platform meets standards, and investigate the functions of other departments after they are made available.
B.explanation: The contract conditions with the dependent party must be aligned before actual termination is possible.

C.text: Maintain both old contracts indefinitely, and claim cost reductions from the actual operation month onward.
C.explanation: Treat the costs of contracts that are not terminated as already reduced.

D.text: Confirm dependencies on old functions, acceptance of alternatives, and concurrent costs along with the notification deadline, then recalculate net benefits based on a possible termination date.
D.explanation: It is possible to verify both business continuity and costs that actually disappear.

learning.concept: Including the state where the dependent party can terminate the old contract and costs associated with retirement in the transition decision
learning.reason: Verify the dependencies on the old side and the contractual exit date, including necessary transitions and concurrent costs. Account for the reduction starting from the point where the contract termination conditions are met.

aib-c01-d2-078@1.title: Measure stock surplus and shortage simultaneously
aib-c01-d2-078@1.prompt: We want to reduce excess inventory in store demand forecasting. While some stores can reduce inventory uniformly, it will result in a decrease in excess amounts, but the needed items will be missing from the shelves. Choose two indicators for purpose and quality.

A.text: For the same product group, measure the cost of excess inventory, including disposal and storage.
A.explanation: Meets the inventory reduction target.

B.text: Tracks the stockout rate during specific time periods and the percentage of orders that were supplied.
B.explanation: You can check whether the capacity reduction has not worsened the service level.

C.text: Evaluate only the ratio of stores that have reduced the types of racks.
C.explanation: It cannot be distinguished between cases where excess decreases due to changes in handling volume.

D.text: Measure only the number of stock updates; do not count during periods when inventory runs out.
D.explanation: Doesn’t account for the impact on customer supply.

E.text: The number of inventory prediction requests is used as a substitute for how much the inventory has improved.
E.explanation: The number of requests does not reflect storage burden or shortages.

learning.concept: Combine the reduced inventory value with service levels to identify excessive inventory reductions
learning.reason: List the impact of excess inventory burden and shortages on supply. Stores with different handling methods should be compared under similar conditions.

aib-c01-d2-079@1.title: Verify the criteria forgotten before implementation from existing records
aib-c01-d2-079@1.prompt: After starting AI-based maintenance reception, it was discovered that previous working hours were not recorded. In some locations, there are previous processing records showing dates and tasks, while in other locations, only monthly counts of cases are available. What is the appropriate approach to evaluate results?

A.text: Match the definitions using only sites that can track the same process, calculate the previous time, and clearly indicate the unmeasured parts and evaluation range.
A.explanation: The applicable reasons and areas where a judgment cannot be made become clear.

B.text: The average of several sites with time records is considered as the pre-implementation time for all sites, without verification.
B.explanation: I have not confirmed the definition of the work or the differences between locations.

C.text: Multiply the monthly count by the current average time, and treat all the difference between the past and present as the AI effect.
C.explanation: No past actual working hours have been observed.

D.text: All records from the implementation month are saved under the name “before implementation”, and the difference between them is considered as a result.
D.explanation: The installed state is not a measurement of the previous state.

learning.concept: When reconstructing comparison values from past data, examine the definition, subject, and accuracy to explicitly indicate missing values
learning.reason: Reconstruct the pre-implementation standards within the range where the project and time align. Sites where measurements cannot be confirmed are not treated as reliable results, and subsequent comparisons will be adjusted accordingly.

aib-c01-d2-080@1.title: Convert the churn rate change into investment returns based on profit
aib-c01-d2-080@1.prompt: The target group contains 2,000 customers. In a comparison trial, the annual churn rate fell from 12% without AI support to 10% with it. Assume the same effect applies to the defined customer group. Each retained customer contributes an additional JPY 30,000 in contribution margin, and the AI costs JPY 800,000 per year. What is the net incremental profit?

A.text: 400,000 yen. Subtract the annual cost from 1.2 million yen of additional marginal profit for 40 companies.
A.explanation: Use the absolute difference in churn rates, the number of retained contracts, and costs correctly.

B.text: 1.2 million yen. Treat the full profit of retained contracts as the net increase.
B.explanation: The annual AI cost has not been subtracted.

C.text: 5.2 million yen. Assume 200 companies continue additionally corresponding to 10%, then subtract costs from profits.
C.explanation: 10% is the churn rate with AI support, not the proportion of contracts retained additionally due to the initiative.

D.text: −740,000 JPY. Treat 2 percentage points as 2 customers and multiply by JPY 30,000.
D.explanation: The ratio has not been applied to the number of target cases.

learning.concept: Distinguish between relative change rates and point differences, and use the number of additional retained contracts and marginal profit
learning.reason: A difference of 2 percentage points means 40 customers retained. Their additional contribution margin is 40 × JPY 30,000 = JPY 1,200,000. Subtracting the annual AI cost of JPY 800,000 leaves JPY 400,000.

aib-c01-d2-081@1.title: Measuring Verification Actions Prior to Long-Term Defect Reduction
aib-c01-d2-081@1.prompt: The contract review AI displays items that require verification to reduce omissions in clauses. Whether actual contract issues decrease is unknown until the update period. Which metric indicates whether attention is reflected in work, not just the display?

A.text: Number of times the verification screen was closed.
A.explanation: Just closing the screen does not indicate that verification was performed.

B.text: Annual rate of contract issues that are confirmed during updates.
B.explanation: It is the final result and cannot be achieved in time for initial judgment.

C.text: Percentage of cases where the responsible person verified the basis and recorded it within the deadline among those requiring verification.
C.explanation: It shows whether the necessary action was taken after the warning was issued.

D.text: Total number of characters in the generated warning text.
D.explanation: It does not measure whether necessary verification was performed.

learning.concept: Measuring the proportion of cases where necessary verification is completed early to proceed to the next step before results are confirmed
learning.reason: Using cases that require verification as the denominator, tracking the percentage of cases where the responsible person verifies the basis and records it within the deadline. This is also linked to the number of issues that are confirmed later.

aib-c01-d2-082@1.title: Costs that remain fixed even during idle time should be reviewed
aib-c01-d2-082@1.prompt: During the last two days of the month, 80% of the workload is generated; on other days, it is less. There is a proposal to set up a fixed purchase plan throughout the year. The maximum waiting time should be maintained. Which cost plan should be tried?

A.text: Measure the required amount during normal and month-end periods, combine the usage-based and peak additional quotas, and compare the resulting cost and deadline with the fixed quota.
A.explanation: Handles both demand variability and required service levels.

B.text: Limit to only the cheapest quota; for what cannot be processed at month-end, do not notify a deadline and move it to the next month.
B.explanation: Does not meet the waiting time conditions required by the business.

C.text: Do not include days with low activity; estimate the cost for the two days at month-end as annual costs.
C.explanation: Reduces the basic annual costs and expenses on other days.

D.text: Even on non-operating days, set the maximum fixed quota; only consider the unit price and decide if it is cheap.
D.explanation: Does not evaluate the total amount including unused parts.

learning.concept: Compare the difference between fixed quota and usage-based costs using actual usage patterns, and verify peak quality and annual costs
learning.reason: Use normal and peak demand levels, compare the costs of usage-based and short-term additional quotas with the fixed quota. Also check if the deadline during peak times is actually met.

aib-c01-d2-083@1.title: Even with similar features, investigate why customers refuse to adopt them.
aib-c01-d2-083@1.prompt: The candidates for business AI have speeds and accuracy comparable to those of competitors. Multiple customers chose them because they were shown records from the control tests before the competitors' implementation. Which survey determines the company’s next improvements?

A.text: Lowering prices in response to competition, and adding the necessary information for control after customer review.
A.explanation: Fails to meet the pre-employment screening criteria.

B.text: Confirm the evidence and deadline required by the customer review team, and compare the available materials with those of competitors to measure their impact on the contract decision.
B.explanation: We can identify the factors that actually influenced the hiring decision.

C.text: Only investigate the cost of doubling the model speed; do not handle the control test materials requested by the customer.
C.explanation: It does not identify the difference that actually determined whether the solution would be adopted.

D.text: Compare the competing brand names, but do not conduct surveys on customers who have lost business.
D.explanation: The conditions that didn’t get selected are just guessed.

learning.concept: In competitive comparisons, besides performance, factors such as ease of approval and the evidence required by customers are also considered.
learning.reason: Confirm the evidence and timing required for customer review, and investigate the differences between the company and competitors, as well as the impact on the contract if resolved.

aib-c01-d2-084@1.title: From serving existing customers, testing businesses with different sales channels
aib-c01-d2-084@1.prompt: We have been selling the corporate meeting notes support function exclusively to our own company. Since direct sales to small customers using conference systems are costly, the system provider wanted to re-sell the function within our product. What is a way to test a new business model?

A.text: Only the direct sale price is reduced; income and costs through resale partners are not measured.
A.explanation: It does not test whether the offering can succeed in the new sales channel.

B.text: Decided to provide free distribution to the provider without any usage limits, assuming that as users increase, profits will also increase.
B.explanation: It is not possible to compare revenue and costs.

C.text: The provider company tries a small resale, and measures the revenue allocation, customer usage, operations, and support costs.
C.explanation: We can actually verify the sales channels, revenue, and responsibility structure.

D.text: If the company’s inference accuracy is high, re-selling will be considered profitable, and support responsibilities will be determined after launch.
D.explanation: Product performance and the profitability of the business model are separate.

learning.concept: Integrate the AI-powered features into existing products to verify who will bear the costs and support
learning.reason: Try providing integration-based delivery to a small customer base, and verify the revenue distribution across sales channels, customer usage and support costs, and unit profit.

aib-c01-d2-085@1.title: Even with a general-purpose model, low delivery costs can be achieved over the long term.
aib-c01-d2-085@1.prompt: The enterprise-grade document verification AI uses the same model as competitors, but the high cost arises from having to recreate the same tests and operational settings for each customer. It allows the company to standardize industry-wide verification tasks, while handling customer-specific inspections separately. Which investment helps continuously enhance competitiveness?

A.text: Wait for the competitor's price increase, and continue to recreate all tests and configurations per customer.
A.explanation: No improvement in time and cost that can be managed by the company itself.

B.text: Maintain the cost, and increase contracts at a price where no profit is made in the first year.
B.explanation: Even if the number of customers increases temporarily, a sustained advantage in delivery costs will not be maintained.

C.text: Change to the cheapest model and eliminate all customer-specific checks.
C.explanation: Even if the unit price is reduced, costs may increase due to quality degradation or reprocessing.

D.text: Reuse common checks and operational settings, while maintaining customer-specific checks. Track implementation costs, cost per completion, and quality.
D.explanation: Reduces the cost of repeating the same work, and allows for measurement of business quality.

learning.concept: By standardizing the routine work of verifying and operating similar services, rather than relying on reduced feature prices, quality can be maintained
learning.reason: Standardize the testing and operation mechanisms that can be used across customers, while maintaining the quality of customer-specific components. Track whether the implementation cost and the cost per confirmed completed project continue to decrease.

aib-c01-d2-086@1.title: Investment will be made at the stage when demand and business profitability are proven.
aib-c01-d2-086@1.prompt: In the support market for security inspections, multiple paid trials have been updated, and the profitability, including prices and support fees, is within expectations. Industry standards and sales procedures have been established, and competition is increasing. Which is the most appropriate AI investment for this period?

A.text: Due to competition, no investment in a mature market is made, and paid trials are also completed.
A.explanation: Ignoring proven customer value and profitability.

B.text: Without checking actual trial results, the budget is uniformly increased by the same amount to include overseas areas, proportional to the increase in the number of competitions.
B.explanation: No consideration has been given to the markets and costs that can be implemented.

C.text: Invest gradually in supply and quality management within the range where demand can be confirmed, and determine the next expansion based on renewal rate and costs.
C.explanation: Can reflect market reliability into funding allocation.

D.text: Since the experiment has been updated, it is assumed that profitability will be maintained in the future, and the measurement of operational burden will be stopped.
D.explanation: Costs change at a scale that’s hard to track, and competition can’t be monitored.

learning.concept: Do not adjust investment based solely on competitor moves, but evaluate the maturity of demand and supply simultaneously
learning.reason: Since payment and operational conditions have been proven, investments will be made gradually in capacity and quality maintenance within the range of demand, adjusted based on retention rate and cost.

aib-c01-d2-087@1.title: Not only process returns, but also choose measures to reduce the causes of returns
aib-c01-d2-087@1.prompt: The seller can process return submissions quickly. The business goal is to reduce repeat returns for the same product. It is possible to compare the order details with the reasons written by users, and the product department can correct components or descriptions suspected of being the cause. Which measure is appropriate?

A.text: Shorten the text for return responses and further reduce the average time from submission to sending.
A.explanation: It has nothing to do with the goal of eliminating the cause of returns.

B.text: Link products and versions with reason texts to identify trends, correct the confirmed causes, and measure the return rate for the same reasons.
B.explanation: It can link AI analysis to actionable improvements and effects.

C.text: Offer coupons to frequent buyers and evaluate product improvements based on the number of exchanges.
C.explanation: It does not address the causes of returns per product.

D.text: Calculate the number of staff for the next month based on the total past returns, without examining differences due to products or reasons.
D.explanation: It can be used for staff planning, but does not identify the causes that should be reduced.

learning.concept: Understand recurring causes from details and reason texts, and measure product improvements and effects
learning.reason: Link reason texts with products and versions to identify potential causes, and the product department verifies and corrects them. Then measure returns for the same reason.

aib-c01-d2-088@1.title: Align the budget priority with the outcomes that should be protected
aib-c01-d2-088@1.prompt: The benefits of AI in gathering records needed for contract review mainly lie in reducing audit findings, with minimal time savings. An alternative is to shorten the drafting of a public relations proposal, but the top priority for the next strategy is improving review quality. Both do not fit within the budget. What is the appropriate way to assign priorities?

A.text: First invest in a proposal that improves the evidence and findings of the review to meet strategic quality goals.
A.explanation: It is not directly linked to profits but can address outcomes that companies prioritize.

B.text: Since both are AI systems, assign the same priority and decide not to set a deadline for verification until the next year.
B.explanation: It is impossible to link strategic goals with current budget constraints.

C.text: Collect only the number of audit findings; if expectations are high, proceed with full company deployment even if data cannot be used.
C.explanation: It may not verify feasibility based solely on value, and the desired results may not be achieved.

D.text: Choose the option that offers the greatest time savings, ignoring audit deadlines and review quality in investment evaluation.
D.explanation: It ignores the quality that the business should protect and its impact.

learning.concept: Evaluate not only direct cost-effectiveness but also key business outcomes and avoidable disadvantages
learning.reason: Compare value without focusing solely on time savings; evaluate the business’s top priorities and the actual impact on reviews. Prioritize review improvements that meet the standards.

aib-c01-d2-089@1.title: Borrowing external expertise while taking over evaluations for the own company
aib-c01-d2-089@1.prompt: Food manufacturers want to use inspection support for their own processes. Pre-packaged products cannot provide the necessary justification for certain equipment categories. Although there is on-site knowledge within the company, there is no experience in AI evaluation. A potential partner can create evaluations together with the on-site team and transfer the procedures. Which is the best choice?

A.text: Ignore the constraints of device classification and introduce cheaper pre-made products, with the field providing explanations for them.
A.explanation: There are categories that cannot provide the basis for the inspection.

B.text: Select a specialist partner to conduct evaluations jointly with the site, and make the ability to re-evaluate independently by the company a condition for successful transfer.
B.explanation: Compensate for missing skills, and maintain quality on its own after release.

C.text: Entrust the entire evaluation to the partner, and receive only the score result; do not share test cases or passing criteria.
C.explanation: Unable to manage business changes and re-evaluations in-house.

D.text: The basis for monitoring the model by entrusting evaluations without transferring business knowledge to external parties will be sought after implementation.
D.explanation: No validation and operational handover that reflects the on-site conditions are possible.

learning.concept: Evaluate and transfer capabilities that cannot be met by off-the-shelf solutions, and make these into the selection of partners and acceptance criteria
learning.reason: We compare the partnership based on the skills required for joint evaluation, case studies for validation, evaluation procedures, and the ability to conduct independent re-evaluation as acceptance criteria.

aib-c01-d2-090@1.title: Even if it can be predicted, if the measures aren’t timely enough, we will review the policies.
aib-c01-d2-090@1.prompt: The retail company wants to adjust the morning shipment volume by detecting shortages using AI on the same day. The only signal that was valid for validation was the result of midday inventory inspection, and the shipment volume cannot be changed at that time. The data available at dawn did not improve the current decision. What is the next priority policy?

A.text: Do not use the current morning adjustments, and consider information obtained early on, as well as any supplements or guidance available in the afternoon.
A.explanation: We can first check whether the predictions can be applied to operations where they actually make a difference.

B.text: Every morning, it reports that displaying the previous day's training output for the model using the daytime results can prevent shortages on that day.
B.explanation: Even showing the previous day’s results does not become a signal for the current day, and no improvement has been verified.

C.text: Increase the number of model training iterations while maintaining the unchangeable time, and continue to improve daytime accuracy.
C.explanation: Even by improving the accuracy of existing verification results, the constraints on unavailable times remain.

D.text: If high precision is available via daytime signals, it can be implemented to reduce morning shortages even if the shipment volume cannot be changed.
D.explanation: You cannot take the desired action when accurate information is not available.

learning.concept: The high accuracy of the prediction and the point at which the results can be applied in actual operations
learning.reason: For models that use daytime signals, the current process cannot change morning shipments. We will test a plan that can change the signal or adjustment time, and for now, we will consider subsequent tasks that can be handled.

aib-c01-d2-091@1.title: To organize the routes customers can use at any time before switching
aib-c01-d2-091@1.prompt: Introduce an AI reception for payment consultations. Standard consultations can be directed immediately, but consultations via agents will be handled using existing phone reservations for now. The notification before the switch states that "all consultations are completed on screen". Which action is necessary to continue operations?

A.text: Maintain the notification that all consultations are completed, and only assign internal handling when a query arrives.
A.explanation: Misinform the available options, resulting in no alternative being established.

B.text: Guide both target phone reservations and non-target reservations, allowing participants to test both from receipt to completion.
B.explanation: Continued operations for necessary tasks are possible during the transition.

C.text: For existing users who know traditional phone reservations, do not send notifications and simply switch.
C.explanation: New users or those who have changes are unable to handle the situation.

D.text: Remove guidance to old reservations to increase usage of the new route, and non-target users should find a support source after an error occurs.
D.explanation: Non-target customers become less likely to receive support.

learning.concept: The scope after the change and explanations for alternatives and users are conditions for the transition
learning.reason: Clearly communicate the target, maintain the entry point and responsible party of phone reservations. Test whether users can actually start and complete both routes.

aib-c01-d2-092@1.title: How much operational capability increases with reduced processing time
aib-c01-d2-092@1.prompt: The AI inspector reduced the drafting time for inspectors by half. The organization’s goal is to increase approved inspections within the same working hours. While the number of documents increased, there are many unapproved records due to corrections. What would be an appropriate key metric?

A.text: Compare the number of completed documents by increasing working hours and excluding additional work from measurement.
A.explanation: It is impossible to determine the increase under the same personnel conditions.

B.text: Measure only the average generation time for drafts, and do not evaluate correction time.
B.explanation: The total amount completed as a whole is unknown.

C.text: Determine productivity based solely on the number of completed drafts.
C.explanation: It does not reflect the number of inspections that can be used after approval.

D.text: Measure the number of inspections completed with quality verification within equivalent personnel time, while tracking unapproved and correction burdens.
D.explanation: It allows observation of the actual increased operational capability available.

learning.concept: Observe effective results and quality achieved with the same personnel, distinguishing them from theoretical reduction time
learning.reason: Measure the completion of inspections that have officially completed quality verification under the same personnel and working conditions. Track unapproved document numbers and correction burdens separately.

aib-c01-d2-093@1.title: Determine the trial effect after knowing the normal range of fluctuations
aib-c01-d2-093@1.prompt: Document processing varies significantly in difficulty each operating day. The AI experiment manager said the processing was slower only the previous day, so they want to report the improvement rate based on that day. What metrics should be set before starting?

A.text: Select the first week in which AI has improved, and use the peak value of that week as the past reference value.
A.explanation: Choosing the measurement period based on the implementation results seen will distort the evaluation.

B.text: Measure across representative multiple periods using the same category and definition, so that normal fluctuations and post-experiment changes can be compared.
B.explanation: The accidental difference of one day is difficult to distinguish from evaluation.

C.text: Assume that if the overall system uptime is the same, the complexity of tasks is also the same, and establish the baseline based on the measurement from the previous day.
C.explanation: No conditions for changes in case composition have been considered.

D.text: Set it based on the slowest day, and exclude days where improvement cannot be measured from the calculation.
D.explanation: Select only the favorable aspects from normal fluctuations.

learning.concept: Record normal fluctuations over multiple periods before implementation, and do not conclude results based on daily differences
learning.reason: Determine the multiple periods and project categories to be represented, and examine the central value and variability of the processing. Similar conditions are also investigated in experiments, taking normal variability into account.

aib-c01-d2-094@1.title: Do not count the benefits already obtained as results of additional investment
aib-c01-d2-094@1.prompt: The current AI support provides a benefit of 4 million yen and a cost of 2.2 million yen per year. In the premium version, the benefit becomes 5.2 million yen and the cost becomes 3.6 million yen. There is no difference in other conditions such as quality. What is the annual net benefit increase if switched to the premium version?

A.text: 1.8 million yen. Compare the current benefit and current cost.
A.explanation: It shows no effect of the change based on the current net benefit.

B.text: 1.6 million yen. Subtract the cost of the premium version from the benefit of the premium version.
B.explanation: It is the net benefit of the premium version alone; it is not a difference from the current version.

C.text: −200,000 JPY. Compare the net benefits of the current and proposed options.
C.explanation: It measures the difference due to the switch, excluding the benefits already obtained.

D.text: 1.2 million yen. Use only the difference between the benefit of 5.2 million yen and the current benefit.
D.explanation: The 1.4 million yen increase in annual cost is not deducted.

learning.concept: Determine the economic viability of the change based solely on the incremental benefit and incremental cost of additional features
learning.reason: The current value is 1.8 million yen, and the premium version is 1.6 million yen. With an incremental benefit of 1.2 million yen but a cost increase of 1.4 million yen, the difference is minus 200,000 yen.

aib-c01-d2-095@1.title: Measuring the supply capacity of implementation before the number of uses after release
aib-c01-d2-095@1.prompt: The value derived from the company’s AI initiatives can only be evaluated after six months. In the past, although there were many proposals, many were halted due to essential data and the review of responsible persons required for actual implementation. What are the early indicators that will help us understand the potential for rollout next month?

A.text: Total number of AI ideas presented at the meeting.
A.explanation: It’s unclear whether the proposal will pass all requirements.

B.text: Total profit from all AI initiatives after six months.
B.explanation: An important final result, but it won’t be ready for next month’s evaluation.

C.text: Among the proposals under consideration, the proportion that has achieved data approval and secured a real-world responsible person to meet the next trial conditions.
C.explanation: Identify the scope and bottlenecks of the projects to be advanced first.

D.text: The value of the number of types of newly introduced models divided by the number of departments.
D.explanation: It is impossible to measure the state where business value can be provided.

learning.concept: Observe the number of items that become operational after important reviews, to avoid just an increase in proposal numbers
learning.reason: Complete the actual required approvals and preparations, and track the proportion of progress and reasons for delays in trials and deployments. Evaluate and distinguish economic effects.

aib-c01-d2-096@1.title: Reduce the cost of unnecessary documents sent repeatedly
aib-c01-d2-096@1.prompt: The cost of the maintenance consultation AI has increased. While all product manuals unrelated to each request are included, the target time and justification for responses must be maintained. Choose two measures to take.

A.text: Always switch to the highest-performance model while keeping the current input configuration.
A.explanation: The processing volume causing the increase has not been changed.

B.text: Ensure all documents are sent until the end, and only verify those with a low monthly charge.
B.explanation: The input is not reduced, and the comparison targets are biased.

C.text: Remove all justification documents; if costs decrease, it is assumed that response quality can also be maintained.
C.explanation: All necessary justifications are lost, and there is no quality verification.

D.text: Confirm the acquisition and accuracy of justifications for representative issues, and compare waiting time and cost per completed task.
D.explanation: It is possible to verify whether business requirements can be maintained while reducing costs.

E.text: First filter out approved documents related to the target product and consultation, and provide only the necessary parts.
E.explanation: Unrelated input each time can be reduced.

learning.concept: Investigate the cost breakdown, and determine the necessary range of documents and justifications from the large volume sent each time
learning.reason: Select the documents needed for the product and inquiry, reduce input volume. Compare the missed justifications, quality, and actual processing costs.

aib-c01-d3-061@1.title: To measure whether it can handle natural variations in user input
aib-c01-d3-061@1.prompt: In device submissions using AI, high accuracy is achieved with well-organized original documents. However, field personnel often take photos with papers still folded or submit them in dimly lit areas. The results required for work remain the same. What are the priorities for verification from a responsible AI perspective?

A.text: Use examples including darkness and breaks to measure the accuracy of key items, and confirm re-submission if they cannot be read.
A.explanation: It allows verification of quality and recovery paths in the actual site condition.

B.text: Unreadable images are removed from evaluation, and poor results are not explained to users before proceeding to production.
B.explanation: No problematic conditions, and no alternative methods available.

C.text: Measure accuracy using only the most readable original text, and apply that value to all usage conditions.
C.explanation: Cannot verify business results in the state that occurs during use.

D.text: Only assign a number of brightness points per image; the reading results of the application are not evaluated.
D.explanation: Input characteristics alone cannot measure operational errors.

learning.concept: Test the expected input changes in advance to confirm whether important business results can be maintained
learning.reason: Create representative examples based on actual conditions, and investigate errors and unrecognized cases for each input state.

aib-c01-d3-062@1.title: Do not release unfounded advertising content prioritizing the publication date
aib-c01-d3-062@1.prompt: The guidance on products created by AI is attractive, but we cannot confirm the effects until internal verification is completed. We want to meet the upcoming launch date, but claiming effects without support is prohibited by policy. What is the appropriate action?

A.text: Fix the publication date, then show the effects created by AI directly and then find the basis.
A.explanation: We inform the user of unverified claims first.

B.text: If similar effects are described in other generative AI, it will be selected without checking the product’s performance.
B.explanation: The match between the two outputs is not evidence of the product’s effectiveness.

C.text: Add small notes to all effects, and present them as established facts without checking for supporting evidence.
C.explanation: Just paying attention to the presentation does not guarantee support.

D.text: Only the verified facts and guidance will be published; the determination of effectiveness will be considered after the basis is confirmed.
D.explanation: While maintaining the public purpose, it can meet the required accuracy.

learning.concept: To balance business time constraints with accurate display, the public access range is adjusted based solely on approved conditions
learning.reason: Remove unverified claims, and prepare only the confirmed facts that can be published. Add expressions after verifying the evidence.

aib-c01-d3-063@1.title: Designed to allow correction and suspension of usage through the provider
aib-c01-d3-063@1.prompt: Integrate AI candidate suggestions into the distribution recipient’s booking service. Since suggestions appear on screens that cannot be directly accessed from the original company, there is a lack of someone who can stop or correct errors when they occur. What should be included in the design?

A.text: Only the introduction text displayed on each screen will be prepared; work on stopping and correcting will be discussed after the incident.
A.explanation: When issues occur, permissions and responses are not defined.

B.text: In the contract and acceptance tests, include conditions for both parties to act on issue notifications, suspension within the agreed scope, and correction of incorrect proposals.
B.explanation: It is possible to confirm that a series of actions can be carried out even on external screens.

C.text: If the provider can stop the company-side screen, it is not verified whether it will continue to be displayed on the distribution side.
C.explanation: The effectiveness at the distribution points cannot be guaranteed.

D.text: Assign the person who received the error report to contact the other company, and no follow-up will be made on the correction completion.
D.explanation: It is not possible to verify whether the impact has been reflected for users.

learning.concept: In deployments across multiple organizations, establish communication, authority, and exercises for suspension and correction before activation.
learning.reason: Determine which company will notify regarding the suspension and correction of the proposal, and provide evidence to confirm the reflection of the correction before proceeding.

aib-c01-d3-064@1.title: Do not confuse the expiration time with someone's approval
aib-c01-d3-064@1.prompt: The payment support AI generates a proposal and asks the responsible person for confirmation. According to internal regulations, payments exceeding the limit can only be finalized after an approval action. In the prototype, if the responsible person does nothing within the time limit, the payment is finalized. Which improvement is appropriate?

A.text: If the responsible person does not respond, approve the action instead based on the AI's confidence level.
A.explanation: The required person's approval as stipulated in the regulations cannot be obtained.

B.text: Since the responsible person may return after confirmation, record a nominal approval even if there is no response.
B.explanation: Use an approval that has not actually been obtained to finalize the payment first.

C.text: If there is a read receipt for the confirmation request, explicit approval for the transfer content is not required.
C.explanation: A read receipt does not indicate permission for a specific action.

D.text: If explicit approval is not given, keep it pending and contact the agent responsible person. The payment is finalized only after the approval is recorded.
D.explanation: Even without a response, the required approval can be maintained.

learning.concept: For operations that require explicit approval, treat the absence of a response as pending, similar to negation
learning.reason: Do not treat no response as approval; instead, notify the agent responsible person that it remains pending. Record the approval result and the conditions for finalization, then test both with a response and without it.

aib-c01-d3-065@1.title: Assign a person responsible for resolving conflicts between departments based on AI acceptance criteria
aib-c01-d3-065@1.prompt: The business department reviews the schedule, legal checks the contract, and operations assesses quality before an AI service goes live. There is no rule for a case that one team approves and another puts on hold. How should the review process be organized?

A.text: Combine all employees into a single approval account, without recording who made each decision.
A.explanation: It is impossible to track responsibilities, outcomes, and unresolved items.

B.text: Define the scope and mandatory conditions for each department, and specify the reporting party, deadline, and review procedures in case of unresolved issues.
B.explanation: It is possible to clarify who made the decision and how conflicts are resolved.

C.text: Publish even if there is no agreement among departments, and review the review system during the next annual audit.
C.explanation: The mandatory conditions that remain in abeyance are provided without verification.

D.text: Adopt the decision of the department that responded first, and do not contact other responsible parties who declared the project in abeyance.
D.explanation: The mandatory conditions of departments with different review targets are left unaddressed.

learning.concept: Separate the evaluation of operations, security, and legal affairs, and assign responsibility for adjusting conflicting conditions
learning.reason: Define the review items and approval conditions of each department, and specify the person responsible for adjustment and re-review in case of conflict. Do not provide the service until the mandatory conditions are met.

aib-c01-d3-066@1.title: To properly respond when a copy of records is requested
aib-c01-d3-066@1.prompt: According to the company’s policy, if an individual requests a record of their AI consultation, it must be provided within a specified period after identity verification. In addition to the original records, the saved AI summaries used by the staff also fall under this requirement. Choose two measures needed before service launch.

A.text: Recreate some records using AI and provide them as previous saved records.
A.explanation: It is not possible to provide the actual saved content at that time.

B.text: Try to obtain both the original records and saved summaries using the individual’s ID, and record the applicable scope and time.
B.explanation: It covers every item in scope and provides evidence that the requirement was met.

C.text: To ensure quick response, do not verify whether the requester and the record owner match.
C.explanation: There is a risk of disclosing someone else’s records.

D.text: Set the responsible person, procedures, and response deadline for accepting the verified request.
D.explanation: It enables acceptance and deadline management in accordance with requirements.

E.text: Since the summary is automatically generated, no storage location is checked; only the original records are targeted.
E.explanation: This does not comply with the policy, which requires including saved summaries as well.

learning.concept: Assign assumed disclosure requests to identity verification, search targets, deadlines, and completion evidence
learning.reason: Establish a pathway with identity verification and a response deadline, and try to obtain related saved summaries. A record of compliance is also kept.

aib-c01-d3-067@1.title: Migrate from shared credentials to minimal operational permissions
aib-c01-d3-067@1.prompt: During the internal AI trial, three departments are using a single permanent service credential. The libraries and data used vary by department, and it is difficult to determine who to block if a leak is suspected. What should be the priority?

A.text: Change only the name of the credential among department staff, while keeping the actual authorization information shared.
A.explanation: The scope of operations does not change based on the displayed name.

B.text: Establish separate execution entities for different purposes, limit permissions to what is needed, enable auditing, and eliminate the common credential.
B.explanation: Localize the impact area during a leak, allowing tracking of the entity using the credential.

C.text: To reduce impact, distribute the same credentials to external support personnel in addition to all departments' applications.
C.explanation: The scope of sensitive permissions shared expands.

D.text: Update the common credential regularly, but maintain the permissions for all departments and all data.
D.explanation: Just updates may not resolve issues with scope and entities.

learning.concept: Abandon the common permanent credential; localize impact through service-specific roles and auditing
learning.reason: Identify by purpose and move to minimal permissions, track changes and usage. The old credential is disabled after migration.

aib-c01-d3-068@1.title: Before transitioning from prototype synthetic data to actual records, review the classification
aib-c01-d3-068@1.prompt: We verified the internal query summary using synthetic data and classified it as low-risk. In the next attempt, we want to include inquiries from actual users. The operation and model are the same, but the inquiries include records linked to individuals. How should we handle this during review?

A.text: Allow anyone to use it, limited to a few actual records; the storage conditions will be determined later.
A.explanation: Even by reducing the number of cases, access and storage conditions cannot be eliminated.

B.text: Since the output format is the same, use the approval from synthetic data directly.
B.explanation: The impact of handling sensitive actual records is not included in the review.

C.text: Ask the model not to output information linked to individuals, and exclude input processing from the classification.
C.explanation: The risks of receiving, storing, and viewing sensitive information remain.

D.text: Re-evaluate the sensitivity and purpose of actual records, confirm access, storage, and deletion conditions, and then expand the target scope.
D.explanation: We can prepare approvals and operations that match the new information range.

learning.concept: Even if the purpose and function are the same, management changes when the sensitivity of the handled information and the impact of leaks vary
learning.reason: Based on the differences between the data used in the prototype and actual records, we reassess and prepare purposes, access, storage/deletion, and verification before introducing actual data.

aib-c01-d3-069@1.title: Verify the number of critical incidents based on usage and observation range
aib-c01-d3-069@1.prompt: The operations team monitors incorrect contract guidance weekly. Recently, traffic has doubled, and the number of incorrect guides has also doubled. However, even one critical incorrect guide requires immediate response. Which of the following is appropriate for reviewing the monitoring?

A.text: Do not record the denominator using only the weekly count; instead, report that the model performance has halved despite the doubled count.
A.explanation: It is impossible to distinguish the impact of changes in usage.

B.text: Exclude all weeks with low usage, and only notify about critical incidents at the end of the month.
B.explanation: It fails to meet the criteria for detection, and the decline during low usage is not visible.

C.text: Record the number of guided incidents and the target category, then compare with the normal defect rate. Critical incidents must be reported and investigated regardless of the number of cases.
C.explanation: Both trend and urgent response to critical incidents can be maintained.

D.text: Consolidate everything into a rate, and do not begin verification unless the overall rate increases for critical incidents.
D.explanation: It is impossible to handle critical incidents that require response even for a single case.

learning.concept: Distinguish between a small sample and an increase in the number of incidents; critical incidents are managed including the single-case condition
learning.reason: The overall trend is measured by aligning the denominator and observed range. Critical incidents are maintained as a separate urgent response condition.

aib-c01-d3-070@1.title: Don’t turn past unbalanced decisions into correct answers for the training data
aib-c01-d3-070@1.prompt: The priority model for career counseling uses records of what staff members have supported in the past as training data. In audits, some offices excluded users with certain work arrangements even under the same conditions. You can choose two measures before training proceeds.

A.text: If the distinctions are removed from the classification records, it is assumed that there is no bias in the teacher labels either.
A.explanation: There is a possibility that the original selected results may still be biased.

B.text: After publication, compare it with the verified business assessment and check whether errors have reoccurred in the categories where issues were identified.
B.explanation: Unbalanced issues can also be detected during post-training operation.

C.text: Re-evaluate representative cases using appropriate criteria, and prepare aligned training data not just from past selections.
C.explanation: Minimize the risk of reproducing biased judgments as correct answers.

D.text: Past judgments are based on performance, so they remain unchanged; their consistency serves as sufficient evidence of fairness.
D.explanation: High accuracy can be achieved by learning from past imbalances.

E.text: Evaluate only the largest interface, and remove the category mentioned in the concerns from monitoring.
E.explanation: Unable to evaluate conditions requiring improvement.

learning.concept: Do not assume past processing results are valid, but evaluate and monitor them based on independent criteria
learning.reason: Separate past judgments from proper criteria, and re-evaluate representative examples independently. Even after operation, monitor errors including those affected categories.

aib-c01-d3-071@1.title: Verify whether the generated output contains external license terms
