aib-c01-d3-071@1.prompt: The AI created a short processing code for the distributed product. The developer noted that it closely resembles specific sections in a third-party project. Internal policies require confirming permission before distributing external code. What should be the next step?

A.text: Keep the questionable sections and review their origin and usage conditions. If the conditions cannot be confirmed, do not adopt it and replace it with a valid method.
A.explanation: The legal requirements can be verified before distribution.

B.text: Just change the variable name, and it can be assumed that the original usage conditions are still valid.
B.explanation: Changing the name does not ensure the origin or application conditions are verified.

C.text: Only notify the generation tool name, and do not verify the permission for the third-party project.
C.explanation: Indicating the generator does not prove the permission for external code.

D.text: If the code works, treat it as if the distribution conditions are met.
D.explanation: The functionality and external usage conditions are separate issues.

learning.concept: Before distribution to business use, a person verifies recognizable external content and usage conditions.
learning.reason: Separate the questionable parts from distribution and verify the origin and conditions of similar content. If not approved, replace it with a valid method.

aib-c01-d3-072@1.title: Safeguard the response when no basis can be found
aib-c01-d3-072@1.prompt: When the AI that guides the eligibility criteria stopped functioning to obtain approved documents, it provided definitive answers based solely on the model’s knowledge. The system wants to keep the reception active, but it cannot send answers that cannot be verified through documents. What is a valid processing method?

A.text: Maintain normal display while stopping, and check with users whether corrections are needed after restoration.
A.explanation: It sends claims without supporting evidence while document retrieval is unavailable.

B.text: By shortening the text, the rationale becomes clearer, so the answer itself is always considered definite.
B.explanation: No basis can be obtained from the length change.

C.text: If a dependency goes down, withhold any definitive guidance and send the user only an acknowledgment of receipt. Hand the case to someone who can verify it and test the behavior again after recovery.
C.explanation: While continuing with the reception, you can avoid meaningless guidance.

D.text: Even if no basis can be referenced, it is likely to send a response that the model has generated in the past.
D.explanation: No match with the requested data.

learning.concept: Detected that there was no basis required even during temporary outages, and did not switch the target service to unverified generation
learning.reason: If no evidence is available, no conclusions are drawn; wait for confirmation or hand over to someone on-site. Test the operation during a failure, and verify that reliable evidence has returned.

aib-c01-d3-073@1.title: To enable users to distinguish confirmed information from unconfirmed suggestions
aib-c01-d3-073@1.prompt: An AI that helps correct addresses displays confirmed current address and estimates for new delivery regions in the same format. The user interpreted the estimate as confirmed. How should the display be improved?

A.text: Display the confirmation status of each value and the next confirmation method, to see if users can differentiate between candidates and confirmed options.
A.explanation: Connects uncertainty to actual actions.

B.text: Present everything as confirmed for consistency, and send a correction notification when needed.
B.explanation: Increases misunderstandings by treating estimates as confirmed.

C.text: Add a general description of the model to the manual, without indicating whether each value on the screen is confirmed.
C.explanation: Unable to distinguish at the user's judgmented location.

D.text: Display only the baseline value for the estimate next to the current address, without indicating which has been actually confirmed.
D.explanation: Cannot understand status or actions from the numbers.

learning.concept: Show users in a way that makes it clear where output is confirmed and where the agent confirms it
learning.reason: Display confirmed information, unconfirmed candidates, and confirmed agents and methods separately. Test the user's understanding of the display.

aib-c01-d3-074@1.title: Design a system that ensures the correction of misleading directions reaches those who need it reliably first
aib-c01-d3-074@1.prompt: Make the AI guidance for payment applications accessible to users even anonymously. If conditions are displayed before the regulation update, it is necessary to avoid collecting additional personal information and allow affected users to confirm corrections. What should be included in the design?

A.text: Make the displayed version and date available for users to verify, and prepare correction information and a verification path to test in advance.
A.explanation: Users can verify their reference information and find the necessary corrections.

B.text: Only the general disclaimer is displayed on the screen, without recording the version or scope of corrections.
B.explanation: I cannot confirm which directions were corrected.

C.text: To ensure access to the explanation, the name and detailed personal records of all users must be required before viewing.
C.explanation: Collect excessive identification information for correction.

D.text: When the issue is found, the old screen is deleted, and no correction path is provided for those who saw its content.
D.explanation: Users who have seen it before cannot notice the error.

learning.concept: Prepare methods for identifying targets to be corrected in design and notifying users, to prevent the inability to track users later on
learning.reason: Show the version of the policy and application date without increasing the collection of personal identification data, and prepare a public accessible history of corrections and verification channels. Test the delivery path for corrections.

aib-c01-d3-075@1.title: When a user reports an error, a person corrects the result
aib-c01-d3-075@1.prompt: The AI classified the application as excluded. The agent can receive inquiries, but has no authority to update the excluded status; it can only return the same result as the re-evaluation by the same AI. What changes are needed under effective supervision?

A.text: Allow all users to update the application status without manual inspection.
A.explanation: Exceeds required permissions, and no basis for correction can be verified.

B.text: Allow only a re-execution of the AI, and if the result remains the same, objections are invalid.
B.explanation: There is a possibility of repeating the same omissions or errors.

C.text: Give the designated agent the authority to recheck evidence, resume and correct the process, and record the judgment basis and notification to the user.
C.explanation: The person's review result can be reflected in the actual procedure.

D.text: The agent only provides reasons, and the application status and subsequent procedures cannot be changed.
D.explanation: Even if the report is valid, the inappropriate state cannot be corrected.

learning.concept: In addition to accepting objections, allow the review agent to recheck existing information and correct the operational status
learning.reason: Let the designated agent investigate the basis, correct the judgment error, and restart the operation. Record the correction and notification.

aib-c01-d3-076@1.title: Determine which path requires recording requirements in business operations
aib-c01-d3-076@1.prompt: Within the company, searches for general guidance do not require recording, but when obtaining consent to contract terms, it is necessary to record the content and time. The same AI interface is planned to handle both tasks. Which approach is most appropriate as a control before public release?

A.text: Handle general guidance and consent through separate paths, confirming the content and time recording during consent and later retrieval.
A.explanation: It ensures that the required evidence for each business task is correctly obtained.

B.text: Record only general guidance in detail, and estimate actual consent from the provider's statistics.
B.explanation: It is impossible to identify the content agreed upon by the individual.

C.text: Since the interface is the same, skip recording for search functions even after reaching consent.
C.explanation: The content and time of consent are not retained.

D.text: If the number of consents per month is recorded, it can be treated as a way to verify individual consent content.
D.explanation: The role of the count and individual evidence is different.

learning.concept: Not only the name of AI functionality, but also the actual business tasks and required records are associated with the usage path
learning.reason: Clearly separate general guidance and consent, and only record necessary items when moving to consent. Test the switch and exceptions.

aib-c01-d3-077@1.title: Restrict the location where output can be sent with approval information
aib-c01-d3-077@1.prompt: AI summarizes sensitive documents and sends them to the designated management portal. The person in charge proposed that the address created by AI based on the entered company name be used directly as the destination. Which design sends the messages only to authorized destinations?

A.text: It simply displays the recipient address clearly, and the sending process is executed by trusting the AI input text.
A.explanation: The processing side cannot prevent sending to unauthorized recipients.

B.text: In the sending processing, compare the destination and permissions of the approved ledger with those in the system; if they do not match, keep it pending and confirm with the responsible person.
B.explanation: Prevents unconditional forwarding to the generated address.

C.text: Only a cancellation function is provided in case the destination is incorrect, and the address is not verified before sending.
C.explanation: It is not guaranteed that all content sent out to external parties can be recovered.

D.text: Since AI can distinguish similar company names, if the output includes an email format, it will be sent.
D.explanation: No permissions for sending in a form, nor existing management portals, can be confirmed.

learning.concept: Do not rely solely on the string generated for email addresses and partners; the service side should enforce approved recipients and roles
learning.reason: Only the results from matching with the authorized delivery records are used for sending. Any discrepancies or changes are sent for verification, and authorization and sending results are recorded.

aib-c01-d3-078@1.title: If one measure is effective, another type of risk may remain.
aib-c01-d3-078@1.prompt: For customer-facing AI, facility guidance has been corrected to refer to the latest version, and incorrect operating hours no longer appear. Meanwhile, the inquiry content includes personal records, and staff without eligibility can also view logs. Which is the update of the review form?

A.text: Using one integrated point, the viewing issues are offset through improvements in accuracy.
A.explanation: The ability to view personal records without permission will not be removed.

B.text: Since the accuracy test was passed, it is recorded that the log viewing permissions have also become less risky.
B.explanation: Accuracy measures do not limit viewers.

C.text: Since the risk of viewing remains, the test records to verify accuracy have also been deleted, and everything has been returned to unexamined status.
C.explanation: Loss of evidence of the effectiveness of the already implemented measures.

D.text: Accuracy management has been confirmed, and access to logs remains a risk that will be evaluated and addressed separately.
D.explanation: It is possible to clearly identify which measures changed which risks.

learning.concept: Assign measures and evidence that work for each risk, and do not classify the entire system as low with a single measure
learning.reason: Separate measures for accuracy of information and measures for information viewing. Even if accuracy improves, the risks related to the viewing range must be evaluated and addressed separately.

aib-c01-d3-079@1.title: Stop the distribution of harmful byproducts from the replication source
aib-c01-d3-079@1.prompt: It has been confirmed that one of the materials created using advertising AI contains content that degrades people with a certain attribute. The same material will be copied to multiple regions, and several pieces are scheduled to be distributed the next morning. After disabling the future generation function, what is the top priority action to take?

A.text: Postpone the response until the next model test, and stop distribution the next morning only if customer requests removal.
A.explanation: There is still a risk of releasing confirmed harmful content first.

B.text: Use the affected material’s version to locate copies and scheduled releases, then pause distribution. Have the responsible person verify what was already published and the evidence of the response.
B.explanation: Stop current distribution, verify the impact, and proceed with necessary corrections.

C.text: Only delete the original generation file; do not check the sharing destinations and reservation list for other regions.
C.explanation: Deleting the original file alone does not remove copies or cancel scheduled distribution.

D.text: Stop only the new generation, and all already approved pre-orders will be carried out as planned.
D.explanation: Problematic materials spread from the reserved route.

learning.concept: Not just stopping the generation, but also tracking saved outputs and scheduled releases to prevent the spread of impact
learning.reason: Compare the distribution recipients and reservations, and cancel the release before the target materials arrive. Protect the necessary evidence and check the already published areas as well.

aib-c01-d3-080@1.title: Check the fluent text in existing result verification
aib-c01-d3-080@1.prompt: An AI system that writes product recall notices uses product revision information from an existing register. The format and quantities were correct in testing, but some notices reversed which revisions were affected and which were excluded. The register already lists the confirmed revisions within scope. What safeguard is needed?

A.text: Make the verification only after automatic sending so that the target can be notified first.
A.explanation: Send notifications for incorrect targets first.

B.text: Only generate natural text notifications and skip verification of which product version is a target.
B.explanation: It is impossible to determine the correctness of the notification target based on the style.

C.text: Confirm the target product version with the confirmed ledger before sending the notification and keep any discrepancies for further verification.
C.explanation: The meaning reversal that cannot be determined by the text format can be detected.

D.text: If the number of notifications is similar to past levels, it is acceptable for targets and non-targets to be swapped.
D.explanation: It is impossible to determine which product version's guidance is incorrect based on the number of notifications.

learning.concept: Even if the AI generation appears correct, compare it with the confirmed numbers or states in business operations before proceeding to the next step
learning.reason: Verify whether the notification targets the correct product version with the confirmed ledger. Keep any discrepancies pending and allow confirmation of which data and result were used.

aib-c01-d4-061@1.title: Verify individual preparation completion reports during the actual handover
aib-c01-d4-061@1.prompt: In the AI-based preparation review for equipment acceptance, all parties involved—site, data team, and approval department—responded that their work was ready. However, no cases close to actual operations were processed throughout the entire process, and it is not confirmed whether delays in integration or a shift to manual handling were reported. What evidence should be obtained before making a public decision?

A.text: After the live start, we will finally determine the contact details of our responsible department and consider the announcement as complete preparations.
A.explanation: Once an exception occurs, responsibility will be determined, which will affect the continuity of existing operations.

B.text: Only remeasure model accuracy and uptime, and exclude handover during data latency.
B.explanation: No verification of inter-departmental operations required for business completion.

C.text: Have the relevant teams rehearse both processing representative cases and switching to the fallback when data is delayed. Check who handles each step, when the handover happens, and the final outcome.
C.explanation: Check for any discrepancies between departments, and verify the success or failure of operations with actual evidence.

D.text: Score each department’s self-reporting, and determine that the average is above a certain level if the handover is also successful.
D.explanation: Even if preparations are in place for each department, they may not work under the required collaboration conditions.

learning.concept: Not just listening to preparations by each department, but checking whether data provision, approval, and exception handling are connected in representative projects
learning.reason: Confirm with relevant departments regarding representative cases and exceptions, and ensure that necessary input, judgment, handover, and alternatives are completed within the time limit.

aib-c01-d4-062@1.title: Verify whether the operation of multiple deployments is a reproducible deployment
aib-c01-d4-062@1.prompt: In the company, six departments' AI systems operate independently in production. Each new department must re-create its own approval, fault handling, and monitoring processes every time it is launched, and the previous responsible person cannot be transferred when it is launched. Which is the most useful evidence for determining the maturity of company-wide deployment?

A.text: Just check if the actual number of screens has doubled in half a year.
A.explanation: The dependence on reproducibility and operation may not have improved.

B.text: Identify the department with the highest utilization rate among the six departments, and use that utilization rate as the company-wide maturity level.
B.explanation: The utilization rate of a deployment does not indicate the ability of other departments to launch independently.

C.text: The subsequent departments will be established using common approval, monitoring, and support mechanisms to prove they can maintain responsibility and quality.
C.explanation: Unlike number of units or people, you can verify the expandable capacity.

D.text: If a new department is opened with continued support from the previous supervisor, the post-leave operation will not be evaluated.
D.explanation: There is a constraint that makes it harder to secure a person to handle tasks the more you expand.

learning.concept: Not only based on the number of deployments, but also by evidence that allows subsequent departments to continue operations under common standards, to determine the maturity stage
learning.reason: It measures whether subsequent departments can use the common infrastructure, support mechanisms, and controls to maintain quality while enabling reproducible deployment.

aib-c01-d4-063@1.title: Find the reason why projects don’t close even with departmental success
aib-c01-d4-063@1.prompt: Three departments are each testing AI-based input, approval, and notification, and each system operates as required. However, the criteria for completion vary by department, resulting in notified cases remaining unfinished. Which capabilities should be enhanced?

A.text: Conduct repeated training to improve generation accuracy across all deployments, and keep the status conditions unchanged.
A.explanation: Problems remain without a common completion status.

B.text: The completion criteria are maintained per department, and the number of stopped cases is not counted.
B.explanation: It is not possible to restore business operations across departments.

C.text: Determine the common status and completion criteria with the department in charge of the entire case, so all departments can confirm the same status.
C.explanation: By establishing appropriate responsibilities and handovers, we can prevent projects from becoming floating.

D.text: Have the department with the highest number of processing tasks complete registrations in bulk without checking the status of other departments.
D.explanation: I cannot confirm whether the required tasks for each case have been completed.

learning.concept: Achieving individual tasks and separating the responsibility for completing all tasks from the lack of a common state
learning.reason: The person responsible for managing the entire project, and defining the common state from start to finish, as well as coordinating handover between departments.

aib-c01-d4-064@1.title: Instead of increasing trials, allocate funds to improving reproducibility
aib-c01-d4-064@1.prompt: In the group companies, nearly identical data search trials have been repeated successfully. However, few departments have moved to actual operation because they had to create measurement methods from scratch for new departments. Which policy is the most effective way to allocate the next budget?

A.text: Add all attempts of the same hypothesis to all departments, and prioritize increasing the number of successful reports.
A.explanation: No common operations or evaluations are established.

B.text: To increase the number of migrations to production, individual quality checks will be abolished.
B.explanation: Doesn’t develop the ability to maintain quality and expand.

C.text: Replace the infrastructure with a high-performance version, and treat it as production even if no operational responsibilities or measurement methods can be determined.
C.explanation: The capabilities of the operations that currently hinder progress remain unchanged.

D.text: Allocate funds for common evaluations and staff development, and measure whether the deployment locations can verify quality using the same procedures for operation.
D.explanation: Supports the ability to delay the migration from testing to production.

learning.concept: At the stage where effects have already been confirmed, invest in common operational capabilities that hinder current maturity
learning.reason: Instead of increasing the number of trials with the same hypothesis, we will improve common evaluation and operations, and use this method to verify the steady operation of representative departments.

aib-c01-d4-065@1.title: To determine the valid version based on the number of documents
aib-c01-d4-065@1.prompt: Create a product warranty guide. The sales department should refer to promotional materials, the legal department to the final version, and support to the old version. I want to search for PDFs from all three departments, but there are different titles and application dates. Which option is appropriate for data preparation?

A.text: Confirm the owner, official version, and application period, and verify the version reference using the ledger and representative warranty guides.
A.explanation: Collect information that can identify the basis for use in operations.

B.text: Assume higher preparation level when there are more search targets, and compare cases where old documents are returned incorrectly later.
B.explanation: Inability to resolve many inconsistent conditions with a large number of documents.

C.text: Automatically adopt the document with the latest creation date and month, without checking official approval or validity dates.
C.explanation: Even if created recently, it may not be approved or potentially applicable in the future.

D.text: Import all files and consider the first matching title as the current version.
D.explanation: It is impossible to distinguish conditions and deadlines between documents with the same title.

learning.concept: Compare the version and validity period of documents held by other departments, and verify whether they are ready as a basis for use
learning.reason: Confirm the official owner and application period of documents, and gather information that allows distinction between current versions and required history. Compare the correct period and document using representative examples.

aib-c01-d4-066@1.title: To establish approval for using shared data for a new purpose
aib-c01-d4-066@1.prompt: The three departments managing the facility share the maintenance records. Under the original agreement, use is limited to accident investigation support. The new department also wants to use it for staff performance evaluations. Which approach is appropriate as a strategy for shared data?

A.text: Remove only the user names, allowing use regardless of the original purpose of sharing.
A.explanation: Removing names does not change the restrictions on use.

B.text: Keep the existing agreement and take copies of all data for each evaluator for individual management.
B.explanation: It is impossible to manage the permission and sharing scope for the new purpose.

C.text: Since it can be viewed on the shared platform, treat it as unconditional reuse for any task.
C.explanation: It is used beyond the permitted purpose.

D.text: Review the conditions for compatibility and reuse with administrators and the new purpose, and record permissions and responsibilities by purpose.
D.explanation: The permitted sharing scope can be compared with the new task.

learning.concept: Separate the ability to access from usability in tasks, and agree on purposes and scope between providers
learning.reason: Review the purpose, required items, and usage conditions of data management and the new purpose. Share only the permitted scope to distinguish it from previous access.

aib-c01-d4-067@1.title: First, evaluate the foundational conditions required for future tracking
aib-c01-d4-067@1.prompt: Choose the foundation for consulting AI. For each inquiry, the responsible person needs to check the model and version used later and determine which business process it was assigned to. Although a operation monitor is listed in the feature list, whether such integration is possible has not been confirmed. Which foundation evaluation is appropriate?

A.text: Just verify whether the breakdown can be seen on the administrator’s screen, and record the version of the regulations after publication.
A.explanation: Evidence that meets the requirements has not been checked during foundation selection.

B.text: In a representative case study, perform exercises by tracing from the inquiry ID to the model, regulations, and processing destination, and verify both viewing and storage.
B.explanation: It is possible to determine whether the requirements can be met in actual operation.

C.text: If the number of inference uses can be displayed, the origin of each case can also be determined later.
C.explanation: The aggregated number does not show individual configurations or business results.

D.text: Save only the full text of the user, without retaining the used version or processing responsible person.
D.explanation: It is not possible to reproduce what was used in business decisions.

learning.concept: Verify whether data such as integration, configuration, reference data, and business results can be linked together in addition to the model
learning.reason: In a representative inquiry, test whether necessary versions and actions from each processing stage can be linked via reference ID. Also confirm permissions for records and storage conditions.

aib-c01-d4-068@1.title: Link on-site achievements from the promotion role to management decisions
aib-c01-d4-068@1.prompt: From the AI promotion team across the company, multiple issues are raised monthly, but the management meeting approves the next steps based solely on the number of users. There are still quality issues in two departments. Which operational aspect should the sponsor first change?

A.text: If the number of users increases, the promotion reports should focus solely on collecting good examples after publication.
A.explanation: Quality and inhibitory factors fail to influence the funding decision.

B.text: Integrate the quality and effectiveness performance from implementation roles into decision-making, and management will define targets and timelines to review the deployment conditions.
B.explanation: Instead of leaving the cause entirely to the scene, management authority can make decisions on support and expansion.

C.text: Assign expansion to each actuator under different quality conditions, and then sum them up in one table.
C.explanation: It is not possible to compare deployment outcomes and constraints under the same criteria.

D.text: Management only reports on performance, and does not assign responsibility for issues shared by multiple departments.
D.explanation: The necessary decisions for adjustment are not made.

learning.concept: Allow management to make decisions and outcomes, and enable frontline staff to report actual improvements and barriers to action
learning.reason: Sponsors decide on investment based on usage numbers, business outcomes, and quality. Despite obstacles from promoting parties, they determine the necessary support and responsibilities and deliver results.

aib-c01-d4-069@1.title: Determine the responsibility for accepting handover between the development and operations sides.
aib-c01-d4-069@1.prompt: Equipment consultation: The team that developed AI will move to a different project next month. The maintenance side is responsible for quality and exceptions after operation, but they have not seen the reasons for the trial decisions or recovery procedures. What is required for the cross-team transition?

A.text: Development shares the standards and reproduction procedures, while operation practices simulate exceptions and restores operations. Both parties determine whether the handover is approved and who will remain responsible.
A.explanation: Knowledge is transferred, and the response capabilities for the next operation can be confirmed.

B.text: Only send the documents from the development department for transfer, and whether it can be restored in practice will be confirmed by the operations side after the release.
B.explanation: Doesn’t verify the capabilities required before migration.

C.text: If the operation side sets up a duty, the settings, quality assessment, and return destination information will remain saved in the development department.
C.explanation: The operations team cannot reach the necessary basis when responding.

D.text: To eliminate friction in handover, the development management authority is directly given to everyone, and no responsibilities are fixed.
D.explanation: Responsibilities and minimal permissions become ambiguous.

learning.concept: The technical side provides the steps and change details, and the operations side jointly verifies whether they can handle them.
learning.reason: Development provides the reproduction steps and criteria for approval or rejection, while operation practices and recovery procedures are tested and accepted. The remaining matters involve determining the responsible party and deadline.

aib-c01-d4-070@1.title: Inform staff about what the AI usage records are used for
aib-c01-d4-070@1.prompt: To improve the AI tool, a company logs user actions and errors. Staff worry that what they say will routinely feed into their performance evaluations. Company policy limits who can view the logs and how they can be used and prohibits their use in personnel evaluations. What should the company explain to staff?

A.text: Do not inform of the existence of the record; only convey the improvement results after implementation.
A.explanation: It omits the explanation users need to understand and trust how usage records are handled.

B.text: To eliminate concerns, it is stated that there are no error records at all.
B.explanation: The actual usage status does not match the explanation.

C.text: Only the term "improvement objective" is notified; what can be viewed is decided later at the administrator's request.
C.explanation: Questions regarding the scope of collection and access remain unresolved.

D.text: Explain what is logged, why, who can access the records, and how long they are retained. Explain the policy that bars using these records for personnel evaluations and tell staff whom to contact with questions.
D.explanation: It can clarify actual handling and reduce discrepancies from assumptions.

learning.concept: Explain the purposes of use and areas not used, as well as viewing and inquiries, to reduce misunderstandings
learning.reason: State the items to be collected, purpose, access and storage, and conditions under which they will not be used for other purposes. Also indicate the channels for reporting concerns or requests for corrections.

aib-c01-d4-071@1.title: To see if the preference for counting awards does not lead to an undesired usage pattern
aib-c01-d4-071@1.prompt: The department began rewarding AI operations count, and staff started using it for tasks that are not suitable for AI. Those who reported errors had less time to stop using it, resulting in lower rankings. Which intervention helps establish responsible usage?

A.text: Reconsider the count competition and evaluate quality, appropriate use, and error reporting. Managers are supported in making stop decisions.
A.explanation: The organization can encourage desired business behaviors and outcomes.

B.text: Eliminate all usage records and remove metrics for quality and suitability of targets.
B.explanation: It is impossible to verify responsible usage and improvement.

C.text: Individually reprimand those who use the tool in a dangerous way, while continuing the count competition.
C.explanation: The incentives for behavior caused by organizational evaluation are not changed.

D.text: Increase further usage targets, and treat error reports as personal additional work without time measurement.
D.explanation: Motivation to hide issues by prioritizing counts increases.

learning.concept: When the practice of competing on usage amounts hinders careful use, revise evaluation criteria and manager responses
learning.reason: Evaluate not only rewards based on operation counts but also appropriate use selection, quality, and improvement from errors. Managers support stops.

aib-c01-d4-072@1.title: Don’t limit the training to just one instance, instead adapt it to changes
aib-c01-d4-072@1.prompt: All personnel completed the initial training upon implementation. Afterwards, the documents that can be submitted and the handover procedures for users when AI holds results back changed. The field team is still practicing with the old version of the procedures. What is the appropriate training strategy?

A.text: Since the initial training is complete, no new conditions will be trained on until the next year, and no impact will be measured.
A.explanation: It is not possible to confirm whether the new decisions can be made.

B.text: Use the modified document conditions and handover examples to conduct another training session with the team member, and confirm whether they can execute the new procedure.
B.explanation: It is possible to evaluate whether the actual changes match the required skills and abilities.

C.text: The new procedure is only notified to administrators, and users continue with the old version of processing.
C.explanation: Errors remain in the proposal and handover.

D.text: All basic lectures are taken again with the same content, and only the number of terms learned is measured.
D.explanation: Don’t practice the updated practical differences.

learning.concept: Confirm the latest procedures required for the role through practice, and update the knowledge of staff whose operating conditions have changed
learning.reason: Ensure staff using the updated procedures can implement the authorization scope and handover in real examples after the update. Identify those who haven’t mastered it and provide additional support.

aib-c01-d4-073@1.title: Efficiently streamline preparation with AI, allowing humans to handle negotiations and decisions
aib-c01-d4-073@1.prompt: In procurement, a lot of time is spent organizing past prices and contract terms. For contract renewals, there is work involved in negotiating conditions with external parties and determining priorities for non-negotiable points. Which is the appropriate way to divide tasks after introducing AI?

A.text: Rank all contracts based solely on future prices, so the responsible person cannot verify other conditions.
A.explanation: Cannot handle the conditions to be adjusted through negotiation.

B.text: Have AI prepare comparison materials, and the responsible person will review them to conduct negotiations and make a final decision.
B.explanation: Efficiently prepare templates and retain human interaction and discretion.

C.text: People collect all the documents, and AI negotiates with the other party to finalize the contract.
C.explanation: Keep the labor-intensive routine tasks, and transfer important decisions to machines.

D.text: Evaluate the time spent using AI, but do not assign responsibilities for negotiations with clients or outcomes.
D.explanation: There is no redesign of actual work.

learning.concept: The sorting of options is supported by AI, and people are assigned to the role of understanding conflicting conditions and reaching an agreement
learning.reason: AI organizes approved records. The responsible person verifies the reasons, listens to the other party’s situation, and negotiates and approves the conditions.

aib-c01-d4-074@1.title: Even after the accuracy verification is completed, we will test the operational hypothesis
aib-c01-d4-074@1.prompt: The document classification was successful in past tasks, but it has not been confirmed whether the person responsible for the next step can quickly determine the priority based on the AI output. The company is introducing it to reduce reception time. Which is the next step?

A.text: The person in charge tries limiting the scope of where the classification results are used, measures time and the accuracy of the judgment, and decides on the next step.
A.explanation: Verify the deployment hypothesis before proceeding safely to the next step.

B.text: Just because the technical accuracy rate is passed, we move on to production; the time taken by the responsible person for judgment is measured later.
B.explanation: The capabilities intended by the project have not been confirmed.

C.text: No practical trials are conducted; the development department predicts the processing time and reports it as a reduction.
C.explanation: The required time for the work and business quality cannot be confirmed.

D.text: Remove the actual responsible person from the trial, and use only increasing the existing classification data as the new verification.
D.explanation: It is impossible to measure whether the representation helps with decision-making.

learning.concept: In the experiment, the technical hypothesis and operational hypothesis were tested separately, and after gathering sufficient evidence, the next step was chosen.
learning.reason: Record the technical success, and test display, judgment time, and quality in a near-real-world operation environment. Based on those results, select the public release conditions.

aib-c01-d4-075@1.title: Among the short-term outcomes, make features available to multiple departments as a common offering
aib-c01-d4-075@1.prompt: A department achieved short-term results through a system that separates signed documents from drafts. While the approval process for other departments is different, distinguishing documents is still necessary. What is the way to continue expanding?

A.text: Make the confirmed categories a common feature with clear versions and owners, and test the connection with approval from various departments as well as on-site quality.
A.explanation: While leveraging short-term results across multiple departments, core operations can be maintained.

B.text: Each deployment only includes the results obtained in the documentation, and the same categories are created individually by each person.
B.explanation: No maintenance of common features or reuse of learned knowledge is possible.

C.text: Transfer all approval procedures for successful departments to other departments, replacing existing responsibilities and processes uniformly.
C.explanation: Changing the business operations beyond what can be reused.

D.text: Without defining the functions and responsible persons, all departments ask the first person in charge to handle everything each time.
D.explanation: The same person is needed every time it is deployed.

learning.concept: Provide proven common features in a condition-based and maintenance-responsible format, separating them from department-specific operations
learning.reason: Provide proven classification as a common feature, and clarify the responsibilities for version, quality, and support. Each department maintains its own approval process to verify connections.

aib-c01-d4-076@1.title: To identify exceptions at the field level that cannot be addressed according to common operating standards
aib-c01-d4-076@1.prompt: The AI specialist organization established a company-wide trial procedure. Recently, three departments using the same data equipment reported exceptions stating that standard tests alone cannot verify important formats. What should the specialist organization do?

A.text: Accept all exceptions permanently and never update the original standards or history of responses.
A.explanation: The unified conditions become ineffective, and similar exceptions continue to occur.

B.text: Prioritize the description of common standards and do not investigate which conditions prevent proper testing.
B.explanation: The state where necessary quality for practical use cannot be evaluated remains.

C.text: Verify the quality required by exceptions and return the results to common standards. Make reproducible tests available to other departments as well.
C.explanation: Integrate field constraints while maintaining common standards and enabling improvement.

D.text: Take the evaluation task away from the department that submitted the exception and declare that the results are correct solely by the specialist organization.
D.explanation: Do not verify the equipment conditions and eligibility at the field level.

learning.concept: The specialist organization handles exceptions and incorporates issues common to multiple departments into standard improvements
learning.reason: Handle the basis, safety measures, and deadlines of exceptions individually, and evaluate whether recurring issues can be reflected in common tests or application conditions

aib-c01-d4-077@1.title: When Business Priorities Change, Re-evaluate the Evaluation
aib-c01-d4-077@1.prompt: The initial goal of AI support was to reduce processing time. The following year, it became important to reduce inquiries that do not progress to formal procedures; time-based metrics cannot explain the value at the field level. What is a way to improve operations?

A.text: Do not start measuring the new metric until time reduction stops.
A.explanation: It takes longer to identify new business challenges.

B.text: To simplify forms, discard past time records and apply only the number of completions to previous results.
B.explanation: It is impossible to distinguish between the trend of the old goal and the change in new results.

C.text: Maintain the existing time reduction trend, add completion rate and reasons for abandonment, and evaluate the conditions of continuation together with field feedback.
C.explanation: Both the changed strategy and the desired operational results can be observed.

D.text: Set the most improved metric as the top priority each month, and do not record changes or reasons.
D.explanation: It is impossible to track stable long-term value.

learning.concept: Keep the initial measurements while clearly stating new business goals and revised metrics to determine continuation
learning.reason: Maintain time metrics for comparison with the past, define new metrics related to completion and abandonment. Combine with field reports to understand which goals have improved.

aib-c01-d4-078@1.title: Do not move the prototype exception to official operation
aib-c01-d4-078@1.prompt: In the AI prototype, it was a temporary setting where a small team could view all samples. In production, each person should only see the tasks assigned to their department. The accuracy of the prototype was satisfactory. Choose two conditions for acceptance in production.

A.text: Use the minimum permissions required in production and verify that authorized cases and cases from other departments are handled according to the specification.
A.explanation: We can verify whether the official access works before it goes live.

B.text: Since the trial found no issues, transfer permission to see all exception cases to the permanent assignee.
B.explanation: In production, this violates the required restrictions per department.

C.text: Change it to a different color than the trial interface, and do not require the same access settings as before.
C.explanation: Permissions cannot be changed due to differences in the screen.

D.text: Stop the exception usage paths and determine the department responsible for formal permission assignment, changes, and audits.
D.explanation: No temporary permissions remain, and operations can continue under this responsibility.

E.text: Direct the model to “not look at other departments,” and proceed to production without adding permission restrictions on the actual data side.
E.explanation: The restrictions that should be enforced depend on text generation.

learning.concept: Inventory the temporary access and data handling for experiments, and replace them with formal permissions and operations
learning.reason: Replace with formal permissions, and try obtaining approval and rejection from departments in a test environment. Remove experimental exceptions and define the responsibility and review for formal access.

aib-c01-d4-079@1.title: To enable continuity of unresolved issues across regions
aib-c01-d4-079@1.prompt: AI is shared among three regions, and the support for one existing region is only available during the day. The processing speed during testing is normal, but issues occurring at another region at night are left unresolved until the next day. What should be addressed before expanding to all regions?

A.text: Keep the handling history separate in each region, and do not share unresolved issues with other regions.
A.explanation: The responsibility for judgment and response is interrupted during shift changes.

B.text: Standardize incident reception during outages, and determine who will respond only after the existing region is in daylight.
B.explanation: Some regions cannot resolve issues within the required time.

C.text: If the same interface is accessible worldwide, it is assumed that the response deadlines for all regions are met.
C.explanation: Technical availability and actual support hours may differ.

D.text: Define shifts and handovers to meet the deadlines of each region, and test whether the status and responsibility are transferred to the next time period.
D.explanation: Even when expanded to all regions, operational continuity can be verified.

learning.concept: In expanding common services, design not only operation but also support hours, responsibilities, and transfer of unresolved cases
learning.reason: Confirm regional business hours and response deadlines, and establish a support system where responsibilities are not interrupted. Practice handovers across time zones and activation of alternatives.

aib-c01-d4-080@1.title: Do not confuse the data that has been verified with the actual recorded data
aib-c01-d4-080@1.prompt: Share the inquiry records across multiple departments. In the future, in addition to the classifications determined by the responsible person, the classifications temporarily generated by AI will also be saved in the same field. Other departments will retrieve the correct answers for the next model from this field. Which of the following is a required rule for sharing?

A.text: The input side does not record whether it has been verified, and other departments infer the accuracy of all records later.
A.explanation: Lose information related to data creation and judgment at the necessary time.

B.text: Separate the origin of values and verification status, and specify in the sharing specification that the use of teacher data is limited to the range that has been verified by the responsible person.
B.explanation: Users can select records that can be used as correct answers according to their needs.

C.text: If the text of the record is the same, use it as a correct answer for teacher data regardless of the inputer or verification status.
C.explanation: Unverified predictions become the correct answers for the next model, taking over the errors.

D.text: Remove only some examples determined by AI, and do not share which field can be used with other departments.
D.explanation: Cannot continue to manage the meaning and verification status of shared use.

learning.concept: A framework for shared use that clarifies the original data, values from AI, verification status, and usable purposes
learning.reason: Record the verification by the original responsible person and the temporary output of AI as separate states. The owner defines the usable purposes and adheres to the verified conditions for use in teacher data.

aib-c01-d1-085@1.title: Check if the prediction range can be used in personnel planning
aib-c01-d1-085@1.prompt: Every day, the service counter’s demand model gives a forecast of next-day visitor counts and an 80% prediction interval. Staff want to use the interval to decide how many extra people to assign. Which evaluation shows whether the interval is useful?

A.text: If performance falls outside the range for even one day, it is determined that 80% of the range is meaningless.
A.explanation: 80% range does not assume all days are included.

B.text: Only measure the absolute difference between the forecast value and the average actual value; do not consider the range.
B.explanation: From no precision at all, we don’t know the proportion that falls within the range.

C.text: On representative days, measure the percentage of actual visitor counts that fall inside the prediction interval and measure the interval’s width. Check whether it is useful for staffing on busy days.
C.explanation: It can evaluate the range for matching with actual performance and for decision-making.

D.text: Expand the range to include all days, and do not interpret which days require personnel.
D.explanation: It only covers the scope; it does not address whether the extent is useful for the plan.

learning.concept: In addition to a slight error, verify the proportion within the prediction range and required width using actual data.
learning.reason: On representative days, measure how often the actual visitor count falls in the prediction interval. An interval can be too wide for staffing decisions, so check its width and how it varies across conditions.

aib-c01-d1-086@1.title: Choose the feature that arranges recommendations from existing options
aib-c01-d1-086@1.prompt: The enterprise-specific learning portal should propose the order of existing courses that learners can take, tailored to their experience. The content and requirements for taking the courses must not be changed. There is no need to generate unavailable courses either. What is the most appropriate approach?

A.text: Based on the desired content, freely generate the title of the new course and display it as if it exists on the portal.
A.explanation: Does not meet the condition of returning only the courses that are available.

B.text: Without knowing the available courses, only those with the highest number of courses offered are sent to everyone.
B.explanation: Ignores the participants' experience and enrollment requirements.

C.text: Extract the courses that can be taken, arrange them in order matching experience and learning outcomes, and return the actual course IDs.
C.explanation: The goal is the ranking of approved candidates, and no fake courses will be created.

D.text: Classify which courses existed first by date, and prioritize older ones for learning.
D.explanation: The creation date does not indicate suitability for the participants.

learning.concept: Assigning relative priority to existing candidates and separating the generation of new content
learning.reason: Restrict candidates based on approval criteria, and rank them based on fit with experience and outcomes. If necessary, only generate a description for the display.

aib-c01-d1-087@1.title: Do not determine the service target region based solely on the address string
aib-c01-d1-087@1.prompt: The inspection service allows visits within the same postal code, but the range varies depending on the road. There are registered address strings and map data that represent the official service boundaries. Which data processing step determines whether an object is relevant before AI generates an explanation?

A.text: Just based on the proportion of past visitors, and if the actual boundaries are updated, the previous targets will still be maintained.
A.explanation: It may not align with the official scope.

B.text: Convert to a location where the address can be verified and match with the official boundary; if the location cannot be identified, request verification.
B.explanation: The variation in address notation can be separated from the operational geographical conditions.

C.text: Classify by the first word of the address and postal code, ignoring differences based on roads.
C.explanation: Cannot handle conditions where approval changes within the same postal code.

D.text: Summarize the map display image into text; if the address matches the description, it is confirmed as the target.
D.explanation: Cannot verify the boundaries and target locations of the domain.

learning.concept: Separate the notation of addresses and the coordinate data that allows for comparison of area boundaries.
learning.reason: Convert to a location where the address can be matched, and compare under the same coordinate conditions as the verified boundary. If the location is ambiguous, reserve confirmation for later.

aib-c01-d1-088@1.title: Distinguishing recorded completion from actual resolution for learning
aib-c01-d1-088@1.prompt: I want to determine the likelihood of resolution through AI inquiry. The 'completion' in the ledger applies not only when a customer resolves the issue but also when the user leaves without waiting for a response. While the prediction of completion is accurate, it is unclear whether it helps improve the service. How should I change the preparation for learning?

A.text: After predicting completion, convert the regression output into a long explanation and consider it as a resolution.
A.explanation: Changing the output format does not alter the teacher's meaning.

B.text: Distinguish resolution, abandonment, and indeterminate states using independent criteria, and prepare an evaluation based on resolution as the teacher.
B.explanation: It can be aligned with the outcome of the task aimed at obtaining learning objectives.

C.text: Since the completion record is clear, treat all cases as the user's resolution.
C.explanation: Cases where users left are also learned as successes.

D.text: Since the accuracy of the completion prediction remains, no additional resolution records are needed.
D.explanation: The predicted target and the desired service outcome do not match.

learning.concept: Use a definite result representing business objectives as the teacher, rather than an easy-to-measure proxy value
learning.reason: Administrative completion is not the same as actual resolution. Use results confirming resolution or independent matched cases as teacher data to distinguish them from abandonment.

aib-c01-d1-089@1.title: Comparing agent reports with actual operation results
aib-c01-d1-089@1.prompt: In a test inventory ledger, an agent performs the procedure to return borrowed items. The response states 'return completed', but it is possible that another item's status was updated during execution. Which evaluation is used to determine whether the agent can be used for work?

A.text: Only check if the response is exactly 'return completed', and do not score any changes in the ledger.
A.explanation: Even if the text is correct, it cannot be said that no other item was updated.

B.text: If the total number of returned items increases by one, do not verify individual items.
B.explanation: Even if the total matches, it is not guaranteed that the items are correct.

C.text: Measure the number of operations performed by the agent; the fewer, the better, indicating accurate handling.
C.explanation: Even a small number of operations can affect the wrong item.

D.text: Compare the operation history with the final ledger to verify that the specified item has been returned and no unrelated items have been changed.
D.explanation: The intended result can be distinguished from unauthorized side effects.

learning.concept: Since the agent selects multiple operations, verify the correctness of the conversation separately from the final status and side effects of the ledger
learning.reason: Only the response does not reveal the target and final result. Compare the executed processes, targets, intended results, and any changes to the test ledger.

aib-c01-d1-090@1.title: Do not judge based solely on the number of cases when the task using the model changes
aib-c01-d1-090@1.prompt: The product code extraction AI was used in repair forms that met the criteria. Recently, the person in charge has started using fewer-character attached photos as well, resulting in a lower overall accuracy rate. What should be done to investigate the cause while maintaining the operation for repair forms?

A.text: Compare performance and case numbers by separating repair forms from photos, and determine the additional paths or tests required for unexpected photos.
A.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between existing quality and non-targeted usage and address them accordingly.

B.text: Delete the photo records until the number of cases returns to the same level as before, and report that there has been no decline.
B.explanation: Hide the actual increased usage and errors.

C.text: If the response time of the AI is fast, even without checking the accuracy rate, it can be used for photos.
C.explanation: Short time does not guarantee the correctness of the extraction values.

D.text: Since the overall accuracy rate has decreased, create a new model for the traditional repair forms without investigating the purpose.
D.explanation: It is unclear whether quality degradation also occurs in traditional usage.

learning.concept: Due to changes in allocation to new uses, the simple average shifts; thus, quality is separated between the original and new uses
learning.reason: Measure the number of cases and quality for each input path, and determine whether existing uses have deteriorated or unexpected usage has added. Based on this, update the usage range and evaluation.

aib-c01-d1-091@1.title: Try a stable output format with a small number of examples
aib-c01-d1-091@1.prompt: The internal AI can correctly extract the approved values, but the order of items does not match the unique delivery specifications. There are only a few correct input/output examples, and no new business knowledge needs to be incorporated. Choose two appropriate measures.

A.text: Test a field configuration that was not shown in the prompt examples. Check that both the field order and the values match the specification.
A.explanation: It checks whether the model can apply the format to new cases beyond the examples it saw.

B.text: Add the sequencing rules and a few examples of correct input/output to the prompt.
B.explanation: The desired format can be transferred to the existing model.

C.text: Assuming the recipient rerecords the displayed order each time, format differences are not recorded.
C.explanation: There are still returns due to differences in specifications.

D.text: To update the learned weights, a large number of copies of several examples are created, and the success/failure is also determined using the same examples.
D.explanation: No diverse examples or independent performance validation.

E.text: Add a large number of documents with unchanged content via search until the order of the project is fixed.
E.explanation: Even if the amount of reference data increases, the desired writing style remains unclear.

learning.concept: When the goal is a stable output method with few examples, specify the format using a few examples before adjustment learning.
learning.reason: Specify the format and provide a few representative examples, then automatically check the format on a separate set of evaluation examples. A small set of examples does not warrant adjusting model weights immediately.

aib-c01-d1-092@1.title: Doesn’t display the ranking score as a probability
aib-c01-d1-092@1.prompt: The sales case ranking model assigns priorities from 0 to 100. Validation is performed in the order of the top 10 cases, and the meaning of probability has not been confirmed. The 담ster wants to display “Priority 75 means a 75% chance of closing a deal this month.” Which is the appropriate explanation?

A.text: Priority is used only for ranking, and to display as a probability, its validity must be verified separately based on the period and performance.
A.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between properties that can be verified and those that require additional verification.

B.text: Since it falls within the range of 0〜100, priority 75 is set directly to 75% of this month's deal probability.
B.explanation: The numerical range does not guarantee the meaning of the output.

C.text: By subtracting the average value of all cases from the priority, the resulting value is the actual contract completion probability.
C.explanation: The conversion based on averages and the incidence rate of actual occurrences are not related.

D.text: If the top 10 rankings match, all scores for all cases are also assumed to have correct probabilities.
D.explanation: Even if the ranking is correct, individual probabilities can deviate.

learning.concept: The output designed for ranking can be treated as a probability only when there is evidence it can be converted into individual occurrence rates
learning.reason: The values used to assign rankings cannot be directly converted to probabilities. To use them as probabilities, a defined period must be established, and it must be evaluated whether the performance matches the group of cases with the same value.

aib-c01-d1-093@1.title: A translation that cannot be achieved just by transcribing the audio requires careful selection
aib-c01-d1-093@1.prompt: We want to create a Japanese record from the audio received in a foreign language, without omitting any numbers or dates. The transcription of the original language can already be done accurately. Which AI feature is most necessary next?

A.text: Translate the correct transcription into Japanese while preserving the meaning, and verify the consistency of numbers, dates, and negations.
A.explanation: Both Japanese records and necessary information can be verified.

B.text: Convert the original exchange into a summary in Japanese, and you can freely choose the numbers and dates to include.
B.explanation: Required details may be omitted.

C.text: Make the translation of characters in the original language faster, and do not evaluate whether Japanese can be read.
C.explanation: Even when texted, it cannot be converted to the desired language.

D.text: Classify audio as emergency and normal, and consider the classification names as Japanese records.
D.explanation: Cannot save the content of the speech.

learning.concept: Texting, translation, and summarization distinguish the subjects each changes, and evaluate the necessary information
learning.reason: Use a translation that preserves the meaning of the original language, and verify that important meanings in business such as numbers, dates, and negations remain unchanged.

aib-c01-d1-094@1.title: Do not count orders and invoices as the same analysis unit
aib-c01-d1-094@1.prompt: Predict the number of returns per order. There is one line per order in the order header, and more than one line per order in the product details. Simply counting lines resulted in repeated counts for orders with a large number of products. Which data preparation is appropriate?

A.text: The order header and details are linked only by column names, without matching via order ID.
A.explanation: Unable to verify the match between information and target order.

B.text: Issue a different order ID for each combined row, and use the total of the rows as the actual number of orders.
B.explanation: A problem remains where one order results in multiple observations.

C.text: To condense the details to one line, only the products with higher amounts are retained from each order, and the reasons for selection are not recorded.
C.explanation: Unnecessary information about usable product configurations is discarded, and the aggregation format is also unclear.

D.text: The details are aggregated per order, and the count is verified to ensure each order corresponds to one observation.
D.explanation: It allows maintaining the prediction units while using breakdowns.

learning.concept: Recognizing a one-to-many structure, and separating the number of units to be predicted from detailed information aggregation
learning.reason: Explicitly indicate the units for predictions, and consolidate details per order. Compare the number of orders with the total items to avoid double counting.

aib-c01-d1-095@1.title: Don’t turn the time difference from the local time into errors in daily data
aib-c01-d1-095@1.prompt: The shipment predictions are learned based on the operating days of each warehouse. Each warehouse stores the local time, and the difference from UTC is also recorded for input. However, currently, the time difference is ignored, and all items are aggregated only by date. Which data quality measures are appropriate?

A.text: Use the date of the head office across all warehouses, and also put items after the closing time of each warehouse into the same day.
A.explanation: The operating days for each target warehouse will change.

B.text: Add 12 hours uniformly to every warehouse, and only count the items with changed dates.
B.explanation: Cannot reflect the time differences and actual closing times per warehouse.

C.text: Align the time points based on the record offset, determine business days along with each warehouse closure, and compare boundary cases.
C.explanation: Can properly handle both real events and business-time constraints.

D.text: Format all time numbers identically and remove timezone information.
D.explanation: Even when the formatting is consistent, we cannot compare the points in time where the same event occurred.

learning.concept: Align the recording time and business day definitions to correctly aggregate events on the same day
learning.reason: Keep the original time and offset, synchronize the timestamps, and assign them to business days according to the closing time set in the warehouse. Verify the boundary example.

aib-c01-d1-096@1.title: Do not use individual results as labels for the organization's aggregation
aib-c01-d1-096@1.prompt: The training company wants to predict the likelihood that each participant will redo the assignment. The available history only shows the re-submission rate for each course, but it doesn’t tell us who did the re-submissions. What kind of learning decision can be made using this?

A.text: In courses where the retake rate exceeds half, all participants are considered to have retaken, and internal differences are not taken into account.
A.explanation: Treating the group frequency as an individual fact.

B.text: Prepare a history that can be linked to individual results. If only aggregation can be used, the predictions at the course level should be evaluated separately.
B.explanation: Align the learning targets with the granularity of the actual correct answers that can be verified.

C.text: Record the re-submission rate of the courses as individual results for all participants, and measure accuracy by the consistency with these values.
C.explanation: There is no correct answer as to whether the individual submitted it again.

D.text: By increasing individual attributes, it is believed that even without a correct answer, the individual’s re-submission rate can be verified.
D.explanation: Even with more input, the correct comparison results cannot be obtained.

learning.concept: Check whether the correct answers in the history exist at the granularity required for business operations, and do not apply the aggregation results to individuals
learning.reason: The proportion of courses cannot be treated as individual results. Provide data that allows for comparison of individual results, or change the use of course units to those that can be evaluated through aggregation.

aib-c01-d1-097@1.title: Automate only the parts where the judgment conditions can be fixed.
aib-c01-d1-097@1.prompt: In the return process, checking the purchase date and calculating the deadline can be carried out according to established rules. Even if the deadline has passed, only in cases where delivery is halted due to disasters will the responsible person verify the evidence and make a decision on exceptions. Which method is appropriate?

A.text: Have the AI learn how earlier exceptions were handled. Even when it cannot retrieve the purchase date, have it guess whether the request is within the time limit and finalize the decision.
A.explanation: Constraints are determined with insufficient facts.

B.text: The deadline is determined by the calculated time, and exceptions due to disasters must be sent to the responsible person with supporting evidence.
B.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between tasks that can be processed definitively and those judged by people.

C.text: Applications that have passed the deadline will all be terminated in the same way, regardless of any exceptions in the regulations.
C.explanation: Does not handle exceptions that should be checked.

D.text: To reduce the burden on the personnel, the calculation and negotiation of dates are also entrusted to a single exception judgment model.
D.explanation: It’s impossible to distinguish between established rules and discretionary management.

learning.concept: Separate the accuracy of predictions required by business operations from the arithmetic rules that must be strictly followed and human judgment.
learning.reason: Date inquiries and deadline calculations are performed as a default process, and even if the results are not applicable, no exceptions are automatically inferred; they are forwarded to the authorized person.

aib-c01-d1-098@1.title: Even when dividing long regulations into sections, do not separate clauses from exceptions
aib-c01-d1-098@1.prompt: Split the long policy, including return conditions, into sections up to a maximum length. If separated only by headings, even if the main rule is obtained, the exception section is not obtained immediately, leading to incorrect guidance. The entire text cannot be entered at once. Choose 2 solutions.

A.text: If a sentence fits this rule, answer without checking other sections.
A.explanation: Incorrectly guides the normal conditions in cases where there are target exceptions.

B.text: The exception clause is condensed into a single sentence common to all cases, and no record is kept of which cases are excluded from the rule application.
B.explanation: It becomes impossible to determine under which conditions the exception applies.

C.text: Link the rule and exceptions it applies to, so they can be obtained as a set needed for the question.
C.explanation: No need to include the entire long regulation; only the sections needed for decision-making can be processed together.

D.text: Provide examples where the result changes depending on the rule or exception, and evaluate whether both justifications are obtained to reach the correct conclusion.
D.explanation: We can verify improvements in splitting and transfer through actual judgment.

E.text: Stop splitting, and if the full text sent each time exceeds the limit, cut off the last part unconditionally.
E.explanation: It is not guaranteed that necessary exceptions or references to separate sections will remain.

learning.concept: When breaking down, keep the subsequent conditions and reference sections under the same evaluation unit
learning.reason: Link the exceptions and their applicable rules together, group them into separate sections, and include the necessary scope together. For cases where exceptions are used, verify the results and rationale.

aib-c01-d1-099@1.title: Distinguish between non-applicable blanks and forgotten entries
aib-c01-d1-099@1.prompt: In the repair intake records, only requests covered by warranty require a warranty number. A validation rule marked every blank field as defective data, so many valid out-of-warranty requests were deleted. What is the most appropriate improvement?

A.text: Remove the guarantee number column, and do not evaluate whether necessary information has been obtained within the target.
A.explanation: The absence of data needed for operations becomes invisible.

B.text: All empty rows are removed, and the remaining items under guarantee are used to estimate overall performance.
B.explanation: Since non-target requests are also handled in operations, representativeness is lost.

C.text: Fill in the blank with the latest guarantee number uniformly, and the number of items with a number is considered quality.
C.explanation: Assigning incorrect numbers to multiple projects, including non-matches.

D.text: Record as non-applicable and missing depending on whether it is covered by the guarantee, and identify cases where no required numbers exist.
D.explanation: Preserves the meaning of the data and allows for checking for actual missing items.

learning.concept: Using form branches and application conditions, proper blanks and missing data are handled separately
learning.reason: Determine whether the quality assurance number is applied from the pre-project, and distinguish between cases where it does not apply and those where it is required but not specified, to assess quality.

aib-c01-d1-100@1.title: Clarify the scope of system responsibilities using common AI terminology
aib-c01-d1-100@1.prompt: In procurement documents, there are departments that refer to 'AI system' only as a model file, and departments that refer to the entire service including data input and operation. First, we want to reread the specifications of both departments using the same concept. What is the appropriate reference and usage?

A.text: Refer to ISO/IEC 22989 to organize AI terminology and concepts and explicitly state the procurement boundaries in the specifications.
A.explanation: Using common terminology, the discrepancy in included scope can be resolved.

B.text: Replace the term 'system' in all documents with 'model', and treat the specifications that included operation using the same expression.
B.explanation: The original scope is not confirmed before being reduced.

C.text: If certification to ISO/IEC 42001 is a condition, the contract scope of the term 'AI system' will also be automatically determined.
C.explanation: Only management system certification does not define the work included in the contract.

D.text: Select model component names from ISO/IEC 23894 alone, and the meaning used by departments is not consistent.
D.explanation: Risk management guidelines alone do not solve the problems of common terminology and contract scope.

learning.concept: Avoid ambiguous terms in meetings and align technical concepts and contractual responsibilities with a common definition
learning.reason: Organize AI terminology and concepts according to ISO/IEC 22989, and express the structure and responsibilities included in procurement targets in text.

aib-c01-d1-101@1.title: Do not mix two tasks performed by the same person
aib-c01-d1-101@1.prompt: The agent for equipment reservations handles multiple requests handled by one person at the same time. An example was given where the 'Confirm' action was applied to another equipment that had already been opened. Choose two measures to prevent this.

A.text: Compare the target and the latest status just before confirmation, and ask the person in charge to make a choice if there is any ambiguity.
A.explanation: This can prevent the confirmation of incorrect cases and old operations.

B.text: Only include the equipment name in the confirmation response, without checking against the ledger before confirmation.
B.explanation: Even if the name is in the report, incorrect operations cannot be prevented first.

C.text: To reduce mistakes, all requests being handled by the same person are automatically confirmed.
C.explanation: Changes are made to all items except those specified.

D.text: Separate the case ID and status for each request, and pass the required ID to the tool for operation.
D.explanation: It allows distinguishing the target object regardless of conversation order.

E.text: Remember the equipment used by the person in charge last, and all confirmations where the target is omitted are performed using that equipment.
E.explanation: Processing other requests in parallel can lead to misidentification of the target.

learning.concept: Add verification of the target case and the latest status for each agent operation
learning.reason: Instead of deciding which case to operate based on conversation order, use the explicitly provided ID and current status. If the target is ambiguous, verify it before confirmation.

aib-c01-d1-102@1.title: Make the recognition distinction available for staff to use in daily decisions
aib-c01-d1-102@1.prompt: The AI list of the company has labels indicating “authorized”, “under review”, and “not available”. However, staff assume that if it is authorized, external secrets can also be entered, and they are looking for unregistered services in case it is not available. What improvements could be made?

A.text: Treat "under review and unavailable" in the same sense as receiving a consultation from staff, and do not guide them to other options.
A.explanation: No clear options or process for reviewing to continue operations safely.
