B.text: A list shows the uses, materials that can be handled, restrictions, application and alternative methods for review, and verifies decisions with specific examples.
B.explanation: Staff can make selections and submit applications for work.

C.text: Only the distinguished names are changed briefly; which data can be entered is not listed.
C.explanation: I still don’t understand the necessary conditions for choosing a tool.

D.text: Authorized products are uniformly allowed to be used in any feature or any document.
D.explanation: Misunderstanding the “registered” category as the scope of application.

learning.concept: To enable users to choose tools that match their goals and data, the meaning of each category and the application process are shown.
learning.reason: The approved scope is indicated by purpose and information category. If not approved, it guides the review process; if excluded, it provides guidance on approved alternatives.

aib-c01-d1-103@1.title: Do not mix the values included in the example into this data
aib-c01-d1-103@1.prompt: The administrative AI creates a billing record. The sample format includes a fictional department code, and when the department code is not written in the actual document, this fictional code is output. What is the recommended improvement?

A.text: Separate the sample format from this document, extract values only from this document, and indicate missing fields as not recorded.
A.explanation: Fix the role of the example, ensuring no use of fictional information.

B.text: Increase the number of examples containing the same fictional code, prioritizing codes that appear frequently in the example.
B.explanation: Strengthen the reason for copying the original values.

C.text: Make the appearance of the fictional code similar to the actual code, and always fill in missing fields with something.
C.explanation: Determines values that do not actually exist.

D.text: Do not distinguish between the example and this data, and instruct to use shorter codes instead.
D.explanation: Cannot achieve a matching relationship between document records and outputs.

learning.concept: Separate the sample format from this document in the prompt, and indicate not to rely on the example values
learning.reason: Clearly state that the example only shows the format, and extract this data from this document alone. Try the condition of not using the example for unknown fields.

aib-c01-d1-104@1.title: Investigate why even short user texts reach the limit
aib-c01-d1-104@1.prompt: Even though it’s a short question, the consultation AI sometimes reaches its limit. For users who use the product frequently, many additional entries from past interactions and ledger queries are added. Even restricting only the user’s text didn’t fix it. What should be measured next?

A.text: Since the ledger query is executed outside the model, the content returned to the model is not included in the capacity.
A.explanation: The query results added to the model input use the limit.

B.text: Measure the number of characters again for users' questions only; if the questions are short, it is considered no problem.
B.explanation: The model does not account for any other information received.

C.text: Measure the actual instructions sent, history, query results, and required responses, and provide only the necessary information.
C.explanation: Can understand the length constraints including elements other than questions.

D.text: It claims to be able to handle all requests if the answer is short, and does not even limit the input.
D.explanation: We cannot prevent cases where there is only input.

learning.concept: Including instructions, past conversations, search/tool results, and generated content in context calculation
learning.reason: Calculate the total input and required output capacity for the model, categorized by type of additional information. Reduce unnecessary history and query results from the work.

aib-c01-d1-105@1.title: Align the old and new versions of the same system with the target date for the question.
aib-c01-d1-105@1.prompt: Contract procedures: AI can search for both the latest and previous versions. Users may also need to verify previous applications and respond to the conditions at that time. It is often the meaning search that selects the latest regulations. Which improvements are appropriate?

A.text: Mix past and current policies into one answer, and let the user's judgment determine the differences.
A.explanation: Without clear conditions for application, it becomes inaccurate guidance.

B.text: Just increase the number of search candidates for meaning, and use the longest document without checking which version it is.
B.explanation: Even if there are previous versions as candidates, they cannot be selected based on application criteria.

C.text: All old versions will be removed, and previous procedures will be answered based solely on the latest conditions.
C.explanation: Cannot refer to the version applied to past applications.

D.text: Compare the start and end dates of document application and the target date for questions, and obtain the relevant version to indicate it.
D.explanation: You can select a rationale that matches both the content similarity and the application period.

learning.concept: Using the explicitly specified conditions for the search, select a version based solely on semantic similarity, not on supporting evidence
learning.reason: Confirm the target date in the question and use the application period of each document as the search criteria. Provide the relevant version as the basis for the answer, and if the date is unknown, verify it.

aib-c01-d2-097@1.title: Using AI to Address Causes of Outdated Information
aib-c01-d2-097@1.prompt: In product support, different departments use different procedures for the same malfunction, leading to repeated visits. The history of repairs and approved procedures can be tracked. Which measure reduces repeat visits?

A.text: Summarize the latest repair report in a short form, measuring only the number of views on the summary.
A.explanation: It is impossible to assess the discrepancy in procedures and reduce repeat visits.

B.text: Predict customers who are likely to visit again and use them for station allocation, without reviewing conflicting procedures.
B.explanation: Even if a staffing plan is created, the underlying guidance remains unchanged.

C.text: Match versions and fault categories to identify potential conflicts, then measure repeat visits after using the procedures corrected by the responsible person.
C.explanation: Link actionable improvements to the causes of the issues.

D.text: The AI automatically creates the original document from procedures that are fluent, ignoring approved versions.
D.explanation: It is not possible to identify the most up-to-date and correct procedures based on fluency.

learning.concept: Link business losses to update processes, allowing the responsible person to choose a usable method
learning.reason: Extract discrepancies in descriptions and target versions for the same malfunction, and have departments approve corrections. Compare the use of corrected procedures with repeat visits.

aib-c01-d2-098@1.title: Compare procurement proposals based on actual operational conditions rather than sales materials
aib-c01-d2-098@1.prompt: I want to purchase AI-powered application reading. The proposals from two companies have the same speed and accuracy on average, but at the field level, large requests concentrate just before the deadline. Delayed requests cannot be processed for review that day. Which comparison should be done before signing the contract?

A.text: Compare only the highest speed shown by the provider and assume that this speed is maintained across all cases.
A.explanation: The fastest conditions do not reflect slower cases or deadlines.

B.text: Measure only by departments with small submission documents and apply the measured speed to the entire company.
B.explanation: The actual size and load that cause problems are not reflected.

C.text: If the average is the same, adopt the cheapest proposal and collect results at the deadline after operation.
C.explanation: The processing capacity needed at the busy time is not determined.

D.text: Process the representative request under the arrival conditions at the deadline, measure the slower cases, completion rate, and quality, and verify the guarantee conditions.
D.explanation: Real constraints can be compared under the same conditions.

learning.concept: In addition to the published average performance value, verify the service capability with representative inputs and high loads that are important for operations
learning.reason: Replicate large request arrival simultaneously, compare completion rate, slower cases, quality, and contract guarantees under the same conditions between both companies.

aib-c01-d2-099@1.title: Compare the effects achievable with existing features before starting new initiatives
aib-c01-d2-099@1.prompt: The sales department wants to invest in a new AI for classifying customer data headings. Other departments already have classification functions that meet the same goals and quality standards; they can be used by adding sales permissions and terminology. The new system has not yet shown additional benefits. What decision is appropriate?

A.text: Check if existing features are available under the business terms and confirm any additional costs, and delay development until the new proposal demonstrates added value.
A.explanation: It allows avoiding unnecessary development and operations while maintaining the required quality.

B.text: Add the number of trials for the new proposal to the number of active instances of existing features, and consider it effective across the entire company without considering duplicates.
B.explanation: Unable to distinguish the additional value from different strategies.

C.text: Pre-stop existing features, and conduct a trial for the sales department only after both operational costs are determined.
C.explanation: Common assets that can be used are lost before cost comparison.

D.text: If departments are different, even the same effect may be considered valuable for a different product, and the new idea is given priority.
D.explanation: No comparison has been made between existing reuse and additional burden.

learning.concept: Prioritize whether the gap between existing capabilities and additional offerings can be confirmed as business value, including costs for adding other offerings
learning.reason: Compare the implementation of existing features with new development to determine the benefits and maintenance costs brought by the new proposal. Allocate resources first to areas that meet the shared conditions.

aib-c01-d2-100@1.title: Determine whether to add predictions to processes where decisions cannot be changed
aib-c01-d2-100@1.prompt: The device is required to conduct a full routine inspection every 90 days starting from the last inspection. Even if failure prediction accuracy improves, the inspection targets, schedule, and procedures cannot be changed. Which option is the most appropriate for this period's operational improvement?

A.text: Improve the system to calculate deadlines and track unfinished tasks, but do not add failure predictions to this fixed process.
A.explanation: Work on the adjustable parts so that the routine inspection conditions can be maintained.

B.text: Add predictions to all items and report the prediction accuracy as an improvement amount for maintenance, even if not used in the schedule.
B.explanation: No operational improvement has occurred.

C.text: Abandon all current procedures regardless of prediction results, and keep only manual work schedules.
C.explanation: Lose the available system and fail to address actual challenges.

D.text: Early inspect those that become high-risk through predictions, and partially reduce routine inspections for low-risk devices.
D.explanation: Contradicts the condition where targets and schedules cannot be changed.

learning.concept: When prediction results do not affect actions or outcomes, do not introduce additional complexity
learning.reason: Investing in predictions that do not change business decisions is not prioritized. Improve current work through schedule management based on known dates and tracking of unfinished tasks.

aib-c01-d2-101@1.title: Ensure that the reported figures can be interpreted in the same way even when the business is switched over.
aib-c01-d2-101@1.prompt: An AI system for maintenance requests breaks each request into multiple tasks. Current management reports track the percentage of requests completed on time, which is also a contractual metric. The new system reports the number of individual tasks completed. What should be verified before migrating?

A.text: Assign the work to the original request and re-calculate according to the contractual completion criteria. Verify that the conditions match the previous calculation before migration.
A.explanation: The new project can also maintain the downstream reporting obligations.

B.text: Treat the increase in work items as quality improvement, and do not record the correspondence with the original request.
B.explanation: Unable to track the reasons for the improvement in reported values or contract progress.

C.text: Only inform that the reporting method has been changed; the definition of existing contracts will not be restored.
C.explanation: Cannot perform continuous evaluation under the specified calculation conditions.

D.text: Compare the completion rate of the work unit directly with the value of the previous request unit.
D.explanation: The denominator and completion conditions have changed, so the same results cannot be measured.

learning.concept: If AI transformation changes the definition of the number of cases, try to connect downstream aggregation with previous standards for a transition.
learning.reason: Properly reconstruct the completion of the request based on the work status, and compare the aggregates with the contract definitions and criteria over the representative period.

aib-c01-d2-102@1.title: Measuring Whether Evidence Required for Audits Can Be Actually Extracted
aib-c01-d2-102@1.prompt: I am organizing evidence for purchase reviews using AI. The goal is to ensure auditors can reproduce the transaction reason and applicable regulations within a specified time frame. Many documents are stored in the system. Which is the most appropriate success metric?

A.text: Number of times the latest regulations could be searched.
A.explanation: It is not known whether the past transaction reasons and the corresponding regulation versions can be reproduced.

B.text: Total number of documents stored by the system.
B.explanation: It is not possible to confirm whether all necessary evidence is available for each case.

C.text: Percentage of transactions randomly selected where the necessary approval reason and the corresponding regulation version can be fully extracted within the specified time.
C.explanation: It allows verification of both the required completeness and the required time.

D.text: Median value until the first related document is displayed.
D.explanation: The time taken to reach the first document alone cannot measure the overall collection of necessary evidence.

learning.concept: Evaluate not by the number of records generated, but whether the records that can reproduce the review are available and can be provided within the required time
learning.reason: Check whether for the selected transactions, the records of approval reason, the corresponding regulation version, and verification can be fully extracted. Measure the success rate within the specified time.

aib-c01-d2-103@1.title: Compare the time taken between results that have reached the same quality level
aib-c01-d2-103@1.prompt: Implement AI for creating investigation reports. Currently, completion is defined when humans have completed all reviews, while the trial side proposed completion when AI submits the first draft. What are the necessary criteria to compare the effects?

A.text: Compare the time AI takes to create a first draft with the time needed to obtain current approval.
A.explanation: The criteria for completion and the processes involved are different.

B.text: Arrange the definition of completion in a quality-verified report, and measure both start and end times and verification durations.
B.explanation: It allows for comparison until achieving results of the same quality.

C.text: The time taken by the old procedure relied only on staff memory, while the new method records in seconds.
C.explanation: The difference in measurement methods affects the improvement rate.

D.text: Reports that were difficult to verify are excluded based on the lack of replacement effect, so only AI results are used.
D.explanation: Reduces the verification burden in practice.

learning.concept: Align the completion criteria of the deliverable before the trial, and finish the measurement without a draft
learning.reason: Both the old procedure and trial processes must meet the approval criteria, and the time from start to completion of verified results is measured. The difficulty level and any rework are also recorded.

aib-c01-d2-104@1.title: Calculate profit including additional costs for expansion
aib-c01-d2-104@1.prompt: The AI utilization at two additional locations includes a confirmed benefit of 1.6 million yen per location per year and additional operational costs of 900,000 yen per year. Only 600,000 yen is spent on shared education in the first year for both locations. The current income and expenses remain unchanged. What is the net additional benefit in the first year of expansion?

A.text: 800,000 yen. Subtract the additional operational costs and shared education expenses from the benefits of the two locations.
A.explanation: Include each cost that occurs as an additional expense.

B.text: 2.6 million yen. Subtract only the shared education from the benefits, assuming operational costs remain unchanged.
B.explanation: Does not include the increased operational costs at each location.

C.text: 200,000 yen. Account for the 600,000 yen for education separately at each location.
C.explanation: Double-counts a single shared expense.

D.text: 1.4 million yen. Only records the difference between the benefits of two locations and operational costs.
D.explanation: Reduces the shared education cost in the first year.

learning.concept: Do not directly expand the net benefit obtained during the trial by the number of locations
learning.reason: From 3.2 million yen in benefits of two locations, subtract 1.8 million yen in costs and 600,000 yen for shared education, resulting in 800,000 yen.

aib-c01-d2-105@1.title: Estimate the capacity during expansion based on the correction burden immediately after implementation
aib-c01-d2-105@1.prompt: AI generates drafts of inspection documents. The actual cost of the formal inspection will be known at the quarter-end, but we want to decide whether processing continues through a specialist verification process before expansion. What is the appropriate leading indicator?

A.text: Only count the number of items generated; do not distinguish between items that required correction.
A.explanation: I don’t know the capacity needed for the review when enlarged.

B.text: Measure the proportion of corrections needed and the time for expert verification by difficulty level, and estimate the required scope for the expected number of cases.
B.explanation: Identify the conditions under which processing can stop before the effect is confirmed.

C.text: Just wait for the cost of the final formal inspection to be determined at the quarter-end.
C.explanation: The final effect is clear, but there is no information until the expansion decision.

D.text: Only the training time of experts is measured; individual tests are not measured.
D.explanation: Training time is not a predictive indicator of workload and correction burden.

learning.concept: While waiting for the results to be confirmed, observe the revision rate and expert time to identify potential future bottlenecks
learning.reason: Early measurement of the revision ratio and time distribution for the target project. Calculate the required expert quota based on estimates, and compare with the final cost later.

aib-c01-d2-106@1.title: Find the processing costs that increase in addition to the inference fees
aib-c01-d2-106@1.prompt: Half of the cost for image classification was spent on copying and converting the original-sized images from the storage location before distributing them to AI. Only certain areas require classification, and they can be retrieved within permitted areas. What is one cost-effective measure to maintain quality?

A.text: Due to requests for reduction from the provider, all images are set to the same minimum quality without measuring classification quality.
A.explanation: It is impossible to compare the loss of necessary information with cost reduction.

B.text: Create the required image area at the permitted location, and compare the costs including the original method, classification quality, transfer, and conversion.
B.explanation: Reduce the identified sources of increase, and verify the required quality.

C.text: We will only compare the monthly cost of the inference model; the costs associated with movement and transformation are handled by another department and are not considered.
C.explanation: Missing the total cost of processing the request.

D.text: The entire image is constantly replicated across multiple environments, without measuring the communication volume between them.
D.explanation: Processing volume and storage costs could increase further.

learning.concept: Even for models with low unit prices, when data movement or transformation is large, compare the total cost per task
learning.reason: Compare the quality and completion costs of the plan that separately accounts for the costs of movement and preprocessing, and extracts the necessary areas within a safe range.

aib-c01-d2-107@1.title: Evaluating the impact of price reductions based on actual customer choices by segment
aib-c01-d2-107@1.prompt: Competitors have significantly lowered the prices of document AI. Small customers are considering switching due to the price difference, while large customers focus on whether they will continue using the same document processing services. What analysis should be conducted before applying the same price reduction to all customers?

A.text: Apply the competitor’s price reduction across all customers without considering differences in value or contract continuation.
A.explanation: Even those with low necessity may lose profit.

B.text: Investigate the price sensitivity and transition requirements for each customer segment, and select a response based on actual reasons for renewal or cancellation.
B.explanation: It is possible to evaluate the threat to the business and effective countermeasures by customer segment.

C.text: Make the number of features similar, assuming all customers want the same price and quality.
C.explanation: It does not address the actual differences in decision-making reasons.

D.text: Assume large customers will not change their contracts, and judge all other conditions based solely on competitor advertising.
D.explanation: It does not verify customer behavior or business conditions.

learning.concept: Investigate market-specific usage features, transition burden, and price sensitivity not only based on competitor prices
learning.reason: Investigate payment willingness, usage conditions, and transition burden by customer segment, and evaluate the reasons for contract loss and the costs of maintaining contracts.

aib-c01-d2-108@1.title: Test using AI-driven transaction mediation as a new source of income
aib-c01-d2-108@1.prompt: The tool store uses AI-based inventory suggestions to identify excess stock. External construction companies have also expressed interest in borrowing tools that are surplus from other companies. What is a way to try out a brokerage service that requires the participation of specialized professionals?

A.text: Estimate fee income based on the number of inventory proposals processed; do not measure the willingness of other companies to pay.
A.explanation: Confusing the number of intermediaries that generate internal processing and revenue.

B.text: Assuming that the number of registrants will increase, fee income is certain, and contract and loan confirmation will be considered after publication.
B.explanation: The number of registrations does not indicate the completion of a transaction or the scope of responsibility.

C.text: Improve inventory forecasting only within the company, and do not investigate user conditions for loans and borrowings.
C.explanation: No conditions for the establishment of both parties in the transaction have been verified.

D.text: Trying out small intermediary services between lenders and borrowers, to determine transaction completion, fees, identity verification, and dispute resolution costs.
D.explanation: You can verify the new revenue unit and the validity of the required operations.

learning.concept: Efficiency of the company’s operations and distinguishing transaction-based revenue and responsibilities between users
learning.reason: For small transactions including both sides, examine the success rate, willingness to pay fees, and costs of verification and dispute resolution.

aib-c01-d2-109@1.title: The reason why recovery capabilities during operation are preferred for a long time
aib-c01-d2-109@1.prompt: Multiple companies offer AI component lookup systems of the same quality. Since service interruption affects customer inspections, during contract renewal, alternative procedures and performance records of recovery are evaluated. Which investment creates a long-term advantage?

A.text: Only purchase separate contracts for the same model when a failure occurs, without verifying whether there is a common impact.
A.explanation: The recovery capability to reproduce success is not guaranteed.

B.text: Promote only the high evaluation rank of the model, and leave the response during downtime to external users.
B.explanation: The operational practices that are emphasized during contract renewal have not been improved.

C.text: Establish a rule of not reporting recovery time, and inform customers only whether a stop occurred.
C.explanation: The recovery ability and improvement cannot be evaluated.

D.text: Develop independent alternatives and response procedures, and continuously improve through training and performance records of continuous operation and recovery.
D.explanation: By accumulating systems and human capabilities, customer value can be maintained.

learning.concept: In operations where customers cannot be stopped, accumulate the ability to safely recover from problems to create a difference
learning.reason: Standardize alternative paths and support, evaluate training and actual recovery time, and the operations that can continue. Continue improving based on performance records.

aib-c01-d2-110@1.title: Determine the range of fixed investment until specifications are finalized
aib-c01-d2-110@1.prompt: While the logistics AI market is growing, the evidence presented to customers is divided between two industry specifications, and a decision on a unified specification is expected next year. The demand for a universal aggregation function has been confirmed. What is the investment strategy?

A.text: Until specifications are determined, both functions will be suspended for demand verification and provisioning.
A.explanation: Loss of options due to confirmed value.

B.text: First, fix all costs to one specification; do not evaluate changes or customer impacts if the decision differs.
B.explanation: Loss of flexibility to adapt to market choices.

C.text: Develop common functions with demand, and separate format-specific adjustments. Decide on additional investment based on finalized specifications and actual demand.
C.explanation: It is possible to separate the value obtained from the pending decision part.

D.text: Adopt the format chosen by competitors directly, without handling customer requirements or changes in costs.
D.explanation: Using competitor actions to substitute for one’s own demand and risks.

learning.concept: When there is market demand but specifications are competitive among competitors, invest in common parts and separate parts that are difficult to change.
learning.reason: Develop common functions with confirmed demand and separate format-specific changes. Adjust investment using contracts or implementations that work for either option.

aib-c01-d2-111@1.title: Adjust the multilingual initiatives based on the reasons for non-compatibility, rather than the number of cases.
aib-c01-d2-111@1.prompt: At the travel counter, there are few multilingual guides, but many people stop the process midway because they don’t understand the cancellation fees. There are approved conditions and a language representative who can be confirmed. Which of these is appropriate as a testing measure?

A.text: Remove the explanation of fees and report only the increase in completion rate as a result.
A.explanation: Users lose information needed to understand the conditions.

B.text: All long domestic guides with many items will be shortened, and completion by foreign language users will not be evaluated.
B.explanation: Does not target the causes of crashes that need improvement.

C.text: Increase the total number of words in automatic translation, and do not measure what users are struggling with.
C.explanation: The translation volume does not show an increase in the completion of procedures.

D.text: The fee is presented with justification in the target language, and after confirming the translation, it measures completion and misunderstandings by language.
D.explanation: Can address both the specific reasons for disconnection and quality issues.

learning.concept: Apply AI language processing capabilities to tasks that users cannot actually complete.
learning.reason: Provide an explanation of the conditions halting the process in accordance with the approval content, and compare completion by language and misdirection.

aib-c01-d2-112@1.title: Even in a consolidated proposal, the value and feasibility vary; separate those parts
aib-c01-d2-112@1.prompt: There is a proposal to support all regular reports with AI. For sales weekly reports, approval data are available, which significantly reduces the preparation time. For investment reports, the use of external evidence is not approved, and there is little support for the benefits of the plan. Which allocation is appropriate today?

A.text: Due to the same proposal, implement it simultaneously for all reports, and approve external evidence after operation.
A.explanation: It extends the preparation of one aspect to approval of all operations.

B.text: If there is any uncertainty, do not reconsider at all, including those with available evidence.
B.explanation: Unable to utilize the useful and feasible scope.

C.text: In the sales weekly report scope, verify costs and outcomes; for investment reports, re-examine approval and effectiveness of use.
C.explanation: Ability to determine priorities smoothly based on different assumptions.

D.text: If the creation is short, consider it of equal value; do not include approval and user outcomes in priority ranking.
D.explanation: Does not evaluate the effectiveness and implementation conditions of the measure.

learning.concept: Evaluate proposals with the same name by scope, and allocate budget to parts where benefits can be confirmed under available conditions
learning.reason: Evaluate whether deployment is possible by department and benefits separately. Test with those with available evidence, and clarify conditions for expanding to others.

aib-c01-d2-113@1.title: Compare the provider's definition of the number of successful cases to what is charged.
aib-c01-d2-113@1.prompt: There are two options for supporting invoice classification. Option A is a fee per processing success, but it also applies to reattempts of the same invoice. Option B involves a monthly fee, with only invoices accepted by the business side included in the usage fee. The accuracy is similar, but more reattempts occur for complex invoices. What is the procurement evaluation?

A.text: Compare only the initial execution fee for A and the usage fee for B, excluding monthly fees and exceptions.
A.explanation: It does not include important parts of the total cost.

B.text: Sign the contract based solely on the price difference, and estimate any unknown costs later and add them to the budget.
B.explanation: The factors of cost required for selection are unverified.

C.text: Since there is a phrase “success” in A, no fees are considered for results that are not accepted in business operations.
C.explanation: The meaning of success and the payment conditions for retrying are different.

D.text: Confirm the billing unit of the contract, and compare the cost per case accepted by the business using representative data with a retry option.
D.explanation: The required results and pricing can be adjusted to match actual conditions.

learning.concept: The unit used in purchases and partnership agreements, and the actual business results must be consistent
learning.reason: Differentiate successful processing, retry attempts, and business acceptance according to contract definitions, and compare costs per acceptance case using representative forms.

aib-c01-d2-114@1.title: Determine whether to create a system that requires continuous operation for a one-time task
aib-c01-d2-114@1.prompt: The branch will only change 12 contracts' addenda to a common format once. The input fields and current values are finalized, allowing someone to complete and verify them in half a day. Automated creation by AI requires several weeks for review and environment preparation. Which is the appropriate proposal?

A.text: It is created using existing formats and item checks, and verified by the responsible person. It will be re-evaluated if similar tasks increase in the future.
A.explanation: It can be executed with the current quantity and period, and quality can also be verified.

B.text: Assuming it can be done quickly with AI, contract data will be inputted before approval is granted.
B.explanation: The conditions required for implementation are not met, and the estimated cost has not been measured.

C.text: Create the permissions and environment for AI first; even after the work is done, the maintenance costs of the recurring contract are not evaluated.
C.explanation: It does not check whether the benefit of a one-off task justifies the setup and ongoing costs.

D.text: Even though all formatting requirements are clear, it is postponed to the next phase because without AI, nothing can be created.
D.explanation: The required results can be achieved using existing procedures.

learning.concept: Considering the number of times, room for change, and minimum quality, we can keep costs low if a standard procedure is sufficient
learning.reason: For repetitive, routine tasks, use existing templates and verification to achieve the required results. If there is no basis for generating costs from AI implementation and maintenance, it will not be prioritized.

aib-c01-d2-115@1.title: Even after the switch, the purchased usage quota remains intact
aib-c01-d2-115@1.prompt: Transition corporate AI services to a new model. Under the old contract, prepaid remaining quota can be used until the deadline, and some customers have time-specific special agreements. In the new model, it starts with a standard monthly quota. What is required before the launch?

A.text: Set a uniform value for the remaining quota across all customers, and ignore special agreements based on the number of included cases.
A.explanation: Unable to handle differences in individual contract conditions.

B.text: Link the remaining quota, deadline, and special agreements, compare the amount available in the representative contract with charges, and determine the handling for cases not migrated.
B.explanation: Can maintain the switching operation and pricing conditions for customers.

C.text: At the point where old mode usage is stopped, all remaining quotas are deleted, and only new pricing is indicated.
C.explanation: Does not meet the conditions of existing contracts that can be used within the deadline.

D.text: Confirm that the new model has started, and restore the remaining quota only if a customer complains.
D.explanation: Unable to maintain purchased rights at the launch time.

learning.concept: Not only a technical switch, but also compare contracts and usage rights transferred to the new model
learning.reason: Convert and compare remaining quota, deadline, and special agreements per contract to the new model. Ensure no double billing or unusability in representative cases.

aib-c01-d2-116@1.title: Measure the impact of changing priorities in both critical and regular cases
aib-c01-d2-116@1.prompt: AI determines the priority of consultations. The goal is to process urgent consultations quickly, but it also promises to respond to regular requests by the next day. Choose two key metrics.

A.text: The percentage of routine cases that did not receive a response by the next-day deadline.
A.explanation: You can verify that priority processing has not impaired the delivery to standard projects.

B.text: Measure only the average time for all doors, and do not record the difference between emergency and normal cases.
B.explanation: Emergency improvements may hide normal delays.

C.text: Rank by length of consultation guide.
C.explanation: It has nothing to do with the promised response or the actual waiting time.

D.text: The percentage of cases confirmed as urgent and independent that could start responding within the specified time.
D.explanation: Can observe emergency responses that need to be improved first.

E.text: Total of cases labeled as urgent by AI.
E.explanation: The number of labels does not represent true urgency or response time.

learning.concept: Improvements for critical cases, and manage the disadvantage of over-delayed regular cases using separate metrics
learning.reason: For cases confirmed as urgent, measure the time taken to handle them. For routine cases, measure the percentage that miss the agreed deadline. An overall average cannot distinguish the two.

aib-c01-d2-117@1.title: Do not turn high-potential collaborators' performance into a benefit of the implementation effect
aib-c01-d2-117@1.prompt: For the AI trial, staff who regularly use new technologies voluntarily gathered together. Management wants to measure the implementation effect on all employees. In terms of operations, the target groups can be divided by experience level for phased implementation. Which evaluation design is appropriate?

A.text: Measure only the results after introducing the candidates for the position, and use that value as the effectiveness of all employees.
A.explanation: The knowledge and motivation of those who participate themselves determine the outcome.

B.text: Measure the pre-implementation results by experience level, create groups with different implementation phases at each level, and compare them using the same definition.
B.explanation: It makes it easier to distinguish between the bias of the target and the impact of the implementation.

C.text: Distributed to all employees on the same day, with the top-performing participants from the first week serving as the baseline before implementation.
C.explanation: It is based on a state different from before implementation.

D.text: Compare the average after the introduction of candidates and those who did not participate, without examining each individual’s experience and values before the introduction.
D.explanation: Can't distinguish between the original differences and the changes in AI.

learning.concept: Determine the comparison targets and assignments in advance, considering the collaboration conditions and the skills of the responsible personnel
learning.reason: From before implementation, target users are determined based on experience levels, with pilot implementations and traditional operations for each layer. The entire system is not estimated based solely on highly motivated collaborators.

aib-c01-d2-118@1.title: Compare the first-year cost based on the number of items included in the contract and the surcharge
aib-c01-d2-118@1.prompt: Assume 10,000 transactions per year. Plan A costs JPY 1,800,000 per year and includes 8,000 transactions. Each additional transaction costs JPY 150, and training costs JPY 200,000. Plan B costs JPY 600,000 per year plus JPY 140 for every transaction, and training costs JPY 500,000. Quality and all other conditions are the same. How do the first-year costs compare?

A.text: A is 300,000 yen lower. Only calculate the difference in education costs; other expenses are considered equal.
A.explanation: The base fee and usage conditions are not the same.

B.text: B is 1.3 million yen lower. Apply the 150 yen per additional item from A to all 10,000 items, and exclude education costs from both.
B.explanation: In A, 8,000 items are included in fixed costs, and education costs also apply.

C.text: A is 200,000 yen lower. Include the 2,000 additional items from A and education costs for both methods.
C.explanation: The billing conditions of the contract are applied to the actual number of operations.

D.text: B is 1.2 million yen lower. Compare only the annual base fees of both methods.
D.explanation: Does not include usage and education costs.

learning.concept: Do not use a uniform unit price estimate, but compare additional usage, fixed costs, and education costs per contract unit

aib-c01-d2-119@1.title: Check if the number of types of exceptions that can be processed has increased
aib-c01-d2-119@1.prompt: The AI support for delivery initially could only handle regular documents. The ultimate result of the improvement will be the reprocessing costs in the next quarter, but I want to decide by the end of this month whether to continue investing in expanding exception handling. What are some useful early indicators?

A.text: Classify exceptions based on frequency and impact, and track the proportion of types that meet the criteria for representative tests among the actual targets.
A.explanation: It allows us to determine the scope of improvement earlier than investment decisions.

B.text: Only measure the frequency of inputting regular documents into AI.
B.explanation: I don’t know the scope of what exceptions can be handled.

C.text: Just wait for the final cost of reprocessing to be determined in the next quarter.
C.explanation: I can see the final result, but it won’t be ready in time for this month’s decision.

D.text: Count only the number of exception issues prepared for evaluation, regardless of whether they were processed correctly.
D.explanation: The activity of creating examples and the scope that can be handled in production are different.

learning.concept: Measure whether the scope of important use cases expands from validated examples before outcome confirmation
learning.reason: Create a exception classification that shows occurrence and impact, and track the proportion of types and items meeting the criteria in independent tests.

aib-c01-d2-120@1.title: Do not continue non-urgent tasks at the same cost as immediate tasks
aib-c01-d2-120@1.prompt: Assisted document review and monthly archiving of historical material both use the same expensive real-time processing capacity. Document review needs a response within minutes, while archiving only needs to finish by the next morning. Choose two measures that reduce costs.

A.text: Verify deadlines and quality through a divided path and measure cost per completion including retries.
A.explanation: It allows measuring actual costs and services for both purposes.

B.text: Split past data organization into a cheaper batch process aligned with deadlines.
B.explanation: Avoid using expensive quotas for non-immediate tasks.

C.text: To appear cost-stable, exclude failed candidates from billing usage counts.
C.explanation: It is impossible to accurately compare actual costs with successful processing.

D.text: Move everything to slower processing and compare only monthly costs even if review assistance cannot meet deadlines.
D.explanation: It is impossible to maintain tasks requiring immediate responses.

E.text: Eliminate only past data organization and do not confirm if organization is needed for the next day's work.
E.explanation: Reduce costs without achieving necessary results.

learning.concept: Divide tasks with different deadlines and maintain deadlines and quality using a low-cost path
learning.reason: Maintain emergency quotas and move non-urgent tasks to a cheaper batch path. Track deadlines, quality, and cost per successful task.

aib-c01-d3-081@1.title: Protect Confidential Information on an AI Device in a Shared Area
aib-c01-d3-081@1.prompt: On the AI device used for joint processing, the user can view the details of their inquiry. Even after the user leaves, the response remains on the screen, allowing others in the queue to see it. Which improvement ensures that the user can verify the details while maintaining privacy?

A.text: Enable access via a common QR code that allows anyone to view the consultation history, only closing the display on the device.
A.explanation: The issue of sensitive information being visible from the sharing interface remains.

B.text: Keep all details on the screen and only forcefully close it when the next user starts.
B.explanation: During the waiting period in front of the device, information about the completed user can be read.

C.text: Show only the minimum information required for processing on the shared screen, and route the details to a private channel for the user. Remove the display and session when it ends.
C.explanation: The user can use the information while minimizing exposure to others and subsequent users.

D.text: Display a note indicating confidential status, and do not change the visible information from the queue or the state after completion.
D.explanation: A note alone cannot prevent others from seeing the content.

learning.concept: Separate from individual authentication, reduce exposure to others and display after usage ends
learning.reason: Allow individual details to be verified through a private channel after authentication. Reduce sensitive information remaining on the shared screen, and remove the display and session when it ends.

aib-c01-d3-082@1.title: Do not compromise the selection of notifications to increase response rate
aib-c01-d3-082@1.prompt: In a learning service, create notifications that encourage participants to continue their training. In multiple trials, the click rate increased, but participants who chose to stop received notifications through other channels. Which approach balances business effectiveness with user choices?

A.text: Make the notification display less prominent, but do not change the number of messages sent or the method of conveying stop settings.
A.explanation: Even with a different display, the cause of unnecessary notifications still exists.

B.text: Respect the stop setting for all notification channels and set a frequency limit for those who are allowed, comparing the continuation of learning with complaints.
B.explanation: While preserving user choices, it is possible to evaluate the effectiveness of learning actions required by the business.

C.text: Make only the click rate a success criterion, and leave channel-specific stop settings for future operations.
C.explanation: Even if the click rate improves, the choice to receive notifications may not be maintained across channels.

D.text: Since response rates increase across all channels, ensure that stopped participants receive notifications only once.
D.explanation: The already established stop selection cannot be maintained.

learning.concept: Even if business response increases through personalization, manage the impact of user choices and repeated notifications
learning.reason: Reflect stop selections across notification channels while setting frequency limits for allowed users. Within this scope, evaluate both effective learning actions and complaints.

aib-c01-d3-083@1.title: Requirements for cases where the answer cannot be determined upfront
aib-c01-d3-083@1.prompt: The internal AI is planned to present the contract terms to sales staff, but only standard contracts can be used for prototyping. Staff responsible for special contracts are also expected to use the same interface, and if their judgment is wrong, they may make promises not included in the contract. What should be done first at the requirements stage?

A.text: The requirements include distinguishing between the scope of operation and special agreements, as well as holding off and handover procedures. During testing, both normal and outside-scope scenarios are attempted.
A.explanation: Actions that do not present incorrect contract terms can be verified from the design stage.

B.text: Treat special contracts as similar to regular contracts in terms of conditions, and decide not to specify a method for marking them as non-applicable.
B.explanation: Even in situations you’ve never tried before, it makes you think the answer is correct.

C.text: If the prototype average score is high, it will be made public for all employees without assigning a person to handle special contracts.
C.explanation: On average, it cannot guarantee tasks not covered by the test scope.

D.text: The trial should only cover standard contracts, and the reservation feature should be added after incorrect navigation due to special contracts.
D.explanation: Do not verify the risks known at the design stage before public release.

learning.concept: Define the conditions not applicable to design and the reserved destinations to include in trials.
learning.reason: Define the contracts to be verified and the exclusions from application. If conditions are unclear, retain the response and forward it to the relevant specialist for further review.

aib-c01-d3-084@1.title: When small errors overlap with the same user, they are carried over
aib-c01-d3-084@1.prompt: Support AI notifies you of missing information for each item. After repeating notifications of different documents to the same user for several days, the process never progressed. Each single notification was minor and not a person to be checked out. What is the appropriate supervision?

A.text: Users with unfinished processing will stop all future communications and wait for inquiries from the user.
A.explanation: There is no supervision to help recover from the unable-to-proceed situation.

B.text: Monitors re-notifications and delays per user, and allows the responsible person to summarize and verify/correct the history under certain conditions.
B.explanation: Even if it's small per item, it can intervene in the cumulative impact.

C.text: Notifying one by one is minor, so I continue the AI processing without checking accumulated notifications.
C.explanation: Even when the impacts on users overlap, they cannot be recognized.

D.text: Simplify the notification format; increase notifications even if there are inconsistencies with previous notifications.
D.explanation: Doesn’t address the causes hindering the process.

learning.concept: Do not continue automatic processing based solely on the weight of a single item, but include the cumulative impact as a condition for supervision
learning.reason: Verify re-notifications and progress per user, and route them for the supervisor’s detailed review in case of repetition or stagnation.

aib-c01-d3-085@1.title: Even when the reviewer is absent, responsible decisions can continue to be made
aib-c01-d3-085@1.prompt: The suspension of AI services is determined by both the business side and the risk officer. On the weekend when an incident occurred, the risk officer was absent, and no one could take over the authority to suspend operations. Which change is necessary for organizational control?

A.text: Establish a formal substitute, record the conditions under which suspension is possible and the reporting party, and practice decision-making and handover during holidays.
A.explanation: Maintains clear responsibility and can handle the necessary time period.

B.text: Distribute the suspension authority to all operators, and eliminate the scope of the substitute and decision records.
B.explanation: Even with a substitute, responsibility and authority cannot be controlled.

C.text: Continue providing services without confirming the cause or external impact until the responsible person returns.
C.explanation: Critical decisions are delayed due to significant impacts.

D.text: The AI provider determines the risk itself, so no internal substitute is provided.
D.explanation: Business responsibility and suspension decisions cannot be established.

learning.concept: Establish a clear formal responsible person, define the authority, scope, and records of the substitute
learning.reason: Specify the main responsible person and a qualified substitute, prepare decision scope, reporting conditions, handover, and records.

aib-c01-d3-086@1.title: Also maintaining the location conditions during failure, as a backup path.
aib-c01-d3-086@1.prompt: Process the contract proposal using AI. According to the contract, processing and storage are limited to a specified region. The main route meets the conditions, but the provider automatically selects a fallback route in case of failures, without confirming which region will handle the processing. What should be done before starting operations?

A.text: Since the conditions are met on the main route, it is assumed that no exceptions occur for audits outside the region only during outages.
A.explanation: The terms of the contract apply even during outages.

B.text: The verification is completed by simply displaying the region conditions on the screen, and no selection of the processing destination is verified.
B.explanation: The representation does not control the actual processing location.

C.text: Only record normal processing and storage; the backup path relies on the region names in the recovery data and does not perform actual operations.
C.explanation: It cannot be proven that the specified conditions are maintained during actual switching.

D.text: Confirm the actual processing destination and storage location via primary and backup paths, and limit them within the specified range. Also try to stop when safe continuation is not possible.
D.explanation: Necessary conditions can be applied up to operation during failures.

learning.concept: In addition to approving the regular route, verify the region where the data will be processed and stored on the alternate route.
learning.reason: Verify the processing and storage of the primary path and failover path. Only allow paths that meet the conditions, and also try to safely stop.

aib-c01-d3-087@1.title: Only the necessary items are passed to the AI from the records with access rights
aib-c01-d3-087@1.prompt: Accounting AI verifies the payment date and amount. People have access to all details of a transaction, but only the required items for payment are given to the model; personal notes from the responsible person are not used. Choose 3 measures.

A.text: Provide all columns, and limit to only instructions for the model to avoid touching personal notes.
A.explanation: The data sent to the model itself exceeds the required range.

B.text: Even when payment operations are suspended, unrelated personal notes are still collected as evaluation materials.
B.explanation: It is expanding the required use cases and scope.

C.text: The client specifies the items used by AI, and only returns the necessary fields such as amounts and dates.
C.explanation: Unnecessary columns can be removed before passing them to the model.

D.text: Ensure that unnecessary fields do not appear in the model input or the recording of its processing.
D.explanation: Not only can settings be configured, but actual retrieval and processing can also be verified.

E.text: The target project is obtained after matching it with the permission of authenticated users.
E.explanation: Prevents unauthorized access to target records.

learning.concept: Don’t limit data access to just record permissions; restrict the items and usage given to AI
learning.reason: Verify access via AI-specific acquisition processing and provide the permitted items. Confirm that personal notes are not included in inputs or related records.

aib-c01-d3-088@1.title: Even if it says “people are to verify”, it is necessary to review whether it can be implemented
aib-c01-d3-088@1.prompt: An AI system for benefits notices was rated as medium risk on the condition that staff check each notice before it is sent. A planned expansion increases daily volume tenfold. The department plans to send most notices without review and has no plans to add staff. How should the risk be handled?

A.text: First, distribute it to all items. Only when accidents increase, check if there is a shortage of confirmers.
A.explanation: The impact of insufficient verification has not been evaluated in advance.

B.text: Reclassify based on the number of items confirmed and the impact when not confirmed, and expand after reviewing the verification scope and operations.
B.explanation: Compare the assumptions of the original evaluation with the actual supervision that can be provided.

C.text: It’s the same model and same guide, so the actual confirmation rate is not included in the category.
C.explanation: The premise that a lower tier was allowed has changed.

D.text: If the confirmation screen is displayed, it will be recorded that the previous supervisor was maintained without the manager having to verify it.
D.explanation: The existence of the screen does not indicate that the conditions have actually been verified.

learning.concept: Determine whether implementing the assumption of control is truly possible based on the workload, and classify accordingly.
learning.reason: Since no verification to support the previous classification is carried out, the impact of the incident and remaining controls must be re-evaluated before expansion. The effectiveness of new verifications and scope restrictions will be tested.

aib-c01-d3-089@1.title: Ensure that new processing paths are also included in the monitoring scope
aib-c01-d3-089@1.prompt: Among the AI-based queries, regular audits of results are conducted on existing screens. When an additional reception app was added, although using the same infrastructure, the responses from that route were not included in the audit scope. What is the improvement?

A.text: Match the audit targets and volume for each production route, and notify about new routes and unaudited cases.
A.explanation: You can check where the audit is missing across the entire infrastructure.

B.text: Measure only the uptime of the new app, and evaluate any results errors only in cases where they occurred on the legacy screen.
B.explanation: Confuses the uptime rate with the quality of the answers.

C.text: Save the results of the new route only after they are published, and confirm whether they were added for auditing if the user asks.
C.explanation: Cannot reflect changes in application targets into control.

D.text: Since it is a common foundation, it is considered that not only traditional screen-based audits can be performed, but the operations of other apps can also be evaluated.
D.explanation: Missing inputs and settings specific to different screens.

learning.concept: Continue to verify whether quality monitoring targets reflect all real-world paths.
learning.reason: Match the audit targets and results for each processing path. For new paths, management is applied from the start, and notifications are sent if unaudited paths increase.

aib-c01-d3-090@1.title: To determine if the overlap of results affects the measurement of fairness
aib-c01-d3-090@1.prompt: In the enrollment consultation AI audit, satisfaction levels remaining at the end of the consultation are compared by group. Those who left quickly due to difficult guidance have no records, and the proportion varies depending on the language used. Which of the following is an appropriate review of monitoring?

A.text: It is determined that not saving the language used will eliminate group bias.
A.explanation: Even if the information is hidden, the difficulty of use does not disappear.

B.text: Since there are fewer responses in minority languages, the results of that group are compensated by scores in majority languages.
B.explanation: It replaces empirical measurements to detect differences.

C.text: Only users who received scores are used to determine overall fairness, and those who left are excluded.
C.explanation: Those who could not use the service are excluded from analysis.

D.text: Compare conditions for language-specific exits and scores, and obtain reasons for early exit and independent quality assessments within the permitted range.
D.explanation: It is possible to identify which users' results are not visible.

learning.concept: Observing only users with clear results does not deny bias, and exits after determination are also verified
learning.reason: Satisfaction levels of respondents are not considered representative of all users. Measure language-specific mid-exits and guidance quality, and perform additional verification within the permitted range.

aib-c01-d3-091@1.title: Separate the permission for using the material from the permission for generated character representation
aib-c01-d3-091@1.prompt: In advertising production, a product description video is created using approved photos. The AI also generated material in which the photo subjects spoke statements that they did not agree with. According to company policies, such representations require the individuals to approve both the purpose and content. Which action is correct?

A.text: Materials where the purpose and speech content not approved by the individual cannot be used; only approved representations should be used.
A.explanation: It is possible to distinguish between the use of photos and the approval for new individual statements.

B.text: Assume that the 'AI-generated' label meets the individual’s approval requirements.
B.explanation: The creator’s indication does not replace the rights holder’s consent.

C.text: Since permission for the photo exists, publish it without informing the individual that speech was generated.
C.explanation: The person’s approval of the new purpose and content has not been obtained.

D.text: Generate a different person similar to the existing photo and publish it as if it is a recommendation for the same character.
D.explanation: This may lead users to misunderstand the support not expressed by the individual.

learning.concept: Do not treat it as possible to generate the individual’s support or speech and publish it simply by accessing the original photo.
learning.reason: Check the permission for using the photo and the approved recommendation separately. Unapproved parts are set aside, and they are replaced with approved representations.

aib-c01-d3-092@1.title: Compare outdated reused results with current references
aib-c01-d3-092@1.prompt: The product information AI can immediately obtain the updated version. However, previously answered questions still return stored old responses. During the investigation, no verification of the data version was performed before reusing old responses. Which improvement is appropriate?

A.text: Link the reused results to the reference version and disable them through updates or application changes. Confirm whether to answer new questions from the new reference.
A.explanation: Directly improve and verify the execution path that returns old responses.

B.text: Change only the display date of all responses to today, without recording which data they are based on.
B.explanation: It only appears as if the old references have been updated.

C.text: Try only obtaining the current version through search, and assume stored responses remain unaffected.
C.explanation: The old state is returned via a path that does not run the search.

D.text: Prioritize returning the same text for the question, and keep past responses even after updating the data.
D.explanation: It is not possible to maintain the current information required by users.

learning.concept: Check the path where previous responses are used even after updating search results, and verify version linking and disabling
learning.reason: Link the reused results to the reference version and disable them when current information changes. Test both new and old questions.

aib-c01-d3-093@1.title: Let users be able to choose the scope to assign to AI depending on the scenario.
aib-c01-d3-093@1.prompt: The document navigation feature can be used when users select only a portion of the document and send it to the AI. Currently, when you click “Start,” all pages are automatically sent, and the instructions appear after sending. Which of the following is a necessary change for the design to protect personal information?

A.text: Display what was sent after starting, and eliminate any operation to change the range before sending.
A.explanation: Users cannot select it before sending.

B.text: If only the document name is provided, all pages inside can be sent, and selection is possible.
B.explanation: Can’t select a range because I don’t understand what is being sent.

C.text: Based on the summary results, personal information can be omitted, and it is determined that the transmission scope need not be controlled.
C.explanation: Handling of results does not limit the transmission of original data.

D.text: Allow users to specify the range before sending and select only the necessary parts, while also showing options for what not to use.
D.explanation: Can implement information minimization and user selection.

learning.concept: Before starting the support, inform the recipient and the information to handle, so a minimal selection can be used.
learning.reason: Make sure the target and purpose can be confirmed before sending, and set up a default setting that allows only the necessary parts to be selected. If not needed, allow the message to continue without being sent.

aib-c01-d3-094@1.title: Reverse calculating the contact procedures for the client from the internal accident reporting deadline
aib-c01-d3-094@1.prompt: According to the policy of the organization that outsources AI processing, a first report should be made within 24 hours after identifying any data leakage, even if the scope is not yet determined. The contractor has proposed to summarize any issues in weekly regular communications. What is the approach before implementation?

A.text: Maintain weekly updates, and receive reports indicating that the time detected by the contractor is unnecessary.
A.explanation: Unable to properly handle the timely first report and incident timeline.

B.text: If the uptime rate is specified in the contract, notifications regarding information leaks will also be automatically fulfilled.
B.explanation: Service operation and incident notification/reporting are separate.

C.text: Require the vendor to notify the organization immediately and designate who will report for the organization. Record timestamps and confirmed facts, and rehearse filing the initial report while the full scope is still unclear.
C.explanation: We can translate the deadlines and provisional reports into actual responsibilities.

D.text: Neither the organization nor the contractor will begin communication until all affected data is confirmed.
D.explanation: This contradicts the condition that a preliminary report is required even if the scope is not determined.

learning.concept: When the organizations responsible for detecting and reporting incidents are different, clarify the point of contact, required evidence, and the person in charge
learning.reason: Practice being able to contact the client early, assign a primary reporting officer for the organization, establish records of accident information and time, and meet the deadline without waiting for regular communication.

aib-c01-d3-095@1.title: The overall performance does not offset the disadvantage to some users
aib-c01-d3-095@1.prompt: Candidate A for window guidance offers significant time savings overall, but the proportion of users who need to use certain functions to complete the procedures falls below the set minimum standard. Candidate B provides less time savings, but meets quality and the minimum standards for each group. Which judgment is appropriate?

A.text: Due to the significant time reduction, the group-specific conditions are lowered after evaluation before approval.
A.explanation: The mandatory criteria have been changed after it was determined that disadvantages would arise.

B.text: Since the overall time savings are the highest, A is made public, and those groups that couldn’t complete are excluded when reporting the overall results.
B.explanation: If the minimum conditions of that group are not met, improvement becomes difficult to observe.

C.text: Choose B as the baseline, and then decide after confirming that A can address the group's disadvantages and meet the minimum requirements again.
C.explanation: It can achieve time savings in operations while maintaining the required service standards.

D.text: Add the overall performance of A and the completion rate of the disadvantaged group of B, and treat it as if A has achieved both.
D.explanation: The results obtained by another method cannot be combined and proven.

learning.concept: Compare the candidates both in terms of the pre-set minimum standards by group and business efficiency.
learning.reason: First, choose a method to meet the required conditions of each group. A will be re-evaluated only when it can reduce the impact and meet the minimum standard.

aib-c01-d3-096@1.title: Start processing the evaluation data after it is used up
aib-c01-d3-096@1.prompt: The company plans to keep only the approved documents for one month for quality verification of the consultation AI. The evaluation will be conducted in multiple environments, but after the purpose is fulfilled, the original copies and temporary files must also be disposed of. Which option meets the requirements best?

A.text: After the test, search for the storage location; any documents not found will be deleted.
A.explanation: Have not prepared evidence to dispose of them within the deadline.

B.text: Set a deadline only for the data, and assign the replication of the evaluation environment to someone not on the system.
B.explanation: Unable to meet the requirement of discarding regardless of the target.

C.text: Keep a copy indefinitely for re-verification, and do not check whether the purpose of use is the same.
C.explanation: Does not meet the one-month usage condition.

D.text: Before collection, ensure that all destinations, copies, uses, expiration dates, and deletion responsibilities can be recorded, and design a verification process at the end.
D.explanation: Track the used range to verify if processing is complete.

learning.concept: Design the termination and evidence, including the purpose, deadline, and copies, before collection.
learning.reason: Record the destination and replication, and decide on a method to verify the deadline, responsible person, and deletion before collection.

aib-c01-d3-097@1.title: Remove unnecessary user data from the incident sharing document
aib-c01-d3-097@1.prompt: An AI service returned an error, and we want to share investigation details with external support personnel. What is needed are the time of occurrence, error type, and model version, but the original log includes the full text and user name. Which is the most appropriate approach?

A.text: Share all entries from the operation log without a time limit, but label the file as confidential.
A.explanation: The information and recipients are not restricted by the display method.

B.text: Extract only the required items, and share access and expiration dates with the approved support channel.
B.explanation: Only the information needed for the purpose and the recipients are limited.

C.text: Remove the time and version before sharing, and provide only the entered full text.
C.explanation: The information needed for investigation is lost, and unnecessary content is provided.

D.text: Copy the full text and have the recipient remove any unnecessary parts.
D.explanation: Unnecessary information is provided at the time of sending.

learning.concept: Even when external support is required, limit the information sent and user permissions to the investigation purpose
learning.reason: Create a document containing only the required items for investigation, and limit it to the authorized support channels. Confirm the content and scope of sharing.

aib-c01-d3-098@1.title: Change the risk handling for each operation even on a single screen
aib-c01-d3-098@1.prompt: The internal order AI includes features such as displaying candidates, creating drafts accessible only to the responsible person, and sending confirmed orders to customers. Incorrect confirmed orders incur cancellation fees. Which category is appropriate?

A.text: Since it is used by the order department, candidate display and confirmed orders are handled together without keeping separate records.
A.explanation: No appropriate control and verification can be implemented for the operation.

B.text: Assign the shortest processing tasks to low risk, and more time-consuming tasks to high risk.
B.explanation: It is impossible to measure the impact of errors in execution time.

C.text: Evaluate candidates, drafts, and final submissions by operation type, and require stronger approval and documentation for operations that place orders externally.
C.explanation: Even a single function can be adjusted according to the business impact of each processing task.

D.text: All of them can be used in the same input field, so all are grouped under a "only candidate display" category.
D.explanation: It does not include the impact of sending definite orders externally.

learning.concept: Even for the same user actions, when the effects of verification and execution differ, they are classified and controlled separately
learning.reason: Based on the results, categorize them by impact and recovery potential, and establish strong approval and tracking mechanisms for final delivery.

aib-c01-d3-099@1.title: Verify that the user selection remains functional after the configuration change
aib-c01-d3-099@1.prompt: Requests from those who choose not to use AI are assigned to a human agent. Even after the settings are changed, selections appear on the screen, but some requests chosen not to be used proceed to automated processing. What is one of the measures for continuous operation?

A.text: The higher the proportion of automated processing, the better the quality; the use of human pathways is excluded from measurement targets.
A.explanation: Unable to evaluate the selection of users who should be protected.

B.text: Compare selected information with the processing path to notify any discrepancies, and check before and after setting changes.
B.explanation: Confirm that the selection is reflected in the workflow.

C.text: Only monitor the display status of the screen; do not investigate which actual path was taken.
C.explanation: Even if the display is correct, the selection may not be reflected.

D.text: If the results are delivered to each user, it is not confirmed whether they were conducted via the desired route.
D.explanation: Confusing the arrival of results with the fulfillment of choices.

learning.concept: In operational monitoring, include continuous verification of processes that fulfill the promised deliverables.
learning.reason: Detecting discrepancies between user selection and actual processing paths. Test representative cases via configuration changes, and establish procedures to stop incorrect paths.

aib-c01-d3-100@1.title: The completion of some queries does not determine the overall result.
aib-c01-d3-100@1.prompt: The AI that checks whether products can be shipped checks both inventory and quality approvals. If one is timed out, it answers that shipping is possible only with the other. The results of each check and its completion status can be retrieved. What is a way to improve operational reliability?

A.text: Complete the expired query with the previous response, and do not check the target product or update time.
A.explanation: It may use results from other products or previous states.

B.text: Shorten the judgment statement, and do not record the end status of each query.
B.explanation: It is impossible to distinguish between the decision when the required results are obtained and the behavior in case of failure.

C.text: Confirm that it is the same product as both parties' success, then make a decision. Test the hold and handover in case one party does not return it.
C.explanation: The mistake of determining shipment readiness when the required results are insufficient can be avoided.

D.text: Just determine based on the first normal response; do not check whether the other query is finished.
D.explanation: It is determined by only some of the mandatory conditions for shipment.

learning.concept: If all inputs required for parallel acquisition are necessary, specify the completion criteria and safely retain any missing results without attempting to infer them.
learning.reason: It is determined only when both checks succeed and the results for the same product are available. Failed attempts and timeouts are intentionally tested, and any missing results are sent to the responsible person for confirmation.

aib-c01-d4-081@1.title: Update the "ready" determination when the assumptions change
aib-c01-d4-081@1.prompt: The job consultation AI passed the quality and on-site training tests. Subsequently, the desk that supported the trial operations ended its business hours on holidays, leaving no alternative for customers who can only use it on holidays. How should the pre-publication preparatory review be updated?

A.text: Since there are no holiday customer numbers yet, I will evaluate the entire group without targeting those customers and existing support.
A.explanation: Unable to determine the preparation for conditions where impact is directly present.

B.text: Due to its high quality, after the change of the agent, automated responses are forced only for customers who encounter issues.
B.explanation: The current quality and the alternatives required under various conditions are different.

C.text: Since I passed the previous review, even if the support premise changes, I will remain ready as prepared.
C.explanation: I have not verified the current operational capacity.

D.text: Confirm the requirements for users on holidays and prepare appropriate alternatives. Re-evaluate feasibility under changed support conditions.
D.explanation: By leveraging the obtained technical evidence, we can verify the unusual assumptions of the operation.
