learning.concept: Maintaining the passing of the technical evaluation, and re-evaluating the external support and data changes required for actual delivery
learning.reason: Re-evaluate the assumptions under which the implementation is supported, and determine the scope where affected users, contracts, and holiday alternatives are necessary. Verify whether it is possible to handle it using the revised procedures.

aib-c01-d4-082@1.title: Not considering the purchase of AI utilization slots as the establishment of the experiment
aib-c01-d4-082@1.prompt: The department purchased the usage quota for AI services and listed several improvement ideas. However, no representative projects or success criteria were established, and no results have been tested in actual operations. Which is maturity and the next action?

A.text: As a step toward materializing the concept, define the target business, and set conditions for success and termination to conduct a small experiment.
A.explanation: Organize the conditions for proceeding with actual testing, and use the acquired resources.

B.text: Since the resources have been purchased across the entire company, it is now at a stage where all departments can operate with the same capabilities.
B.explanation: No verification has been done on the actual responsibilities, procedures, and outcomes.

C.text: For full operation, no assumptions will be made for the business until the usage quota increases.
C.explanation: Misunderstanding environmental procurement as actual operation.

D.text: Since payment has started, the experiment is considered successful, and the department to continue will be determined by the number of users.
D.explanation: Purchase is not the result of hypothesis validation.

learning.concept: Separate the maturation of the concept from the start of real measurements, and move to the next stage with specific targets and evaluation criteria for experiments
learning.reason: Only a prepared environment will not yield experimental results. As a conceptual stage, determine one use case, hypothesis, measurement, and scope before starting the experiment.

aib-c01-d4-083@1.title: Investigate why even if the field staff makes corrections, the organization cannot improve
aib-c01-d4-083@1.prompt: There is version management and AI monitoring; the field staff can correct errors manually. However, the corrected content and reasons do not reach the evaluation environment, leading to the same error being repeated during model updates. Which capability should be enhanced?

A.text: Prohibit field staff from making corrections and only provide the correctly returned results to the evaluation.
A.explanation: Lose the means of addressing issues and the evidence needed for improvement.

B.text: Exchange for a new model, and consider whether to receive the correction reasons after that.
B.explanation: A structure remains that prevents the cause of recurrence from being reflected in the next evaluation.

C.text: Share the correction reasons as examples, involve the person responsible for incorporating valid cases into evaluations, and establish verification procedures for the next version.
C.explanation: Link the field staff’s corrections to prevention of recurrence.

D.text: Assume there is no capability deficiency since the field staff can correct, and report version quality only based on the company average.
D.explanation: Information about repeated failures is not used for improvement.

learning.concept: Distinguish between things that can be operated by humans and the ability to transform correction reasons into reusable evaluations
learning.reason: Record the content and reasons, create a process of selecting valid examples for testing and improvement, return the results after changes to the field staff as well.

aib-c01-d4-084@1.title: Invest first in the ability to support the company’s goals multiple times
aib-c01-d4-084@1.prompt: The organization aims to present results and rationale for audits in both current document AI and business AI for the next year. One option involves developing a dedicated screen, while another proposes recording common evidence and training for on-site evaluations. The dedicated screen is intended for a single task only. Which investment order is suitable for the objectives?

A.text: Create a dedicated screen first, and record the necessary evidence for other purposes separately.
A.explanation: The necessary capabilities are not linked to the current state.

B.text: Will not address the lack of current evidence until the next year's operations begin.
B.explanation: We will miss the opportunity to demonstrate the skills needed for current work.

C.text: Refine the current operations with common evidence records and on-site assessments, and add the necessary screens and operations for specific uses based on those evidence.
C.explanation: It can fill current shortages while having the ability to be reused for multiple purposes.

D.text: Only the model speed is improved, and the verification of evidence is done at the user's discretion.
D.explanation: No common capabilities for auditing are in place.

learning.concept: Choose the capabilities that are needed repeatedly even if their future uses differ, and deploy them according to individual maturity levels
learning.reason: First, develop the necessary traceability and evaluation capabilities for multiple uses. Verify functionality in current operations, and implement individual screens according to their required purposes.

aib-c01-d4-085@1.title: Even with accurate data, check if it can be used on time.
aib-c01-d4-085@1.prompt: The AI that notifies employees of their request status aims to achieve improvements within one day of the application. The personnel records are accurate and comply with authority, but they are provided in a summary at the end of the month. What is a method for determining the readiness for the trial?

A.text: The quantity and accuracy are consistent, so preparation is complete. The notification sent next month can also be considered as improved.
A.explanation: There is a lack of timeliness required for the initial response.

B.text: Only check the viewing rights due to deployment; the time when the data arrives is not considered before the infrastructure is implemented.
B.explanation: Even with permissions, the information may not arrive when needed.

C.text: Check the delay from the application date to when it can be used, and consider approved information that is valid by the deadline or changes in use.
C.explanation: Among data quality, the time at which it can be obtained is evaluated to meet actual needs.

D.text: Assign the end-of-month values equally to each day, and use them as known values on that day for learning and evaluation.
D.explanation: Use the values that couldn’t be obtained on that day.

learning.concept: Evaluate based on the available amount of history data, accuracy, and freshness available when applicable
learning.reason: Measure the actual usability against the required action deadline. Consider whether there are early approved information or other uses.

aib-c01-d4-086@1.title: Determine the scope of shared use in departments where data cannot be transferred
aib-c01-d4-086@1.prompt: The three departments want to collectively aggregate the business impact of AI. The original details are managed by each department, and under the permission conditions, they cannot be moved outside the department. On the other hand, the aggregated results based on the determined classification unit can be shared. Which is the appropriate data strategy?

A.text: To unify the aggregation mechanism, move all details from each department to a common storage location.
A.explanation: This contradicts the condition that cannot send the original details outside the department.

B.text: Keep the original details with each department, and agree on definitions and disclosure units. Share only the summaries that the owner has verified for quality.
B.explanation: While maintaining departmental management, they can be jointly used under the same standards.

C.text: I can’t transfer the reports, so I’ve given up on any comparison between departments, including approved summaries.
C.explanation: It may be possible to compare departments within the permitted range.

D.text: Each department calculates and shares the data over different periods and targets, and the AI estimates the difference at the total.
D.explanation: The necessary definitions and evidence for the joint result are not available.

learning.concept: No physical concentration is required for sharing, and verified aggregated data can be shared within the scope that each owner can manage.
learning.reason: Each owner manages the details and provides only the required results in the defined units and definitions approved by them. Quality, disclosure scope, and update responsibilities are established as shared rules.

aib-c01-d4-087@1.title: Check the conditions for being able to resume operations on another platform
aib-c01-d4-087@1.prompt: Determine the foundation for internal AI. At the end of the contract, we want to transfer configured and approved search data to the new foundation to maintain the reviewed quality. One candidate explains that it can be transferred, but no business connectivity has been tested after the transfer. What is the best way to verify this?

A.text: Just because a write-start file has been generated, it is determined that everything works on another platform as well.
A.explanation: No compatibility, connections, or quality have been verified yet.

B.text: Let the vendor retain all work records, and only discuss which items to retrieve when they are needed.
B.explanation: This approach does not verify in advance which materials will be available or how much time is needed at contract termination.

C.text: From representation setup and integration, to reconnection to operations and quality verification, record the required time and any deficiencies.
C.explanation: Not only can it determine whether the operation is possible, but it can also check the conditions under which work continues at the new location.

D.text: If the processing speed in the first year is the fastest, the conditions after contract termination will not be evaluated.
D.explanation: It is not possible to determine whether the specified future business continuity conditions will be met.

learning.concept: In addition to a list of proposed features, verify the migration of deliverables, required connections, and evaluation under the same criteria in practice
learning.reason: Set up representatives and transfer authorized data, make it readable format, connect to existing operations, and verify quality on a separate platform.

aib-c01-d4-088@1.title: Management will clarify the areas where on-site champions can make improvements
aib-c01-d4-088@1.prompt: The AI promotion officers at each branch must wait for the same overall company review, whether it involves converting approved scripts into local vocabulary or changing customer data handling. Business sponsors want to accelerate improvements on the ground while maintaining safety. How should permissions be established?

A.text: The regionalization of approved exercises is delegated to the coordination role under standards and records, and the handling of customer data is elevated to specified reviews.
A.explanation: While promoting low-impact improvements, critical management decisions remain with the relevant parties.

B.text: The branch improvements are not evaluated, and all text is edited one by one by the business sponsor.
B.explanation: Decisions are also focused on low-impact improvements that can be implemented by the on-site champions.

C.text: Minor changes should be made on an informal sharing platform, and no changes should be recorded.
C.explanation: The scope and outcomes are not confirmed by the organization, making it difficult to distinguish from unapproved changes.

D.text: To make it available to all regions, the authority to modify training documents and customer data is granted to branches collectively.
D.explanation: Even for significant changes, the same permissions are given as for low-impact exercises.

learning.concept: Daily minor improvements are assigned to the field with defined scope, while decisions to change control are made by management and relevant departments.
learning.reason: Approve changes that maintain the evaluation criteria with minimal impact. Changes that affect data or external parties should be sent to the existing review process, and records and reports must be maintained.

aib-c01-d4-089@1.title: Add a team responsible for understanding changes in people's work to the implementation team
aib-c01-d4-089@1.prompt: Introduce AI into insurance operations. The role of model creation has been assigned, but there is no person to handle the role of consultant, training, and reflecting user complaints into design. What is the composition of the cross-functional team?

A.text: Incorporate operations, consultants/development, technology, legal affairs, and quality into the process, and determine who will carry out role changes, training, and user verification.
A.explanation: It can assign individual responsibilities for technology, the field, and the impact on users.

B.text: A wide range of departments are invited to the meeting, but testing and approvals are consolidated under a common lead without a title.
B.explanation: When the issue is found, it’s unclear who makes the decision and takes action.

C.text: Leave everything to the development team; training and complaint handling will be decided after quality is met.
C.explanation: Jobs and users directly affected are not reflected in the design.

D.text: The impact of users and consultants is evaluated by the provider, and the internal team is only responsible for determining the implementation date.
D.explanation: Unable to design a system for remaining operations and responsibilities within the company.

learning.concept: Design, user impact, quality, and legal responsibilities are handled by different teams.
learning.reason: Add business owner, consultant/development manager, technology, quality, and legal departments, and assign each to the redesign of work and evidence of acceptance.

aib-c01-d4-090@1.title: Communication About Work Changes and How Field Feedback Is Reviewed by Decision-Makers
aib-c01-d4-090@1.prompt: The employee received a notice about AI implementation stating that 'productivity will increase,' but starting next month, they don’t know which tasks to handle or where to report incorrect outputs. Which notification should be changed?

A.text: Start the implementation first, and only after a certain number of questions arise, inform them about the most impactful tasks.
A.explanation: They cannot prepare at the time of task change.

B.text: Indicate the change date, role-specific tasks and responsibilities, contact information for errors, and the timing of decisions that reflect feedback.
B.explanation: They can act during the change and continue to report issues and concerns.

C.text: Announce that all employees will use the same method, and non-targeted tasks will be decided through individual consultation.
C.explanation: The actual role and exception procedures are not clear.

D.text: List only the AI brand and the expected productivity, and do not notify on the day of role change.
D.explanation: They cannot understand the details of daily work changes.

learning.concept: Provide specific roles and procedures during transition to allow employees to participate in consultation and correction
learning.reason: Indicate the changing tasks, ongoing responsibilities, expected start date, exception responsible person, and procedures for providing improvement suggestions. Unresolved matters are indicated by the next decision date.

aib-c01-d4-091@1.title: Addressing Concerns About Approved Use Areas Through Managerial Practices
aib-c01-d4-091@1.prompt: Some departments understand how AI is used, but managers only say 'avoid mistakes,' leaving no clarity on what is permitted. Many employees refuse to explore potential improvements. What is the appropriate first step?

A.text: Do not explain approved use cases until a certain number of improvement suggestions are submitted.
A.explanation: Ask people to try things without knowing what is allowed.

B.text: Explain that all uses not prohibited are at their own risk, and managers will not handle exceptions.
B.explanation: There is a lack of mechanisms to support responsible experimentation within the organization.

C.text: Set a minimum usage target and let confused employees use the same methods as other departments.
C.explanation: It does not address the uncertainty of approvals and departmental conditions.

D.text: Share examples approved by managers and on-site, establish limited trials and a consultation channel, and actually support those decisions.
D.explanation: It addresses the ambiguity of the system and concerns about failure in a concrete way.

learning.concept: Not only instructing users to read rules, but also making the easy tasks and those that require consultation concrete on-site
learning.reason: Actually show examples where managers approved and where consultation is needed. Allow limited testing and support decision-making for confused employees.

aib-c01-d4-092@1.title: The priority of training is determined based on actual judgment errors.
aib-c01-d4-092@1.prompt: In the audit, although many staff members can generate AI text, they were unable to distinguish approved reference information from outdated reference information, resulting in incorrect directions. Training time is limited. What is the most effective way to develop staff?

A.text: The staff will shift the training to topics of greatest interest, and the decisions on revision and suspension will be based solely on self-evaluation.
A.explanation: Cannot verify if the necessary tasks can be performed correctly.

B.text: Select reference versions, compare against criteria, and use pending cases to verify whether the responsible person can make correct decisions.
B.explanation: Limited time is allocated to impactful operational capabilities.

C.text: There are many inquiries about new features, so the verification of old processes with issues is excluded from training scope.
C.explanation: It does not complement the ability to reduce incorrect directions sent.

D.text: A course focused solely on learned text generation is conducted again to evaluate whether one can write long texts.
D.explanation: Does not address the most critical weakness.

learning.concept: Rather than focusing on interest, learning is designed based on the locations and impacts of errors repeated in roles.
learning.reason: Identify tasks with many errors, compare versions and rationale, and repeat the process of holding off on unverified items using practical examples. Measure whether it can be implemented.

aib-c01-d4-093@1.title: Redirect the time spent on automated input tasks toward maintaining the quality of operations
aib-c01-d4-093@1.prompt: The entry of product codes is accurately assisted by AI. When a new product is added, the staff member notices that similar codes exist for other products and can align the product department’s regulations. Which option is the most appropriate for redefining the role?

A.text: AI assists with entry, and the staff member is responsible for unusual checks and improving registration standards with the product department, as well as confirming quality after changes.
A.explanation: Utilize the time saved through efficiency for human judgment and continuous quality improvement.

B.text: It is assumed that since entry is automated, there is no need for humans to judge product codes anymore.
B.explanation: The ambiguity between new products and existing data has not been resolved.

C.text: AI automatically updates regulations related to new products without verifying their correctness, and the staff member only continues with entry.
C.explanation: Leave changes that require organizational judgment to be automated, while retaining routine tasks.

D.text: The staff member’s work is evaluated based on the number of times they open the screen, and any improvements made to exceptions are not recorded.
D.explanation: It is impossible to evaluate the value of work changes in terms of operations.

learning.concept: Reduce routine entries with AI and assign people to addressing exceptions and maintaining standards/assessment
learning.reason: Assign the staff member to investigating exceptions and updating standards and evaluations, while leaving AI to handle verified routine processes. Continuously monitor changes and quality.

aib-c01-d4-094@1.title: When conditions change between trials and production, re-evaluate
aib-c01-d4-094@1.prompt: In the AI documentation experiment, all documents were pre-classified by the responsible person. In production, both classified and unclassified documents are accepted. The person in charge wants to use the results of the experiment to move to the next stage. What is the appropriate approach?

A.text: Since the experiment was successful, assume the quality of unclassified documents is the same and publish them all.
A.explanation: There is an extrapolation to conditions not measured in the experiment.

B.text: Remove all records of processing unclassified documents from the experiment and maintain the success rate for the next report.
B.explanation: The necessary conditions are excluded from evaluation.

C.text: If the experimental results cannot be used, return to the original plan without measuring both classified and unclassified documents.
C.explanation: It is impossible to proceed with work by separating confirmed results from unverified conditions.

D.text: Record the original success conditions and verify both successes and failures handling for the experiment with additional unclassified documents.
D.explanation: The conditions that increase in production can be incorporated into the learning before publication.

learning.concept: Understand the conditions of the obtained evidence and explicitly state different assumptions for the next experiment
learning.reason: Preserve the results of classified conditions within an effective range, and measure the quality, time, and verification process of unclassified documents in the next small-scale experiment. Decide on publication based on the range that meets the conditions.

aib-c01-d4-095@1.title: Link short-term results to the next stage of the same task
aib-c01-d4-095@1.prompt: The AI for organizing application documents reduced the classification time at the reception. For the same applications, another department will then verify the deficiencies and respond to the customers. It is not confirmed whether the downstream processes can understand the new delivery details. How should the expansion proceed?

A.text: Since a time-saving solution was introduced, it is assumed that the same ratio can be automated in subsequent steps as well, and all are switched simultaneously.
A.explanation: The required delivery and post-process results have not been verified.

B.text: Since the post-processing is done by a different department, we do not share any methods or results with the reception team and create separate products independently.
B.explanation: Increasing duplicates without using proven delivery or measurement methods.

C.text: Measure only the number of AI users across all processes, and do not use customer responses for expansion decisions.
C.explanation: The increase in numbers cannot demonstrate the effect on the entire application.

D.text: Connect the confirmed categories to smaller targets in the subsequent stage, verify understanding and exceptions, and compare the completion of the entire application.
D.explanation: We can verify the conditions under which short-term results can be utilized in the overall process.

learning.concept: Identify the factors contributing to the initial success, and investigate conditions under downstream processing where value remains, to expand the scope.
learning.reason: Leverage confirmed results from reception to test new delivery with downstream teams. Measure the results and workload until completion, and expand from processes where effectiveness has been confirmed.

aib-c01-d4-096@1.title: Professional organizations do not handle everything; they develop on-site execution capabilities
aib-c01-d4-096@1.prompt: The company-wide AI professional organization sets standards but handles all new quality tests. As a result, new projects are delayed, and departments cannot conduct the tests themselves. How should the professional organization be managed?

A.text: All tests are handled centrally, with only completion results provided to other departments.
A.explanation: Dependence continues, and additional experts may be needed when expanding.

B.text: The central team provides standards and guidance, and the departments carry out the initial tests together; departments become self-sufficient within their capacity, while the central team supports challenging projects.
B.explanation: Execution capabilities are distributed while maintaining common quality standards.

C.text: Only departments with long test wait times can publish results without evaluation.
C.explanation: Quality conditions are not maintained.

D.text: Leave everything to the departments; common evaluation criteria and expert consultation are removed.
D.explanation: While promoting independence, it is not possible to share quality and overall organizational learning.

learning.concept: When work concentrates on a few central experts, expanding capabilities to the field through collaborative practice
learning.reason: Use recognized methods and examples to develop departmental responsibility, with the first round conducted jointly. The central team focuses on consulting for challenging projects and maintaining standards.

aib-c01-d4-097@1.title: When the purpose of the operation can no longer be maintained, other evaluations besides continuation are considered
aib-c01-d4-097@1.prompt: Although the number of AI uses is high, the completion time for tasks has worsened for three consecutive months, and staff report increased verification tasks. It was suggested to continue using the AI due to the high usage rate. What is the appropriate operational decision?

A.text: Do not record changes in objectives, but select the metric that yields the best results each month.
A.explanation: It becomes impossible to determine if improvements continue.

B.text: Separate the number of uses from outcomes, and remeasure effectiveness in processes with increased verification. Also determine how to reduce the scope that does not meet the criteria.
B.explanation: Ensure long-term value based on performance.

C.text: If usage is high, even if performance is poor for months, it will be reported as continued success.
C.explanation: Doesn’t reflect the value of actual work in metrics.

D.text: Exclude on-site feedback from the aggregation, and only improve if the model rank drops.
D.explanation: Do not investigate the specific reasons for the increased verification work.

learning.concept: Based on long-term results and the changes shown in the field, it allows for the choice of reducing scope or eliminating them.
learning.reason: Analyze the increased work through regular results and on-site reports. Set improvement conditions by use case, and evaluate stops or simplification in areas where no recovery basis exists.

aib-c01-d4-098@1.title: Including manual updates in real operations as part of responsibility
aib-c01-d4-098@1.prompt: The AI prototype passed the product list every day. During testing, developers manually replaced it with the latest version, but in real operations, it operates on holidays and old lists are prohibited. Choose two conditions for accepting official operation.

A.text: Fix the manually placed list for testing into real operations and only replace it when users point out errors.
A.explanation: The prohibited guidance continues even after the list becomes outdated.

B.text: Determine the process and responsibility for updating the officially approved version and test whether it arrives at the required time during holidays.
B.explanation: Make the implicitly performed updates from testing into a sustainable operation.

C.text: Confirm that suspension and notification to the responsible party occur when the version is unknown or the update has passed its deadline.
C.explanation: This demonstrates that the system will withhold outdated information even when an update fails.

D.text: Change the display update date daily without checking whether the list content is updated simultaneously.
D.explanation: Cannot prevent guidance based on old materials.

E.text: Have the AI guess the new product-list values and leave update delays out of the existing tests.
E.explanation: Cannot obtain the current official value.

learning.concept: Not only evaluation results, but also a method to maintain the assumption of manual updates and define the behavior in case of failure
learning.reason: Define the approved update process, the person responsible, and the update objective. Test whether the system can suspend responses if it cannot obtain the latest product list, including on holidays.

aib-c01-d4-099@1.title: Evaluate both the verification burden of increased users across the entire company and the infrastructure capacity simultaneously
aib-c01-d4-099@1.prompt: The AI document assistance used across the company satisfied the inference capability of one department during testing. When multiple departments use it simultaneously, exceptions requiring quality verification are also sent to a common reception point in another department. Select three measures that should be taken to ensure existing operations are not interrupted after deployment.

A.text: Delete the record of the busiest day after scaling up, and use only the average wait time for regular days.
A.explanation: Unable to evaluate the usage conditions that may cause issues.

B.text: Try using multiple deployments simultaneously and measure both the inference and confirmation wait times.
B.explanation: You can understand constraints that are not visible when measured as separate departments.

C.text: Confirm the priority of the contact point based on importance and deadline, as well as the responsible person and any necessary spare capacity.
C.explanation: The conditions of important existing operations can still be verified after expansion.

D.text: Practice the conditions for terminating the next department if the deadline is not met, and the switch to existing routes.
D.explanation: It is easier to prevent the impact from spreading to existing operations even when capabilities are exceeded.

E.text: If all inferences are successful, there is no need to worry about the remaining capacity of the verification team or the waiting time for existing requests.
E.explanation: Even if AI is running, there may be delays in human tasks.

learning.concept: In addition to the individual response speed, test the operational conditions where exceptions occur simultaneously across multiple departments
learning.reason: Verify the maximum load of simultaneous inference and manual verification, and prepare priority conditions and responsibilities for essential tasks, as well as phase stop or alternatives in case they are not met.

aib-c01-d4-100@1.title: The management should also develop the skills to approve and stop AI.
aib-c01-d4-100@1.prompt: AI technical training is widely taken. At a management meeting, they increased the budget based solely on the number of inference uses, without realizing that the quality standards were not met. What should be prioritized as education for executives?

A.text: Conduct a approval exercise to compare active usage and business value, quality standards and evidence, and confirm the reasons for investment or suspension decisions.
A.explanation: It allows practicing the decisions that roles actually make.

B.text: All executives are only given practice in optimizing long input processes, while investment decisions remain the same as before.
B.explanation: It fails to complement the skills related to manager judgment errors.

C.text: Since a specialized operation team can make the judgment, the management does not need to understand quality and risk.
C.explanation: The responsibility for deciding to invest, expand, or stop remains.

D.text: Share the top department with high usage as a success case, and keep quality requirements limited to on-site training.
D.explanation: The information needed for the meeting cannot be used for decision-making.

learning.concept: In career-specific education, provide managers with practice in reading evidence of outcomes and risks to make decisions.
learning.reason: In cases close to actual approval, read the minimum requirements for business outcomes, quality, lack of evidence, and termination criteria, and be able to explain the reasons.

ai-business-strategist-practice-01@2.title: Priority of Use Case
ai-business-strategist-practice-01@2.prompt: The customer support and billing team proposed two generative AI pilots. One has significant impact but unorganized data contracts, while the other is smaller but ready. How should it be evaluated to allow the management meeting to make a decision?

A.text: Choose based solely on the expected reduction amount for the first year
A.explanation: Ignores whether data usage is possible, implementation costs, and the magnitude of impact.

B.text: Compare business value, data preparation status, implementation difficulty, and risks
B.explanation: Can consider both expected impact and feasibility.

C.text: Choose cases where the largest model can always be used
C.explanation: Model size does not indicate business value or implementation feasibility.

D.text: Choose cases with the most stakeholders
D.explanation: Number of users alone does not reveal the outcomes or risks of the use case.

learning.reason: Can consider both expected impact and feasibility.
learning.concept: Start with challenges that can be tested small and where success or failure can be measured.

ai-business-strategist-practice-02@2.title: Measurement of Business Outcomes
ai-business-strategist-practice-02@2.prompt: The contact center wants to reduce call duration with AI support. It must not increase re-requests due to incorrect guidance. What should be prepared before the pilot starts?

A.text: Record only the number of model parameters
A.explanation: The size of the model is not a baseline for business outcomes.

B.text: Set the goal solely on the activation rate of the new tool
B.explanation: Admission rate can be measured, but there is no standard for comparing business impact and quality.

C.text: Set the baseline and goals based on current response time, resolution quality, etc.
C.explanation: It is possible to compare before and after implementation using common metrics.

D.text: Collect only comments that were positive after the release
D.explanation: There is a selection bias, and it is not possible to compare with before implementation.

learning.reason: It is possible to compare before and after implementation using common metrics.
learning.concept: Not only efficiency, but also quality indicators such as incorrect guidance and re-requests should be included.

ai-business-strategist-practice-03@2.title: Final Judgment by Person
ai-business-strategist-practice-03@2.prompt: Generate a draft notification using AI that affects the customer's rights. It is difficult to correct if a notification referencing an incorrect policy is sent. Which is appropriate as a control before sending?

A.text: The responsible person checks the rationale and text and approves before sending
A.explanation: Leave human judgment for outputs that could lead to serious consequences.

B.text: Automatically send the text without condition, assuming the model has high reliability
B.explanation: Fluency of language does not guarantee correctness.

C.text: Address the risk of automated sending by simply taking audit logs
C.explanation: Post-event verification is possible, but it does not prevent incorrect sending itself.

D.text: After automated sending, a person conducts a consolidated audit the next day
D.explanation: Evaluation is possible, but irreversible sending cannot be stopped in advance.

learning.reason: Leave human judgment for outputs that could lead to serious consequences.
learning.concept: Clarify the reviewer responsible, approval criteria, and rollback procedure based on the impact.

ai-business-strategist-practice-04@2.title: Organization of Usage Data
ai-business-strategist-practice-04@2.prompt: In the internal search pilot, documents, personal information, and public materials that are not allowed for contractual purposes are mixed together. For development, having only public materials and approved internal documents is sufficient. What should be done first?

A.text: Shorten the prompt to manage confidentiality
A.explanation: The input length does not guarantee whether data can be used or how it should be handled.

B.text: Enter all documents in bulk and then verify the restrictions
B.explanation: It is possible to use content that is not permitted.

C.text: Display warnings in search results and index all materials
C.explanation: There is a possibility that the contract usage restrictions will be exceeded during indexing or transmission.

D.text: Classify data and limit it to the range that is necessary for the purpose and allowed for use
D.explanation: It is possible to compare the purpose with the confidentiality and usage conditions of the data.

learning.reason: It is possible to compare the purpose with the confidentiality and usage conditions of the data.
learning.concept: Determine the purpose of use, access range, retention period, and whether transmission to third parties is allowed from the start of verification.

ai-business-strategist-practice-05@2.title: Implementation Cost and Benefits
ai-business-strategist-practice-05@2.prompt: In the summary pilot measurements, the drafting time per item decreased, but operation requires human corrections and quality audits. The department will decide on investment for the next period. What should be compared?

A.text: Compare the value of reduced time with the total cost of inference, operation, and reviews
A.explanation: Business benefits and ongoing costs can be viewed using the same evaluation unit.

B.text: Compare only the initial development effort during testing
B.explanation: Does not account for costs and benefits incurred from continuous use.

C.text: Consider only the reduction in generation time, excluding the time spent on corrections by humans
C.explanation: Overvalues the benefits achieved across the entire process.

D.text: Decide solely based on the lowest token price of models
D.explanation: Output adjustments, quality differences, and operation costs are not included in the evaluation.

learning.reason: Business benefits and ongoing costs can be viewed using the same evaluation unit.
learning.concept: Explicitly state the assumptions regarding the number of items, retries, and review rate, and also estimate costs when these increase.

ai-business-strategist-practice-06@2.title: Judgment After Pilot
ai-business-strategist-practice-06@2.prompt: Although the processing time target was achieved during the trial implementation at some counters, a significant misdirection exceeded the limit. The business owner needs to determine whether it is safe to expand the scope. What should be done next?

A.text: Expand to the entire system as long as the average satisfaction of the inquiry remains stable
A.explanation: The average value replaces the criterion for significant errors.

B.text: Analyze the cause of the significant error and limit the scope until it falls within acceptable limits before re-evaluating
B.explanation: Both efficiency and quality can be reflected in the expansion decision.

C.text: Expand to all operations based solely on the time target
C.explanation: The scope expands while a significant failure remains.

D.text: Use the number of users as a new success metric
D.explanation: Quality issues cannot be identified or reduced.

learning.reason: Both efficiency and quality can be reflected in the expansion decision.
learning.concept: Determine success and stop conditions before expansion, ensuring that failures in critical cases are not overlooked by the overall average.

ai-business-strategist-practice-07@1.title: Causes and Sustainability of Implementation Results
ai-business-strategist-practice-07@1.prompt: The processing time for departments that implemented agent support was reduced by 15%. During the same period, price adjustments increased the number of simple inquiries, and quality audit results have not yet been released. Which evaluation is necessary for the next investment decision?

A.text: Create a comparison group with similar inquiry types and load, and measure both the re-inquiry rate and processing time
A.explanation: Separate the apparent improvement due to structural changes, and also detect quality degradation.

B.text: Calculate the investment by multiplying the reduction rate across all companies
B.explanation: Does not separate the effectiveness of implementation from changes in inquiry composition.

C.text: Compare before and after only with the staff member with the best performance
C.explanation: Selection bias and changes in inquiry composition remain.

D.text: Treat the number of support tool uses as a KPI for results
D.explanation: The implementation status is known, but it does not directly relate to business results.

learning.reason: Separate the apparent improvement due to structural changes, and also detect quality degradation.
learning.concept: In pilots, business KPIs are predefined in advance, and controls for comparison and quality are included.

ai-business-strategist-practice-08@1.title: Deployment Order Based on Risk Level
ai-business-strategist-practice-08@1.prompt: There are two potential options: using the same foundation model for internal meeting summaries and for advising on customer loan approvals. The management team wants to see results quickly, but they do not approve pre-validation automation with high-impact decisions.

A.text: Since the model is the same, a single approval process is applied to both tasks for simultaneous deployment
A.explanation: It is impossible to handle differences in impact based on usage context.

B.text: Automate for high-impact loans first, then assess quality
B.explanation: This would be pre-validation automation for high-risk activities, which is not allowed.

C.text: Determine loan eligibility based solely on meeting costs
C.explanation: Different outcomes and risks are substituted with a single judgment.

D.text: Classify use cases by impact, start with low-risk tasks, and design high-risk uses with verification and human approval first
D.explanation: It balances phased value realization with risk-based control.

learning.reason: It balances phased value realization with risk-based control.

ai-business-strategist-practice-09@1.title: Identify the reasons for low adoption rate
ai-business-strategist-practice-09@1.prompt: The support AI meets quality standards, but field utilization is low. Users report more copies to a separate tab and unclear exception handling procedures. What should be prioritized?

C.explanation: Even with reduced safety, operational issues are not resolved.

D.explanation: While usage increases, additional load and exception handling remain.

learning.reason: Reduce the operational challenges and unclear points, allowing the effectiveness of the implementation to be verified.

ai-business-strategist-practice-10@1.title: Ensure the data requirements for the AI contractor are met
ai-business-strategist-practice-10@1.prompt: The sales department compares multiple AI vendors. To utilize customer inputs, the deletion deadline and secondary use for retraining are managed through a contract, and audit trails must be obtained in preparation for switching.
